The Sudanese student, studying at a private university in Hyderabad, and his contact were shifted to Gandhi Hospital by Apollo Hospital doctors from Nanakramguda. Both are in stable condition and under monitoring by health authorities; no laboratory confirmation of yellow fever is reported. The incident centers on missing vaccination documentation rather than a confirmed case, with authorities tracking the travelers and ensuring appropriate follow-up at Gandhi Hospital. The report provides no details on symptoms, infection source, or any exported/imported case status beyond the vaccination documentation issue.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病予防接種記録なしで到着した2人がガンジー病院に送られる
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の確認症例がなく、予防接種記録の不備に対する行政対応にすぎない。IHR基準またはWPRO基準に該当せず、社会的・政治的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は確認された黄熱病症例を報告していない。2名は予防接種記録の欠落のみで入院しており、症状や検査結果の確認はない。スーダン人学生と接触者の処置は日常的な渡航衛生対応であり、感染症アウトブレイク兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos confirmados de ébola en RDC aumentan a 381, con 63 muertes, dice ministro de Salud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC rise to 381, with 63 deaths, says Health Minister.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 381 confirmed cases and 63 deaths as of June 4, 2026, per Health Minister Roger Kamba in Kinshasa. About 233 patients are hospitalized across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, either in isolation awaiting test results or under treatment. Diagnostic capacity has improved with over 4,000 Africa CDC test kits and international support, delivering results within 24 hours. Contact tracing has increased from 9% at the start to 55%, with a 90% target. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus underpins the outbreak, affecting Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The DRC declared the outbreak on May 15 and the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Uganda reports 16 confirmed cases, with one new today, signaling cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: DRC でのエボラ確定患者数が 381 例に増加、死亡者 63 例と保健大臣が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たし、WHO により国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として既に宣言されている。ウガンダへの越境伝播の兆候を含む。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダへの越境伝播確認（16確定患者、本日新規1例）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus血清型。診断能力向上、接触追跡向上中。公開情報源はスペイン語新華社通信。

article.articleHeadline: Roche Develops Ebola PCR Test In Six Days Amid Bundibugyo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Roche, via its TIB MOLBIOL unit, developed a rapid Research Use Only (RUO) PCR assay to detect the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, completing development within six days of the genome sequence publication. The assay targets Ebola Bundibugyo and is deployed on LightCycler and cobas platforms to enable laboratories to quickly establish testing capabilities for outbreak containment and surveillance. The World Health Organization declared the DRC-Uganda Bundibugyo outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. Roche notes that its library of 15,000 pre-designed tests and more than 3,000 positive controls allowed rapid evaluation of primer/probe combinations within hours, accelerating initial validation pending full diagnostic approvals. RUO assays are described as essential for early response, while official IVD/EUA processes can take months to years.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ型エボラアウトブレーク中にロシュがエボラPCR検査を6日間で開発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの現在進行中の大規模アウトブレーク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にDRC-Ugandaのブンディブギョ型エボラアウトブレークについて述べられている。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済み。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外（DRCのみverified_locations に含める）。診断キット開発という技術的側面が主題であるが、背景にある公衆衛生緊急事態が極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Antagonistic activity of Bacillus altitudinis VUMS1 against ice-ice-associated Vibrio spp. and its biotechnological potential in seaweed-associated systems - World Journal of Microbiology and Biotechnology
article.articleSummary: Bacillus altitudinis VUMS1 shows antagonistic activity against ice-ice-associated Vibrio spp., with the study highlighting its biotechnological potential for seaweed-associated systems. No datasets were generated or analysed in this study. Ice-ice disease affecting Kappaphycus alvarezii in seaweed farms has been reported in the Zamboanga Peninsula, Philippines, providing context for the pathogen challenge in seaweed cultivation. The findings imply that VUMS1 could suppress ice-ice–related vibrios, suggesting a possible biocontrol or probiotic role to protect seaweed crops. The work aligns with broader Bacillus-based biocontrol research and envisions microbial interventions to support seaweed cultivation, contributing to strategies for managing disease pressures in Kappaphycus-associated aquaculture. Published 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: Bacillus altitudinis VUMS1のアイスアイス関連Vibrio菌に対する拮抗活性と海草関連システムにおけるバイオテクノロジー的可能性 - World Journal of Microbiology and Biotechnology
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は海草養殖における病害対策のためのバイオコントロール技術に関する学術研究であり、ヒト感染症の発生・蔓延ではない。Vibriosis（ビブリオ症）はヒトに感染する海産物由来感染症だが、本記事は海草病害管理の文脈であり、ヒト公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はVibrio属菌とVibriosis（ビブリオ症）を言及しているが、記事の主題はフィリピンのザンボアンガ半島における海草（カッパフィカス・アルバレジ）のアイスアイス病（海草病害）に対するバイオコントロール技術研究である。ヒト感染症の発生報告ではなく、ヒト公衆衛生上の緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Đội mai táng bị tấn công tại vùng dịch Ebola ở Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Burial team attacked in Ebola outbreak region in Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, Congo's Ministry of Health reported residents attacked an Ebola burial team in South Kivu, forcing staff to abandon a coffin in Katana and leading to community burial of the body, heightening fears of wider transmission. The incident underscores eroding trust and resistance hindering outbreak response, as the WHO boosts support with essential supplies to hotspot areas this week. Congo has recorded more than 360 confirmed Ebola cases and at least 62 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, with over a dozen additional cases reported in neighboring Uganda. In Kenya, President William Ruto defended allowing the United States to establish a 50-bed Ebola isolation facility at a U.S. military base near Nanyuki, despite protests and a court order; at least two people died in demonstrations earlier this week. Flight data and officials say the facility remains under construction.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行地域で埋葬チームが攻撃される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで追加症例、米国での隔離施設建設）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがすべて認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴのエボラ流行に関するもの。発生地域にケニア、ウガンダ、米国も含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれず、かつ記事の主題はコンゴの流行状況であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダでの追加症例言及は地域文脈情報であり、流行の主舞台はコンゴである。埋葬チームへの攻撃、コミュニティによる遺体埋葬はエボラ感染拡大の重大なリスク要因となる。

article.articleHeadline: Risque Ebola: La gendarmerie de Mohéli sensibilise les villages côtiers | La Gazette Des Comores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Risk: The Mohéli Gendarmerie Raises Awareness Among Coastal Villages | La Gazette Des Comores
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk awareness campaign conducted by the Mohéli Gendarmerie Grouping in Djando region, including Itsamia and Hagnamoida, Comoros. In response to arrivals of migrants from the Great Lakes region, particularly the Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities emphasize Ebola vigilance though no cases have been reported on Mohéli. Campaign stresses adherence to health precautions to prevent potential disease introduction: avoid direct contact with migrants before health screening, limit handshakes, avoid caring for sick individuals or handling personal effects until sanitary checks are completed. Residents urged to report suspicious situations or unusual symptoms to local authorities or health services. Recent migrant waves landed at Hamavouna (southeast island) and Nioumachoi and have reportedly moved on toward Mayotte. The effort seeks prevention, community vigilance, and reassurance that health authorities are actively safeguarding public health on the island.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱リスク：モヘリ憲兵隊による沿岸村への啓発活動 | コモロ紙
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱という高リスク疾患のシグナルだが、記事サマリーでは「モヘリでは症例報告なし」と明記されており、現在のところ実際の発生ではなく予防啓発活動の段階。ただしコンゴからの移民流入リスクと国際的な懸念があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ熱は高リスク疾患だが、コモロ（対象国外）での啓発活動に関する記事。サマリーでは「モヘリでは症例報告なし」と明記。DRCからの移民流入による潜在的リスク認識ではあるが、実際の発生地域は対象国のDRCのみに限定。症例発生の確認がないため現段階ではWATCHに分類。

article.articleHeadline: Không để sốt xuất huyết bùng phát diện rộng trong mùa mưa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent dengue fever from spreading widely during the rainy season.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Lâm Đồng province, Vietnam, as the rainy season begins, with 1,130 dengue cases reported January–May 2026. In week 21 (25–31 May 2026), 48 new cases and 10 active dengue clusters were recorded, with hotspots in Đạ Huoai, Bảo Lộc, Di Linh, Tánh Linh, Đức Linh, and Bắc Bình. Vector indices exceed the transmission threshold, signaling potential explosive spread as rains peak. The provincial Department of Health calls for intensified epidemiological surveillance, early case and outbreak detection, and rapid containment of all outbreaks within 48 hours to cut transmission chains. Local health facilities should maintain larval monitoring and weekly larval source reduction in high-risk areas, plus biweekly campaigns during April–November. Aggressive public communications and strengthened hospital capacity for triage, emergency care, and early warning signs aim to minimize fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季におけるデング熱の広範な拡大を防止する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのラムドン省でデング熱の症例が急増しており、既に1,130例が報告されている（2026年1月～5月）。雨季の到来に伴い爆発的拡大のリスクが高まっており、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）で複数該当するため、フルRRA実施の対象とすべき。
triage.notes: ラムドン省ではデング熱の多数の活動的なクラスター（10クラスター）が確認されており、媒介昆虫指数が伝播閾値を超えている。雨季の加速に伴い爆発的な拡大の可能性が高い。保健当局は警戒態勢にあり、積極的な疫学監視と迅速な封じ込め対策を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's World Cup dream meets Ebola, U.S. visa roadblock
article.articleSummary: Ten African nations—Algeria, Cape Verde, DR Congo, Egypt, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Morocco, Senegal, South Africa, and Tunisia—qualified for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, hosted across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico from June 11 to July 19. Yet visa roadblocks loom: U.S. visa bonds of $5,000–$15,000 for some nationals; qualified fans with World Cup tickets may be exempt but must register via FIFA and undergo social media background checks. Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo and neighboring regions (Bundibugyo strain) has claimed more than 130 lives and raised travel and screening concerns ahead of the event; Uganda is also affected, with North American authorities monitoring. DR Congo's Leopards face additional health and travel restrictions impacting preparations and movement for supporters, officials, and media. The combination of immigration hurdles, travel costs, and public health measures threatens in-person attendance despite Africa's historic World Cup presence.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのワールドカップの夢、エボラと米国ビザの障壁に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の東部コンゴ民主共和国での発生（130人以上の死亡）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、国際的なワールドカップイベント開催に関連した国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有するため、IHR基準を複数満たす。また国際的な社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUSA、Canada、Mexicoを含むが、これらは2026ワールドカップ開催国であり、記事サマリー上のエボラ発生地は東部DR Congo、周辺地域、ウガンダである。対象国リストのうち確認できるのはDRC（203312）、Ghana（2300660）、Uganda（226074）のみ。記事は全10アフリカ国家のワールドカップ参加とそれに伴う渡航・入国制限の課題、エボラ流行による健康リスクを主題としており、IHR基準4つ全て該当、かつWPRO基準5つ全て該当する高リスク事象。フルのRapid Risk Assessment進行が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Infectólogo advierte sobre el riesgo del ébola para el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease specialist warns about the Ebola risk to the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Ebola virus disease is a high-lethality outbreak detected in the northwest region of the Democratic Republic of Congo, prompting warnings about potential spread to the country. Dr. Héctor Balcácer warns that despite no pandemic yet, rapid international communication can reach nearly the entire world within about 36 hours, underscoring vigilance. The Republic of the Congo has imposed movement restrictions; with a border to nine countries and high cross-border mobility, precautions are essential to prevent entry. Ebola currently has no approved treatment or vaccine and can cause substantial mortality, with roughly 40–60% fatality among those infected. Authorities emphasize quarantine measures already enacted by the DRC and global surveillance to prevent further transmission. The doctor also notes circulation of other viruses (influenza, adenovirus, RSV, and COVID-19) and urges prompt medical consultation and Covid testing when appropriate.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症医が国へのエボラ感染リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当。DRC内での高致死性アウトブレイク報告と国境地域での拡大懸念が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC北西部でのエボラ高致死性アウトブレイク検出と、DRCから9カ国と国境を接する地理的リスクを明確に記述。40-60%の致死率、承認された治療法やワクチンの欠如が強調されている。複数の呼吸器系ウイルス（インフルエンザ、アデノウイルス、RSV、COVID-19）の同時流行も報告されており、複合的な脅威状況。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة للبلدان الأمريكية تعزز الاستعدادات لمواجهة فيروس إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pan American Health Organization strengthens preparations to confront the Ebola virus - Shorouk Gate
article.articleSummary: PAHO activated its emergency management system and, in collaboration with national health ministries, is strengthening surveillance, testing, and infection control to rapidly detect and respond to Ebola in the Americas, where risk is assessed as low. The agency is organizing shipments of materials and molecular diagnostic kits for detecting the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage and will deploy them to selected countries based on risk assessments. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Bundibugyo lineage, highlighting global concern. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities report 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, with 116 suspected cases under investigation. The measures aim to bolster early warning, case management, and cross-border readiness to prevent exportation of cases.

triage.headline_ja: 汎米保健機構がエボラウイルスに対する準備を強化 - ショロウク・ゲート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数地域での対応体制構築が記載されており、国際的な関心と対応が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統によるアウトブレイク。DRCで344確定症例、60死亡、116疑い患者。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。カナリア諸島やスペインは記事の主題の発生地ではなく、準備体制の対象地域として言及されているため除外。アメリカ大陸での発生は記載されていない（低リスク評価）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak a growing concern due to mistrust: Former CDC director
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has driven two deaths at an Ebola isolation facility in Kenya, underscoring widespread mistrust of the DRC and aid workers that hampers containment. Former CDC director Dr. Robert Redfield says distrust is a key factor, and notes that quarantining an infected person's body after death, while a critical control measure, can inflame communities that want the body released. He warns the outbreak could become the second-largest Ebola pandemic in history, though he does not expect it to spread beyond central Africa, describing the region as facing a very big problem with more cases expected in the weeks and months ahead. Separately, a House Oversight Committee report criticizes the Trump administration's USAID shutdown for weakening outbreak response, arguing hundreds of thousands have suffered preventable hunger, illness, or death as a result.

triage.headline_ja: 信頼の欠如が懸念される中、エボラアウトブレイクが拡大：元CDC所長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症による多数の死亡例、国際的拡大のリスク、および深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が認められるため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であり、ケニアではDRCからの流入による2例の死亡が報告されている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。元CDC所長による警告、死亡例、社会的不信による感染拡大リスク、および国連関連機関の関与により社会政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 突如其来一场病！知名演员妻子"切了一片肺"，起因是这种常见感染，结果不可逆，别不当回事
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A sudden illness strikes! The wife of a well-known actor 'had part of her lung removed'—caused by this common infection, with irreversible consequences. Don't take it lightly.
article.articleSummary: Wang Can, wife of actor Du Chun, was hospitalized for a sudden lung infection and underwent lobectomy; by June 4, 2026 she reported discharge, with the outcome attributed to prior misdrug use and delayed treatment leading to irreversible lung damage. The report warns about the seriousness of lung infections and the consequences of incorrect therapy. It also cites prior Chinese cases: in July 2017, a 37-year-old man in Fuzhou with a week-long flu-like illness deteriorated into fulminant myocarditis with shock and multi-organ failure, attributed to delayed treatment for severe pneumonia. In November 2025, a 42-year-old professional woman rapidly progressed from cough to severe pneumonia, with CT showing a "white lung" and life-threatening risk, underscoring the danger of underestimating respiratory infections and self-medication. The article uses these cases to advocate timely medical care for lung infections.

triage.headline_ja: 突然の病気が襲う！著名な俳優の妻が「肺の一部を切除」—この一般的な感染症が原因で、結果は回復不可能。甘く見てはいけない
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ関連の個別事例報道であり、新規集団発生、異常な流行パターン、国際的拡大のシグナルなし。医療教育的な警告記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 記事は著名人の個別の合併症事例（インフルエンザ後の肺炎進展による肺葉切除）に関する医療警告記事。複数の個別事例を引用して自己治療の危険性を警告しているが、新規の集団発生イベント、流行状況の異常、国際的なシグナルは含まれていない。2017年、2025年の過去事例も参照されており、現在進行形の流行拡大を示す情報なし。エンターテイメント・医療教育的な報道。

article.articleHeadline: Una enfermera superviviente del actual brote de ébola relata su experiencia: "Gritaba de dolor, me dolía el cuerpo y sentía picor por todas partes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A nurse who survived the current Ebola outbreak describes her experience: "I cried out in pain, my body hurt, and I felt itchy all over."
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province near Bunia) caused by Bundibugyo virus variant. Four healthcare workers, including nurse Furaha Tikamanyire (30), were discharged May 31 from the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center after contracting the disease likely through close contact with patients and exposure to blood; symptoms included severe headache, fatigue, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, conjunctivitis, eye pain, body aches, and itching. The outbreak began in Mongbwalu about 75 km away; authorities declared the outbreak on May 15. As of June 2, the DRC reports 363 confirmed cases, 206 hospitalized or isolated, and 62 deaths; suspected cases 116. Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases and 1 death. Six people have recovered in DRC and two in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine; three experimental vaccines are in development. Early supportive care is key for survival. WHO Director-General Tedros attended the discharge.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱流行の生存者である看護師が経験を語る：「痛みで叫んだ、体が痛く、全身がかゆかった」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規流行、複数国への国際拡大、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの新規流行により即フルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）におけるBundibugyo型エボラ流行の詳細を述べている。ウガンダへの二次的な国際拡大も確認されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。発生地域フィールドにKigali Province（ルワンダ）が含まれるが、サマリー上ではルワンダでの流行発生は報告されておらず、Rwampara Treatment Centerはコンゴ側の施設と解釈されるため除外。WHO事務局長の関与、ワクチン開発動向、医療従事者への曝露リスク等、国際的関心の高さが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Sääskedega liigub Euroopasse viirus, millele pole ravi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mosquito-borne virus heading to Europe for which there is no cure.
article.articleSummary: Climate warming creates ideal conditions for Asian tiger mosquitoes (Aedes), potentially enabling the chikungunya virus—previously confined to tropical and near-tropical regions—to become common in temperate zones, with painful joint pain affecting residents of Europe and North America. Zhejiang Chinese Medical University researchers warn that climate change is creating an optimal environment for the spread of dangerous disease-carrying mosquitoes in temperate regions. Chikungunya virus, previously regarded as a tropical/subtropical exotic disease that causes painful joint pain, could become a real threat to Europe and North America. There is no cure for chikungunya. The risk is expanding toward Europe and North America.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊によってヨーロッパに向かうウイルス、治療法がない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。チクングニア熱の温帯地域への拡大は新たな脅威であり、ヨーロッパ・北米への感染拡大リスクが示唆されている。
triage.notes: 記事は浙江省の研究者による警告を引用しており、チクングニア熱の温帯地域への拡大リスクについて論じている。発生地域フィールドにはZhejiang ShenとChinaが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はアジアの蚊がヨーロッパ・北米に移行するリスク評価であり、現在の具体的な感染者発生地はサマリーに記載されていない。ただし、中国の研究機関による警告であることから中国を検証済み地域として含める。気候変動に伴う蚊の北上と感染症リスクの拡大という長期的な脅威として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa: Ebola Is a Pandemic That Should Concern All On the Continent - President Ramaphosa
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains a continental concern as President Cyril Ramaphosa reaffirms South Africa’s commitment to strengthened preparedness and response through Africa CDC. South Africa previously contributed $5 million to AU-CDC to bolster health systems and outbreak readiness in the DRC and Uganda, reinforcing regional capacity to manage Ebola. Ramaphosa urged continued international support to enable Africa to deal effectively with this threat. Ruto said Ebola is a pandemic, not confined to one place, and Eastern DRC’s outbreak remains a regional concern. Kenya has instituted entry-point screening, trained health personnel, and 23 isolation facilities, with 2,000–3,000 Ebola tests conducted daily. A US-backed quarantine facility at a Kenyan military air base is part of broader preparedness, supported by 1.8 million Kenyan shillings. The leaders emphasize coordinated action to protect Africa’s public health and bolster national health systems.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ：エボラは大陸全体が懸念すべきパンデミック - ラマフォーサ大統領
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生を報告しており、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」で該当し、政府首脳級の関心と国際的支援の必要性が示されているため。
triage.notes: 記事では東部DRCでのエボラ発生が地域的懸念として言及されている。南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないが、DRCはリストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。本イベントはEbola（IHR届出対象感染症）の区域外症例報告かつ多国間での地域対応が進行中の状況を示しており、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: East Africa: EAC Ministers Agree to Harmonise Response to Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: East African Community health ministers agreed to harmonise Ebola response across DR Congo and Uganda amid ongoing outbreak confirmed in DR Congo (121 confirmed, over 1,000 suspected cases with dozens of deaths) and Uganda (11 confirmed cases including one death). At the 1–2 June extraordinary meeting, they standardised border screening at airports, seaports and land crossings, and instituted traveller health declarations and exit screening in line with WHO guidance, while expanding community surveillance and risk communication. A Regional Technical Taskforce on Ebola and other high-consequence diseases will coordinate outbreak monitoring with real-time epidemiological data sharing to detect new cases early. Ten mobile laboratories are deployed at border points and hotspots, funded by KfW (€1 million) with technical support from the Bernhard Nocht Institute. PPE distribution continues; vaccines/diagnostics fast-tracked; frontline training and EAC rapid-expert refreshers planned. Security challenges hinder tracing; a multisectoral meeting will address trade and movement impacts.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ：EAC保健相がエボラ発生への対応調和で合意
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国で121例の確認患者、1,000以上の疑似患者、数十人の死亡を含む重大なエボラアウトブレイクが進行中であり、ウガンダへの国際的な拡大が既に確認されている。複数国にまたがる多国間調整が実施されている高度な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙。記事サマリーでは両国でのアウトブレイク確認と多国間調整が述べられているが、評価対象国はDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く、既に死亡者が報告されている。国際的な感染拡大リスクは高く、複数国での境界検査強化やワクチン配布などが実施されている状況からも管理が困難な可能性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Daerah Tambang dan Rawa di Bangka Selatan Jadi Fokus Pengawasan Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mining and swamp areas in South Bangka become the focus of malaria surveillance.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Bangka Selatan Regency, Indonesia, maintains malaria elimination status achieved in 2015, despite two years with no reported malaria cases. Surveillance targets swampy areas and mining districts where standing water creates Anopheles mosquito habitat, including Toboali District (Desa Rias) and high-activity mining zones near Sukadamai and Kelurahan Tanjung Ketapang. High human mobility in these areas raises the risk of imported malaria from endemic regions, prompting intensified migration surveillance and rapid response. Diagnostic steps begin with a Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) and are followed by microscopic confirmation. The program, led by Slamet Wahidin of the Health Office, emphasizes early detection, field checks, and vigilant monitoring to prevent reintroduction and sustain malaria elimination amid ongoing mobility and environmental risk.

triage.headline_ja: 南バンカ県の鉱業地域と湿地帯がマラリア監視の焦点に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアではマラリア排除状態を維持しているが、記事の主題は既に排除達成地域における監視強化であり、新規の流行や異常事態の報告ではない。IHR基準の該当が限定的であるが、地域内での再導入リスク対策として情報の継続監視は必要。
triage.notes: 記事は南バンカ県における既達成のマラリア排除状態の維持と監視活動に焦点を当てており、新規の感染症流行事象ではない。ただし、採鉱地域での継続的な曝露リスク（standing water）と高い人口移動性により、再導入リスクが存在するため、継続監視の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DRC accelerates as WHO reports rapid case rise
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak is expanding, with more than 1,000 suspected infections and over 200 deaths reported across Ituri, North and South Kivu and neighboring Uganda. Bunia opens a new treatment centre as WHO and partners coordinate containment, while MSF underscores the crucial role of community trust and local engagement. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccines or treatments, contributing to rapid spread and stressing diagnostic and treatment capacity. This marks the 17th Ebola eruption since 1976, amid security challenges and humanitarian needs in the region. International funding gaps and delays threaten containment, underscoring the need for greater country-led coordination. In the coming weeks, authorities expect expanded treatment capacity, more mobile laboratories, and intensified contact tracing to reduce transmission and improve case-fatality outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ流行が加速、WHOが急速な患者数増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で1,000件以上の疑い患者、200人以上の死亡が報告され、複数国に拡大している公衆衛生上の深刻な事態。ワクチン・治療法がないため制御困難。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラはワクチン・治療法が利用不可。セキュリティ上の課題、医療能力の制約、国際資金の不足が対応を阻害している。ウガンダも感染発生地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Two Scientists On Their Race to Make a New Ebola Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has 359 confirmed cases and 61 deaths, concentrated in Ituri province in NE DRC. Existing vaccines protect the Zaire strain, not Bundibugyo, prompting development of a candidate by Oxford Vaccine Group researchers Teresa Lambe and Rebecca Makinson using the ChADOx1 viral-vector platform. The program, tied to CEPI fast-track funding awarded on June 1 alongside Moderna and IAVI, aims to accelerate preclinical work, animal testing, and batch manufacture toward a phase 1 trial “relatively soon.” Outbreak context includes conflict, displacement, and stretched health facilities. The scientists are adapting prior Ebola vaccine work (2022) in pursuit of protection against Bundibugyo, with attention to rapid availability when and where outbreaks occur in DRC and potentially across the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：新しいエボラワクチン開発に取り組む2人の科学者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebola outbreakはDRC及びウガンダで359確定症例、61死亡を記録しており、既存ワクチンでは防御不可能な株での発生、国際的な拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響が認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo EbolaSの発生がDRCおよび隣国ウガンダで報告されていることを述べているが、サマリーの主題は「DRCのIturi州に集中した発生」である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（ID 203312）として含める。既存ワクチン非適応株での新規ワクチン開発という観点から、技術的な関心と並行して疾病管理上のシグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Mycobacterium tuberculosis transmission from tuberculosis patients with and without recognized symptoms: a case-contact study in eastern China
article.articleSummary: Case-contact study in Jiangsu Province, eastern China, found substantial transmission from tuberculosis patients with and without recognized symptoms. Index cases from four health centers yielded 473 TB patients and 1,050 contacts, plus 560 unexposed controls. Symptoms were assessed for the 3 months prior to diagnosis and at diagnosis. Among index cases, asymptomatic TB ranged from 15% with no symptoms to 44% with no prolonged cough. Relative risks of QuantiFERON positivity were higher for contacts of asymptomatic (aRR 2.06, 95% CI 1.28–3.33) and symptomatic patients (aRR 2.23, 95% CI 1.66–3.01) versus controls; alternative QuantiFERON cutoffs yielded similar results. QuantiFERON and ESAT6-CFP10 skin test levels were comparable between contacts of symptomatic and asymptomatic patients. Findings suggest minimally symptomatic or unrecognized TB patients may be infectious.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者からの結核菌伝播：症状認識の有無に関わらず中国東部での症例接触者研究
triage.triage_reason: 結核の疫学的知見を報告する学術研究論文であり、新規の流行イベントではなく、既知感染症の伝播特性に関する研究成果。即座のフルRRA対象ではないが、無症状患者からの感染可能性という公衆衛生上の重要な知見として経過観察する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は Nature Communications に掲載された学術論文であり、江蘇省で実施された症例接触者研究の結果報告。新規の感染症流行イベント（outbreak）ではなく、既知の結核の伝播特性に関する疫学的知見を報告するもの。無症状結核患者からの感染可能性が示唆されるため、公衆衛生上の意義はあるが、即座の緊急対応を要するイベントではない。情報源が学術論文であり、社会的・政治的関心レベルは記事から判断できない。

article.articleHeadline: Evalúan de positivo comportamiento de letalidad de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Positive assessment of Ebola lethality in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows a case fatality rate under 17% as of June 5, 2026, according to Health Minister Roger Kamba. He contrasted this with mortality rates up to 80% seen in past Zaire Ebola outbreaks, attributing the improvement to early detection, medical care availability, and rapid treatment. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 63 deaths. The epidemic remains confined to three provinces: Ituri (about 95% of cases), North Kivu, and South Kivu, affecting 25 health zones. The Ministry announced distribution of 340 tons of medicines and supplies to Ituri and North Kivu, joining 150 tons previously delivered by UNICEF, to strengthen patient care and frontline response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の致死率の行動を好意的に評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響（381例・63死）」「予想外/異常性（過去より低い致死率）」「国際的拡大リスク」の3基準に該当し、かつエボラ出血熱という高い社会的・政治的関心を持つ疾患であるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の高優先度疾患。DRCでの381確認例・63死亡は深刻な公衆衛生事象であり、過去のザイールエボラとの比較における致死率低下も注目される。複数州での持続的感染伝播と25の保健地区への拡大が報告されている。UNICEFを含む国際的な支援体制が既に展開されており、国境を越えた拡大リスクは中程度以上と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola cases hit 363, as Uganda reports 4 recoveries
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola cases rise to 363 with 62 deaths; Uganda reports four recoveries as of June 5, 2026. Outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain declared May 15; WHO designated a public health emergency of international concern. In the DRC, six patients have been discharged among the 363 cases and 62 deaths. Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases (11 imported, 4 healthcare worker infections) with four discharged; 620 contacts have been monitored, of whom 270 completed the 21-day observation. Laboratory capacity expanded, delivering results in about four hours, and testing is now closer to the epicenter, enabling faster confirmation. First Ugandan case traced to cross-border movement from the DRC; the response is being decentralized to health zones with rapid response teams. WHO Africa urges regional cooperation, cautions against misinformation and blanket travel bans, and emphasizes border screening at official points. Uganda has not exported Ebola in previous outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: DRC(コンゴ民主共和国)のエボラ症例が363件に達し、ウガンダが4件の回復を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大（DRC363件、ウガンダ15件）、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）指定、高い死亡率（62死亡）、国際的な拡大リスク・渡航制限懸念が明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）によるアフリカ大陸での多国間アウトブレイク。DRCで363件（62死亡）、ウガンダで15件の確認例がある。2026年5月15日にPHEIC指定済み。越境移動による感染拡大が確認されており、地域的な協力体制と迅速な対応が進行中。注: Uganda は対象国リストにないが、記事の主題が DRC と Uganda 両国にまたがるため、DRC のみ verified_locations に含める（訂正: Uganda は対象国でないため除外）

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Roberta Villa: "Nessun allarme in Italia ed Europa, ma è dramma in Congo e Uganda"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Roberta Villa: "There is no cause for alarm in Italy and Europe, but it is a crisis in Congo and Uganda"
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, and in Uganda. The World Health Organization reduced the number of suspected cases from 906 to 116 after analyses and tests showed malaria and other infections in some patients, though the risk remains real. The situation is difficult in Ituri and Uganda, with international aid arriving but two major gaps: lack of personal protective equipment and shortage of diagnostic tests. About 20% of confirmed Ebola cases are healthcare workers, indicating unsafe working conditions and elevated nosocomial risk. While there is no cause for alarm in Italy and Europe, the crisis persists in Congo and Uganda, underscoring the need for ongoing international support, stringent infection control, and enhanced laboratory capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ロベルタ・ヴィラ：「イタリアとヨーロッパでは警報の原因はないが、コンゴとウガンダは危機的状況」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の確認症例と疑い症例が複数国で発生しており、公衆衛生への重大な影響、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: Ituriプロビンス（コンゴ北東部）で発生。Ugandaも発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。記事はコンゴとウガンダでの危機的状況を強調しており、国際的関心は高い。PPE不足および診断検査の不足が指摘されており、医療従事者の感染リスク（確認症例の約20%）も深刻である。

article.articleHeadline: Over 50 Fall Ill After Sewage Contaminates Narmada Water Supply In Ahmedabad's Ghatlodia Area - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, over 50 residents across nine Ghatlodia housing societies in Ahmedabad fell ill after drinking water contaminated by sewage due to a leaking underground pipeline that mixed with treated Narmada water. Seven people were hospitalised; symptoms included diarrhoea and vomiting. AMC isolated the contaminated supply and began repairs, deploying four medical vans and about 40 health teams for door-to-door checks and intensified water quality monitoring. No fatalities were reported. Residents had earlier complained of foul odour, discolouration and muddy taps. Officials said the contamination source had been identified and corrective measures implemented. The episode drew political attention, with Union Home Minister Amit Shah reviewing the situation. Public health experts warn sewage-contaminated drinking water can trigger diarrhoeal diseases and, if not quickly addressed, more serious illnesses such as cholera, typhoid and hepatitis. The incident highlights concerns about urban water infrastructure, maintenance and accountability.

triage.headline_ja: アメダバードのガットロディア地域でナルマダ水道がし尿で汚染され50人以上が発病
triage.triage_reason: 下水による水道汚染により50人以上が発病し7人が入院。コレラ・腸チフス・肝炎の発症リスク。インド政府（連邦内務大臣）が関心を示し、国内で政治的注視が高まっている。
triage.notes: 下水混入による飲料水汚染イベント。既に50人以上が発病、7人入院。コレラ・腸チフス・肝炎の二次感染リスクが専門家により指摘されている。インド政府（連邦内務大臣アミット・シャー）が状況を視察・評価しており政治的関心が高い。都市給水インフラの維持管理・説明責任に関わる構造的な問題として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare: Sudanese man under watch in Hyderabad
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05 in Hyderabad, a 35-year-old Sudanese national was placed under observation in Gandhi Hospital after fever was detected during routine screening at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport. The traveler, who recently visited Uganda and South Sudan and had a scheduled knee surgery in Hyderabad, recorded ~100°F and was moved to an isolation room as an Ebola precaution. Blood, urine and swab samples were sent to the CCMB for testing; results are awaited and, if positive or suspicious, will be sent to NIV Pune for confirmation. The patient remains stable and asymptomatic since admission; officials say no conclusions can be drawn until tests are back. Translators are aiding in obtaining medical/travel information. Officials noted 58 passengers who arrived from Ebola-affected countries showed no symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒：ハイデラバードで観察下のスーダン人男性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染の疑いのある国際旅行者が検出され、エボラは国際的蔓延リスクの高い高病原性疾患。IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）および重症度・流行可能性の観点からシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 患者はスーダン・ウガンダ訪問歴を有し、エボラ流行地域からの渡航者。検査結果が陰性の可能性もあるが、現段階ではシグナルとして取り扱う必要がある。エボラは高病原性・高致死率疾患であり、国際的関心が極めて高い。ニパウイルスも同時記載されているが、記事本体ではエボラが主題。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana: Two suspected of Ebola virus sent to Gandhi hospital isolation ward
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, two suspected Ebola cases are being treated at Gandhi Hospital in Secunderabad, Telangana. Mohammed Yagouch Ahmed, a 36-year-old Sudanese national who arrived from Sudan for knee treatment, was admitted with Ebola-like symptoms and a high fever; he is in the Ebola isolation ward. A second person, a close contact of Ahmed, is also under treatment in a dedicated isolation ward. Both individuals had traveled from Sudan, with airport screening of travelers from Ebola-affected Central African regions ongoing at Shamshabad Airport. Ahmed’s samples have been collected and sent to CCMB and subsequently to the National Institute of Virology in Pune for testing, with results expected within a week. A 20-bed isolation ward has been established at Gandhi Hospital to accommodate suspected cases, amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak concern in Central African countries.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州：エボラウイルスが疑われる2人がガンディ病院の隔離病棟に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。スーダンからの移入症例とその接触者という国際的な感染症伝播シナリオが確認され、エボラウイルスの確定診断待機中である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疑似症例（確定診断待機中）がスーダンからインドへ移入。感染症危機管理上、国際的な連携が必要な段階。スーダンおよび中央アフリカは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めず、インドのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Las primeras recuperaciones del ébola Bundibugyo abren una grieta de esperanza en un brote sin vacuna ni tratamiento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first recoveries from Bundibugyo ebolavirus open a glimmer of hope in an outbreak with no vaccine or treatment.
article.articleSummary: Eight patients discharged from the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo offer a glimmer of hope that lacks a vaccine or targeted therapy. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, with Ituri as the outbreak’s epicenter, has caused 363 cases and 62 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases and one death. The index patient developed symptoms on April 26, weeks before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Patients presented with generalized itching, intense pain, loss of appetite, conjunctivitis, and body pains; clinicians provided supportive, symptom-based care, as there is no approved antiviral for this strain. Early care and intravenous hydration underpin survivors. Contact tracing reaches about 45.5% due to logistical challenges and public mistrust, complicating containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラの初の回復事例が、ワクチンも治療法もない流行に希望の光をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の多国家流行であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダも確認されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含めた。363例の患者、62例の死亡、有効なワクチンと治療薬がない状況はWHO通知レベルの深刻性を示す。接触者追跡カバレッジが45.5%に留まることは管理可能性の懸念を増す。

article.articleHeadline: أستراليا تخصص 5 ملايين دولار لدعم الاستجابة الدولية لتفشي إيبولا في أفريقيا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Australia allocates $5 million to support the international response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: Australia has allocated 5 million Australian dollars to support the international response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa, specifically in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The funding, announced on 2026-06-05, aims to help curb transmission by bolstering frontline response efforts and supporting affected communities along the outbreak’s front lines. In a joint statement, Foreign Minister Penny Wong and International Development Minister Anne Ali emphasised that the contribution demonstrates Australia’s commitment to global health security and shared responsibility in tackling Ebola. The funds are intended to assist international partners and local teams working to contain the virus, mitigate impacts, and prevent further spread. The announcement reflects ongoing international cooperation as the Ebola situation persists in the region.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリア、アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行への国際対応を支援するため500万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）での進行中の流行
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を明記しているが、対象国リストはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外。Australiaの資金支援は二次的情報であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRC（対象国）。

article.articleHeadline: Eatern Africa U18/U20 Championships postponed due to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, the Eastern Africa U18/U20 Athletics Championships in Arusha, Tanzania, have been postponed indefinitely due to an Ebola outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak, initially reported in eastern DR Congo, has prompted regional precautionary measures. New dates will be announced once the Ebola situation is contained. Athletes scheduled to travel have been informed that the event is deferred. Kenya had named a 20-athlete team; three athletes—Emmanuel Lemiso, Collins Tendera, and Nancy Kibet—will join the national training camp in Nairobi next week. The championships, planned for Friday and Saturday at Arusha Stadium, were to feature competitors from Tanzania, Zanzibar, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Eritrea, Ethiopia and Djibouti, with Kenya aiming to defend the title.

triage.headline_ja: イボラ流行に伴いアフリカ東部U18/U20選手権が延期
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）、スクリーニング基準でも複数該当。ウガンダおよびコンゴにおけるエボラ流行が地域規模の公衆衛生イベント（スポーツ大会の延期）を引き起こしており、国際的な関心と対応が生じている。

article.articleHeadline: Elveszíthetjük a külföldi piacokat? Odavág a sertéspiacnak a vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Could we lose foreign markets? The virus hits the pork market hard.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) detected at a Vállaj farm in Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg, Hungary, with about 3,000 pigs including 250 sows. The outbreak threatens third-country pork markets (Serbia, Montenegro, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Vietnam, South Korea) that last year accounted for over 10,000 tons of exports, roughly 10–15% of Hungary’s total 150,000 tons. Import restrictions are expected, risking short-term domestic market disruption as supply is redirected. The industry notes the market impact could be amplified by the presence of ASF in wild boar since 2018, complicating control. A few large meat companies had recently rebuilt access to some markets, but regionalization of bans may help resume exports from disease-free zones. ASF has been present in the country for eight years; effective wild boar culling remains crucial.

triage.headline_ja: 外国市場を失うのか？ウイルスが養豚市場に大きな打撃を与える
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は動物疾患であり、既知の地域（ハンガリーで8年間存在）での発生である。ただし複数の第三国への輸出市場への経済的脅威と国際的な貿易制限のリスクが存在し、情報不足のため注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜疾患（動物カテゴリ）であり、IHR対象の人獣感染症ではない。ハンガリーはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには対象国リストのベトナム（1562822）のみ含める。その他の発生地域（韓国、モンテネグロ、ボスニアヘルツェゴビナ、セルビア）は対象国ではないため除外。貿易制限リスクは存在するが、動物疾患であること、ハンガリーでの既知地域での発生であること、人間への直接的な公衆衛生上の脅威がないことから、フルRRAには進まない段階。

article.articleHeadline: NHS warns staff to prepare for Ebola outbreak in Britain with medics urged to isolate patients
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda dominates UK health security briefings as of 2026-06-05. The World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern last month; hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths have been confirmed, with 43 fatalities reported and more suspected cases under investigation (over 1,100). The Bundibugyo strain is challenging due to limited approved countermeasures. UKHSA warns hospitals to identify and isolate potentially infected patients, ensure up-to-date case management protocols, and maintain PPE stocks. The risk to Britain remains extremely low, but imported cases are possible. Clinicians should consider Ebola in patients with fever and severe illness who have traveled from the DRC or Uganda in the past three weeks. Posters with Ebola guidance appear at Heathrow, Gatwick, Manchester, Birmingham, and St Pancras; Uganda has weekly direct flights, while the DRC connects via Paris/Brussels.

triage.headline_ja: NHS、イギリスでのエボラ流行に向けて職員に準備を促す、医療従事者は患者の隔離を指示される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで、複数国での確認事例と死亡報告があり、シグナル価値が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはUK、ベルギー、フランス、ウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCおよびウガンダでの流行であり、UK等は警戒体制の事例地点である。評価対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebola株による流行でWHOが緊急事態宣言済み、43例死亡確認、1,100例以上の疑い例がある重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: 境外移入麻疹引發群聚！個案傳染同住友人 疾管署發布提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported measles from abroad trigger a cluster outbreak! A case infected a housemate. Taiwan CDC issues alert.
article.articleSummary: Measles imported from abroad triggers a Taiwan cluster. As of 2026-06-02, Taiwan CDC reported a domestic measles cluster linked to an imported index case. Case 1 is a foreign woman in her 30s who arrived in mid-May; three days later she developed fever, cough, runny nose, and a rash, with laboratory confirmation. Case 2 is a male in his 20s in northern Taiwan, a household contact, who developed cough, fever, and rash and was confirmed. The cluster totals 2 cases; 491 contacts have been traced and monitored through 2026-06-16. Year-to-date Taiwan has 11 measles cases (3 domestic, 8 imported) with infections from Vietnam, Malaysia, United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand (one each). Globally, Japan reports 511 cases this year; Bangladesh has 70,936 with 585 deaths. Vaccination remains key: free MMR in Taiwan; those born since 1966 should consider pre-travel MMR; emphasize hygiene and prompt reporting if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 境外移入麻疹引發群聚！個案傳染同住友人 疾管署發布提醒（海外からの麻疹輸入で集団発生！患者が同居者に感染 疾病管理当局が警告を発表）
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での麻疹集団発生（輸入例から二次感染）であり、IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスクを満たす。対象国（インド、インドネシア、タイ、ベトナム）を含む多国への感染リンクと、バングラデシュの大規模流行が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング複数基準に該当。
triage.notes: 台湾でのクラスター発生は報告対象外（WPRO内で対象国外）だが、リンク元の対象国（インド、インドネシア、タイ、ベトナム）を中心にシグナル化。バングラデシュの70,936例・585死亡は深刻な背景情報。日本511例、米国での事例も報告されているが、検証対象国はインド・インドネシア・タイ・ベトナムに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Curanderos del Congo promueven remedio tradicional contra el ébola en medio del brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healers in the Congo promote a traditional remedy against Ebola amid the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, is highlighted as an ongoing health crisis. A pair of traditional healers claims to have developed an Ebola remedy using aloe vera, eucalyptus, and other plants. In Ituri and across the country, limited healthcare access means many patients first consult traditional practitioners. Health authorities urge patients to seek conventional medical care at clinics to receive standard treatment. The article provides no confirmed case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or identified infection sources. The situation underscores tension between traditional healing practices and public health guidance, with potential delays in pursuing proven therapies and risks from misinformation influencing outbreak response. Published date: 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの治療師が流行中のエボラに対する伝統的な治療法を推進
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の3項目に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行可能性」「管理可能性」に該当。進行中のエボラ流行は即座にフルRRAを実施すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州）における進行中のエボラ流行を報じており、伝統的治療法の使用と公式医療ガイダンスの間の緊張が記載されている。症例数や検査確認の詳細は記事に記載されていないが、DRCでのエボラ流行自体が既知・進行中の公衆衛生危機である。伝統療法の未検証情報が流行対応を阻害するリスクが指摘されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事の主題として検証される。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة للبلدان الأميركية تعزز الاستعدادات لمواجهة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pan American Health Organization strengthens preparations to confront the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: PAHO intensifies preparedness for Ebola in the Americas as of 2026-06-05, noting regional risk remains low. The Pan American Health Organization activated its Emergency Operations Management System and is coordinating with national health ministries to enhance surveillance, screening, and infection prevention and control to rapidly detect and manage cases. It is organizing shipments of materials and molecular diagnostic reagents for detecting Bundibugyo ebolavirus to be sent to selected countries based on risk assessments. The measures accompany the World Health Organization’s declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Bundibugyo strain. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 344 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, with 60 confirmed deaths and 116 suspected cases under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 汎米保健機構、エボラウイルスへの対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ症例（344確定例、60死亡）は深刻だが、PAHO記事は南米地域への準備強化が主題であり、対象国での実際の発生は報告されていない。情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はPAHO（南米地域）の準備強化であるが、実際のエボラ症例の発生地はDRCに限定される。Canary Islands（スペイン）は発生地域フィールドに含まれるものの、サマリーに直接の発生報告はなく、単に南米からの地理的遠さの参考として列挙されたと推察。WHOがBundibugyo株でPHEICを宣言しており、IHR基準2つ以上該当するが、対象国の実際の流行報告がないため確定PICKUP判定は保留。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana activates Ebola Response plan as outbreaks surge in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ghana activates Ebola preparedness as outbreaks surge in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of June 3, 2026, DRC reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; suspected cases total 116 after backlog clearance. In Uganda, 15 confirmed cases and one death have been recorded, including a Congolese resident who travelled via the United Arab Emirates before entering Uganda. Ghana Health Service (GHS) notes three laboratories able to confirm Ebola infections—the National Public Health and Reference Laboratory (Accra), Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research, and Kumasi Centre for Collaborative Research (KCCR). Enhanced entry-point surveillance at Accra’s airport and other crossings, with health screening and IPC measures, is in place; suspected entrants are isolated and transferred to designated facilities (GIDC, Korle-Bu and regional centers). Ghana reports no Ebola cases yet. WHO urges exit screening; PHEIC declared May 17, 2026 for Bundibugyo virus disease in DRC and Uganda; no approved vaccines or therapeutics exist. Bundibugyo virus is zoonotic, with fruit bats as reservoirs, spreading via contact with infected body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナがエボラ対応計画を発動、DRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイクが急増
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認例と国際的拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）が存在し、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。ガーナを含む複数国での準備態勢強化が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでのエボラ確認例も明記されているが、GeoNames IDリストに該当国がないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCではIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州で344確認例・60死亡が報告されている。ガーナは現在患者がない状態での準備態勢強化であり、国際的な移動を通じた感染リスク（UAE経由でウガンダへの移動例）が確認されている。Bundibugyo virus diseaseについてもPHEIC宣言されており、人獣共通感染症対策が重要。

article.articleHeadline: เตือน! หมูดิบตลาดสดอุบลฯ ปนเปื้อนเชื้อไข้หูดับ 83%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! Raw pork from Ubon Ratchathani fresh market contaminated with Aujeszky's disease (pseudorabies) at 83%.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infections in Thailand are rising, with 1,340 cumulative cases nationwide during 2022–2024 and an ongoing upward trend. A survey of raw pork from Ubon Ratchathani Province found contamination as high as 83.3%, highlighting foodborne transmission risk. S. suis is a gram-positive bacterium found in the upper respiratory tract, tonsils, and GI tract of pigs; humans acquire infection through contact with diseased animals or via wounds, or by consuming undercooked pork, blood, or organs. Infections can lead to septicemia and meningitis, with potential permanent deafness and death. Surveillance shows prevalence at 0.088% in 2022, 0.048% in 2023, and 0.20% in 2024. Most patients are male (about 68%), aged 55–74, especially 55–64. Diagnostic samples are predominantly blood. Public health guidance urges thorough cooking, avoidance of raw pork, and protective measures for individuals with wounds.

triage.headline_ja: 警告！ウボンラーチャターニー県の生鮮市場の豚肉がアウエスツキー病（仮性狂犬病）に83%汚染
triage.triage_reason: Streptococcus suis の国内での上昇傾向（2022-2024年で1,340件、2024年に0.20%と増加）、食品媒介感染リスクの明確な実態調査結果（83.3%汚染）、重症度が高い（髄膜炎、敗血症、永久難聴、死亡の可能性）ことから、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はStreptococcus suis（豚レンサ球菌）の感染を扱っており、見出しの翻訳「Aujeszky's disease」は誤訳と考えられる。サマリー本文ではS. suis と明確に記載されている。タイ国内での累積1,340件、2022-2024年の上昇傾向、生豚肉の高汚染率（83.3%）、重症合併症（髄膜炎、敗血症、永久難聴、死亡）が確認されており、食品安全と公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: East Africa Ebola Outbreak: इबोला के खिलाफ नई उम्मीद, मॉडर्ना और ऑक्सफोर्ड समेत 3 वैक्सीन पर रिसर्च जारी | Ebola Vaccine Research East Africa Outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Africa Ebola Outbreak: New Hope Against Ebola, Ongoing Research on Three Vaccines Including Moderna and Oxford | Ebola Vaccine Research East Africa Outbreak
article.articleSummary: East Africa is experiencing a rapidly spreading Ebola outbreak. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention announced the outbreak on 15 May, and two days later the World Health Organization designated it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. By 2 June, the Democratic Republic of Congo has more than 321 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 62 deaths, with over 350 suspected cases under investigation and 16 health workers infected. Uganda, a neighboring country, has also reported transmission and several new cases. The situation underscores ongoing vaccine development, with research on three vaccines, including Moderna and Oxford, as part of hopeful measures against Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ エボラアウトブレイク：エボラに対する新たな希望、モデルナとオックスフォードを含む3つのワクチンの研究継続中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルスの急速に拡大するアウトブレイクであり、WHOがPHEICを宣言した国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地として321例の確認患者と62例の死亡が報告されている。ウガンダも隣接国として二次感染が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。モザンビークは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは言及されていないため除外。WHOがPHEICを宣言しており、国際的な対応が必要な重大な感染症事象。

article.articleHeadline: สุ่มตรวจหมูดิบอุบลฯ พบปนเปื้อนเชื้อ 'ไข้หูดับ' 83.3% ป่วยสะสมทะลุ 1.3 พันราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Random sampling of raw pork in Ubon Ratchathani finds 83.3% contaminated with pseudorabies (Aujeszky's disease); cumulative cases exceed 1,300.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infections remain a public-health concern in Thailand. Nationwide cumulative S. suis cases from 2022–2024 total 1,340, with incidence rising to 0.2% in 2024 after 0.088% (2022) and 0.048% (2023). Most patients are male (≈68%), aged 55–74 (especially 55–64), and are hospitalized; laboratory samples are mainly blood, reflecting severe disease such as sepsis and meningitis, with risks of permanent deafness or death. Regionally, Health Regions 1, 3, 8, 2 and 10 report the highest numbers (288, 249, 171, 136, 114). In Ubon Ratchathani, real-time PCR testing of 42 raw pork samples found 83.3% contaminated with Streptococcus suis; 37.1% of isolates are serotype 2, the major virulent human strain. Contamination spans markets across multiple districts. Authorities coordinate alerts with provincial health and livestock offices. Public guidance: cook pork thoroughly, avoid raw pork, separate raw and cooked utensils, and wear gloves on wounds.

triage.headline_ja: ウボンラーチャターニー県の生豚からStreptococcus suis汚染が83.3%で検出；累積患者数が1,300人を超過
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるStreptococcus suis感染症が公衆衛生上の懸念であり、2022-2024年の国全体での累積症例数1,340件に対して2024年の発生率が上昇（0.2%）、生豚製品からの高い汚染率（83.3%）、重症度の高さ（敗血症、髄膜炎、難聴リスク）がIHR基準4項目中3項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはStreptococcus suisについて述べているが、見出し（翻訳）にはAujeszky's disease（pseudorabies）の言及がある。記事本文が欠落しているため、この相違の詳細な確認は不可能。ただし、サマリー主題はS. suis感染症であり、生豚市場の汚染と関連する食品衛生リスクが確認された。タイは対象国に含まれており、ヒト・動物両方に影響するため、PICKUP判定の根拠は十分。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 63 décès sur les 381 cas enregistrés en RDC (Gouvernement)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 63 deaths out of 381 recorded cases in the DRC (Government).
article.articleSummary: Twenty days after Ebola was officially declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the government reports 63 deaths among 381 confirmed cases, yielding a case-fatality rate under 17% in the three northeastern provinces affected. Public Health Minister Roger Kamba announced the figures at a Kinshasa briefing on June 4, 2026, alongside Minister of Communication Patrick Muyaya. The decline in fatalities and cases is attributed to improved response, with laboratories installed and care kits enabling precise case counting. The ministers urged continued adherence to the barrier measures issued by the outbreak response committee. The outbreak, officially declared on May 15, 2026, continues to affect three provinces in the Northeast of the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：DRCで確認された381例中63人が死亡（政府発表）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された多数の死亡例と発症例があり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。DRCにおける重大な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、381確認例・63死亡（致死率16.5%）という規模は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。公式宣言は2026年5月15日。政府レベルでの対応が報告されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials focused on Ebola, measles
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda has been designated a WHO public health emergency of international concern. Global health authorities report more than 260 confirmed Ebola cases and about 1,100 possible infections; the Bundibugyo strain is often fatal, with no approved treatment or vaccine. No Ebola cases in the United States as of June 5, 2026; transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids of a symptomatic patient and is not a respiratory threat, making wide-spread spread unlikely during the World Cup. Public health prep includes enhanced entry screening for travelers from Congo, Uganda or South Sudan at designated airports (Atlanta, Houston, New York, Washington, D.C.) with 21‑day incubation monitoring and local notification of arrivals. Measles risk rises after last year’s high U.S. case counts; other concerns include Covid-19, influenza, dengue, heat- and foodborne illnesses. The World Cup spans 16 host cities across the United States, Canada and Mexico, with 48 teams.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局がエボラ出血熱と麻疹に焦点を当てている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がWHOの国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態に指定されており、260以上の確認症例と約1,100の可能性のある感染者が報告されている。また、複数の病原体が大規模国際イベント（ワールドカップ）の開催期間と重なっており、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラはコンゴとウガンダで報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。スーダンも発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリー上では主題ではなく、また対象国リストに含まれていない。米国、カナダ、メキシコは対象国リストに含まれておらず、記事ではこれらの国での直接的な流行ではなく入国スクリーニングと準備段階であるため含めない。ただしこのイベント自体は多数の懸念される病原体と国際的な規模のため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dvojica znanstvenika optužena za pokušaj krijumčarenja opasnog virusa u SAD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two scientists charged with attempting to smuggle a dangerous virus into the United States.
article.articleSummary: Two U.S. virologists, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, were charged in a Detroit federal court with smuggling vials of inactivated monkeypox (mpox) virus from Africa and giving false statements at a Michigan airport. The indictment states they were stopped in January after returning from Paris, following a nine-day stay in the Republic of the Congo, during which they allegedly carried mpox samples. Munster, head of the Virus Ecology Department at Rocky Mountain Laboratory, and Kwe allegedly did not report the materials or obtain the required approvals. FBI testing reportedly confirmed their possession of the vials. Authorities warn that deliberate concealment and importation of biological materials without authorization jeopardizes public safety. The Congo mpox outbreak, officially declared over in April, has been linked to more than 2,000 deaths. WHO notes mpox typically causes rash and fever and can lead to serious complications.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の科学者がアメリカへの危険なウイルス密輸未遂の容疑で起訴される
triage.triage_reason: 本件は密輸の法的問題に焦点があり、新規の感染症発生事例ではない。DRCでの流行は2024年4月に終息宣言済みであり、現在の活動的な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はMpox密輸の刑事事件である。DRCのMpox流行は既に終息(2024年4月)しており、現在の活動的な感染症シグナルではない。本件は感染症イベントではなく法執行事案として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ibu Dua Anak di Jembrana Meninggal Dunia Suspek Rabies, Digigit Kucing Liar Saat Jemur Pakaian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mother of two in Jembrana died of suspected rabies after being bitten by a stray cat while drying clothes.
article.articleSummary: Ni Ketut Sari, 38, of Banjar Kembangsari, Tukadaya, Melaya, Jembrana, Bali, died of suspected rabies after a bite from a stray cat in April 2026. The bite occurred on her right calf; she washed the wound with soap and water and did not seek care. On May 23, 2026 she developed rabies-compatible symptoms, including hydrophobia and aerophobia, and was treated at RSU Negara after an initial visit to a Puskesmas. She died in the early hours of May 24, 2026. Family reports a prior exposure to a rabies-transmitting animal via a stray cat at home about one month earlier. Health authorities confirmed the exposure and conducted emergency rabies vaccination in the surrounding area on June 4, 2026. The article does not report laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンブラナで狂犬病疑い例、野良猫に咬まれた母親を含む2人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）で狂犬病の疑い例による死亡が報告され、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性を満たす。スクリーニング基準でも重症度（複数死亡）と感染しやすさ（未確認の野良猫の継続的存在）が認められ、地域の公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、事例はインドネシア・バリ州ジェンブラナの住民であることが明確。複数の死亡（見出しに「2人の子ども」、本文に母親38歳の死亡）が報告されている。ただし記事本文が提供されておらず、実際の死亡数や症例数の詳細は記事サマリーのみから判定。狂犬病は確定診断されておらず「疑い例」であるが、臨床症状（恐水症、空気恐怖症）が典型的。野良猫による継続的な暴露リスクと、6月4日の緊急予防接種実施から地域保健当局の対応が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: WORLD IN BRIEF: Hezbollah rejects ceasefire, Mali offers rewards for militants, Ruto backs US Ebola facility and other stories
article.articleSummary: Kenya's President William Ruto defended a planned US-backed Ebola quarantine facility in Nanyuki, a 50-bed center intended for Americans potentially exposed to Ebola during the DRC outbreak. The proposal has faced court challenges and public protests, but Ruto insists Kenya is contributing to international health security and outbreak containment. The Ebola outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with this facility illustrating cross-border public health measures and international cooperation, even as domestic opposition persists. Ruto framed the facility as doing the right thing and supporting international health efforts, underscoring ongoing collaboration to isolate and monitor potential exposures. No case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース速報：ヒズボラが停戦を拒否、マリが過激派への報奨金を提供、ルト大統領が米国エボラ施設を支持、その他のニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高リスク疾患であり国際的関心が高いが、本記事はDRCでの継続的なアウトブレイク対応施設の政治的支持に関するもので、新たなエボラ発症者報告ではなく、具体的な患者数やリスク情報が欠落している。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアとDRCを言及していますが、実際のエボラ発症者やケースサージについての情報がなく、政治的な国際協力施設の支持についての報道です。DRCでのアウトブレイク継続は示唆されていますが、具体的な疫学データが不足しているため、続報を待つ段階です。ケニア自体での発症は報告されていません。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة للبلدان الأمريكية تتأهب لمواجهة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pan American Health Organization prepares to confront the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, the Pan American Health Organization announced intensified Ebola preparedness for the Americas, noting regional risk remains low. PAHO activated its Emergency Operations Management System and is working with health ministries to strengthen surveillance, screening, and infection prevention and control to detect and manage cases rapidly. It is arranging shipments of materials and Bundibugyo Ebola virus molecular diagnostic kits to targeted countries based on risk assessments. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Bundibugyo strain. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 344 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported with 60 deaths, and 116 suspected cases are under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 汎米保健機構、エボラウイルスへの対応準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC におけるエボラ出血熱の確定症例 344 件および死亡 60 件が報告されており、WHO が PHEIC を宣言している。国際的な拡大リスク（米州への備えと物資配送）が確認される。IHR 基準 3 つ以上該当し、WPRO スクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはカナリア諸島やスペインが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは DRC が主たる感染発生地であり、米州は準備段階の対象地域として言及されている。確定症例 344 件、死亡 60 件、疑い症例 116 件という具体的な患者数が報告されている。WHO は Bundibugyo Ebola ウイルス株について PHEIC を宣言しており、国際的な公衆衛生への影響が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Επεκτείνεται στην Ελλάδα το κουνούπι-φορέας της ιαπωνικής εγκεφαλίτιδας | ΕΙΔΗΣΕΙΣ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Japanese encephalitis-carrying mosquito is spreading to Greece.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC), via VectorNet, updates maps of arthropod vectors across Europe, reflecting shifts in distribution. Aedes aegypti, the primary vector of dengue fever, is officially reported in Luxembourg for the first time, signaling increased dengue risk. In Greece, the updated maps show further expansion of Culex tritaeniorhynchus, a known potential vector of Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV). C. tritaeniorhynchus traditionally inhabits Asia (India, Thailand, Vietnam, Bangladesh, Singapore) and parts of Sub-Saharan and Northeast Africa, feeding on large mammals (cattle, pigs) but also biting humans. It thrives in low-elevation, stagnant-water environments and dense vegetation, including urban water containers near homes. Infections from JEV vectors are usually mild or asymptomatic, but neuroinvasive disease can occur, with high fever, headache, neck stiffness, confusion, and, in severe cases, seizures, coma, paralysis, or lasting neurological damage.

triage.headline_ja: ギリシャに広がる日本脳炎媒介蚊
triage.triage_reason: 日本脳炎とデング熱の媒介蚊が複数国で分布拡大し、ヨーロッパでの新規出現が確認された。IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・流行しやすさが該当し、公衆衛生への潜在的脅威がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはギリシャ（対象国外）、ルクセンブルク（対象国外）、シンガポール（対象国外）、バングラデシュ（対象国外）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は対象国であるインド、タイ、ベトナムでの媒介蚊の伝統的分布とギリシャ・ルクセンブルクでの新規出現の地理的拡大。媒介蚊の分布拡大は気候変動や国際貿易に関連する根本的なリスク要因を示唆し、アジア地域の感染症リスク増大を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : une brigade des jeunes pour sécuriser les centre de traitement d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: a youth brigade to secure Ebola treatment centers - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ituri province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically Bunia, is the site of a proposed youth-led security initiative for Ebola Treatment Centers (CTEs). On 4 June 2026, Deogratias Bungamuzi, president of the Ituri Provincial Youth Council, proposed creating a brigade of trained, supervised youths dedicated to securing CTEs and supporting the response effort. He argued that, given current security challenges, uniformed agents cannot be everywhere; a community-based brigade could guard facilities and contribute to public awareness. The plan aims to reduce patient abandonment and escapes that can fuel Ebola transmission, and to ensure continuous access to care. Bungamuzi urged the government to scale up youth involvement in the outbreak response, emphasizing that effective Ebola control must combine medical treatment with surveillance, community engagement, and robust protection of treatment centers to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥーリ州：エボラ治療センターを守るための青年部隊 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地（DRC・イトゥーリ州）が確認されており、IHR基準（異常性・重症度・国際拡散リスク）に該当する可能性が高いが、記事本文が不明で詳細なリスク評価が困難。続報による確認が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRC（対象国）で確認されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（重症度と異常性），WPRO基準5つ全て該当。政府関与・国際支援必要性も認められる。ただし記事本文が欠落しており，現在の流行状況の詳細（症例数、死亡者数、流行段階）が不明。フルRRA実施前に追加情報収集を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Traditional Healers Play Vital Role Amid Ebola Outbreak In Eastern Democratic Republic Of Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, centered on Bunia, was declared on May 15, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain has infected 359 people and caused 61 deaths, according to the World Health Organization. With little to no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain, traditional healers—tradi-practitioners living in communities—help in the response but risk delaying care, as some patients seek plant-based cures or rituals before formal diagnosis. The healers’ practices, including 'laboratories of the ancestors,' reflect deep mistrust of formal health services in conflict-affected areas where infrastructure is crumbling. WHO notes only about 45% of contacts are followed up; authorities are distributing protective equipment and urging healers to refer patients to health centers. The aim is to integrate communities and rites into a faster, safer outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行対応において伝統的治療者が重要な役割を果たす：コンゴ民主共和国東部
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認患者359名、死亡61名のエボラ出血熱流行であり、医療システムの脆弱性と治療遅延リスクが管理可能性の懸念を高める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（ブンディブギョ型）は既知の低致死率株であるが、本流行では致死率約17%を記録。紛争影響下の東部イトゥリ州での発生であり、接触者追跡率45%、医療インフラの崩壊、伝統的治療者への依存による治療遅延が重大な懸念。WHO通知の対象イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Two suspected Ebola cases admitted to Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases admitted to Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad as Telangana Health Department heightens surveillance over Ebola linked to Central African outbreaks. The first case is 36-year-old Sudanese national Mohammed Yagouch Ahmed, who arrived in Hyderabad early Thursday after screening at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport. He was placed in a special isolation ward; another person who had close contact is under medical tests and observation. Blood samples were sent to the CCMB, Hyderabad for preliminary testing and will be sent to NIV Pune for confirmation; final results expected within a week. A 20-bed isolation ward is ready at Gandhi Hospital to handle emergencies. Public urged not to panic; those with fever, severe fatigue, or bleeding should seek immediate medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードのガンジー病院にエボラの疑い患者2人が入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。致命的な病原体エボラの疑い症例が確認され、中央アフリカでの流行関連、国際的移動症例のため。
triage.notes: サマリーに明記されているとおり、2例の疑い患者がハイデラバード（テランガナ州）のガンジー病院に入院。1例はスーダン国籍で中央アフリカ関連の流行地から渡航。血液検体はCCMB→NIV Puneに送付され、確定診断は1週間以内に予定。初期対応として20床の隔離病棟が準備されている。エボラウイルスは高い致死率と国際的拡大リスクを持つため、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान में इबोला का पहला संदिग्ध केस, युगांडा से आई महिला में दिखे लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first suspected case of Ebola in Rajasthan, symptoms observed in a woman who arrived from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: First suspected Ebola case in Rajasthan: A foreign woman visiting from Uganda developed Ebola-like symptoms and was admitted to Jaipur's RUHS Hospital, placed in isolation. Health authorities have not confirmed infection; samples have been sent to a Pune-based lab for testing, with results expected by Friday evening or Saturday morning. Dr. Anil Gupta of Rajasthan University of Health Sciences noted confirmation awaits laboratory results; treatment continues under special monitoring as the case is investigated. In Telangana, Hyderabad identified a Sudanese national with Ebola-like symptoms on arrival at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport after travel to South Sudan and Uganda. He was sent to an isolation center at Gandhi Hospital, and airport screening has been intensified amid ongoing Ebola outbreak concerns. Officials emphasise this is not a confirmed case yet; confirmation will follow testing and results.

triage.headline_ja: ラージャスターン州でエボラの初の疑似症例報告、ウガンダから到着した女性に症状が確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。致死的感染症エボラの複数地域での疑似症例報告であり、国際渡航関連で複数国間の疫学リンクが存在するため、確認前であっても緊急警戒対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドにおけるエボラ疑似症例の報告に焦点。ウガンダとスーダンは疫学的リンク国として記載されているが、実際の発生地はインド（ラージャスターン州ジャイプル、テランガナ州ハイデラバード）。両症例とも未確認（検査結果待機中）だが、致死的病原体の疑似症例、国際渡航関連、複数地域での同時報告という特性により高い警戒が必要。airport screening intensified の記載より、空港での感染制御強化が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia, DR Congo, June 5, 2026 (AFP) - DR Congo's traditional healers on Ebola front line
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bunia reports Ebola front-line involvement by traditional healers, per AFP dated 2026-06-05. Separately, Windhoek, Namibia (04 June 2026) notes a public safety measure: the Roads Authority will install speed humps on the B1 Western Bypass (Independence Ave Interchange near Katutura Hospital to Lafrenz Interchange) and on the A1 (Prosperita to Windhoek Country Club Resort) in the Khomas Region, following a rise in pedestrian-related crashes. The article does not provide Ebola case counts, laboratory confirmation, or transmission details, and the Windhoek section does not address disease outbreaks. No information on imported/exported cases or symptoms is provided within the text provided.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア、コンゴ民主共和国、2026年6月5日（AFP）- コンゴ民主共和国の伝統的治療者がエボラ対策の最前線に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生地域（DRC）が確認されており、伝統的治療者の関与という社会的側面が注目されるが、症例数、検査確認、感染経路などの具体的な流行情報が記事に記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ流行の詳細情報（症例数、確認例、伝播状況）が記載されていない。Windhoek、Namibia（ナミビア）に関する記載は交通安全対策に関するもので、感染症イベントではないため除外した。DRCにおけるエボラ関連の具体的な公衆衛生情報の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Κουνούπι φορέας εγκεφαλίτιδας απειλεί την Ελλάδα - Τα ύποπτα συμπτώματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Encephalitis-carrying mosquito threatens Greece - The suspicious symptoms
article.articleSummary: Greek authorities warn that the mosquito species Culex tritaeniorhynchus, a principal vector of Japanese encephalitis virus, now has a near-complete presence across Greece, according to ECDC and EFSA vector maps (VectorNet data dated June 3, 2026). Although Japanese encephalitis primarily occurs in North Asia and parts of Africa, the vector feeds on pigs, cattle, and humans, posing public health risk; Asia includes India, Thailand, and Vietnam. The mosquito thrives in low-lying, stagnant-water areas such as lakes and wells, but can adapt to urban settings near domestic water storage. Infections are often asymptomatic or mild; severe cases affect the nervous system and brain, with high fever, severe headache, confusion, and neck stiffness. In severe disease, seizures, paralysis, coma, and permanent neurological sequelae may occur, underscoring the importance of prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎媒介蚊がギリシャを脅かす - 疑わしい症状
triage.triage_reason: Japanese Encephalitisの媒介蚊がギリシャで拡散しているという予想外の地理的拡大を示唆しているが、ギリシャは対象国外であり、記事サマリーは媒介蚊の分布警告であって実際の感染患者の発生報告ではない。対象国（インド、タイ、ベトナム）での具体的な患者発生情報がないため、スクリーニング基準評価に不確実性がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な焦点はギリシャへの媒介蚊の拡散警告であり、ギリシャは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。記事サマリーでは対象国（インド、タイ、ベトナム）がJEの風土病地域として言及されているため、これらを verified_locations に列挙。ただし、これらの国での実際の患者発生やアウトブレイク報告は記事に記載されていない。媒介蚊の地理的拡大（ギリシャへの侵入）は国際的な疫学的関心を高めるが、対象国での具体的なインパクト情報が不足しているため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Lima Orang Warga Sempat Diserang Anjing Rabies, Jembrana Catat 33 Kasus Positif pada Hewan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Residents Were Briefly Attacked by Rabid Dogs; Jembrana Records 33 Positive Cases in Animals.
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, a rabies vaccination and dog sterilization drive was held at Balai Banjar Batuagung, Batuagung Village, Jembrana District, Bali, after five Banjar Masean residents were bitten and a dog tested positive for rabies. A total of 110 animals received services: 60 sterilizations to control the dog population and 50 rabies vaccinations, conducted in collaboration with a foundation. Batuagung was chosen due to prior rabies in a domestic dog and mid-May bite incidents. Authorities report 33 rabies-positive animals across Jembrana, with Mendoyo District recording the highest numbers. Public participation is urged to vaccinate pets and reduce stray dog populations to prevent further bites and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 5人の住民が狂犬病の犬に咬まれた；ジェンブラナでは動物33件の陽性ケースを記録
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は重篤な動物由来感染症であり、複数の動物での確認とヒトへの暴露が報告されている。しかし現時点では重篤なヒト患者の発症報告がなく、対応措置（ワクチン接種・不妊去勢プログラム）が実施されているため、情報追跡が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・バリ州ジェンブラナ地区における動物の狂犬病35例（＋ヒト暴露5件）を報告。狂犬病は重篤だが、ヒト症例の確認がなく、当局の対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が既に実施されている。IHR基準では『異常』性に欠け1基準のみ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・長期曝露・流行可能性で3基準該当するため、シグナル寄りだが、ヒト患者の重症度不明確のため『WATCH』と判定。続報にて確定症例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Експериментално лекарство за хепатит B показва резултати при намаляване на нивата на вируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An experimental drug for hepatitis B shows results in reducing viral load.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B drug Bepirovirsen (Bepi) shows functional cure potential in two international trials, reducing viral load enough for immune control in about 20% of treated patients. This marks first time such remission-like responses are observed in HBV, said Dr. Sun Ge Lim of Singapore's National University Health System, who leads the studies funded by GSK. Results presented at a Barcelona conference and published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Chronic hepatitis B causes liver cancer or liver failure, killing around 1.1 million people annually worldwide; current lifelong therapies remain limited in access. While promising, experts caution that duration of remission is unknown and more trials are needed. The FDA previously granted accelerated review, with a decision expected in October; regulators in Japan, China, and Europe are also evaluating the drug. Drug developed by GSK and Ionis Pharmaceuticals.

triage.headline_ja: B型肝炎の実験的治療薬がウイルス量の低下で成果を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医療技術の進展（B型肝炎治療薬の臨床試験結果）に関するニュースであり、感染症の急性発生・流行の通知ではない。疾患発生の急速な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急対応が必要な状況は示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の慢性B型肝炎患者に対する新規治療薬の臨床試験結果の報道であり、新たな感染症イベント（アウトブレイク・流行）ではない。地理的に複数国が言及されているが、イベントの主題は医療技術開発であり、特定国での感染症発生ではない。対象国リスト内の China, Japan は医薬品規制当局として言及されているのみである。

article.articleHeadline: Bahrain Issues Ebola Travel Warning for Uganda and DRC
article.articleSummary: Bahrain’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a travel advisory for Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreaks caused by the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak was confirmed mid-May 2026 in DRC’s Ituri Province and has since spread to Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. By late May, the DRC reported over 900 suspected cases and more than 220 deaths; Uganda reported seven cases, several linked to healthcare workers in Kampala. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. The advisory urges travelers to exercise caution, adopt preventive measures, and stay informed through WHO updates. For those with bookings, check airline and insurer options and consider registering travel plans with the Bahraini embassy; monitor MFA and WHO communications.

triage.headline_ja: バーレーン、ウガンダとDRCに対するエボラ渡航警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（WHOの国際的関心を要する公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言）であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。複数国での確認、高い死亡率、渡航制限のリスク、国際的な対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的関心を要する公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、DRCで900以上の疑い例・220以上の死亡、ウガンダで7例の確定例が報告されている。ワクチンや特異的治療薬がない状況。バーレーンの渡航警告発表は国際的な関心の高さを示す。Bahrain自体の発生は報告されていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's traditional healers on Ebola front line
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the current Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026—the DRC's 17th. WHO reports 359 infections and 61 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain drives this flare-up; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Traditional healers, including Mariam Kabika and Dauda Tshimanga, operate a non‑official 'laboratory of the ancestors' and claim a plant-based cure delivered by boiled plant inhalation, though no patient has tried it in this outbreak. Health workers face mistrust; only about 45% of contacts have been followed up. WHO urges integrating communities and rites, distributing protective equipment, and referring patients to health facilities. Ebola spreads via close contact and bodily fluids, and the response in this conflict-affected, resource-poor region remains slow to mobilize.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴの伝統的治療師たちがエボラ対策の最前線に
