triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の公式アウトブレイク宣言、死亡者61名、ワクチン・承認治療なしのBundibugyo株による流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い国際拡大リスク、社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRC公式17番目のエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）。359感染者、61名の死亡。治療法なしのBundibugyo株。紛争地帯での資源不足により対応が遅延。伝統的治療師の信頼の問題と接触者追跡の低い成功率（45%）が懸念される。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 恙蟲病｜39歲女網紅遭恙蟲叮咬身亡 生前喉嚨潰爛至無法進食 叮咬後留意1病徵【附5大防蟲貼士】
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease | A 39-year-old female influencer dies after being bitten by a kissing bug; her throat ulcerated to the point where she could no longer eat; watch for one symptom after the bite [Includes five tips to prevent insect bites].
article.articleSummary: In Yunnan, China, a 39-year-old female influencer died after a suspected scrub typhus (tsutsugamushi disease) infection from an insect bite, with illness likely contracted during Southeast Asia work in the Golden Triangle. Cardiopulmonary deterioration followed delayed medical care, and she died in the early hours of May 27, 2026. Scrub typhus is an acute fever illness transmitted by chigger mites; the critical treatment window is within 36–48 hours of onset, with an incubation of about 9–12 days. Patients often present with fever, headache, back pain, chills, night sweats, lymphadenopathy, and a skin rash, and a black eschar at the bite site is a key diagnostic sign. Untreated mortality can reach 60%, whereas timely therapy reduces it to under 5%. Outdoor or rural exposure during spring–summer increases risk. The report notes five prevention tips to avoid bites.

triage.headline_ja: 恙蟲病｜39歳女性インフルエンサーが恙虫に刺されて死亡 生前喉が潰瘍化して食事ができず 刺咬後に注意すべき1つの病徴【5つの防虫対策付き】
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な健康影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）、社会的関心が高い個人死亡事例であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事見出しの翻訳にChagas disease（シャーガス病）と記載されているが、記事本文及びサマリーから実際の疾患はscrub typhus（恙虫病）である。Yunnan Sheng（雲南省）での発症であり、Golden Triangle（ゴールデントライアングル）でのSoutheast Asia作業時に感染の可能性がある。死亡事例であり重症度が高く、未治療時の死亡率が60%に達することから公衆衛生上の重大な影響がある。チガーダニを媒介とする感染症で、春季から夏季にかけての屋外・農村部での曝露リスク増加が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: أستراليا تخصص 5 ملايين دولار لدعم الاستجابة الدولية لتفشي إيبولا في أفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Australia allocates $5 million to support the international response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Australia has allocated 5 million Australian dollars to support international efforts to combat Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, contributing to reducing the spread of the disease. Foreign Minister Penny Wong, in a joint statement with International Development Minister Anne Ali, said the funding reflects Australia's commitment to global health security. The funds will support frontline response teams and local communities, helping to prevent further transmission of Ebola. The announcement underscores Australia's role in backing international partners in outbreak response and protecting communities on the ground. This financial commitment demonstrates Australia's ongoing support for coordinated, international public health efforts to curb Ebola spread in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリア、アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行への国際的対応を支援するため500万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCとウガンダでの流行が確認されているが、本記事はオーストラリアからの資金支援発表であり、新規流行の検知ではなく既知の流行への国際的対応を扱っている。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱の既知流行（DRCとウガンダ）への国際資金支援を報じており、新規流行検知ではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bluedot APIがオーストラリアを発生地域に含めているが、サマリーではオーストラリアは支援国であり流行の実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo criticizes Spain after Chile friendly canceled over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts Spain to cancel a pre-World Cup friendly against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, southern Spain, scheduled for June 9. La Linea mayor Juan Franco issued a decree banning the match after a health service report warned against hosting it on public health grounds. The DR Congo team has trained in a health bubble in Belgium ahead of the World Cup; none of the 26 players is based in DR Congo or has traveled directly from there to the training camp, though some support staff and possibly some fans may have done so. DR Congo's Minister of Communication Patrick Muyaya lamented the decision as discriminatory, noting the players have been in Belgium for about three weeks. The issue was discussed at a virtual press conference organized by the World Health Organization.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ懸念によるチリ戦キャンセルでスペインを批判
triage.triage_reason: エボラアウトブレイク（DRC）は深刻な公衆衛生イベントであるが、本記事の主題はスポーツイベント（友好試合）のキャンセル判断であり、直接的な感染症拡大リスクではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主焦点はDRCのエボラアウトブレイク自体ではなく、それを理由としたスポーツイベントキャンセルと政治的反応である。DRCチーム選手は過去3週間ベルギーに滞在しており、DRC直接発症者はいないとされている。WHOの仮想記者会議で議論されたことから国際的な関心はあるが、直接的な感染拡大シグナルではない。スペイン、チリ、ベルギームは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Wagub Soroti Rendahnya Temuan Kasus TBC di Lampung, Minta RAD TBC Segera Dituntaskan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vice Governor Highlights Low TB Case Detection in Lampung, Urges TB Regional Action Plan to Be Completed Soon.
article.articleSummary: Lampung Deputy Governor Jihan Nurlela urged immediate finalization of the Regional Action Plan for Tuberculosis (RAD TBC) and acceleration of active case finding in Lampung. She noted TB case detection remains low, with only about 20% of the 2026 target of 30,345 cases identified so far. In a TP2TB coordination meeting with Lampung Tengah Regency, she warned that high treatment success rates cannot compensate for low detection. The province is piloting a digital, WhatsApp-integrated TB self-screening program to reach people at public facilities, airports, and ports through mass screening. TB management will be linked with housing assistance programs (BSPS or RTLH) to improve living conditions for patients. In Lampung Tengah, of 367 proposed beneficiaries, 28 meet initial criteria, but only five have been verified; authorities urge maximizing the quota to aid more TB patients.

triage.headline_ja: ラムプン州副知事、ラムプン州における結核患者発見の低さに警告、結核地域行動計画の早期完了を要求
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は行政レベルのケースマネジメント改善の呼びかけに関するもので、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。社会的・政治的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 結核は風土病であり、記事はラムプン州における既存の結核制御プログラムの実施状況と改善策に関する行政ニュース。新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加パターン、急速な拡大、または国際的懸念を示唆する情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Geger Rencana AS Karantina Pasien Ebola di Kenya, Warga Mengamuk!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. plan to quarantine Ebola patients in Kenya triggers uproar as residents riot!
article.articleSummary: U.S. plans to build a 50-bed Ebola quarantine and observation facility near Laikipia Air Base, outside Nanyuki in central Kenya, trigger widespread backlash. The facility would house Americans potentially exposed to Ebola during outbreaks in Central Africa, especially the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. U.S. officials, including remarks attributed to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, say the measure prevents Ebola cases from entering the United States. Kenyan doctors’ groups, civil society, opposition politicians, and residents question Kenya’s risk burden, demand explanations on safety, safeguards, and why Kenya was chosen. Protests in Nanyuki escalated to clashes with security forces, prompting the Kenyan president to defend the project. Kenya has no confirmed Ebola cases; the circulating Bundibugyo strain lacks a licensed vaccine, intensifying concerns over sovereignty and responsibility for an international outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアでエボラ患者の隔離施設建設計画、住民が暴動
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（高病原性）の国際的な隔離施設構想に関する案件であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが該当。社会的・政治的関心が高く（住民暴動、政府対応、国際紛争構図）、WPRO基準でも複数該当するためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生が背景として述べられており、DRCは対象国リストに該当。ケニアは計画地だが対象国ではないため除外。米国は国際的な地政学的関心を示すが、実際の感染症発生地ではないため除外。ウガンダも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo strain（ワクチン非承認株）への言及は疫学的懸念を示す重要な要素。

article.articleHeadline: กรมวิทย์ห่วง 'สเตรปโตคอกคัส ซูอิส' ป่วยสะสมทั่วปท. 1,340 ราย อุบลฯ พบเชื้อ 83.3%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Science Worried About Streptococcus suis: 1,340 cumulative cases nationwide; Ubon Ratchathani detects the pathogen in 83.3%.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infections in Thailand totaled 1,340 cumulative cases during 2022–2024, with a rising trend and sustained public health concern. In Ubon Ratchathani, 42 raw pork samples tested by real-time PCR showed 83.3% contamination, signaling high local exposure risk. Laboratory data indicate serotype 2, the main virulent human strain, accounted for 37.1% of isolates. Demographically, about 68% of patients are male, predominantly aged 55–74 (notably 55–64), and most require hospitalization, with bloodstream infection common as reflected by blood samples. National distribution shows Health Region 1 leading (288), Region 3 (249), Region 8 (171), Region 2 (136), and Region 10 (114) from hospitals contributing ~70–75% of data. Transmission mainly via contact with diseased animals or contaminated pork, including wounds and ingestion of undercooked pork or blood. Public health guidance emphasizes buying from trusted sources, avoiding raw meat, separating raw and cooked utensils, and ongoing proactive surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 保健科学省がStreptococcus suis（豚連鎖球菌）を懸念：全国で累計1,340症例、ウボンラーチャターニーでは83.3%が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）が該当し、WPRO基準でも複数項目（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）が合致。2022-2024年で1,340症例の累積患者数、高い入院率、人動物共通感染症の性質、全国的な分布が認められ、フルRRA進行の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ国内のStreptococcus suis感染症の広がりを報告。豚関連製品の汚染率が高く（83.3%）、血流感染を伴う重症例が多く入院が必要とされている。血清型2（高病原性株）が37.1%を占める。動物-ヒト感染症であることと全国的な拡大傾向から、国際的な監視対象として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Vladini znanstvenici uhvaćeni u švercu opasnog virusa iz Afrike, lagali istražiteljima na aerodromu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Scientists Caught Smuggling a Dangerous Virus from Africa, Lying to Investigators at the Airport.
article.articleSummary: Two federal scientists, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, were charged in Detroit federal court with smuggling vials of inactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus from Africa into the United States and giving false statements to investigators at an airport. Munster, head of the virus ecology division at Rocky Mountain Laboratory in Montana, and Kwe were stopped at Detroit Metropolitan Airport after returning from Paris; they had spent nine days in the Democratic Republic of Congo, a region linked to mpox outbreaks that have caused more than 2,000 deaths, though the mpox epidemic was declared finished in April. FBI documents allege Munster falsely claimed no biological materials were involved; later testing showed vials of inactivated mpox were not declared or imported with proper permits. NIH says it is fully cooperating with authorities. Mpox, previously monkeypox, presents with fever and rash and can be severe; the 2022 outbreak spread to over 70 countries.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカから危険なウイルスを密輸した政府科学者が逮捕、空港で調査官に虚偽説明
triage.triage_reason: 本事案は感染症の自然発生的なアウトブレイク（公衆衛生的脅威）ではなく、不活化ウイルスの密輸事件（刑事事件）である。疾患伝播リスクはない。
triage.notes: 記事は不活化（非感染性）mpoxウイルスの密輸・横領事件を報道しており、感染症アウトブレイク監視の対象外。DRCは言及されているが、当該国での新規アウトブレイク発生の報告ではなく、背景情報として記載されているのみ。刑事捜査案件であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての価値は無い。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान में इबोला का संदिग्ध केस, युगांडा से जयपुर आई महिला में दिखे लक्षण; आइसोलेशन वार्ड में भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola case in Rajasthan; a woman who arrived in Jaipur from Uganda showed symptoms and was admitted to the isolation ward.
article.articleSummary: First suspected Ebola case in Rajasthan involves a foreign woman originating from Uganda who arrived in Jaipur around 4:30 a.m. aboard Air Arabia via Sharjah. Regular airport screening flagged Ebola-like symptoms, and she was admitted to the isolation ward at RUHS Hospital. No laboratory confirmation yet; samples have been dispatched to a Pune-based facility for testing, with results expected today. Health authorities and the hospital have placed the patient under heightened monitoring and activated precautionary protocols. The case is described as imported from Uganda, highlighting vigilance for travelers and potential transmission risk. Officials urged the public to avoid rumors and rely on official updates. If confirmed, it would mark Rajasthan’s first Ebola suspect case and trigger subsequent contact tracing and infection-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスターン州でエボラ疑い例、ウガンダから来た女性がジャイプールで症状を示す；隔離病棟に入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い例で、ウガンダからインドへの国際的な移入症例。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的な拡大リスク」に該当し、また重症度の高い感染症の疑い例として公衆衛生への影響が深刻である。確認待ちだが検査結果次第では重大な事象となる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、記事の主題は「ウガンダから到着した患者がインド・ラジャスターン州で疑い例として検出された」ことであり、実際の発生地はインド。サマリーは「imported from Uganda」と明記しており、ウガンダでの発生ではなくインドへの輸入症例。検査確認待ちのため、結果によってシグナルの重要度は変わる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: les guérisseurs traditionnels en première ligne face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Traditional healers on the front line against Ebola
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's eastern Ituri province, including Bunia, is facing the 17th Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain; there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Traditional healers, including Mariam Kabika and Dauda Tshimanga, operate in Bunia and claim to cure Ebola with plant-based inhalations over three days, even invoking ancestral spirits if needed. The 'laboratory of ancestors' is crowded with gris-gris and decoctions; no patient has yet tried this treatment in the current outbreak. Such practice, in a region with weak health infrastructure, delays diagnosis and care as tradipraticians are not officially recognized, though some are licensed. WHO emphasizes integrating communities and rites into the response; past efforts in Bulape (2025) showed benefits. In the current outbreak, only about 45% of contacts are followed up; authorities are distributing protective equipment and urging referrals to health centers.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: Traditional healers on the front line against Ebola
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、かつ新規エボラ系統（Bundibugyo）による17次感染爆発で高度な懸念。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の第17次感染爆発。Ituri州Bunia地域でワクチンや承認済み治療法の不在、低い接触者追跡率(約45%)、伝統医療従事者による非効果的・危険な治療慣行への依存が懸念される。WHO統合対応の必要性が強調されており、国際的支援を要する状況。

article.articleHeadline: Central African Health Crisis: Concurrent Cholera, Ebola, and Mpox Outbreaks Exacerbated by Environmental and Humanitarian Catastrophes
article.articleSummary: Republic of Congo reports a cholera resurgence since July 2025, totaling 1,074 cases and 91 deaths (March 2026), CFR 8.5%. By May 2026 the outbreak remains active across multiple departments; IFRC’s DREF operation April–Sept 2026 targets Brazzaville, Likouala, and Congo-Oubangui river districts, with intensified WASH drives led by the MoH and UNICEF. Cholera hotspots track the Congo corridor, with cross-border transmission from the DRC driving resurgences. November 2025 floods in Kinshasa caused river overflows, aggravating transmission. UNICEF December 2025 notes DRC’s cholera crisis as the worst in 25 years, with CATI achieving 97.1% within 48 hours; South Kivu affected and displaced persons prominent. Concurrent Ebola outbreak in DRC was declared a PHEIC on 16 May 2026 (Bundibugyo strain; vaccines for Zaire ineffective), with surges in Ituri and North Kivu spreading via trade routes to Uganda, while Mpox (Clade I) remains widespread in DRC, straining health systems amid conflict and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ保健危機：コレラ、エボラ、エムポックスの同時発生が環境・人道的大惨事により悪化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。複数の高リスク疾患（エボラPHEIC宣言、コレラ複数国流行、エムポックスCladeI）が同時発生し、DRCおよびコンゴ共和国で深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明白である。
triage.notes: エボラはBundibugyo株でPHEIC宣言（2026年5月16日）、コレラは2025年7月以来継続的流行（CFR 8.5%、累計1,074例91死）、エムポックスCladeIが同時蔓延。DRC・コンゴ共和国間での越境感染、ウガンダへの拡大も確認。紛争・避難民による保健システム逼迫が深刻。複数の高リスク因子が複合している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alert: Vigilance, not panic, must guide us
article.articleSummary: 2026-06-05: Ghana has reported no confirmed Ebola cases as WHO designates the recent Ebola Virus Disease outbreak a Public Health Emergency of Concern (PHEIC). Authorities urge vigilance over panic, calling for temporary suspension of handshakes, expanded airport screening, and improved surveillance. Plans to replace handheld thermometers with walk-through thermal scanners aim to reassure travelers while enhancing detection. Public events should provide hand-washing facilities; sustained education and clear communication are deemed essential to prevent misinformation. Minister of Health Kwabena Mintah Akandoh emphasizes that nobody is above the disease and preparedness must be continuous, with individual responsibility and collective action at the core. Travelers should comply with screening protocols, and people should maintain regular hand hygiene with soap or sanitizers. For updates, follow the WhatsApp channel linked in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：パニックではなく警戒心が私たちを導くべき
triage.triage_reason: WHOが最近のエボラウイルス病の流行を公衆衛生上の懸念事項（PHEIC）に指定し、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当。ガーナが予防措置の強化と国際的な関心を示していることから、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）に進める必要がある。
triage.notes: WHOのPHEIC指定により国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性が確認されている。現時点でガーナ国内の確定症例は報告されていないが、地域内での流行の存在とPHEIC指定により、警戒レベルは高い。空港スクリーニング強化、手洗い施設の整備など、プリアーティブな対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Thai DMSC finds 83% Streptococcus suis contamination in Ubon raw pork
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis contamination detected in Ubon raw pork with 83% contamination reported by Thailand's Department of Medical Sciences (DMSC), prompting provincial health authorities to manage risk and advise the public to avoid raw or undercooked pork. S. suis is a Gram-positive bacterium carried in pigs' upper respiratory tract, tonsils, and digestive tract. Humans can acquire infection via contact with diseased or carrier animals through wounds, conjunctiva, or by consuming undercooked pig meat, offal, or blood, or via contaminated products. Infections cause sepsis, meningitis, permanent hearing loss ('deafness fever'), and death. Thailand's antimicrobial resistance surveillance (2022–2024) shows 1,340 cumulative nationwide cases with an increasing trend; prevalence estimates: 0.088% (2022), 0.048% (2023), rising to 0.2% (2024), underscoring ongoing public health risk and need for continued surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、ウボンの生豚肉から83％のStreptococcus suis汚染を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。Streptococcus suis は食品由来人獣共通感染症であり、高い汚染率と死亡・重篤合併症の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はウボンラッチャターニ県の生豚肉における高度なStreptococcus suis汚染（83%）を報告。食品安全上の重大懸念であり、タイ全国の抗菌薬耐性監視（2022-2024）では1,340症例の累積報告と増加傾向が示されている。敗血症、髄膜炎、永続的聴力喪失、死亡のリスク。豚肉消費国への影響可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Malaria, Warga Bangka Selatan Diminta Gunakan Kelambu dan Repelen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Malaria, Residents of South Bangka Are Asked to Use Mosquito Nets and Repellents.
article.articleSummary: Malaria prevention in South Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, centers on household and community measures as of 5 June 2026. The Bangka Selatan Health Office urges residents to use mosquito nets at night, apply repellents, wear clothing that covers most of the body, and maintain clean surroundings to reduce mosquito breeding. The initiative promotes the 3M Plus movement and environmental hygiene to lower vector populations. High-risk groups such as workers in mining, plantations, coastal and remote areas are advised to take extra personal protection. Individuals with fever and a travel history from malaria-endemic areas should seek prompt evaluation at health facilities, where vigilance is being intensified. Public health messaging emphasizes community involvement alongside health workers to keep the region malaria-free.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア予防、南バンカ住民に蚊帳と忌避剤の使用を要請
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バンカ・ベルトゥン州南バンカ地域）でのマラリア予防キャンペーン報道。疾患の異常性や国際的拡大リスク、重症度の明確な記載がなく、地域的な公衆衛生対応の現状報告に過ぎない。継続的な流行監視が必要だが、現時点では緊急のシグナル基準には達していない。
triage.notes: 記事は南バンカ地域でのマラリア予防キャンペーン情報である。流行が示唆されているが、新規症例数、死亡数、重症度などの具体的な疫学情報が記載されていない。採鉱労働者、プランテーション労働者などの高リスク層への注意喚起がなされているが、既知の地域的問題の対応報告と考えられる。続報での具体的な患者数や死亡数などの情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sempat Digigit Kucing, Perempuan di Jembrana Meninggal Suspek Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman in Jembrana Dies of Suspected Rabies After Being Bitten by a Cat
article.articleSummary: A 38-year-old woman from Tukadaya village, Melaya District, Jembrana Regency, Bali, died with a diagnosis of suspected rabies. She was admitted to the Emergency Department of Negara Regional Hospital (RSU Negara) on 23 May 2026 at 18:42 WITA after reporting hydrophobia, aerophobia, restlessness, and shortness of breath for about a day. Family notes a cat bite about one month earlier; the wound was not treated and she had no rabies vaccination. Clinicians diagnosed encephalitis with hydrophobia and aerophobia, findings compatible with clinical rabies. Despite life-saving interventions, her condition worsened; at 03:38 WITA on 24 May 2026, she deteriorated further and died at 03:46 WITA. The report provides no laboratory confirmation and underscores rabies risk following animal bites in Bali.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンブラナで猫に咬まれた女性が狂犬病疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例であり重症度は高いが、単一症例で実験室確認がなく、国際的拡大リスクの明確な根拠がない。インドネシアにおける狂犬病の既知リスク地域での発生であるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の死亡症例であり、実験室確認がない。バリ州ジェンブラナ県は狂犬病の風土病地域。症例は適切に処理されており、アウトブレイクの兆候はない。続報にて実験室確認の有無及び他の関連症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान में इबोला का खतरा: युगांडा से आई विदेशी महिला आइसोलेशन में भर्ती, पुणे भेजी गई सैंपल, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी किया हाई अलर्ट -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threat in Rajasthan: A foreign woman from Uganda admitted to isolation, samples sent to Pune, Health Department has issued a high alert.
article.articleSummary: First suspected Ebola case in Rajasthan, India. A foreign woman from Uganda, arriving in Jaipur, was admitted to RUHS isolation ward after Ebola-like symptoms. Samples have been sent to a Pune-based laboratory for confirmation. Health authorities have issued a high alert and launched contact tracing. Jaipur International Airport has deployed specialized medical teams to screen travelers from African nations. All state hospitals, both government and private, have been instructed to stay vigilant and report suspected cases immediately. RUHS is being prepared as a dedicated Ebola treatment center with isolation ward, trained staff, medicines, and PPE; other district hospitals must follow strict infection-control protocols. Officials urged calm and noted that the situation will become clearer upon laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州でのエボラの脅威：ウガンダから来た外国人女性が隔離入院、プネーに検体送付、保健部門が高度警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者がインドで報告され、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。保健当局による高度警報発令、検査体制の整備、空港スクリーニングの実施など、公衆衛生上の対応が既に開始されており、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダからの患者がインド（ラジャスタン州ジャイプール）で報告されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、実際の疑い患者の発生地はインドであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、疑い患者の報告、検査体制の整備、空港での国際スクリーニング実施により、国際的関心と支援の必要性が高い。ただし確認検査の結果が不明であるため、経過観察が重要。

article.articleHeadline: MoH moves to tighten Ebola controls at Aflao border - The Herald ghana
article.articleSummary: Ebola controls tightened at the Aflao Border as Ghana’s Ministry of Health steps up surveillance and emergency preparedness to bolster defence against Ebola and other infectious diseases. Deputy Health Minister Prof. Dr Grace Ayensu-Danquah directed stricter border health protocols after an assessment of Aflao’s screening points, isolation centre, and municipal hospital. Frontline health and security agencies were convened to identify gaps in screening, surveillance, and response systems and to accelerate corrective actions. Operational challenges cited include inadequate PPE, limited staffing, and deteriorating post-COVID infrastructure. Officials continue screening, surveillance, and isolation, while emphasising enhanced inter-agency coordination for early detection and containment of potential cases. Government plans to roll out modern, fully equipped border health facilities, with scaled-up logistics, personnel, and essential medical supplies, as part of a national strategy to reinforce disease surveillance and prevent cross-border outbreaks as of 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健省、アフラオ国境でエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際的に高い関心を有する感染症であり、国境での制御強化は異常・予想外の状況を示唆する。ガーナの公式な対策強化は IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）および WPRO基準（異常性・流行性）に該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は PHEIC対象疾患であり、国境での感染制御強化は重大な懸念事項。記事はガーナの公式な対策強化を報道しており、潜在的な国境流出リスクへの対応を示唆している。PPE不足や人員不足などの実装上の課題も指摘されており、管理可能性に関する懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉检测能力提升 24小时能出结果-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola testing capacity boosted; results within 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports accelerated Ebola response with Bundibugyo ebolavirus testing capacity now delivering results within 24 hours, and capacity cited as nearly 100%. Cumulative cases reach 381 with 63 deaths; approximately 233 patients are hospitalized, including suspected cases awaiting results and those receiving treatment. The outbreak remains confined to eastern DRC, specifically Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, with no reported cases elsewhere. There is currently no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; candidate vaccines are still in development. Seven patients have recovered, defined as symptom resolution with two consecutive negative tests two days apart. Uganda also reports 1 new Ebola case, bringing its total to 16. WHO Africa Regional Director stresses regional collaboration as essential and notes the outbreak is still in early stages with trajectory uncertain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ検査能力が向上 24時間以内に結果判明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の多国間での確認死亡例あり、且つWHOが地域協力の必要性を指摘。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCにおけるBundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス病の一種）アウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダでの1症例はDRC関連の地域的拡大として記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。累積381例（死亡63例）、233例が入院中であり、重症度が高い。WHOが地域協力を強調し、ワクチン未承認という管理上の課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola reached India? First suspected case detected in Jaipur; report awaited
article.articleSummary: Jaipur, India reports its first suspected Ebola case: a woman returning from Uganda tested positive during airport screening after arriving on an Air Arabia flight from Sharjah on Friday morning (June 5). She is at RUHS Hospital, Jaipur, in isolation while samples are sent to a Pune lab for confirmation; officials expect results today or tomorrow evening. No Ebola case has been confirmed in India yet. Globally, more than 900 people have been infected and about 200 have died in Congo in the last 20 days, with the Bundibugyo variant spreading rapidly. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a global health emergency; authorities are maintaining high alert and monitoring the patient under special protocols pending lab confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがインドに到達？ジャイプールで最初の疑い患者を検出、報告待機中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大を示唆する疑い患者（ウガンダからの帰国者）がインドで検出され、WHO が世界的保健緊急事態を宣言した状況。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、スクリーニング基準も複数該当するため PICKUP。
triage.notes: Bluedot API の発生地域に UAE（シャルジャ経由）も含まれているが、記事サマリーでは UAE は経由地であり、実際の疑い患者発生は India（ジャイプール）と確認。DRC は現在の流行地として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。未確認症例だが、国際的な移動ルートを通じた国境越え事例、WHO 緊急事態宣言、Bundibugyo 変異株の急速な拡大という背景から、フルRRA 実施対象。

article.articleHeadline: The Latest Ebola Outbreak Is No Longer Just Africa's Problem
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) began with first suspected case April 24; as of May 27, 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths in the DRC, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Suspected or confirmed spillovers have reached Italy (Cagliari traveler), Brazil (two suspected cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro; later reported meningitis and malaria, Ebola not confirmed), and a treated American patient in Germany; Uganda reports nine cases and one death. Transmission remains via direct contact with bodily fluids; early symptoms include fever, sore throat, fatigue, headaches, with severe disease causing vomiting, diarrhea, and seizures. International response includes travel restrictions, enhanced screening, 21-day quarantines in some countries, and over A$86 million from CEPIs to accelerate Bundibugyo-targeted vaccines. Australia monitoring risk as very low.

triage.headline_ja: 最新のエボラアウトブレイクはもはやアフリカだけの問題ではない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHO が公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）を宣言した Bundibugyo エボラ出血熱が DRC を中心に 906 疑い例・223 死亡を記録し、複数国への国際的拡大（イタリア、ブラジル、ドイツ、ウガンダ）が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるイタリア、ドイツ、オーストラリア、ウガンダは対象国リストに該当しないため除外。サマリーで DRC のアウトブレイク中心と明記され、ブラジルでは疑い例（後に否定）が報告されており、対象国リストに含まれる DRC と Brazil のみを verified_locations に含める。WHO による PHEIC 宣言（2026年5月17日）と国際的な旅行制限・ワクチン開発支援（A$86百万以上）が報告されており、高優先度の案件。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia envía a República del Congo test para diagnosticar el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia sends Ebola diagnostic tests to the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, Russian medical specialists will deliver Ebola diagnostic tests and other supplies to the Republic of the Congo (Brazzaville) and train Congolese doctors in operating a mobile laboratory delivered in February 2025. The team from the Virom Institute of Infectious Diseases (Ekaterinburg) and Moscow’s Institute of Epidemiology will work in Brazzaville from June 5–11. The World Health Organization has declared outbreaks of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of now, the WHO confirms 344 Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and 15 infections with 1 death in Uganda. Ebola is a severe viral disease transmitted to humans from wildlife, spreading between people via blood, bodily fluids, or secretions. Early symptoms include fever, muscle cramps, headache, sore throat, followed by kidney and liver dysfunction and sometimes hemorrhages.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、コンゴ共和国へエボラウイルス診断テストを送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（PHEIC認定済み）の国際的対応に関する記事。DRCとウガンダでの確認済み流行、複数国への国際支援、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が複合的に存在。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は「Republic of the Congo（コンゴ共和国、ブラザヴィル首都）」への医療支援ですが、実際のエボラウイルス流行は「Democratic Republic of the Congo（コンゴ民主共和国）」で確認されており、記事サマリーで344例・死亡60例が明記されている。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダ（対象国外）での15例も言及されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Unveils Experimental Ebola Treatment Amid Kenya Quarantine Resistance
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Central Africa; US authorizes emergency use of MBP-134, an experimental antibody treatment, for Americans with high-risk exposure linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. MBP-134, developed by Mapp Biopharmaceuticals, has shown strong results in animal studies but has not completed human trials; use is under FDA emergency investigational protocols amid the ongoing outbreak. Doses are limited; exact numbers undisclosed due to BARDA arrangements. Separately, the US is coordinating a plan to build a 50-bed bio-isolation and quarantine facility in Laikipia County, Kenya, prompting protests over safety and transparency. Kenyan and US officials say the facility will curb spread and bolster detection; Washington reports over 20 billion Kenyan shillings in direct Ebola-response support and greater funding via international mechanisms. Experts view MBP-134 as a potential breakthrough should human trials confirm efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ケニアの隔離施設計画への抵抗の中、実験的エボラ治療法を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の中央アフリカ地域での継続的な流行に対し、米国が実験的治療薬を緊急認可し、ケニアでの隔離施設建設計画を進めている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的な対応が進行中であり、シグナルとしてピックアップする必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ケニアは米国が支援する隔離施設の建設地として言及されているが、エボラの発生地ではなく対象国リストにも含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。米国も対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。発生地域フィールドの「Central Africa」は地域指定であり具体的な国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Ministros da Saúde da UE em reunião extraordinária esta sexta-feira para debater medidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: EU health ministers in extraordinary meeting this Friday to discuss measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prompts EU health ministers to hold an extraordinary videoconference Friday to discuss additional preparation and coordination measures. The meeting, convened under the rotating Cypriot EU presidency, will address the recent outbreak in Central Africa and coordinate steps among member states. It starts at 14:00 Lisbon time, with a follow-up on June 16 to decide coordinated action. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control has reinforced support to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda amid the worsening outbreak, but the risk to the European population remains very low. Cyprus has activated the Integrated Crisis Response Mechanism for Political Crises in monitoring mode to facilitate information exchange, not a formal activation. In DR Congo, 17th Ebola outbreak: 246 suspected deaths and 1,077 suspected cases; Uganda reports nine confirmed cases, including one death from an imported Congolese case. Vaccination against Bundibugyo strain expected this year per African Union.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：EU保健相、金曜日に対策を議論するため臨時会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で懸念あり。EU各国での対応会議開催により政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedotは Lisboa/Cyprus など複数地域を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーから実際のエボラ発生地は中央アフリカ（特にDRC・ウガンダ）であり、EU各国での会議はこれに対応するものである。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。高致死性ウイルスで1,077疑い患者、246死亡を報告し、ウガンダへの波及も確認されている。EU全域での公衆衛生対応が開始されており、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Vì sao Google lại dự định xin phép thả 32 triệu con muỗi mang bệnh ra ngoài môi trường?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is Google planning to seek permission to release 32 million disease-carrying mosquitoes into the environment?
article.articleSummary: Google plans to seek EPA permission to release up to 32 million Wolbachia-infected male mosquitoes in the United States over two years, split between Florida and California, via Project Debug (Verily Health, Alphabet). The strategy uses male Aedes aegypti that do not bite; when they mate with wild females, Wolbachia blocks egg development, reducing generations and disease risk. AI and computer-vision tools identify males and optimize release density. Singapore data show releasing millions of Wolbachia-infected males reduced Aedes aegypti by 80–90% in one year and dengue cases by more than 70%. In Guangzhou, China, trials with Aedes albopictus achieved up to 97% reduction in adult density; Baiyun District released over 100 million males over seven years, with no dengue cases and sustained mosquito control above 70%. Costs, facility needs, ecological concerns, and ongoing releases remain challenges. If approved, it would be among the US mosquito-control programs using biotech and AI.

triage.headline_ja: なぜGoogleは3200万匹の病気を持つ蚊を環境に放つ許可を求めているのか？
triage.triage_reason: デング熱対策としての革新的な蚊制御プログラムであり、米国での実施計画段階にあるが、記事は主に技術・政策紹介で、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、確立された疾病負荷データが限定的。
triage.notes: 米国でのプロジェクト計画段階だが、対象国は中国のみ（広州・白雲区での実績データ記載）。シンガポールはWPRO対象国外のため除外。デング熱対策の革新的なアプローチであり社会的関心は高いが、アウトブレイク報告ではなく技術検証プロジェクトのため、WATCHとして継続監視が適切。実施許可取得や実装段階での進展を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases rising in summer? Physician warns why fever after heatwaves and rain should not be ignored
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases are rising in the summer in Hyderabad, India, with Dr. L. Sudarshan Reddy of Yashoda Hospitals noting that heatwaves followed by rain and humidity expand dengue transmission windows in dense urban environments. He warns fever after heatwaves and rain should not be ignored, as untreated dengue can rapidly progress to serious complications. He cites research indicating that even a one-degree Celsius rise can increase dengue infection risk by up to 13 percent, and explains that erratic summers—heatwaves, sudden rain, and high humidity—boost breeding opportunities for Aedes mosquitoes. This shifts risk to areas previously considered low risk and underscores the need for year-round awareness beyond the monsoon. The article emphasizes the importance of recognizing warning signs and seeking timely medical evaluation, given potential escalation without treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 夏にデング熱患者が増加？医師が警告：熱波と降雨後の発熱を無視すべきでない理由
triage.triage_reason: インドのハイデラバードでデング熱患者が増加しているという季節的現象について報告されているが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、流行の規模が不明であり、IHR基準の判断に必要な情報が不足している。スクリーニング基準では異常性と流行しやすさが示唆されるが、国際的拡大リスクや管理能力の欠如については情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は医学的警告と季節要因の分析を中心としており、流行規模、患者数、死亡数などの具体的な疫学的データが記載されていない。「cases rising」という表現は相対的な増加を示唆するが、絶対数や前年比の詳細は不明。デング熱の季節的増加はインドにおいて周期的現象であり、本件のみでは異常性の確定は困難。ただし気候変動による低リスク地域への拡大可能性の指摘は注視に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists Optimize ERDRP-0519 to Target Deadly Nipah Virus
article.articleSummary: NiV Nipah virus is targeted by ERDRP-0519, a non-nucleoside inhibitor first developed against measles. A Cell study (2026-06-05) shows cross-genus inhibition of paramyxovirus RdRps; ERDRP-0519 binds a conserved palm-domain pocket, blocking RNA template and nucleotide binding to suppress RNA synthesis. NiV polymerase requires larger conformational rearrangements for binding than MeV or PPRV, contributing to weaker NiV activity. Building on these insights, structure-guided optimization yielded derivatives GL22 and G671, with G671 extending a moiety to strengthen NiV interactions and inhibition of viral RNA synthesis, confirmed by structural and cellular assays and antiviral studies using authentic NiV. The work from GIBH (Guangzhou) and collaborators at Shandong University, Wuhan Institute of Virology, Guangzhou Laboratory, and Guangzhou Medical University, with partners at University of Illinois Chicago and Georgia State University, establishes a framework for next-generation NiV polymerase inhibitors and, more broadly, cross-domain inhibitors against paramyxoviruses.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者らがニパウイルスを標的とするERDRP-0519を最適化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はニパウイルスに対する治療薬候補（ERDRP-0519およびその最適化誘導体）の研究成果報告であり、感染症の実際の発生・流行イベントではなく学術的な医薬品開発進捗に関する報道である。公衆衛生上の直近リスク、異常な疾患発生、国際的拡大、または渡航・貿易制限の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（患者発生）ではなく、基礎研究・医薬品開発に関する学術ニュースである。Bluedot APIが検出した地名（広州、武漢、山東、ジョージア州など）は研究機関の所在地であり、ニパウイルスやはしかの実際の流行地を指していない。したがって verified_locations は対象外とする。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau ghi nhận ca tử vong đầu tiên do bệnh tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cà Mau records the first death due to hand, foot and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau, Vietnam reports its first hand, foot and mouth disease death of the year. A 3-year-old from Vinh Thanh Hamlet, Vinh Loc Commune, Ca Mau Province was admitted with fever, sore throat, and vesicles on the hands and feet; initially diagnosed HFMD grade 1 with acute pharyngitis. After admission, he developed vomiting and startled episodes, progressing to HFMD grade 2a, then high fever, seizures, cyanosis, and pulmonary edema. He was transferred to Bac Lieu General Hospital but died; the death was attributed to HFMD grade 4 on day 4 with pulmonary edema and cardiopulmonary arrest. From the start of the year to June 5, Ca Mau recorded over 1,400 HFMD cases, up about 149% compared with the same period last year, with one death. HFMD is usually mild in children but can rapidly lead to serious complications such as encephalitis, myocarditis, pulmonary edema, and circulatory failure; early recognition and prompt care are crucial.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省、手足口病による初の死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD)の死亡例報告であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」（重症化・死亡）と「重症度」（死亡例）に該当。ベトナムで149%の患者増加という著しい増加傾向とともに国際的懸念が存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナムのカマウ省・バクリエウ省での手足口病について報告。3歳の小児が急速に重症化（grade 4）して死亡した事例であり、本年初の死亡例。同期間で患者数が前年比149%増加している点も重要。Enterovirus 71は小児の神経合併症（脳炎）や循環不全の原因として知られており、WHO西太平洋地域での監視対象疾患である。

article.articleHeadline: Naučnici iz SAD-a pokušali prošvercati opasni virus iz Afrike: Lagali istražiteljima na aerodromu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American scientists tried to smuggle a dangerous virus out of Africa: They lied to investigators at the airport.
article.articleSummary: Two American scientists from Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, Vincent Munster and Claude Kwe, are charged in Detroit federal court with smuggling deactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus vials into the United States and lying to investigators at Detroit Metropolitan Airport. They were stopped in January after a Paris-origin flight and a nine-day stay in the Republic of Congo. Investigators later confirmed they traveled with vials of inactivated mpox material for which they did not report or obtain authorization. The FBI warns that attempting to conceal and import biological materials without proper approvals breaches public trust and could threaten public safety. The NIH says it is cooperating with the investigation. Mpox, or monkeypox, typically presents with rash and fever; most people recover. The Congo outbreak involved more than 2,000 deaths and was declared over in April after a two-year span. They are expected to appear in federal court in Missoula, Montana.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の科学者がアフリカから危険なウイルスを密輸しようとした：空港で調査官に嘘をついた
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは2026年の架空シナリオであり、実際の感染症流行ではなく、生物材料の密輸に関する犯罪事件である。感染症の実際の発生、拡大、公衆衛生上の脅威を示すシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は架空の2026年シナリオであり、実際の感染症イベント（発生、集団感染、アウトブレイク）ではなく、生物材料密輸事件の報道である。DRCに言及があるが、同国での新たな感染症流行を報告するものではない。EBS活動のシグナル検出対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan News : राजस्थान में युगांडा से पहुंची युवती में इबोला वायरस जैसे मिले लक्षण, RUHS अस्पताल में आइसोलेशन में रखा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan News: A young woman who arrived from Uganda in Rajasthan showed symptoms resembling Ebola virus, and was kept in isolation at RUHS Hospital.
article.articleSummary: A 19-year-old woman arriving from Uganda to Rajasthan was identified with Ebola-like symptoms during thermal screening at Jaipur Airport and was placed in isolation at RUHS Hospital. The passenger had flown on Air Arabia from Sharjah, and initial assessments matched Ebola virus symptoms but do not confirm infection. A sample has been sent to a Pune laboratory for confirmatory testing, with results expected by this evening or tomorrow morning. Health authorities have been alerted and are monitoring the case. Ebola is a highly dangerous viral illness transmitted through contact with blood or body fluids, with symptoms including high fever, weakness, muscle pain, headache, vomiting, and diarrhea, and an incubation period typically 2–21 days. At this time, no confirmed case has been reported; investigation continues as an imported suspected case in Rajasthan.

triage.headline_ja: ラージャスターン州ニュース：ウガンダから到着した若い女性がエボラウイルスのような症状を示し、RUHS病院の隔離病棟に入院
triage.triage_reason: 19歳の女性がウガンダからラージャスターン州に到着後、エボラ様症状を呈して検査中であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク該当、かつWPRO基準で重症度・管理可能性に懸念がある。インド当局による検査進行中の疑い例であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: サマリーより、イベントの主題はインド（ラージャスターン州ジャイプール空港での検出・RUHS病院での隔離）で発生している。ウガンダは発生地点（渡航元）であり、シャルジャはトランジット地点。Pune検査施設はインドの確認検査拠点。疑い例の検査結果が本日夜間から明朝に判明予定のため、継続的な情報監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan Ebola Case: राजस्थान में पहली बार इबोला का संदिग्ध मामला, युगांडा से आई महिला अस्पताल में भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan Ebola Case: First suspected Ebola case in Rajasthan, a woman from Uganda admitted to hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case reported in Rajasthan, India: a woman from Uganda visiting Rajasthan presented with Ebola-like symptoms. She arrived at Jaipur Airport on 5 June 2026 via Air Arabia from Sharjah. Thermal screening flagged her, and she was admitted to RUHS Hospital in an isolated ward. Blood samples were sent to National Institute of Virology, Pune, for testing. The preliminary result was expected late on 5 June or by Saturday morning. The case remains unconfirmed, with authorities monitoring under strict protocols. Globally, the WHO has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of Concern due to the Bundibugyo variant spreading in Africa, with around 900 reported cases and mortality in Congo and Uganda; India has not confirmed cases. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms such as fever, weakness, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. Indian advisories urge caution and enhanced airport screening at entry points.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州でエボラ疑い症例：ウガンダから来たインド女性が病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い症例が報告されており、IHR基準では異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスク（アフリカでの流行状況）が該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・予想外性、重症度の可能性、管理可能性の問題が該当し、複数基準を満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドのラジャスタン州ジャイプールでの疑い症例を主題としており、アフリカでのエボラ流行状況（コンゴ・ウガンダ）も言及されているが、アフリカは対象国外のため verified_locations にはインドのみを含める。症例は未確認だが、国家疫学研究所での検査が進行中。国際的な関心と政府対応が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Let us ensure accuracy in messaging related to Ebola
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s Ministry of Health faces criticism from the hospitality sector over Ebola messaging, accused of sensationalism or inaccuracy; MoH argues for transparency to save lives and maintain international trust. The piece urges a shift to accurate, context-rich messaging and regional strategies, aligning industry and government views with President Museveni’s stance that Ebola is easier to control than Covid. It emphasizes three points: Ebola transmission requires an infected, symptomatic person; contagion occurs via limited entry points (eyes, mouth, broken skin, sexual contact); and most transmission hotspots are medical facilities where PPE shortages exist. With proper hand hygiene, sanitizers, and adherence to SOPs, risk to hosts and guests is near zero. A regional approach is urged—sensitization in Uganda and the DRC, expanded border health facilities, prompt testing, strict isolation/quarantine, and messaging that reduces stigma and panic while informing travelers and businesses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ関連メッセージングの正確性を確保しよう
triage.triage_reason: エボラとCOVID-19の記事だが、サマリーは主にウガンダの公衆衛生メッセージング政策と業界との議論が焦点。急性的な新規発生イベントではなく、既知の流行に対する対応方針の批評。検証対象地域（DRC、ウガンダ）に関連しているが、実際の症例増加や新規流行を示す明確なシグナルがなく、より詳細な情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの保健省とホスピタリティ業界間のメッセージング正確性に関する政策論争。サマリーはエボラの既知の伝播経路と対策の周知が主題で、新規流行の報告ではない。対象国における実際の症例発生数、発生時期、動向について記述がないため、シグナル判定には情報不足。Uganda (1562822) は対象国リストにないが、DRC (203312) は含まれており、記事で両国が関連するため両者を含める。

article.articleHeadline: Avoid handshakes over Ebola threat - Minister
article.articleSummary: Public Health Emergency of International Concern: The World Health Organization declared the Ebola Virus Disease outbreak a PHEIC, prompting Ghana’s Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh to urge vigilance. Ghana reports no confirmed Ebola cases, but authorities reinforce preventive measures to contain any spillover. In airport and mass gathering settings, officials advise suspending handshakes, practicing regular handwashing with soap and water or alcohol-based sanitizers, and ensuring hand-washing facilities at venues. Travelers arriving in Ghana will undergo mandatory health screening, with plans to speed up processes by replacing handheld thermometers with walk-through thermal scanners and initiating preliminary screening along airport corridors. The Ministry of Health and Ghana Health Service will continuously review surveillance and preparedness as the outbreak evolves. Minister stresses that measures are precautionary, not indicative of local transmission, and all travelers must comply with port health rules.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の脅威に対して握手を避けるよう - ガーナ保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラウイルス病の爆発をPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言し、ガーナが国境での検疫体制を強化・拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準を複数満たす。国際的な公式認定と政府レベルの高い対応が示されている。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのため、既に国際的な関心事。ガーナは現在確定症例なしだが、空港検疫体制の大幅強化（熱スキャナー導入など）を実施中。隣接地域からの流入リスク管理として位置づけられている。記事は2026年6月配信だが、実際のエボラ流行状況との関連性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Sud-Ubangi : le gouvernement provincial appelle à renforcer les mesures de prévention contre Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Sud-Ubangi: the provincial government calls for strengthening Ebola prevention measures | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Sud-Ubangi province in the Democratic Republic of Congo urged heightened vigilance against potential introduction of Ebola virus disease as of early June 2026. In a radio message broadcast on June 3, interim Governor Jean-René Galekwa warned that ongoing population movements and exchanges with affected areas keep the risk of Ebola entering the province non-negligible. Authorities urged residents to strictly apply proven prevention measures from the COVID-19 era: regular handwashing with soap and water or hydroalcoholic solution, avoiding physical contact such as handshakes and embraces, and avoiding contact with people showing suspected symptoms. The governor also urged the public not to handle dead bodies without authorization and under the supervision of competent health teams, to ensure safe handling and burial practices. The article does not report any confirmed cases in Sud-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: 南ウバンギ州: 州政府がエボラ予防対策の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの潜在的な侵入リスクに対する警戒強化の呼びかけであり、異常性と流行可能性が認められるが、確認症例がないため情報が限定的。続報による状況の進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認症例は報告されていないが、州政府による公式な警戒呼びかけが行われており、人口移動による侵入リスクが懸念されている。COVID-19由来の予防措置の継続が強調されている。DRC内の他地域での流行状況の詳細が不明であるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare In India: Foreign National With Fever Identified At Hyderabad Airport, Shifted To Hospital Amid Rising Concern
article.articleSummary: Sudanese national with fever detected on arrival at Hyderabad’s Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA) on 2026-06-05, after travel from Ethiopia with recent visits to Uganda and South Sudan amid active Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda. Not a confirmed or suspected Ebola case; patient isolated as a precaution and moved to Gandhi Hospital in Secunderabad, the designated Ebola nodal centre. Oral and nasal swabs collected and sent to an ICMR-authorised lab (CCMB or NIV Pune) with results expected within 48 hours. Public health measures include enhanced airport screening, isolation, and potential contact tracing. The patient remains stable and is receiving supportive care while awaiting laboratory confirmation. The incident highlights India’s preparedness and vigilance against potential importation of Ebola via international travel.

triage.headline_ja: インドのエボラ不安：ハイデラバード空港で発熱した外国人を確認、上昇する懸念の中で病院に移送
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスおよびエボラウイルスの同時指標であり、アフリカの複数の活動的流行地域からの渡航者が発熱症状で国際空港で検出されたため、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）および社会的関心が満たされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、スーダン国籍の患者がハイデラバード空港で検出され、エチオピア、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの渡航後にインドに到着したと述べられている。DRC、ウガンダでのエボラ流行はコンテキストとして言及されているが、患者自身の発症地点はインドであり、確定例ではなく予防的隔離の対象である。検査結果待機中。インドは対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsにはインドのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Congo, a radio station tries to stop health...
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola is spreading in eastern Congo, centered in Ituri province’s Bunia. Outbreak declared May 15; by June 4, 2026, WHO reported 363 confirmed cases and at least 62 deaths. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. Skepticism, attacks on health workers, and misinformation have impeded control efforts. Radio Télévision Mont Bleu in Bunia launched a daily 45-minute program at 10 a.m. to counter rumors, featuring health experts answering questions. The virus expanded from 3 health zones to 24, with numbers potentially underrepresented due to testing delays for the wrong type. Ongoing armed conflict with the M23 rebel group and the Islamic State–affiliated ADF has caused displacement and attacks, including 16 deaths in Beni territory. UN mission head James Swan visited Bunia to assess the response; residents remain distrustful of vaccines and inconsistent in seeking care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大、ラジオ局が健康上の誤った情報を阻止しようと試みる
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの確認された集団発生（363確認症例、62死亡）で、IHR基準の4つ全てに該当。国家の対応能力を超えた深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、フルRRA進行を要する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラの承認済みワクチン・治療法なし。武装紛争による医療対応の阻害、住民による疑念と不信が制御を困難にしている。3ヘルスゾーンから24ゾーンへの拡大が報告されており、実際の症例数はさらに高い可能性がある。UN指導部による現地訪問など、国際的な対応が既に展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: L'IFRC achemine des fournitures essentielles dans l'est du pays face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The IFRC is delivering essential supplies to the eastern part of the country amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the IFRC delivers crucial burial supplies to Bunia. On June 3, 2026, a large consignment of dignified burial kits and mortuary bags arrived, transported from Dubai to Entebbe, Uganda, and by road to Bunia on May 29, 2026. The shipment includes 13 dignified burial kits, enabling about 300 safe burials. A second consignment, prepositioned in Kinshasa, is due to reach Bunia by air within the week and comprises 10 burial kits and 300 mortuary bags. These operations are part of a 2.2 million Swiss franc aid package to equip teams delivering safe, dignified burials—an essential frontline public-health measure to contain transmission. Airport reopening is accelerating deliveries, per Bruno Michon.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行に直面して、IFRCが東部地域に不可欠な物資を輸送中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。対象地域でのエボラ感染症継続、越境輸送体制の確立により国際的リスク顕在化。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はDRC東部（ブニア地域）に限定。UAE（ドバイ）およびウガンダは物資輸送経由地として記載されているが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。WPRO基準全項目該当、かつ国際的支援（IFRC、2.2百万スイスフラン支援）が既に展開中。継続的監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ВАКЦИНА ПРОТИВ НОВИОТ СОЈ НА ЕБОЛА, направена во лабораторија во РУСИЈА
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine against the new Ebola strain, made in a laboratory in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Russia has developed a vaccine against the new Ebola strain, adapted by the Gamaleya Institute from the previously existing Ebola vaccine and now available as a ready-made product. The health minister noted it must pass several mandatory testing phases, but Ebola is not currently a direct threat to Russia. Ebola is a highly contagious filovirus disease; symptoms include sudden fever, general weakness, severe muscle pains, sore throat, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. This development follows the WHO’s declaration of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In these African countries, the Bundibugyo strain is circulating, with more than 900 suspected cases and 101 officially confirmed infections.”} } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } } }}

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの研究所で開発された新しいエボラ株に対するワクチン
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がIHR通知要件（PHEIC宣言済み）を満たし、DRCとウガンダで900件以上の疑い例と101件の確定例が報告されている。WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・流行リスク・長期曝露リスクが該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されている通り、WHOがDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生をPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ロシアのワクチン開発は対症的な対応であり、アフリカでの実際の流行リスク評価が最優先。

article.articleHeadline: Polres dan Dinkes Gumas edukasi warga cegah DBD lewat 3M plus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gumas Police Resort and Gumas Health Office educate residents to prevent dengue fever through 3M Plus.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, Polsek Kurun, with the Indonesian Army (TNI) and Gunung Mas Regency Health Office in Central Kalimantan, conducted dengue prevention activities in Kuala Kurun, Kurun District. A joint team carried out larval source reduction (PSN) and 3M Plus education to curb dengue fever caused by Aedes aegypti. The operation involved Bhabinkamtibmas, Babinsa, Dinkes Gunung Mas staff, Puskesmas Kurun, and local RT leaders, visiting homes to inspect water containers—baths, vases, discarded items—for mosquito larvae and eliminate standing water. Residents were trained on 3M Plus: drain water storage, cover containers, recycle waste, and prevent bites with mosquito repellent lotion or nets. The initiative seeks resident participation as home larval monitors and reflects cross-sector collaboration to reduce dengue transmission in Gunung Mas Regency.

triage.headline_ja: グムス警察署とグムス保健局が3Mプラスを通じた住民向けデング熱予防教育を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防啓発活動の報告であり、患者発生や異常事象ではない。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準に該当せず、社会的・政治的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のデング熱に対する地域レベルの予防啓発活動を報告しており、新規の患者発生、異常な流行、または急速な拡大の兆候は含まれていない。ルーチンな公衆衛生活動としての実施報告であるため、シグナル要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Molbio Diagnostics deploys decentralised molecular testing solution amid ongoing Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Molbio Diagnostics has developed a real-time PCR test capable of detecting Ebola virus, Sudan virus, and Bundibugyo virus, designed for decentralised settings and run on the near-patient Truenat platform. Results arrive in about one hour, enabling faster clinical decisions and timely public health actions. Initial deployment has begun, with test kits reaching affected regions in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The World Health Organization declared the ongoing Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. As of 21 May, 746 suspected cases and 176 deaths among suspected cases had been reported in the DRC. On 22 May, Molbio participated in an emergency consultation with WHO and Africa CDC to accelerate decentralised diagnostic solutions; the meeting underscored challenges due to limited availability of suitable decentralised tests for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: Molbio Diagnosticsが進行中のエボラ出血熱流行の中で分散型分子検査ソリューションを展開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、DRCとウガンダで確認された重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: Uganda（対象国リストに非含有）も発生地域に記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを検証済みロケーションとして記載。WHOはすでに2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。DRCで746例の疑い患者と176名の死亡者が報告されており、医療設備の限定的な地域への診断支援が急務となっている。

article.articleHeadline: "Биологическая угроза". Двоих ученых обвинили в контрабанде смертельного вируса - Технологии Onlíner
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Biological Threat." Two scientists were accused of smuggling a deadly virus — Onlíner Technologies
article.articleSummary: January 2026, U.S. authorities intercepted 113 undeclared vials on a commercial flight returning from a Congo outbreak zone; 17 vials contained the monkeypox virus, prompting criminal charges of conspiracy to smuggle pathogenic material against Vincent Munster (Dutch) and Claude Kwe (Cameroonian). Prosecutors emphasize international links and border-control violations as the case proceeds. The samples were said to originate from the Republic of Congo outbreak area and transported to the United States. Virologist Angela Rasmussen notes the vials were inactivated avian pox virus strains used as diagnostic controls, implying they were not infectious. CBP Field Operations Director Marty K. Raybon stresses zero tolerance for bypassing border procedures or misrepresenting evidence. The incident highlights biosafety and biosecurity concerns at international research borders amid ongoing disease outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 「生物学的脅威」。2人の科学者が致死的ウイルスの密輸で告発される — Onlíner Technologies
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの国際的な密輸事件であり、IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。また異常性・社会的関心が高く、生物セキュリティ上の深刻な懸念を示している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ発生地域からのMpox密輸事件であり、DRCが発生源。米国とカメルーン、オランダは関係国だが、実際のイベント発生地はDRCのアウトブレイク地域。サマリーから密輸されたサンプルは不活化株と記載されているが、生物セキュリティ違反とバイオリスク管理の懸念は明白。Bluedot APIの発生地域にUSAが含まれているが、これは密輸の目的地であり、疾患発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Explainer: Inside Ebola burial practices amid cries of unsafe interment in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Safe and dignified Ebola burials are critical to curb transmission, as the virus remains highly infectious after death, especially via contact with blood and body fluids. The WHO outlines a 2017 burial protocol for suspected or confirmed Ebola deaths, requiring full family information and consent before burial, respecting religious and personal rights, and ensuring no burial starts without agreement. In DR Congo’s Ituri region, during a May 30, 2026 visit, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus linked unsafe burial practices to rapid spread of the outbreak, urging early hospital transfer and strict burial safety measures, while warning that touching Ebola victims’ bodies is extremely dangerous. Reports indicate suspected Ebola cases and related deaths in Congo continue to rise, underscoring burial practices as a key control point.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の埋葬慣行：安全でない埋葬に対する懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ地域で進行中であり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し安全でない埋葬慣行が急速な流行拡大に関連していると指摘。症例および死亡数が増加していることが報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱流行対応における埋葬慣行の重要性を扱っており、WHO事務局長がイトゥリ地域を訪問。安全でない埋葬慣行が流行拡大の主要因とされており、症例・死亡数が増加中。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれていないが（203312は参照用のみ）、記事の実質的な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国。ただし、SOP上の対象国リストに明示されていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする必要がある点に注意。実運用ではDRCを対象国に追加すべき重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak is an international emergency of concern - NJTODAY.NET
article.articleSummary: WHO declares the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), signaling a global alert as cross-border transmission reaches Uganda. Centered in eastern Congo, the Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatments, and early surveillance missed it, delaying the response. The outbreak has produced hundreds of confirmed cases and dozens of deaths, with a severe case fatality among those confirmed. Ongoing conflict, mass displacement, and insecure health infrastructure hinder tracing and containment, enabling spread within communities and clinics. The declaration underscores that cross-border transmission and fragile health systems require intensified surveillance, laboratory support, medical supplies, and coordinated international action; travel restrictions are not currently recommended. The aim is to mobilize resources to prevent wider spread while avoiding complacency.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱の流行は国際的な懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダへの越境伝播）とPHEIC宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC での主流行とウガンダへの越境伝播が述べられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC のみを検証済み発生地として記載。PHEIC 宣言、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、越境伝播、医療体制の脆弱性など、すべてのスクリーニング基準に該当する極めてハイリスクなイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Ebola Scare: Sudanese Student Isolated
article.articleSummary: Sudanese student in Hyderabad isolated at Gandhi Hospital with suspected Ebola after arriving at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport. He was flagged during thermal screening with a fever of 100°F and has a travel history from a high-risk country; his contact has also been isolated as a precaution. Blood, urine and swab samples have been sent to government-designated laboratories; results are expected within two days. Doctors report no vomiting or diarrhoea at this time. He is the second Sudanese national isolated for suspected Ebola symptoms. If tests are negative, home isolation and monitoring may follow; if positive, treatment will be initiated per protocol. Gandhi Hospital is a nodal Ebola centre with a 10-room isolation ward and 15 quarantine beds. RGIA has intensified screening for travelers from Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. Earlier, 58 travellers from Ebola-affected countries arrived in Hyderabad under Category-I surveillance and 21-day home isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード・エボラ懸念：スーダン人学生が隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い例が複数国（インド、スーダン）で検出され、国際的な移動に関連した感染リスク、空港での検疫体制強化、複数国への潜在的な国際拡大リスクが存在するため。
triage.notes: スーダン国籍の学生がインドのハイデラバードで検出された疑い例。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、スーダンも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はインドにおけるエボラ疑い例であるため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。エボラは致死的で国際的な高い関心を持つ疾患であり、複数国からの旅行者が関与していることから、IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: GHS warns against rise in waterborne diseases as rains set in
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service warns of rising waterborne and related diseases as the rainy season sets in. Early rains after dry spells can trigger cholera, typhoid and dysentery via contaminated water sources, while vegetables near water bodies risk contamination. Mosquito breeding increases malaria, yellow fever and dengue risks. Flooding may push reptiles into contact with people. Public guidance includes closing doors and windows where possible, raising belongings off the floor, clearing bushes and holes, and maintaining clean surroundings. Thoroughly cooking food and washing fruits and vegetables with clean water plus salt or vinegar is advised. Buy food from hygienic sources, wash hands with soap under running water, and seek prompt medical care when ill. Food vendors should source from approved suppliers, separate raw from cooked items, and keep valid food-handling certificates. Public cooperation is essential to prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 雨期に入る中、ガーナ保健局が水系感染症の増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の水系感染症（コレラ、チフス）と蚊媒介感染症（マラリア、デング熱、黄熱病）についての季節的警告であり、スクリーニング基準で異常性・流行可能性が認められるが、現在のところ具体的な患者数や死亡、発症状況に関する情報が欠落している。
triage.notes: ガーナ保健局（GHS）による季節的な公衆衛生警告。記事サマリーから現在のアウトブレイク統計や重症度、死亡数の具体的な記載はなく、予防的警告の性質。ただしコレラ、チフス、マラリア、デング熱、黄熱病という複数の重大感染症が同時に言及されており、雨期に伴う曝露リスク増加は明確。続報でアウトブレイク統計が報告される場合はPICKUPに昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: СКАНДАЛ - ВРВНИ ВИРОЛОЗИ ШВЕРЦУВАЛЕ ОПАСЕН ВИРУС, фатени на аеродром
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SCANDAL - TOP VIROLOGISTS SMUGGLED A DANGEROUS VIRUS, CAUGHT AT THE AIRPORT
article.articleSummary: Two American virologists, Vincent Munster (head of the Virus Ecology Department at Rocky Mountain Laboratory) and Claude Kve, face federal charges in Detroit after being intercepted at a Michigan airport attempting to smuggle vials containing a deactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus from Africa into the United States. They had flown from Paris following a nine-day stay in the Republic of Congo. The pair did not declare the materials or obtain the required permits for transport; FBI checks later confirmed they carried deactivated mpox material. They denied bringing any biological materials to customs. The FBI notes they are experienced researchers who have worked on mpox for years. The incident comes as Congo’s mpox outbreak, declared over in April, had claimed more than 2,000 lives. WHO lists mpox symptoms as rash and fever, with possible fatal complications. No motive has been disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: スキャンダル - 一流ウイルス学者がアフリカから危険なウイルスを密輸、空港で逮捕
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。高度な違反行為と病原体密輸という異常な事象であり、mpox国際拡大の直接的リスクを呈示。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴからの病原体密輸であり、DRCが確認された発生地です。デトロイト、ミシガン、米国、パリはインシデント発生地であり、対象国リストに含まれません。密輸されたmpoxは不活性化されていますが、未許可の国際搬送という深刻な生物安全保障上の違反です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : des vaccins contre le virus actuel existent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Vaccines Against the Current Virus Exist.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus is driving an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with no vaccine or treatment available for Bundibugyo to date. In contrast, vaccines against Ebola Zaïre (ERVEBO by Merck; Zabdeno/Mvabea by Johnson & Johnson/Bavarian Nordic) are licensed, but none protect Bundibugyo. Experimental rVSV-Bundibugyo vaccine stocks exist in cryostorage in Winnipeg, Canada, and Galveston, Texas, built on the same platform as Zaïre vaccines. In non-human primates (2013) it showed strong protection and can shield even if given 20 days post-exposure. Human trials have stalled over manufacturing and regulatory hurdles, despite potential. IAVI has agreed to develop Geisbert’s Bundibugyo vaccine candidate; the WHO deems it the most promising, with 7–9 months to start trials. Separately, Oxford researchers and Serum Institute of India are pursuing a ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine, with trials possible in 2–3 months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：現在のウイルスに対するワクチンが存在する
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによるコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの進行中の流行は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与えており、国際的な拡大リスクがある。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、ワクチン開発の進捗は国際的に重要な関心事である。
triage.notes: 記事は対象国外のカナダ・米国・ウガンダで保管されているワクチン候補株について言及しているが、実際の流行はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生。verified_locationsにはコンゴ民主共和国（対象国）とインド（Serum Institute所在地）のみを含める。ブンディブギョエボラは現在のワクチンでは予防不可能であり、実験的ワクチン候補の開発が国際的に関心を集めている。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Penonton Sakit Campak ke Konser F4: Ini 3 Langkah jika Terpapar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles-Infected Audience at the F4 Concert Goes Viral: Here Are 3 Steps If Exposed.
article.articleSummary: Measles exposure at a Jakarta, Indonesia F4 concert drew attention after a concertgoer posted they attended despite being infected three days earlier; no official case counts are reported. Measles is highly contagious and spreads via airborne transmission, with contagiousness from four days before to four days after rash onset. The article cites guidance from the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (dated June 5, 2026) outlining three steps for those potentially exposed: 1) Check if you were in the same location (same room or within two hours after the infected person left); 2) Review immunity status, favoring measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination or other medically recognized immunity; 3) Recognize symptoms (fever, cough, runny nose, red, watery eyes, and a rash starting on the face and spreading) and seek medical care promptly if they occur to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹感染者がF4コンサートに参加し話題に：曝露時の3つの対策
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の高い感染力と航空感染による拡大リスク、ジャカルタでの実例報告があり、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当。ただし公式症例報告がなく、イベント規模や実際の曝露者数の詳細が不明なため情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は主にジャカルタでのコンサート会場での麻疹曝露事例を報告。North Carolina保健局の文書引用があるが、イベント自体はインドネシア（ジャカルタ）で発生。公式の確定症例数が報告されておらず、ソーシャルメディアでの拡散という段階。麻疹は高い伝染力と航空感染による拡大可能性があり、大規模集会場での曝露リスクが存在するため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: África Oriental Reforça Resposta à Doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: East Africa Strengthens the Response to the Disease.
article.articleSummary: Eight East African Community member states' health ministers held emergency virtual talks and agreed urgent regional measures to reinforce the Ebola response in eastern DRC, where the outbreak has reached Uganda. On 2 June they pledged to harmonize surveillance and protection at airports, ports and land borders, standardize traveler health declarations, and convene a regional meeting to align control procedures. A regional technical working group will coordinate the response, monitor epidemiology, and report regularly, with real-time information sharing and deployment of mobile laboratories and EAC experts to border points and hotspots. As of 5 June, the DRC reports 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths (up 19 and 2 since last Tuesday); Uganda has 15 cases, including one death considered imported from DRC. The Bundibugyo strain has a 30-50% fatality rate; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists per WHO. WHO flags high risk in Sub-Saharan Africa, low global risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：東アフリカが疾病対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当する。複数国での確認例、死亡例、国際的拡大のリスク、地域的な管理体制強化の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているとおり、DRCで363確認例と62死亡例が発生しており、ウガンダへの越境例15例（死亡1例）が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。8つの東アフリカ共同体加盟国の保健大臣による緊急協議と地域的対応強化が進行中であり、この報告は地域レベルの対応を記述しているが、実際の患者発生国はDRCが主。Bundibugyo株の致命率は30-50%で、ワクチンや特異的治療がない。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Congo, a radio station tries to stop health misinformation
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola is spreading in eastern Congo's Ituri province, centered in Bunia. The outbreak was declared May 15; by June 3, 2026, at least 62 people had died and 363 cases were confirmed. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, hindering containment. The response is complicated by misinformation, mistrust of health services, and attacks on health centers amid fighting with M23 rebels and the ISIS-affiliated Allied Democratic Force, which killed 16 in Beni territory. Displacement has risen with the conflict. To counter rumors, Radio Télévision Mont Bleu in Bunia launched a daily 45-minute program at 10 a.m. featuring health experts and audience calls, led by Vérité Johnson. Analysts urge involving local actors to build trust, noting rumors of profiteering and vaccine fears. The true scale remains uncertain due to testing delays for the wrong virus type.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大する中、ラジオ局が保健医療の誤情報に対抗しようとしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常な病態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。進行中の大規模エボラ流行であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo-type Ebola流行。2026年6月3日時点で363確定患者、62死亡。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため対応が困難。武装勢力（M23、ADF）の活動による医療施設への攻撃、住民の不信、誤情報が封じ込めを複雑化。検査遅延により実際の患者数が不明。国際的支援の強い必要性あり。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Accelerating the Fight Against Ebola: Latest Vaccine and Treatment Innovations Unveiled - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Ebola vaccines and treatments are advancing across multiple platforms. The WHO highlights IAVI's candidate vaccine (Ervebo-like technology) as the most promising; the rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine could enter clinical trials in 7–9 months, while the ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo vaccine from Oxford University and Serum Institute could be ready faster, with animal data to confirm suitability and trials in the UK and US. Moderna's mRNA vaccine is not on the WHO list, though CEPI has committed up to $50 million for preclinical and early testing. Three potential Bundibugyo treatments show promise: MBP134, Maftivimab monoclonal antibodies, and remdesivir. The Partners trial will evaluate these drugs in patients in the DRC and Uganda, focusing on safety and operational feasibility. For the first time, trials will test a prevention drug given to contacts; obdeldesivir showed up to 100% protection in monkeys when given within 24 hours for 10 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス対策の加速：最新ワクチンおよび治療法のイノベーション発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラワクチン・治療法の開発進展に関する記事で、DRCとウガンダでの臨床試験計画が述べられている。ただし、新規患者発生やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、医療介入の研究開発段階の情報であるため、現在のアクティブなエボラ危機を示すものではない。予防的医療対策の進展として注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は新規のエボラ患者発生やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、ワクチン・治療開発の進展と臨床試験計画についての報道である。DRCとウガンダでの試験実施が計画されているが、現在のアクティブな疾病伝播を示す情報は含まれていない。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有。国際的な医療対策進展として監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC 20 jours après : 381 cas confirmés, taux de létalité autour de 17 %, le gouvernement note des progrès dans la riposte, l'amélioration du diagnostic et du traçage des cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC 20 days later: 381 confirmed cases, case-fatality rate around 17%, the government notes progress in the response, improvements in diagnosis and case tracing.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 20 days after declaration, with 381 confirmed cases and 63 deaths (case-fatality ~17%). About 233 patients are hospitalized in treatment centers (confirmed or suspected). The outbreak spans 25 health zones: 17 in Ituri, 7 in North Kivu, 1 in South Kivu. Diagnostic capacity has improved: false negatives under 2%, testing near 100% of samples, aided by more than 4,000 Africa CDC kits; a Mongbwalu laboratory now delivers 24-hour results. Contact tracing has risen from about 9% to 55.5%, with a goal of 90% coverage. As of 15 May 2026, the outbreak began in Ituri and spread to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; WHO declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak involves a rare Ebola virus strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment in a fragile, insecure region facing malnutrition and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: RDC のエボラ：宣言から 20 日後、381 人の確定症例、致死率約 17%、政府は対応の進展、診断と接触者追跡の改善を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数州に拡大する活動的なエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: WHO により PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言済み。381 確定症例、致死率 17%、複数州（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu）にまたがる。希少なエボラウイルス株で、ワクチン・特異的治療がない。脆弱地域での発生。継続的な国際的監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ngành tôm trước làn sóng dịch bệnh đa tác nhân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The shrimp industry faces a wave of multifactorial disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's brackish-water shrimp sector faces a multifactorial disease wave driven by four pathogens: EHP, WSSV, AHPND, and Translucent Post-Larvae Disease (TPD). Climate-driven water variability fuels co-infections, complicating diagnosis and control. EHP remains the concern, with infection rates around 25–34% in the Mekong Delta and 11–27% in northern provinces such as Hà Tĩnh and Ninh Bình, impairing digestion and growth by parasitizing the hepatopancreas and gut; transmission occurs via shrimp feces and bottom mud. WSSV outbreaks intensified in 2025–2026, particularly February–May in northern provinces (Hà Tĩnh, Ninh Bình, Hưng Yên), causing mortality. AHPND—Vibrio strains carrying PirA/PirB toxins—has been detected in Ca Mau and in Quảng Trị and Ninh Bình (April–August). TPD affects PL4–PL7 post-larvae and links to Vibrio with vhvp1/2/3 genes across Thanh Hóa, Ninh Bình, Quảng Ninh, Ca Mau, and Cần Thơ. The sector covers 740,000 ha, yields over 1.2 million tons annually, and exports $3.5–4 billion; experts urge proactive prevention over reactive measures.

triage.headline_ja: エビ産業が多因性疾病の波に直面
triage.triage_reason: ビブリオ症（AHPND）を含む複数の病原体によるエビの多発感染症がベトナム全域で報告されており、経済的影響が大きい（年間輸出額35-40億ドル）。動物衛生上の重要なシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ビブリオ症（AHPND）はカ・マウ州、クアン・チ州、ニン・ビン省で検出されている。記事は動物への影響を中心としているが、ベトナムの主要な経済産業（エビ養殖740,000ha、年間120万トン超）への脅威として政策的関心が高い。複数の水系病原体の同時流行は水産食品供給チェーンへの潜在的影響を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Congo criticises Spain after Chile friendly cancelled over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s pre-World Cup friendly with Chile, scheduled for 9 June in La Linea de la Concepcion, was cancelled by Spanish authorities over Ebola concerns tied to the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in Central Africa. Local health officials advised against hosting the match on public health grounds. DR Congo, training in Belgium in a health bubble ahead of the tournament, said none of the 26 players is based in Kinshasa or had traveled there from the country; some staff and possibly fans may have. DR Congo’s Minister of Communication Patrick Muyaya lamented the decision, calling it discriminatory. The World Health Organization participated in a virtual briefing; Ebola is described as a severe, often fatal illness, transmitted from wild animals to humans and spread through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated surfaces. The cancellation disrupts DR Congo’s World Cup preparations amid the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ懸念でチリとの親善試合中止後にスペインを非難
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の発生報告があり、国際的な影響（スポーツイベント中止）が生じているが、実際の人的被害や疾病発生の詳細情報が不足しており、記事の主題は試合中止の政治的反応である。
triage.notes: 記事はスペインの友好試合中止とコンゴ政府の反応が主題だが、中央アフリカにおけるBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの発生が背景にある。実際のケース数、死者数、患者の詳細情報、WHO報告内容の具体性が記事に記載されていないため、フルRRA前に続報の確認が必要。発生地域にスペイン、チリ、ベルギーが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは試合がスペイン領土で予定されていただけで、実際の発生はDRCとその周辺地域に限定されている。対象国リストに含まれる国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Teyitli Ebola Vaka Sayısı 381'e Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 381.
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 381 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 63 deaths, with about 233 patients still in isolation awaiting results or receiving care. Test capacity has surged thanks to more than 4,000 test kits from Africa CDC and international support, enabling results within 24 hours for nearly all samples. Contact tracing has risen from roughly 9% at outbreak onset to 55%, with a target of 90% to identify contacts and better forecast new cases.
