The outbreak was declared on May 15 in the eastern provinces; intensified testing, isolation, treatment, and contact tracing have followed, and the WHO has declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Across the border, Uganda reports 16 confirmed cases, including 1 new case confirmed on Thursday.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での確認されたエボラ症例数が381件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、既にWHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダでの症例確認）と渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも16症例が報告されているが、発生地域リストにウガンダが含まれていても対象国リストにはないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。WHOが既にPHEIC宣言済みであり、マルチカントリー(DRC+ウガンダ)の拡大イベントとして重要。

article.articleHeadline: जयपुर एयरपोर्ट पर इबोला का अलर्ट, युगांडा से आई महिला में मिले संदिग्ध लक्षण!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert at Jaipur Airport, suspected symptoms detected in a woman who arrived from Uganda!
article.articleSummary: Jaipur Airport flagged a suspected Ebola case after a foreign woman arriving from Uganda on an Air Arabia flight via Sharjah displayed Ebola-like symptoms during routine screening on 2026-06-05. She was moved to RUHS Hospital in Jaipur and admitted to a dedicated Ebola care block in isolation, with stable health. Samples have been sent to a Pune laboratory for confirmatory testing, with results expected by Saturday to determine whether it is Ebola or another illness. Hospital officials caution that symptoms alone cannot confirm Ebola. Rajasthan health authorities have intensified airport screening and coordination under international health protocols. If confirmed, this would represent an imported Ebola case; health authorities continue monitoring as laboratory confirmation awaits.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプール空港でエボラ警報、ウガンダから到着した女性に疑わしい症状を検出！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の3つに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確定検査待ちだが、エボラの可能性がある輸入症例として検出されたため、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にジャイプール（ラージャスターン州、インド）での検知を主題としており、ウガンダから輸入された可能性が高い。Bluedotが付与した複数地域のうち、実際の発生地はインドのみ。UAEのシャルジャは経由地であり、発症地ではない。確定検査の結果が土曜日に予定されており、確定後は迅速なWHO通知が必要となる見込み。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique du Sud : Ebola et migration au cœur de la visite de William Ruto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Africa: Ebola and Migration at the Heart of William Ruto's Visit.
article.articleSummary: During a state visit to South Africa, Kenyan President William Ruto addressed the ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and in Uganda. Congolese authorities report 60 deaths among 344 cases; Uganda has 15 confirmed cases and 1 death. Ruto defended plans to establish an Ebola quarantine center in Kenya with U.S. support, noting Washington's provision of about 1.8 billion Kenyan shillings for health infrastructure and a dedicated facility that could be used if American citizens or forces require it. In Pretoria, South African President Cyril Ramaphosa spoke on migration amid xenophobic violence, saying envoys would be sent and that Africa must coordinate with global partners to address migration challenges. He added Africa should learn from others’ experiences, stressing cross-continental collaboration rather than isolating responses.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカ：ウィリアム・ルト大統領の訪問の中心となるエボラと移民
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行が東部コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで確認されており、死亡者60名を含む344症例が報告されている。国際的な拡大リスク（ケニアの隔離センター設立、米国の支援）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たしている。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は東部コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダで発生しており、記事サマリーの主題。南アフリカは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。ケニアの隔離センター設立計画と米国の支援が言及されているが、ケニアも対象国外。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の両方で複数該当する重大事象。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UKHSA urges GPs to be alert to signs of Ebola - KMA Updates
article.articleSummary: UKHSA warns GPs to look for Ebola in acutely unwell patients with recent travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) or Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the DRC exceeds 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; WHO says country risk is very high and outbreak hard to contain due to late detection, conflict, and weak healthcare systems. UK risk remains low; Ebola cases in the UK are rare. Ebola spreads via direct contact with body fluids or contaminated materials; incubation 2–21 days. Guidance: isolate suspected patients immediately, minimize contact, seek local infection specialist advice, and arrange transfer. Consider Ebola in feverish patients with recent DRC/Uganda travel within 21 days; urgently investigate malaria as an alternative per ACDP VHF risk algorithm. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo strain yet; three vaccines are in development, including one from the Oxford Vaccine Group. Ebola and other VHFs are notifiable in the UK.

triage.headline_ja: UKHSA、エボラウイルスの兆候に注意を呼びかけ - KMA Updates
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、アフリカでの大規模流行（1,000以上の患者、246人の死亡）とUK内での警戒発令が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（民主共和国コンゴ）およびウガンダでのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。UK への警戒呼びかけは予防的措置であり、UK 国内での発症事例ではない。WHO が「国のリスクは非常に高い」と評価し、ワクチン開発中の新興ウイルス株である点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di Kongo Meluas dan Tantangan Penanganan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Kongo spread and management challenges
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in Congo’s Ituri province have spread to the Rimba health zone, the 17th in Ituri and the 25th nationwide, indicating active community transmission. The National Public Health Institute of Kongo reports 363 confirmed Ebola cases and 62 deaths, all linked to the Bundibugyo variant. On 2 June, authorities announced 19 additional confirmed cases. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said transmission is rapidly moving but being guided by the Congo government to contain it. MSF deputy operations director Dr. Alan Gonzalez warned that field responses lag behind the virus’s spread. In response, Congo’s Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba stressed that past outbreak experience equips medical teams, asserting that they know which steps to take and that they successfully controlled Ebola last year.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が拡大し、対応上の課題が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大、高い致死率、複数地域への地理的拡大、国際的な対応支援が必要な公衆衛生上の重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州での活発な感染拡大を記述。アンゴラはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは主要な発症地域として言及されていないため除外。WHO事務局長やMSF等の国際機関による関心表明あり。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة للبلدان الأمريكية تعزز الاستعدادات لمواجهة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pan American Health Organization strengthens preparations to confront the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, PAHO (Pan American Health Organization) is intensifying efforts to help countries in the Americas bolster Ebola preparedness, despite low regional risk. The agency activated its Emergency Operations Management System and is coordinating with national health ministries to strengthen surveillance, testing, and infection prevention and control to enable rapid detection and response. It is preparing shipments of materials and molecular diagnostic reagents for the Ebola Bundibugyo strain to be sent to selected countries based on risk assessments. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Bundibugyo. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, with 116 suspected cases under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: 汎米保健機関がエボラウイルスに対する対策準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のWHO PHEIC宣言があり、DRCで既に344確認患者・60死亡が報告されている。IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEICは必ずピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）宣言が出されており、DRCでのエボラ患者確認と死亡が既に報告されている。記事はPAHOの米州地域への対策強化を述べているが、実際のイベント発生地はDRCであり、対象国リストに該当する。スペイン（カナリア諸島）への記述があるが、記事サマリーでの対策準備の主題はDRCのエボラ事案であり、スペインは単なる報道地ではない記述がないため検証されない。

article.articleHeadline: Hantaviruses
article.articleSummary: Hantaviruses are worldwide, rodent-borne viruses causing two major human syndromes: haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS). Transmission occurs via inhalation of aerosolised rodent excreta; human-to-human transmission is very rare and has been reported only with Andes hantavirus, which in the UK is classified as an airborne high-consequence infectious disease. Globally, 10,000–100,000 hantavirus infections occur annually, with most cases in East Asia and Northern Europe; the Americas see fewer but often more severe disease. Seoul virus has been detected in UK pet rats, with occasional wild rats; overall public risk is very low. South America records more activity than North America (Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Ecuador, Paraguay, Panama, Uruguay, Venezuela). HCPS is rare in the Americas, about 300 cases/year; incubation 14–17 days; prodrome fever/myalgias, headaches, dry cough and GI symptoms; progression to cardiopulmonary disease can occur.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス
triage.triage_reason: UK政府の公開情報ページであり、既知の感染症の一般的な情報提供。新規のアウトブレイクイベントではなく、流行中の具体的発生地域の報告もない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが取得した発生地域リストは極めて広大であり、記事サマリーを精査すると、これはハンタウイルスに関する一般的な疾患情報であり、進行中のアウトブレイクイベント情報ではない。サマリーで言及されている国（東アジア、北欧、南米など）は背景情報として述べられているのみ。ソースがUK政府の公開ガイダンスであることから、シグナル検知の対象ではない。verified_locationsはサマリーで具体的に地域名が挙げられている対象国のみを列挙（China、Brazil）。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's traditional healers are on the front line of Ebola fight
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Ebola continues to drive an outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, at the outbreak’s center. Traditional healer Mariam Kabika is depicted in her Bunia garden gathering eucalyptus, avocado, mango, and papaya leaves to use in treating Ebola, highlighting the role of local practitioners on the front lines of the response alongside formal health workers. The piece emphasizes Ituri’s fragility—an area ravaged by decades of conflict, where state services are largely absent—shaping community engagement and access to care. The article describes Ebola as a deadly virus spreading in the region and notes the ongoing outbreak, but provides no specific case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or explicit infection sources beyond the broad context.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの伝統療法師がエボラ対策の最前線に立つ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。東部DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク継続中であり、既知の流行地での動向報道だが、伝統療法師の役割という新たな対応課題を浮き彫りにしており、フルRRA実施の価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の東部DRC（Ituri州Bunia）エボラアウトブレイク継続を報道。伝統療法師の関与という対応面での新たな側面が強調されている。具体的な新規感染例数、確認死亡数の記載がないが、「deadly virus spreading」と表現され深刻性が認識されている。紛争地帯での脆弱な保健システムと伝統医療の交差点という文脈が管理可能性の課題を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO and Africa CDC declare the 2026 Ebola disease outbreak a public health emergency
article.articleSummary: 129 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, 1077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths as of May 27, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, linked to Bundibugyo virus (Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense). The outbreak, ongoing in mining and commercial corridors and conflict-affected zones, poses cross-border risks and is considered a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by WHO and a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS) by Africa CDC. No medical countermeasures exist for Bundibugyo virus. A coordinated response is led by the Incident Management Support Team under One Team, One Plan, One Budget, and One Monitoring and Evaluation Framework, emphasizing rapid surveillance and immediate isolation, decentralised diagnostics, infection prevention and control, safe and dignified burials, regular handwashing, and avoidance of direct contact with symptomatic individuals and sick or dead animals. Accelerated research and development for vaccines, therapeutics, and diagnostics is urgently needed.

triage.headline_ja: WHOおよびアフリカCDCが2026年エボラ出血熱の流行を公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例129例、疑い症例1077例、疑い死亡246例でPHEIC/PHECS宣言済み。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、国際的な緊急対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はBundibugyo virus（Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense）に起因。PHEIC/PHECS宣言済み。医療対抗手段が存在しない。鉱業・商業回廊および紛争地帯での流行であり、国境を越えたリスクが高い。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため検証済みロケーションには含めていません。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Congo, a radio station tries to stop health misinformation
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare strain, is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia. Congolese authorities declared the outbreak on May 15. By June 3, 2026, officials reported 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths. The outbreak took locals by surprise after weeks of spreading unnoticed, with many dismissing the news as a Western conspiracy. Skepticism, attacks on health workers, and widespread misinformation have complicated response efforts. A local radio station is working to counter misinformation and inform residents about the evolving situation. The report underscores the tension between urgent public health action and public distrust, highlighting the challenge of containing transmission amid misinformation and security concerns for health personnel.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大する中、ラジオ局が健康に関する誤った情報を止めようと努力している
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola（稀な株）の大規模発生でIHR基準4項目全て該当。DRC内での362確認例・62死亡、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株は稀な株であり、2026年6月3日時点で363例の確認例と62死亡が報告されている。現地での医療従事者への攻撃、誤った情報、市民の不信感により対応が複雑化している。国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク・管理可能性に懸念あり。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Two Sent to Gandhi Hospital Over Missing Yellow Fever Records
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, in the early hours, two travelers arriving at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport in Shamshabad, Hyderabad, were shifted to Gandhi Hospital due to missing yellow fever vaccination documentation. The Sudanese student studying at a Hyderabad private university and a contact person were examined at the airport; discrepancies surfaced in vaccination records. Apollo Hospital doctors facilitated the transfer to Gandhi Hospital, where both individuals are in stable condition with no reported health complications. Yellow fever certificates are mandatory for travellers from endemic countries under international health regulations; officials are monitoring and following standard public health procedures to verify vaccination status and assess import-related infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: イエローフィーバー予防接種記録不備でガンジー病院に搬送された2名
triage.triage_reason: イエローフィーバーの入国検疫事例であり、予防接種記録の不備が検出されたが、現時点では確定患者ではなく、両名が安定した状態であるため。情報の詳細な拡大リスク評価は継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: スーダン国籍の学生が関与しており、スーダンもIHR上のイエローフィーバー流行国として関連がある。ただし記事の主題は、インド・ハイデラバードの入国検疫における予防接種記録の不備であり、実際のイエローフィーバー感染例（confirmed case）ではなく、行政的な検証プロセスの段階。両名が安定状態であることから重症度は低い。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lotus Care Jadi Layanan Unggulan untuk Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lotus Care Becomes a Flagship Service for Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Lotus Care has become the flagship tuberculosis service at Puskesmas Kecamatan Matraman in Utan Kayu Selatan, East Jakarta. Inaugurated on 5 June 2026 by Governor Pramono Anung, the facility showcases Lotus Care for TB alongside Taman Asri for nutrition, Seruni for psychology, and Flamboyan for elderly, pregnant women, and child growth monitoring. The four-story center provides 24-hour emergency and maternity services, Free Health Checks (CKG), and the Integrated Primary Service, serving about 182,809 residents in Matraman with 134,078 registered participants and an average daily patient load of roughly 500 in 2025. Jakarta's provincial government aims to enhance quality across 44 sub-district puskesmas and 292 puskesmas pembantu, maintaining health and education budgets amid economic challenges.

triage.headline_ja: ロータスケアが結核の旗艦サービスとなる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核対策施設の開設式典に関する政策・行政ニュースであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な症例集積、または公衆衛生危機を報じていない。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタにおける結核専門サービス施設（Lotus Care）の開設式典を報じている。新規患者の急増、異常な発症パターン、公衆衛生上の緊急事態は記述されておらず、むしろ既存の結核管理体制の施設化と改善を示すポジティブなニュースである。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo: la Fondation Virunga installe des postes de dépistage dans le parc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo: The Virunga Foundation installs screening posts in the park.
article.articleSummary: Five Ebola screening posts have been installed by the Virunga Foundation along Virunga National Park's main travel corridors to help curb the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak declared on May 15, 2026. The 300-kilometer park sits at the heart of the affected zone, with two-thirds of its area and most staff operating in affected areas, effectively forming a network of checkpoints for travelers exiting the outbreak region. Each post is funded at 17,000 GBP, with the foundation noting that a single station could screen thousands of people per day over a six-month period. Confirmed cases have reached Goma in the Democratic Republic of Congo and western Uganda; there is no vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain. The report emphasizes park-based surveillance and cross-border risk rather than clinical management.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ：ビルンガ財団が公園内にスクリーニングポストを設置
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の確認事例がDRC及びウガンダで報告され、IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。ワクチン未開発かつ国境を越えた感染リスクが存在。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたブンディブギョエボラアウトブレイク。確認事例がゴマ（DRC）およびウガンダ西部に到達。記事はウガンダを提及していますが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。ビルンガ国立公園（300km）が発生地域の中心に位置し、越境感染リスク高。ワクチン未開発という重大なリスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat's Asiatic lion health scare eases, but fresh lioness death raises questions
article.articleSummary: Health scare among Asiatic lions in Gujarat's Gir landscape linked to suspected Babesia and CVD-related infections appears to be subsiding. About eight cubs died in two weeks in the Babaria region (western Gir) and Jasadhar range (eastern forest division), prompting a rapid government response. As of 5 June 2026, 17 lions showing symptoms or under close monitoring were relocated to dedicated care facilities: seven at Jasadhar and ten at Jamwala. Veterinary teams from Sasan, along with Vantara specialists in Jamnagar, and senior forest officials conducted around-the-clock rescue and treatment, with signs of improvement among the affected animals. The episode highlights ongoing challenges of disease surveillance and wildlife health management in Gir, the world’s only natural habitat of Asiatic lions, and led to high-level oversight as Forest Minister Arjun Modhwadia reviewed Jamwala and Jasadhar Animal Care Centres.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州のアジアライオン健康危機は緩和も、新たなライオネスの死亡で懸念が再燃
triage.triage_reason: 本件はバベシア症の野生動物（アジアライオン）での感染事例であり、人獣共通感染症としての公衆衛生的脅威や国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の直接的リスクは明確でない。影響範囲は野生動物に限定され、ヒト感染の記載がなく、感染症危機管理の対象外と判定される。
triage.notes: 本件は野生動物（アジアライオン）における疾病事例であり、ヒト健康への直接的な脅威が記事サマリーには記載されていない。バベシア症は人獣共通感染症であるが、本記事はあくまで野生動物集団の健康管理問題として扱われており、ヒト感染症危機としてのシグナルではない。野生動物衛生の領域となり、感染症危機管理・バイオセキュリティの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: New vaccines will blunt the impact of future Ebola outbreaks, scientists say | The National
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains active in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 344 cases and 60 deaths; Uganda reports 15 cases and 1 death. The Bundibugyo strain drives current transmission, outbreak identified last month with suspected origin dating to January. WHO notes a decline in suspected cases this week, from over 1,000 to 116, with many infections testing negative. A vaccine push for Bundibugyo is intensifying: three candidate vaccines are under development, with Moderna, IAVI, University of Oxford, and production by Serum Institute of India; Cepi has committed up to $50 million to support Moderna’s vaccine, and partners total over $60 million for Bundibugyo vaccines. The only approved vaccine is for the Zaire strain; no vaccine exists for Sudan. mRNA platforms could be adapted in roughly two weeks for new strains, potentially limiting future outbreaks, though distribution remains challenging in rural, conflict-affected areas and amid mistrust toward health workers and clinics.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいワクチンが将来のエボラ出血熱の流行を緩和するだろうと科学者は述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。対象地域DRCとウガンダでの確認症例と進行中の流行が報告されており、新規ワクチン開発への国際的対応が社会的関心を集めている。
triage.notes: Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの継続的な流行（344症例、60死亡）とウガンダでの二次感染報告は確認されるが、インドは発生地域に含まれても記事サマリー上は「Serum Institute of India」のワクチン生産パートナーとしての言及のみで、インドでの実際の発生は報告されていない。ただしBluedot APIが India を発生地域として判定しているため、念のため included。実質的な患者発生は DRC に限定される可能性が高い。Bundibugyo 株によるエボラ・ウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le taux de traçage atteint 55,5 %, objectif 90 % (Ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: the contact tracing rate has reached 55.5%, the target is 90% (Minister of Health) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) as of 5 June 2026: contact tracing of identified contacts has reached 55.5%, with a 90% target set to better anticipate new cases and limit spread. Early tracing was below 9%. Authorities emphasize contact tracing as a key lever to interrupt transmission, with very-high-risk contacts under intensified follow-up and possible preventive isolation. The outbreak remains confined to three provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter (~95% of cases), Nord-Kivu reporting 19 confirmed cases, and Sud-Kivu 3. Overall, 25 health zones are affected: 17 in Ituri, 7 in Nord-Kivu, and 1 in Sud-Kivu. Twenty days after the official declaration, officials say the situation is being contained within these three provinces and no cases have been reported elsewhere, as they push toward the 90% tracing target.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：接触者追跡率が55.5%に達し、目標は90%（保健大臣）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という極度に危険な感染症の確認された流行。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響が明白である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行。6月5日時点で確認症例数は不明だが、3州（イトゥリが約95%、ノルドキブが19例、南キブが3例）にわたり25保健区が影響。接触者追跡率55.5%で目標90%。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Urgent call for an Ebola truce in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Urgent call for an Ebola truce in DR Congo to accelerate outbreak response and humanitarian access. Published 2026-06-05. A broad, international coalition of researchers and public health institutions—including KU Leuven (Belgium), Makerere University (Uganda), Heidelberg Institute of Global Health (Germany), Université Catholique de Bukavu (DR Congo), UCL Institute for Global Health (UK), Rwanda Biomedical Centre, LMU Munich, Institut Pasteur networks (Paris and Dakar), WHO, LSHTM, ISGlobal, and partners across Europe, Africa and beyond—issues the appeal. The statement seeks a ceasefire to enable safe delivery of medical care, outbreak response operations, and cross-border coordination in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The article does not provide concrete case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱に関する緊急停戦要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への影響が極めて深刻であり、国際的な専門家連合による緊急アピールは異常・予想外の対応である。IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はThe Lancetに掲載された査読済み論文であり、国際的な高名な研究機関・公衆衛生機関による共同声明。具体的な患者数や検査確認情報は提供されていないが、コンゴ民主共和国での紛争地帯でのエボラ対応に関する緊急呼びかけであるため、進行中の重大イベントとして捉えられる。発生地域にはDRC南基路州ブカブが含まれ、国際的な人道支援アクセスと防疫対応の障害が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: أميركا: إيبولا سيحرم الكونغو من المونديال.. والمياه قد تصبح سلاحاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: America: Ebola will deprive Congo of the World Cup... and water could become a weapon.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has prompted integrated security and public-health planning ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup across the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The expanded tournament spans 11 host cities, features 48 teams and 104 matches, across 16 venues in North America, with 625 million dollars in federal security funding to bolster law enforcement and services. World Cup officials emphasize cross-jurisdictional intelligence sharing to detect broader threat patterns and manage heat and crowds. The Ebola outbreak has led the Democratic Republic of Congo team to cancel a training camp in Kinshasa; officials warned players who have been in the DRC within the last 21 days should not join camps, to avoid potential travel restrictions if symptoms arise. Separately, discussions consider banning refillable water bottles from venues to prevent weapons, while ensuring safe access to drinking water. No case counts were provided.

triage.headline_ja: 米国: エボラがコンゴをワールドカップから奪うだろう...水が兵器になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生自体は深刻だが、記事の主題は2026年ワールドカップの警備対策であり、具体的な症例数や保健上の直接的な脅威の詳細が不明。スクリーニング基準1項目該当するが情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ発生自体よりも、2026年ワールドカップ開催国（北米）における警備・公衆衛生対策を主に論じている。DRC内での発生実績は述べられているが、具体的な患者数・死亡数・拡大動向の詳細が記載されていない。ウガンダの記載があるが、サマリーではDRCに焦点が当たっており、検証対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため含めない。記事の日付が2026年6月となっているが、これは未来日付であり、シミュレーション記事の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: പകർച്ചവ്യാധികൾക്കും വൈറസ് വകഭേദങ്ങൾക്കുമെതിരെ എഐ വാക്സിൻ | AI vaccine against pandemics and virus variants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AI vaccine against infectious diseases and virus variants
article.articleSummary: London researchers report that an artificial intelligence–designed vaccine component has entered human testing, marking the first time an AI-engineered antigen targeted against current and potential coronavirus threats has been evaluated in people. Cambridge University scientists used AI to analyze the genetic makeup of existing and animal coronaviruses, producing a 'super antigen' intended to elicit immunity against all COVID-19 variants and other related coronaviruses with pandemic potential. In the first-in-human phase, 39 healthy volunteers were assessed for safety; following favorable safety results, about 200 more participants will be enrolled to measure the strength and duration of the immune response. Separately, animal studies are progressing on a universal flu vaccine and an H5N1 vaccine, while consideration is being given to Ebola vaccines for active Congo outbreaks where vaccines are not yet available. Oxford Vaccine Group Director Andrew Pollard and Cambridge virologist Jonathan Heeney emphasize that AI could accelerate vaccine design.

triage.headline_ja: AI vaccine against infectious diseases and virus variants（感染症とウイルス変異株に対するAIワクチン）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発の進展報告であり、実際の感染症の集団発生や流行を報告していない。記事は研究段階の進捗（臨床試験開始）を述べており、公衆衛生上の急性リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれるが、記事本文でDRC内での感染症イベント発生を直接報告していない。DRC内のエボラアウトブレイク言及は仮定的な参考例に過ぎず、本記事の主題はロンドン・ケンブリッジでのワクチン開発進捗である。従ってシグナル該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Another Sudanese national isolated at Hyderabad hospital over suspected Ebola symptoms
article.articleSummary: Second Sudanese national isolated in Hyderabad on suspected Ebola symptoms as of 5 June 2026. A student at Gandhi Hospital is under observation; key Ebola signs have not been reported. Blood, urine and swab samples have been collected and sent to designated laboratories, with results expected within two days. If negative, the patient will enter home isolation and monitoring; if positive, treatment and containment will be initiated immediately. Gandhi Hospital is Telangana's nodal centre for Ebola preparedness, with a facility of 10 isolated rooms and 15 quarantine beds for use. Screening and thermal scanning continue at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport for arrivals from African countries, including Sudan, Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. Earlier this week, 58 passengers from Ebola-affected countries landed in Hyderabad; none symptomatic but placed under Category-I surveillance and advised 21-day home isolation. No Ebola case has been confirmed in Hyderabad so far; measures reflect standard surveillance and containment.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード病院でエボラ疑い症状の別のスーダン国籍者が隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い事例が報告されているが、検査結果は未確定であり、主要なエボラ兆候は報告されていない。対象国のインドで検査中の疑い患者が1例あり、情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はハイデラバード（テランガナ州、インド）での疑い患者報告が主題。DRC、ウガンダ、スーダンは空港スクリーニング対象国として言及されているが、実際の発生地はインドのみ。検査結果未確定であり、確定例ではない。スーダンはデータに含まれているが対象国リストにないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Recul d'Ebola en RD Congo, pourvoi rejeté pour Gleizes, prison à vie pour Ghannouchi : l'hebdo Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Decline of Ebola in the DRC, Gleizes' appeal rejected, life sentence for Ghannouchi: Africa Weekly
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a strong decline in reported probable Ebola cases per a World Health Organization briefing, signaling containment in the outbreak's epicenter. The only airport granting humanitarian access to that epicenter reopened on Tuesday, improving aid delivery and surveillance. Ivory Coast (Côte d'Ivoire) authorities have confirmed a virulent Ugandan-origin strain of a virus affecting cassava (manioc) in western plantations, a development that threatens national cassava production and livelihoods. The finding mobilizes government agencies and industry professionals to intensify monitoring, crop protection measures, and contingency planning to mitigate potential crop losses. Together, these notes reflect ongoing public health and agricultural challenges across the region, with Ebola in the DRC and cassava virus in Ivory Coast as the prominent disease-focused items of the week.

triage.headline_ja: RD コンゴでエボラが減少、Gleizes の控訴が棄却、Ghannouchi に終身刑：アフリカ週刊ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR 基準 2 つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響と異常・予想外の事象）し、エボラウイルス病という国際的に高リスクな疾患の発生である。DRC での流行の沈静化は肯定的だが、依然として重大な監視対象。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC でのエボラの減少傾向が報告されており、流行の沈静化を示唆している。ウガンダとコートジボワールも地域で言及されているが、記事の主要な感染症イベント（エボラ）は DRC における発生であるため、verified_locations は DRC のみとした。コートジボワールのキャッサバウイルスは植物病害であり、本評価の対象外としている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A

article.articleHeadline: മഴയോടൊപ്പം രോഗങ്ങളും വരും; ഇക്കാര്യങ്ങൾ ശ്രദ്ധിച്ചാൽ പകർച്ചവ്യാധികൾ ഒഴിവാക്കാം... | With the rain comes diseases; if you pay attention to these things, you can avoid epidemics...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With the rain comes diseases; if you pay attention to these things, infectious diseases can be prevented.
article.articleSummary: Kozhikode, Kerala, the rainy season heightens infectious disease risk as contaminated water and mosquito breeding intensify. Waterborne illnesses include cholera, vomiting and diarrhea with nausea, typhoid, and other febrile gastroenteric infections. The article also lists vector-borne/zoonotic diseases such as plague, chikungunya, elephantiasis (lymphatic filariasis), Japanese encephalitis, swine flu, malaria, yellow fever, West Nile fever, Rift Valley fever, meningitis including St. Louis encephalitis. Transmission stems from polluted drinking water, stagnant water, poor sanitation, and unsafe food handling. Preventive measures emphasize personal and environmental hygiene, boiling water, safe cooking, protective clothing, mosquito protection, and mask/glove use by caregivers, plus maintaining hand and surface cleanliness. Vulnerable groups—children, elderly, pregnant women—and individuals with asthma, allergies, cancer, or diabetes require extra precautions. Practical steps include a weekly dry day, proper waste disposal, keeping homes clean, releasing guppy fish in water bodies to curb mosquitoes, and covering coughs and sneezes.

triage.headline_ja: 雨の季節には病気も来る。これらのことに注意すれば感染症を避けられる
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症が列挙されているが、記事の主要内容は雨季の一般的な感染症リスク啓発であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州コジコード地域における雨季の感染症リスク啓発記事。複数疾患が言及されているが、新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく季節的予防啓発の性質。具体的な患者数・死亡者数・新規症例報告などの根拠がないため不明評価とした。ただし雨季における水系感染症・蚊媒介感染症の長期曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行易感性（epidemic_prone）は該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Reports Attack on Ebola Burial Team as Outbreak Expands Across Eastern Provinces | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, Congo's health ministry said residents in Katana, South Kivu, an area controlled by AFC/M23 rebels, assaulted a safe and dignified burial team responsible for Ebola case handling, forcing responders to abandon a coffin. The team, trained to manage highly infectious bodies under strict protocols to prevent Ebola transmission, could not complete the safe burial. After the attack, community members reportedly handled the body themselves, a practice health officials say is highly risky because Ebola can pass via infected remains. The incident underscores security disruptions amid an Ebola outbreak expanding across eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱の埋葬チーム襲撃を報告 - 東部州全域での感染拡大の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中3項目該当（重症感染症、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも5項目中5項目該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、セキュリティ問題と埋葬儀式の中断による感染制御破綻は深刻。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC南キブ県カタナ地区での埋葬チーム襲撃事件とエボラ出血熱の東部州拡大を主題としている。セキュリティ問題（M23反政勢力支配地域）と感染制御の崩壊（不適切な埋葬処理）が相互作用し、急速な伝播リスクが極めて高い。フルRRA実施が緊急に必要。

article.articleHeadline: MP Gideon Kimaiyo raises concerns over uproar surrounding Ebola quarantine facility in Laikipia
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, Keiyo South MP Gideon Kimaiyo criticized protests surrounding the planned 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, describing the unrest as sponsored and noting Kenya already has 23 Ebola isolation facilities. The US-backed facility is intended primarily for Americans exposed to Ebola amid an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Kimaiyo argued protests are focused on Laikipia. In Parliament on June 3, 2026, Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale defended the government's Ebola preparedness, saying public consultation is not required before interventions under the Public Health Order and that the state has a constitutional and legal duty to act swiftly to protect Kenyans and travelers. He warned that delays could increase risk if Ebola were to enter Kenya, and stated Parliament would summon him if necessary.

triage.headline_ja: MP ギディオン・キマイヨ、ライキピア県のエボラ隔離施設周辺の騒動について懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は異常・予想外の事象（Yes）かつ国際的拡大リスク（DRC発生源、米国関連施設計画）があるが、ケニアでの実際の患者発生報告がなく、記事主焦点は施設計画への政治的反対であるため。情報不足で判定を留保。
triage.notes: 記事の主焦点はケニアのエボラ隔離施設計画への政治的抗議である。DRCでの発生源は明記されているが、ケニア国内での実患者発生報告がないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。米国施設計画の背景には DRC での進行中の流行が存在し、国際的な準備活動の側面を持つ。ケニアでの今後の患者発生報告があれば PICKUP に昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Second Sudanese traveller isolated in Hyderabad over Ebola scare
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, Hyderabad officials isolated a second Sudanese traveller amid heightened Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) surveillance. The passenger was referred to Gandhi Hospital after presenting symptoms requiring medical evaluation; samples have been collected and sent for testing while doctors monitor the condition. The case remains suspected and Ebola infection has not been confirmed. A day earlier, another Sudanese passenger with travel history to Ebola-affected regions was admitted to Gandhi Hospital’s isolation ward following thermal screening at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA); he was stable and not displaying typical Ebola symptoms. Telangana health authorities and airport officials have intensified surveillance, installing thermal screening at RGIA and closely monitoring arrivals from affected regions. Suspected cases are immediately referred for isolation, testing, and observation until laboratory results are obtained; Gandhi Hospital maintains an Ebola isolation centre. Public reassurance noted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行懸念でハイデラバードに隔離された2番目のスーダン人旅行者
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の疑い例が複数報告され、国際的な移動とサーベイランス強化が確認されているが、確定例がなく、情報不足のため経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: スーダンにおけるエボラ流行が背景にあり、疫学的関連があるが、インド国内での確定例はなく、現在は疑い例段階。IHR基準は2つ該当しWPRO基準も2つ該当しているが、確定例の不在と情報制限により、WATCH判定を適切と判断。続報で確定例の有無を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: दूषित पाण्यामुळे नवी मुंबईकरांचे आरोग्य धोक्यात, मुलांमध्ये वाढतेय संसर्गाची भीती, आरोग्य तज्ज्ञांची महत्त्वाची माहिती...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contaminated water endangers the health of Navi Mumbai residents; fear of infection rising among children; important information from health experts.
article.articleSummary: Contaminated water in parts of Navi Mumbai has raised infection fears, with residents reporting yellowish, turbid, discolored, and off-tasting supply since last week. Health experts warn contaminated water can harbor bacteria, viruses, or parasites, increasing risks of gastroenteritis, typhoid, hepatitis A, and other waterborne illnesses. Children and the elderly, and those with preexisting conditions, are most vulnerable. Currently, about 15 of 100 pediatric OPD patients present with water-related health problems, chiefly diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fever; dehydration can follow. Residents have filed complaints and called for inspection of the water supply and testing. Precautions include boiling water for at least 10 minutes, regular cleaning of home filters, hand hygiene, avoiding exposed fruits and street foods, and using oral rehydration solutions. Seek medical help for persistent symptoms or dehydration.

triage.headline_ja: 汚染水がナヴィ・ムンバイ住民の健康を危険にさらす。子どもの間で感染への恐怖が増加。保健専門家からの重要情報
triage.triage_reason: 複数の水系感染症（A型肝炎、チフス）が同時に報告され、すでに小児OPDの15%が水関連の健康問題を呈示。地域的に限定されているが、公衆衛生への影響は深刻で、住民の関心が高い。
triage.notes: インドのナヴィ・ムンバイにおける限定的な汚染水イベント。A型肝炎とチフスは両者ともIHR届出対象疾患。地域の供給水系統の汚染であるため、継続的な曝露リスクが高い。既に患児の約15%が症状を呈示しており、脆弱人口（小児、高齢者）への影響が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: A disease of deforestation: how Ebola is linked to the smartphone in your pocket
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda are increasingly tied to deforestation in the Congo Basin driven by artisanal mining for cobalt, gold and other minerals. The current outbreak began in early May 2026, with 363 confirmed cases in the DRC and has crossed into Uganda, reflecting the trajectory of prior large epidemics such as the 2014 West Africa outbreak that infected over 28,000 people across 10 countries. Ebola’s reservoir bats migrate through shrinking forests, and edge fragmentation or deep-forrest incursions bring humans into closer contact with viral material. An analysis links per‑cent forest loss to a 20–40% rise in Ebola incidence; 2024 saw a record loss of 1.5 million acres in the Congo Basin preceding Bundibugyo Ebola. Artisanal mining employs about 2 million in DRC, including 380,000 in eastern regions, intensifying forest disruption and exposure risk.

triage.headline_ja: 森林破壊の病気：あなたのポケットのスマートフォンとエボラの関連性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス（高致死性）、複数国への国際的拡大、363例の確診例と死亡リスクがあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生を述べているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は提供される対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙した。2026年5月初旬開始、DRC内363確診例、ウガンダへの越境確認。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus による流行であり、過去2014年西アフリカ流行規模との比較参照。鉱業由来の森林破壊が生態系接触増加とリスク上昇を促進する構造が識別された。国際対応と外部支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Научници од САД се обиделе да прошверцуваат опасен вирус од Африка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American scientists attempted to smuggle a dangerous virus out of Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two US-based virologists, Vincent Munster of Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, and Claude Kwe, were charged in Detroit federal court with smuggling ampoules containing inactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus from the Republic of Congo to the United States and making false statements at Detroit's Metropolitan Airport after returning from Paris and a nine-day stay in Congo. They traveled with deactivated mpox material without declaring it or obtaining the required permits. FBI tests later confirmed the presence of the inactivated mpox virus on the ampoules; Munster allegedly claimed the documents were on his laptop and not needed, a statement the FBI deemed potentially materially false. NIH said it is cooperating with authorities. The case underscores public health risk of importing biological materials and is set against mpox outbreaks in Central Africa with over 2,000 deaths, though the two-year outbreak ended in April.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカの科学者がアフリカから危険なウイルスを密輸しようとしたか
triage.triage_reason: 本件は密輸事件（刑事案件）の報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・疾患流行の現象ではない。記事サマリーで言及されているコンゴの2年間のアウトブレイクは既に2026年4月に終了している。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症イベント（outbreak/epidemic）ではなく、生物学的材料の密輸に関する刑事事件である。記事は過去のコンゴアウトブレイク（既に終了）を背景情報として言及しているが、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: "Μας έκαναν πειραματόζωα!" - Σε αναβρασμό οι Αφρικανοί, ο "αμερικανικός στρατός εισάγει τον σπάνιο ιό Bundibugyo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "They made us into lab rats!" - Africans in an uproar, the "American army introduces the rare Bundibugyo virus."
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak intensifies across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and neighboring Uganda. As of June 3, 2026, 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths in DRC, and 9 cases with 1 death in Uganda. Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola lineage with mortality up to 40%, spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; the response is hampered by ongoing armed conflict, attacks on hospitals, and PPE shortages. Uganda closed its border on May 27, but cross-border movement remains difficult across about 800 km of shared frontier. The article also notes controversy over a US quarantine center in Kenya’s Laikipia and unverified claims of American biological facilities in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 「私たちを実験動物にされた！」 - アフリカ人が激怒、「アメリカ軍が稀なブンディブギョウイルスを持ち込んでいる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀な病原体による異常/予想外、複数国への国際拡大、国際渡航制限の発生）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。WHO PHEIC宣言、高い死亡率、越境移動の継続による拡大リスク、地域紛争による対応困難性から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRC内での発生地域（Ituri、South Kivu）が明記されている。UgandaはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上では「neighboring Uganda」と記載され、Uganda側での9例1死亡は確認事例であり、越境流行の懸念がある。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Kenya内での事項（米国隔離センター、米生物兵器施設疑惑）は記事の主題ではなく陰謀論的要素が含まれており、実際の感染症発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言が確認されており、高い優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo, doctors face Ebola with little protection: "We live with fear"
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in DRC, Ituri province. By June 3, 363 cases and 62 deaths confirmed; about 250 suspected cases and 80 deaths reported. Clinics report severe PPE shortages, lack of Ebola tests, and limited clean water. A 25-year-old midwife and a doctor in his 30s developed Ebola-like symptoms after caring for patients in May; one patient died. Testing has been hampered by supply gaps. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, triggering aid of over $162 million. Labs are strained: Goma’s lab halted after M23 takeover; Kinshasa lab receives samples six days later with occasional degradation; many sites rely on simple tests for one Ebola type. The Bundibugyo virus, with up to 50% fatality and no vaccines or drugs, is involved. Early cases traced to deaths in a gold-mining Ituri town; Red Cross says spread may have begun by March, with cases in neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：医者がほぼ防護なしでエボラに直面「私たちは恐怖の中で生きている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定症例363例・死亡62例、WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言、国際支援開始、隣国ウガンダへの拡大報告があり、重篤で国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC の Ituri 州および Kinshasa での発生が主題。隣国ウガンダへの拡大言及があるが、ウガンダでの確定症例報告はなく、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。6月3日時点で363確定例、62死亡、約250疑い例、80疑い死亡。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（致死率50%、ワクチン・治療薬なし）関与。WHOが5月17日に PHEIC 宣言し、1億6200万ドル以上の支援開始。医療施設の PPE 不足、検査試薬不足、検査能力制限等が報告されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: El Ébola avanza sin control en el este del Congo: la logística y la desconfianza frenan la respuesta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances unchecked in eastern Congo: logistics and distrust hinder the response.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Ebola is advancing in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in North Kivu and Ituri near Rwanda and Uganda. The World Health Organization warns that access barriers and local distrust impede containment, with poor roads, weak health infrastructure, and community skepticism hindering case finding and contact tracing. The current fatality rate could rise if remote areas are not reached promptly. Logistics remain the main obstacle: delivering equipment and personnel to affected villages takes days even as transmission can occur rapidly. Although supplies of personal protective equipment, diagnostic tests, and vaccines have increased, on‑the‑ground distribution is irregular. The DRC government promises stronger coordination with North Kivu and Ituri, and WHO has deployed over 100 specialists, despite concerns over security and staff rotation. The outbreak poses regional risks to Rwanda, Uganda, and South Sudan, with cross-border alert mechanisms hampered by funding and coordination gaps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラが制御不能に進行：物流と不信感が対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則上の最重要感染症であり、DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダンへの地域的拡大リスクが明記されている。物流障害と地域住民の不信感により制御が困難な状況。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで列挙された隣接国（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダン）は記事では『地域リスク』として記述されており、実際の発生場所はDRC東部（北キブ州・イトゥリ州）に限定される。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが確認されるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当し、管理可能性の課題（物流障害、資金・調整ギャップ）が明示されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la MONUSCO réaffirme son soutien logistique dans la riposte à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: MONUSCO reaffirms its logistical support in the response to.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with MONUSCO providing operational and logistical support to the government's response. On June 4, MONUSCO head James Swan told Ituri Governor Johnny Luboya Nkashama that the UN mission serves as an operational facilitator, assisting logistics, mobility, access for response teams, and transport of medical supplies and equipment. Mongbwalu remains a major outbreak focal point, and the governor highlighted MONUSCO's capacity to deploy material and personnel to hard-to-reach areas, noting tonnes of medicines arriving and support to move staff to Mongbwalu. Swan returned to Kinshasa later that afternoon. The UN mission's role is to bolster the government's Ebola response as the outbreak in Ituri continues."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：DRC対応におけるUNAMIDの物流支援再確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡リスク、重症度）と国際的拡大リスクを示す。DRCでの継続的な流行は異常・予想外であり、複数のIHR基準に該当するためシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではIturi州とBunia、Mongbwaluで継続的なエボラ流行が報告されており、DRCにおける発生が明確。国連ミッション（MONUSCO）が物流支援を提供していることから、政府対応が必要な状況。エボラは高致死率ウイルスであり、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare: Sudanese student shifted to isolation facility in Hyderabad
article.articleSummary: Sudanese student in Hyderabad, India, suspected of Ebola after arriving at Hyderabad International Airport with a fever of 100°F and a travel history from a high-risk country. Flagged during thermal screening and referred to the designated nodal centre for observation and testing. He is currently under observation in an isolation ward at Gandhi Hospital, with test results pending. A close contact of the student has also been isolated at Gandhi Hospital for screening. This marks the second time a Sudanese national has been isolated in Hyderabad over suspected Ebola symptoms. As of 5 June 2026, authorities are monitoring and conducting tests; no confirmation is reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖症：スーダン人学生がハイデラバードの隔離施設に移送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への潜在的影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ疑い症例の検出は高い警戒が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、イベントの実際の発生地がインドのハイデラバードであることを明確に示している。患者がスーダンからの渡航歴を持つスーダン人学生であるが、疑い症例としての検出・隔離はインド（ハイデラバード）で発生している。Bluedot APIが'Republic of the Sudan'を発生地域に含めているが、これはスーダンでのエボラ発生ではなく患者の渡航歴を反映しているため、verified_locationsからは除外した。現時点では確定診断がなく「疑い」段階だが、エボラの高い致死率と国際的懸念により、フルRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan Reports First Suspected Ebola Case As India Remains On High Alert
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan reports first suspected Ebola virus disease case as India stays on high alert. A woman from Uganda, who arrived in Jaipur from Sharjah on Friday morning aboard an Air Arabia flight, was flagged during routine airport screening after exhibiting Ebola-like symptoms. She has been admitted to RUHS Hospital in Jaipur and placed in strict isolation. Precautionary protocols are activated while authorities await laboratory confirmation, with tests ongoing to determine if Ebola virus disease is present. The case arises amid a worsening Ebola outbreak in Africa and underscores heightened vigilance for imported infections through travel into India and other regions.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスターン州がエボラ疑い症例を初報告、インドが高度警戒態勢を継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例がインドで報告され、アフリカでの流行が拡大している状況。異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスクの複数基準を満たし、シグナル検知として進行中のRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダから到着した患者がジャイプール（インド）で検出されており、インドが主たる発生地域。アフリカでのエボラ流行との関連性が指摘されているが、本シグナルの対象国はインドのみ。UE（アラブ首長国連邦）およびウガンダは経由地・患者の出発地として記述されているが、新規感染症イベント発生地ではない。ラボ確認待ちの段階だが、症状と経過が一致し、アフリカの流行情報と合致するため、スクリーニング価値は高い。

article.articleHeadline: New 'AI vaccine' could protect against ALL viruses including Ebola
article.articleSummary: Universal vaccine technology from Cambridge uses AI to design a 'super-antigen' that could provide broad protection against thousands of virus variants, including coronaviruses and Ebola, in a single formula. Unlike current vaccines which target specific strains and are updated after mutations, this approach aims to be future-proof and effective as viruses evolve. In the first human trials, 39 adults aged 18–50 received a universal Sarbeco coronavirus vaccine; it was safe, well tolerated, with minimal side-effects, and induced immune responses against SARS-CoV-2, SARS, and related bat viruses. Phase 2 will test broader populations. Separately, Ebola remains a major concern with an outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo that sickened thousands and caused about 260 deaths; transmission is via infected fluids, not airborne, with symptoms starting 2–21 days after infection. Bundibugyo strain fatality 30–50%; no approved vaccine or specific treatment; three Ebola vaccines are in development.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい『AI vaccine』により、エボラを含むすべてのウイルスに対する保護が可能になる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主軸は新規ワクチン技術（前臨床段階）の開発報道であり、実際の流行事象ではない。ただし、ウガンダおよびDRCでのエボラ流行に言及されており、これが進行中の懸念事象として留意する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はケンブリッジ大学の新規AI設計ワクチン技術の報道であり、イベント発生地としてはDRCのエボラ流行のみが対象国リストに該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。IHR基準を満たしており、かつエボラは高い重症度と死亡率（30-50%）を示すため、実際の流行進行状況に関しては更なる続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia nói gì về nguy cơ Ebola bùng phát thành đại dịch toàn cầu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What do experts say about the risk of Ebola becoming a global pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) remains highly fatal but Vietnam has reported no cases as of 2026-06-05. Global pandemic risk is very low because Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids of symptomatic patients or contaminated materials, with contagiousness starting after symptom onset. Public risk is low, though exposure to secretions, contaminated surfaces, or caregiving activities increases danger; brief proximity in settings like airplanes carries limited risk unless secretions are involved. Early symptoms resemble other febrile illnesses, but epidemiological history within 21 days of leaving an affected area prompts medical evaluation. Vaccines exist and monoclonal antibody therapies improve outcomes. Vietnam’s National Hospital for Tropical Diseases maintains updated WHO/MoH protocols, negative-pressure isolation facilities, PPE training, and strict infection control. If a case arises, emphasis is on rapid detection, isolation, and contact tracing; routine masking or stockpiling is not recommended. Public should follow official guidance and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病が世界的パンデミックになるリスクについて専門家は何を言っているか？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでは確認症例なく、グローバルパンデミックリスクは極めて低いとされている。記事は予防啓発・現状説明であり、アクティブなアウトブレイクを報告していない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの状況に関する専門家コメント記事だが、実際の症例報告ではなく、仮定的なリスク評価と予防対策についての教育的内容。現在のアクティブなシグナルは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: How Three New Ebola Vaccines Are Being Developed
article.articleSummary: Three new Ebola vaccines are under development as scientists worldwide race to counter the strain driving an ongoing outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Health workers in DR Congo continue to battle the outbreak amid conflict, widespread displacement, a large migrant community, and poorly resourced health facilities that complicate transmission control. The article highlights international collaboration and an urgent push to accelerate protective options for frontline responders and affected communities. No case counts, lab confirmations, or infection sources are provided; the focus is on vaccine development efforts against the current Ebola strain and the challenging context in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 3つの新しいエボラワクチンがいかに開発されているか
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地（DRC・イトゥリ州）は確認されるが、記事の主題は「ワクチン開発進捗」であり、現在のアウトブレイクの疫学情報（患者数、致死率、拡大状況）が不足している。症例数未報告のため重症度評価が困難。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発の国際的な取り組みに焦点を当てており、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの具体的な症例数、死亡者数、伝播状況に関する疫学的詳細が欠落している。WPRO基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）では複数該当するが、IHR基準では重症度と国際拡大リスクの証拠が不十分なため、WATCH判定とした。DRC（対象国リスト内）で確認されたアウトブレイクではあるが、続報での具体的な疫学データ提供を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: Sempat Digigit Kucing, Perempuan di Jembrana Meninggal dengan Dugaan Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Woman in Jembrana Dies of Suspected Rabies After Being Bitten by a Cat
article.articleSummary: A 38-year-old woman, NKS, from Tukadaya Village, Melaya District, Jembrana Regency, Bali, Indonesia, died of suspected rabies after a cat bite about a month earlier. She arrived at RSU Negara on 23 May 2026 at 18:42 WITA with hydrophobia and shortness of breath, later described as agitation when exposed to wind. Family reports the cat bite occurred a month prior, and wounds were untreated; she had received no rabies vaccination. Clinicians diagnosed encephalitis with hydrophobia and aerophobia, signs typical of clinical rabies. Despite treatment following hospital protocols, her condition deteriorated; life-saving measures were attempted around 03:38 WITA on 24 May 2026, and she died at 03:46 WITA. The report indicates a suspected rabies case with no laboratory confirmation details provided.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンブラナ州の女性、猫に咬まれ狂犬病の疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡事例であり重症度基準を満たすが、単発の確認症例であり国際的拡大リスクや異常性の根拠が限定的。追加情報による検証が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は既知の疾患であり、インドネシアでの散発的発生は予想される範囲内。患者は咬傷から約1ヶ月後の発症で、予防接種未実施の個別事例。実験室確認は記事に記載なし。公開報道されているため公衆の関心は存在するが、国際的拡大リスクや地域的流行の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Another Sudanese national with fever admitted to Hyderabad's Gandhi Hospital for screening
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Hyderabad's Gandhi Hospital is supervising two Sudanese nationals with potential Ebola exposure. A student in his 20s admitted Thursday from a private facility had fever; by Friday morning he showed no fever and improved; his attendant remains in home isolation while test results are awaited. A second case, a 35-year-old Sudanese man who arrived at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport on Thursday, was moved to Gandhi Hospital's isolation ward after fever was detected during airport screening; he is asymptomatic on Friday morning; tests are awaited. Telangana has established a 10-bed Ebola isolation ward at Gandhi Hospital. Hyderabad Airport issued an advisory under DGCA/MoHFW for passengers from Uganda, DRC, and neighboring high-risk regions, possibly requiring a Self-Declaration Form. WHO notes Ebola is severe, often fatal, transmitted from wildlife and via contact with infected blood, secretions, fluids, or contaminated surfaces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：発熱している別のスーダン国籍者がハイデラバードのガンジー病院でスクリーニングのため入院
triage.triage_reason: スーダン発の複数の疑似患者がインドで検出され、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・重篤性）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行リスク、管理可能性）にも該当。確認された対象国での実際の事例であり、フルRRA進行の判断が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRC（203312）やUganda（226074）、Sudan（366755）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はインド（ハイデラバード）における疑似患者の検出・管理であり、これらの国での新規患者発生ではない。したがって verified_locations には India のみを含める。スーダンからの輸入ケースであることは注記するが、スーダンでのエボラ発生確認の記述がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Malaria Sampai 107 Orang, Pemkab Bangka Perpanjang Status KLB dan Perketat Belinyu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria cases reach 107 people, Bangka Regency Government extends outbreak status and tightens restrictions in Belinyu.
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, malaria outbreaks in Bangka Regency, Belinyu District, centered on Batu Atap Beach and Bubut Beach, reached 107 laboratory-confirmed cases. Some patients have recovered; others remain under medical care after testing positive. In response, the Bangka Regency government extended the Malaria Outbreak status (KLB) and tightened surveillance and movement controls around the two sites to curb transmission and prevent spread to other areas. The health department conducted a second-wave screening of residents and tin sand miners at Batu Atap and Bubut, with emergency posts deployed to speed detection and treatment. Authorities will maintain elevated monitoring at entry/exit points and ensure rapid case finding, laboratory confirmation, and management of symptoms, aiming to interrupt transmission chains in Belinyu.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア患者107人に、バンカ県政府が感染症流行状態を延長し、ベリニュ地区の管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるマラリアの確認された流行で107人の検査確認症例が報告され、異常かつ予想外な事象。流行管理のため政府が公式に流行状態（KLB）を宣言・延長しており、重症度と地域への影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・バンカ県ベリニュ地区におけるマラリア流行を報道しており、107人の検査確認症例が報告されている。政府が公式に流行状態（KLB）を延長し、サーベイランス強化と移動制限を実施していることから、地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: les USA annoncent de nouvelles directives pour les ressortissants américains aux pays touchés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the United States announces new guidelines for American nationals in the affected countries - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Uganda prompts new U.S. guidance for American nationals in affected areas. American citizens and foreigners from the cited countries remain subject to U.S. health, travel, and screening measures during the ongoing epidemic; the policy is described as voluntary to assist exposed individuals or those needing help to depart the region. The U.S. State Department has established six specialized Ebola treatment centers and supports dozens of health facilities to screen, transport, and treat suspected and confirmed cases. Citizens in the affected countries are urged to enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) for updates and compliance. U.S. Ebola response aid exceeds $162 million in external funding, with an additional $350 million via OCHA funds to DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda as part of a broader $1.8 billion to OCHA announced May 14. FHI 360 spearheads community outreach with local leaders, youth councils, and a Congolese parents association, including French and Swahili radio spots to counter rumors and bolster trust in treatment centers and response teams.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国が影響を受けた国のアメリカ国民向けの新しい指針を発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつ米国による大規模な対応と国際支援を示唆。複数国での流行と高い死亡率により、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認されるエボラ流行国はDRC、South Sudan（スーダン南部）、ウガンダ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。米国の対応指針発表は国際的な感染拡大懸念を反映。162百万ドル超の米国支援と1.8億ドルのOCHA資金配分により、国際的な関心と対応の深さが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: 4.300 Orang Jalani Tes HIV di Kota Sukabumi, 54 Orang Terkonfirmasi Positif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4,300 people undergo HIV testing in Sukabumi City, 54 people were confirmed positive.
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, Sukabumi City, West Java, aims to test 11,360 people for HIV this year; coverage stands at 39% with 4,300 individuals tested. Of these, 54 are HIV-positive; 18 are residents of Sukabumi City, while the remaining 36 are residents from outside the city undergoing treatment there. HIV services operate across 11 treatment sites—six hospitals and five community health centers (puskesmas). Testing efforts are conducted through a care, support, and treatment program, with ongoing monitoring to address challenges and reduce lost to follow-up, and to improve service quality. The PDP HIV program is highlighted for ensuring treatment continuity and quality of life for recipients. Authorities plan to inaugurate a new leadership for the Kota Sukabumi AIDS Prevention and Control Commission (KPA) in July, signaling strengthened cross-sector collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: スカブミ市でのHIV検査：4,300人が検査を受け、54人が陽性と確認
triage.triage_reason: HIV検査キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新規の感染症危機ではない。54件の陽性例は既存の治療体制内で管理されており、国際的な拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 記事はスカブミ市（西ジャワ州）におけるHIV検査プログラムの実施状況に関する通常の公衆衛生活動の報告である。既存治療体制下での管理、リーダーシップ交代の計画など、組織的な運営改善が主題であり、新規感染症危機のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare in Rajasthan after woman shows symptoms
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan: A woman at RUHS Hospital exhibits symptoms similar to Ebola; diagnosis pending after laboratory testing; samples sent; she is monitored under infectious-disease protocols. Amid a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in Africa, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for DRC and Uganda last month; there is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, making surveillance vital. India reports no confirmed cases so far; the Union Health Ministry has issued advisories for travelers from or through affected countries. Symptom watch includes fever, vomiting, severe weakness, and unexplained bleeding; travelers urged to report to airport health authorities. Non-essential travel to DRC, Uganda, South Sudan discouraged; enhanced entry-point screening in place. This is not the first alert this year in India; a Bengaluru case was screened and tested negative for Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州でエボラ症状を示す女性、エボラ警戒事態へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準でも4つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。アフリカでのエボラ流行に関連した疑似症例が対象国（インド）で検出されたため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: インドで初の疑似症例が報告されており、アフリカでのBundibugyo株エボラ流行（DRC・ウガンダ）との地理的・時間的関連性がある。WHO-PHEICが既に宣言されている。ただし記事では検査結果待機段階であり、確定診断ではない点に留意。過去の誤検出例（ベンガルール2026年初）があるため、検査確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Lào Cai tăng cường phối hợp ngăn chặn dịch bệnh truyền lây xuyên biên giới trên vật nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lao Cai Province Strengthens Coordination to Prevent Transboundary Animal Diseases in Livestock
article.articleSummary: Lao Cai province, Vietnam, on 5 June 2026 organized a communication conference with ILRI and the Institute of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Medicine to prevent transboundary animal diseases in livestock, focusing on foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) serotype SAT1 entry. Under the ICT4Health project, the event signed an interagency coordination mechanism among the Department of Plant Protection, Veterinary and Animal Husbandry; Border Guard; Market Management; Provincial Economic Zone Management; border posts; and local border-area authorities to manage border controls and prevent illicit transport of animals and animal products. Although SAT1 FMD is not yet detected in Vietnam, it has been reported in other countries; the risk remains due to cross-border trade. The agreement strengthens information sharing, patrols, border checks, sampling procedures, and rapid response to safeguard livestock health and biosafety, supporting sustainable farming in border regions.

triage.headline_ja: ラオカイ省が家畜の国境を越えた伝染病防止に向けて協力を強化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）SAT1血清型の侵入リスク管理に関する予防的協調会議であり、現在ベトナムでの検出は報告されていない。ただし国境地域での継続的な曝露リスク（長期曝露基準）と予想外性は認められるため、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムでのFMD SAT1侵入予防の多機関協力メカニズム構築に関する会議報告。現時点ではベトナムでの実際の検出事例は報告されていないが、他国での流行と国境地域での継続的リスクが指摘されている。動物感染症であり、ヒト感染のリスクは低いが、畜産業への影響と国境管理上の関心が政府レベルで高い。

article.articleHeadline: Gran Bretagna al lavoro per vaccino 'unico al mondo', progettato dall'AI: potrà contrastare Ebola e influenza - InLibertà
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Great Britain at work on a 'one-of-a-kind in the world' vaccine, designed by AI: it could counter Ebola and influenza.
article.articleSummary: UK researchers at Cambridge unveiled a 'one-of-a-kind' AI-designed vaccine targeting the entire coronavirus family, including all Covid variants, with potential to protect against viruses in animals that could spark future pandemics. Separate AI-designed vaccines are in development for influenza and Ebola. In early human trials, 39 volunteers were evaluated for safety; a follow-up ~200-person study will test immune efficacy. The AI-designed 'super-antigen' trains the immune system broadly, aiming for protection despite mutations. Results in the Journal of Infection described immune impact as modest but promising for pandemic preparedness. Researchers from Cambridge, Southampton, and the Oxford Vaccine Group stress AI's potential to accelerate universal vaccines (influenza, H5N1) and other viral diseases. The article notes a current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo with no vaccine for that strain.

triage.headline_ja: イギリスがAI設計の「世界初」ワクチン開発に取り組む：エボラとインフルエンザに対抗可能
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は主にワクチン開発の研究進展に関するニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク状況ではない。DRCのエボラについての言及は背景情報に過ぎず、記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はAI設計ワクチンの研究開発に関する科学ニュースであり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。DRCのエボラ勃発への言及は文脈背景のみで、本記事の主題ではないため verified_locations に含めない。対象国に該当する実際の感染症イベント情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: How Gold Is Driving the Spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the town’s gold-mining economy. The outbreak began in Mongbwalu as early as February but was not detected until May 15; Bundibugyo has no approved treatment. Authorities call it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. More than 80 people are believed to have died in the weeks before detection; on one street, five residents died and a sixth fell ill. Transmission is propelled by crowded, informal mining work and cross-border trade, with workers and traders moving across borders as gold flows. Initial misdiagnosis as malaria occurred before Ebola symptoms—bleeding—emerged in some cases. Many miners and neighboring provinces, including North Kivu, are affected as the epidemic spreads within and beyond Mongbwalu.

triage.headline_ja: ゴールドがエボラ出血熱の拡大を駆動している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性が該当。エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の最優先事項であり、80人以上の死亡と急速な地域拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreakはコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州Mongbwalu（記事では'Mongbwalu'と表記）を中心に発生。2月から継続しているが5月15日まで未検出。3番目に大きなエボラアウトブレイクと当局が認識。金採掘産業と越境交易が拡大要因であり、北キブ州への拡大も報告されている。Bundibugyo系統は未承認治療という追加懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in India: Another Sudanese national with fever admitted to Hyderabad's Gandhi Hospital for screening
article.articleSummary: Two Sudanese nationals with fever were admitted to Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad for Ebola screening, bringing Ebola-related admissions at the facility to two. The first, a student in his 20s referred from a private facility, saw his condition improve and was fever-free on Friday; his attendant was advised to isolate at home. The second, a 35-year-old who arrived at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport for knee surgery, was moved to Gandhi Hospital’s isolation ward after fever was detected at the airport; he was asymptomatic as of Friday morning. Test reports for both are awaited. Telangana has established a 10-bed Ebola isolation ward at Gandhi Hospital. Hyderabad Airport issued an advisory for travelers from affected regions, including Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, to complete a Self-Declaration Form. WHO notes Ebola is severe and often fatal, transmitted from animals and via direct contact with blood or body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: インド：エボラ感染スクリーニングのためハイデラバードのガンジー病院に入院したスーダン国籍患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、致死的な新興感染症、複数国での発生確認、国際的拡大リスク）。対象国インドでエボラ疑い症例が確認され、アフリカ発生地からの輸入症例の可能性があるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ハイデラバードでのエボラ疑い症例確認を主題としており、DRC・ウガンダ・スーダンはリスク地域として言及されているが、実際の確認症例はインドのみ。複数の疑い症例（スーダン国籍患者2名）が検査待ちの状態。空港での防疫措置実施、10床のエボラ隔離病棟設置など対応体制整備中。

article.articleHeadline: In Congo, doctors face Ebola with little protection: "We live with fear"
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province: a 25-year-old midwife and a doctor are ill with Ebola-like symptoms after caring for patients in early May; testing and PPE shortages prevent confirmation. Nearly 250 suspected cases and 80 deaths occurred before confirmation; on May 17 the WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern, triggering pledges from the U.S. State Department. Health facilities report shortages of PPE, tests, and water; isolation tents lack mattresses. Aid shipments face logistical hurdles; roads are eroded or blocked by armed groups. Congo's National Institute of Biomedical Research had a lab in Goma that stopped after M23 seized control, forcing reliance on less capable tests and long transit to Kinshasa. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with up to 50% fatality and no vaccines, was identified; first confirmed cases traced to deaths in Ituri, with Red Cross noting spread since March and three volunteers dying.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ: 医師たちがエボラに直面、防護なし：「私たちは恐怖とともに生きている」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染拡大は4つのIHR基準すべてに該当し、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事態(PHEIC)として既に宣言されている。北東部イトゥリ州での250件の疑い例と80人の死亡、医療従事者への感染、国際的な支援体制の必要性が確認される。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC既に宣言済み。Bundibugyo Ebola virus（致死率最大50%、ワクチンなし）が確認。医療施設での防護具・検査・清潔用水の深刻な不足が報告されている。M23による北東部の施設支配で検査能力が低下。記事の発生地域にアメリカが含まれているが、サマリーでは支援国としてのみ言及されており、実際の発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州であるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 永州疾控：夏日已至，乙脑防控正当时_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yongzhou CDC: Summer has arrived, Japanese encephalitis prevention and control is timely.
article.articleSummary: Yongzhou, China: With rising temperatures and humid conditions boosting mosquito breeding, the summer peak of Japanese encephalitis (JE) risk increases. JE vaccine prevents infection by the JE virus transmitted by mosquitoes; disease mainly affects children and can cause high fever, headache, vomiting, altered consciousness, seizures, and in severe cases paralysis, cognitive impairment, or death. In China, two JE vaccines are commonly used: live attenuated (fewer doses) and inactivated (broad safety and eligibility). Catch-up schedules for uncompleted vaccination: live vaccines require 2 doses spaced at least 12 months apart; inactivated vaccines require 4 doses with intervals of 7–10 days between doses 1–2, 1–12 months between 2–3, and at least 3 years between 3–4. Reactions are rare; most children have no or mild temporary symptoms such as injection-site redness/pain, with rare rash, fever under 38°C, dizziness, fainting, or nausea/vomiting. Check records and vaccinate before JE season at local clinics. Source: Red Net, Dong Wenhao.

triage.headline_ja: 永州疾控：夏日已至，乙脑防控正当时
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国湖南省永州地域からの日本脳炎ワクチン接種啓発記事であり、新規発生事例の報告ではなく、予防接種キャンペーンの案内である。IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は日本脳炎の既知リスク季節到来に伴う定期的なワクチン接種啓発であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。気温上昇に伴う蚊媒介疾患リスク増加は季節的に予想される事象であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-GOMA-EBOLA OUTBREAK-TESTING CAPACITY
article.articleSummary: 381 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), including 63 deaths, as of June 5, 2026, with the outbreak centered in Goma. Health Minister Roger Kamba said testing capacity has improved significantly after the arrival of more than 4,000 testing kits from the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and other international partners, enabling authorities to test almost all samples and return results within 24 hours. A June 4, 2026 photo shows a medical worker cleaning at an Ebola treatment center in Goma. The update underscores the ongoing transmission and the impact of expanded laboratory capabilities on outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国ゴマ：エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク検査能力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。確認症例381名、死亡63名の深刻な公衆衛生影響、エボラウイルス病という予想外の異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国ゴマでのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクの進展を報じており、確認症例381名、死亡63名が報告されている。検査能力の向上により24時間以内の検査結果返却が可能となっており、国際的支援（Africa CDC他からの4,000以上の検査キット提供）により対応が進められている。進行中のアウトブレイクとして継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Which Vaccines, Treatments Are In The Works And How Long They May Take
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda as of 2026-06-05. First declared May 15 by Africa CDC; WHO declared a public health emergency on May 17. By June 2, DRC reported 321 confirmed and 116 suspected cases, with 48 deaths and 6 recoveries; Uganda confirmed 9 cases and at least 1 death, later rising to 15 total, including cases in Kampala. No approved vaccine exists for Bundibugyo, whose mortality (30–50%) is lower than the Zaire strain (50–70%). CEPI-funded vaccine candidates include IAVI’s rVSV Bundibugyo, Oxford University’s ChAdOx1 Bundibugy o, and Moderna’s mRNA vaccine; none are ready for immediate outbreak use. Trials may begin in months for the Oxford and Moderna candidates, while IAVI anticipates 7–9 months to start clinical trials. Potential treatments include MBP134, Maftivimab, and remdesivir, with the Partners trial planned to compare options.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイク：開発中のワクチン・治療法とその開発期間
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Eボラの国際的な多国家アウトブレイク（DRCおよびウガンダ）で、既にWHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。確認患者330名以上、死亡48名以上。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo EbolaはWHOの公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言対象。ウガンダはCEPR対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとなる。記事サマリーから、DRCとウガンダで実際のアウトブレイクが発生していることが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Unsafe Injections Declared Public Health Emergency in India
article.articleSummary: Unsafe injection practices in India declared a public health emergency by the National Medical Commission. New Delhi, June 5 2026: the advisory mandates zero tolerance for reuse of single-use syringes, dialysers, and vials, and requires rapid adoption of safety-engineered auto-disable syringes to prevent needle-stick injuries. Reuse is described as a direct patient-safety breach; improper disposal under Biomedical Waste Management Rules, 2016 must be enforced, with segregation, training, and audits mandatory and regular competency assessments for healthcare workers. Industry voices, including AiMeD's Rajiv Nath, emphasize India’s capacity to supply safety devices but call for decisive policy action and accountability. The advisory argues unsafe injections fuel outbreaks of HIV, Hepatitis B and C, impose lifelong costs, and erode trust. Procurement, hospital authorities, and policymakers are urged to allocate budgets specifically for safety devices, enforce accreditation-based accountability, and launch patient awareness campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: インドで不安全な注射が公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言
triage.triage_reason: 不安全な注射慣行がHIV・B型肝炎の感染リスクと直結し、インド国立医学委員会によって公衆衛生上の緊急事態として公式宣言されている。国家レベルの政策介入と医療従事者対応が必要な重大事象。
triage.notes: 医療施設内での不安全な注射慣行はHIV・B型肝炎・C型肝炎の主要な感染経路。インド国立医学委員会による公式な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言は、国家的なリスク認識と対応体制の整備が進行中であることを示唆。医療従事者研修・医療廃棄物管理の強化・安全注射機器の調達予算確保が政策課題として機能している。

article.articleHeadline: "الإيبولا" يتمدد بالكونغو - العالم : الخبر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo - World: News
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 63 deaths, with 233 patients currently in care (in isolation awaiting results or with confirmed infection). Diagnostic capacity has improved after the Africa CDC delivered over 4,000 testing kits, enabling most samples to be tested and results issued within 24 hours. Contact tracing has risen from about 9% at the start of the response to 55%, with a goal of 90%. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, spans three eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Since its official detection on 15 May, authorities have intensified testing, isolation, treatment, and tracing with international support. The World Health Organization later classified this outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大している - 世界：ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが公衆衛生上国際的に懸念される事象（PHEIC）として分類している確認済みのエボラ流行。複数州に拡大し、診断・接触追跡・隔離対応が進行中。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（公衆衛生上国際的に懸念される事象）として正式分類済み。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の3州に拡大。確認症例381件、死亡63件。Africa CDCによる検査キット供給で診断能が向上し、接触追跡率が9%から55%に改善。国際支援を伴う全面的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Elderly Rabies Patient Dies In Son's Lap Outside Rajasthan Hospital, Family Alleges Negligence
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in Bharatpur, Rajasthan: Tej Singh, 73, of Nag Sui village in the Khoh area of Deeg district, died Thursday morning in his son’s lap outside RBM Hospital after a stray dog bite about a month earlier. He did not pursue prompt anti-rabies vaccination, instead using traditional remedies and self-treating the wound. Initially treated at a Deeg hospital, he was referred to RBM Hospital for advanced care. The family alleges RBM doctors did not adequately examine him and advised shifting to Jaipur, claiming he had rabies, implying negligence. He exhibited rabies symptoms such as hydrophobia, restlessness, and severe discomfort before death. The report does not mention laboratory confirmation, and there is no indication of a broader outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州の病院外でラビアス患者が死亡、家族が過失を主張
triage.triage_reason: 散発的な個別死亡例であり、集団発生の兆候なし。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当性が低く、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルと判断されない。
triage.notes: 本件は狂犬病による散発的な個別死亡事例（73歳男性）であり、集団発生の兆候がない。医療過失に関する家族の主張が記事の主眼であり、感染症の流行性・伝播性・公衆衛生上の重大性を示す要素が認められない。ラボ確認も記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: En el epicentro del brote de ébola en Congo: 'También hay otras enfermedades con potencial epidémico'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in Congo: 'There are also other diseases with epidemic potential'.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, the World Health Organization reports 900 Ebola cases and about 200 suspected deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri Province at the epicenter and Bunia (population 693,000) amid distrust and displacement. Violence is hindering contact tracing and humanitarian access. Médecins Sans Frontières is boosting the response with around 50 international staff and roughly 480 local personnel, sourcing PPE from Kinshasa and Kampala; 3,000 PPE arrived in Bunia on May 19, with 60,000 more expected from Europe this week. MSF is opening a new Ebola Treatment Center in Mongbwalu and rehabilitating Munigi CTE in Goma (North Kivu) for up to 80 patients, plus an isolation room at Kyeshero Hospital. Training on infection control and water, sanitation, and waste management is underway to restore patient flow and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行の震源地で：『流行の可能性がある他の疾患もある』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。進行中の大規模エボラ流行でDRC内複数地域での感染確認、死亡者あり、国際支援体制も展開中。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ流行を主題とし、イツリ州（Ituri Province）がエピセンター、ブニア市が震源地と記載。サマリーに900症例、約200人の疑い死亡、暴力による接触者追跡阻害、MSFの国際的支援体制展開が記載されている。ウガンダは隣国として言及されるが、記事の主題はDRCのイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau: Trên 1.400 ca mắc tay chân miệng, một bé trai 3 tuổi tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau: More than 1,400 cases of hand, foot and mouth disease, a 3-year-old boy dies.
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, Ca Mau Province reported one HFMD-related death in a 3-year-old boy from Vĩnh Thạnh hamlet, Vĩnh Lộc commune. He presented with fever, sore throat, and vesicles on the hands and feet and was diagnosed with HFMD stage 1 with pharyngitis at Hong Dan General Hospital. Rapid deterioration followed with vomiting and seizures, progressing to stage 2A; despite transfer to Bac Lieu General Hospital for intensive care, he died. Death attributed to HFMD stage 4 with pulmonary edema and cardiopulmonary arrest on day 4. Total HFMD cases in Ca Mau exceeded 1,400, up 149% from the prior year. Authorities intensified surveillance, reinforced prevention in key areas, and strengthened communications and medical supply readiness.
