HFMD can be severe, causing encephalitis, myocarditis, or respiratory failure; parents urged to seek care promptly. In early 2026, eight HFMD deaths were reported in Ho Chi Minh City and four southern provinces, none last year.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ：手足口病の患者数が1,400人を超え、3歳の男の子が死亡
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病の死亡例を伴う集団発生であり、IHR基準の重症度（死亡例あり）および異常性（前年比149%増加）に該当、かつWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性に該当する。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にベトナムのカマウ省およびホーチミン市を含む南部地域での手足口病の集団発生を記述しており、Bluedot APIの発生地域情報と一致。2026年初頭に8件の死亡がホーチミン市と南部4省で報告されており、前年同期はゼロ件。Enterovirus 71は重症化リスク（脳炎、心筋炎、呼吸不全）が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR CONGO-GOMA-EBOLA OUTBREAK-TESTING CAPACITY
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) centered in Goma, with confirmed cases reaching 381 and 63 deaths as of June 4–5, 2026, Health Minister Roger Kamba said. Testing capacity has significantly improved after the arrival of more than 4,000 testing kits from the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention and other international support, enabling testing of almost all samples and delivering results within 24 hours. A photo from June 4, 2026, shows a medical worker at an Ebola treatment center in Goma, illustrating the intensified response. The update confirms ongoing outbreak control measures and rapid diagnosis within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国-ゴマ-エボラ感染症アウトブレイク-検査能力
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例381件、死亡63件の重大な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準複数該当。国際的支援（検査キット4,000以上）が既に動員されており、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、381例の確認事例と63例の死亡は深刻な事態を示唆。国際的な検査支援が既に展開されており、アフリカCDCなど国際機関の関与を示唆。本事例は定義上フルRRA(Rapid Risk Assessment)対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan Woman Isolated in Jaipur Hospital Over Suspected Ebola Symptoms
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, a woman who arrived in Jaipur from Uganda was isolated at RUHS Hospital in Jaipur after exhibiting symptoms consistent with Ebola. The patient has been placed in a dedicated isolation ward while samples are sent to a specialized laboratory in Pune for confirmatory testing; the infection status remains unconfirmed pending results. Hospital authorities and Rajasthan's health department are closely monitoring the situation and collecting information on contacts for surveillance. The authorities have issued alerts to both government and private hospitals to remain vigilant and to screen travellers arriving from abroad—especially from African countries—at airports to enable timely detection. Ebola is a highly dangerous disease that spreads through contact with bodily fluids. The case is currently imported from Uganda, with further steps contingent on laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダから来たエボラ疑い症例、ジャイプール病院で隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い症例（国際持込事例）であり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクに該当。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが認められ、社会的・政治的関心も高い。確定診断待ちだが、初期段階での迅速対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、エボラ疑い症例はウガンダから到着した患者であり、インドのジャイプール・ラージャスターン州で隔離されている。確定診断はプネの専門検査施設での結果待ちだが、高危険度疾患の国際持込事例として即座のRRA実施が適切。Uganda（226074）はBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題は「インドへの輸入症例」であるため、verified_locationsにはインドのみを列挙。

article.articleHeadline: US Domestic Treatment Centers Ready for Ebola Even as Kenya Plans Persist
article.articleSummary: Nine of 13 US treatment centers in the National Emerging Special Pathogens Training and Education Center report readiness to receive patients exposed to Ebola, as the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak reaches 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths per WHO. One American exposed to Ebola has been treated in Germany. The US State Department would quarantine asymptomatic exposed citizens in Kenya at a government-built facility, while critics debate whether infected Americans should be repatriated to US hospitals. Protests at the Kenya site have caused at least two deaths and a Kenyan court has blocked construction. Since 2014, US funding has supported preparedness; the program now receives about $21 million annually in 2026. Facilities must care for at least two exposed patients, train quarterly, have lab testing and PPE, and the CDC plans to staff Kenya with Public Health Service Corps members.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応準備進む米国、ケニアでの計画が実施へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の活発な流行（コンゴ民主共和国で344確定例、60死亡）により、国際的な広がりリスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、複数国への波及（米国、ケニア、ドイツでの患者発生・対応）が認められ、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。同時にWPRO基準でも重症度、流行リスク、管理上の必要性が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUS、Germany、Kenyaが含まれているが、サマリーでは主に米国、ケニアでの対応準備の議論であり、実際の発生地はDRCとドイツ（1例）に限定される。ドイツは対象国外のため除外。ケニアはサマリー内で対応施設の建設地として言及されているが、実際の患者発生は記述されていないため除外。DRCが流行の中心地であり唯一の verified_locations。

article.articleHeadline: DOJ charged 2 NIH scientists with smuggling deactivated monkeypox virus into US
article.articleSummary: On June 2, 2026, the U.S. attorney's office charged Vincent Munster, a Dutch citizen and head of the virus ecology section at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, and Claude Kwe, a Cameroon citizen and research fellow in Munster's lab, with smuggling the monkeypox virus into the United States. The two allegedly transported 113 glass vials of material in Styrofoam coolers, concealed as diagnostics and testing equipment, departing Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, and arriving at Detroit Metropolitan Airport in January 2026. FBI/CBP investigators later confirmed that some of the 20 vials tested contained deactivated monkeypox virus; such material is non-replicating but used for research and controls. The defendants have pleaded not guilty. The case arises amid mpox outbreaks linked to Congo in 2024–2025, per the CDC.

triage.headline_ja: DOJ、不活化天然痘ウイルス（mpox）を米国に密輸した2人のNIH科学者を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは不活化mpoxウイルスの密輸に関する法執行事件であり、公衆衛生上の実質的な感染症発生ではない。記事サマリーは犯罪捜査に焦点が当たっており、実際の患者発生、集団感染、または新規の流行パターンの報告は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はファクトチェックサイト(Snopes)からの情報であり、不活化mpoxウイルスの密輸に関する法執行事件である。患者発生やアウトブレイク報告ではないため、感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低い。Montana、Michigan、Ohio、Cameroonに言及されているが、実質的なイベント発生地はDRCのBrazzavilleからの密輸であり、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Fact Check: DOJ charged 2 NIH scientists with smuggling deactivated monkeypox virus into US
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, the U.S. Department of Justice charged two foreign-born NIH researchers with smuggling the monkeypox virus into the United States and lying to federal authorities. Dutch citizen Vincent Munster, head of the virus ecology section at the Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Hamilton, Montana, and Claude Kwe, a Cameroonian research fellow in Munster’s lab, allegedly carried 113 glass vials in Styrofoam coolers while boarding a flight into Detroit from Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, in January 2026. The defendants allegedly claimed the case contained diagnostics and testing equipment, but FBI and CBP investigations revealed the vials contained, at least in part, deactivated monkeypox virus—viruses that cannot replicate but can be used for research. The two were charged on June 2, 2026; both pleaded not guilty. The incident follows reported mpox outbreaks in Congo during 2024–2025, and Munster and Kwe had published multiple monkeypox studies.

triage.headline_ja: 事実確認：司法省がモンキーポックスウイルスの密輸で2人のNIH科学者を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 本件は感染症の流行イベントではなく、ウイルス密輸事件の法執行ニュースである。不活性化ウイルスの違法輸送に関する刑事事件であり、感染症危機管理の対象外。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容は2026年6月のNIH研究者による不活性化ウイルス密輸事件の起訴であり、アウトブレイク検知の対象ではない。記事は過去のコンゴでの2024-2025年のmpoxアウトブレイクに言及しているが、本ニュースは刑事事件報道であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではない。DRCは対象国であるため verified_locations に含めるが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : La Communauté d'Afrique de l'Est renforce sa riposte régionale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: East African Community strengthens its regional response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: East African Community (EAC) ministers of health held an extraordinary videoconference on 1–2 June 2026 to strengthen regional Ebola response amid evolving outbreak dynamics. They warned of cross-border transmission risk and endorsed harmonized surveillance and protection measures at airports, seaports, and land crossings, with enhanced health checks in affected zones in line with WHO guidance and national regulations. The EAC Secretariat was tasked with convening a regional meeting to standardize border sanitary controls, traveler health declarations, and related measures, including exit-screening at designated entry points. Resources should be mobilized to bolster control capacities, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) interventions, community surveillance, and risk communication campaigns. A Regional Technical Working Group on Ebola and other high-consequence pathogens will coordinate technical responses and report regularly to EAC bodies. Based in Arusha, Tanzania, the EAC includes Burundi, Kenya, Uganda, DRC, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, and Tanzania.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：東アフリカ共同体が地域対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域的流行が進行中であり、複数国での国境を超えた感染リスク、重症度の高い病原体、国際的な地域調整が必要とされている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東アフリカ共同体（EAC）の地域対応について述べており、複数国が言及されているが、実際のエボラ流行発生地として明確に特定される対象国はDRCのみ。その他の国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ルワンダ、ブルンジなど）はEAC加盟国として挙げられているが、サマリーからは具体的な流行発生地として確認されない。タンザニアはEAC本部所在地（アルーシャ）として言及されているが、流行発生地としては明確でない。

article.articleHeadline: Podcast JR 15 Min #1436 | Grandes eventos, turismo e o avanço das doenças infecciosas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Podcast JR 15 Min #1436 | Major events, tourism, and the spread of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: With the 2026 World Cup approaching, Brazil’s Health Ministry has reinforced travel advisories for host-country visitors to stay up to date with vaccination, especially against measles. Measles, once thought controlled, has resurfaced as a concern for health authorities in several countries. The issue extends beyond sports: major international events, busy airports, and rising global mobility facilitate the spread of viruses and other infectious diseases, including to people who do not travel but return as tourists. The JR 15 Minutos podcast (#1436) analyzes how global mobility shapes public health, the risk of new outbreaks in Brazil, and the role of vaccination in protecting individuals and communities. Guest: Dr. Karis Rodrigues, infectious disease specialist and president of the Travel Medicine Committee of the Brazilian Society of Infectious Diseases. No outbreak specifics or case counts are reported.

triage.headline_ja: ポッドキャスト JR 15 分 #1436 | 大規模イベント、観光、感染症の拡大
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹に関する潜在的な公衆衛生懸念が示唆されているが、具体的な症例数、発生地の確認、重症度の情報が記事に記載されていないため、詳細情報の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年ワールドカップを控えたブラジルの麻疹リスクに関する討論番組の告知であり、具体的な症例数や発生地の詳細情報が記載されていない。ブラジル保健省が予防接種勧告を強化していることから政府レベルの懸念は認識できるが、現在のアウトブレイク状況の詳細は不明。続報で具体的な症例情報が出現した場合は PICKUP に昇格する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: US domestic treatment centers ready for Ebola even as Kenya plans
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, per WHO; one American confirmed with Ebola has been treated in Germany. The United States has 13 treatment centers in the National Emerging Special Pathogens Training and Education Center network, nine of which confirmed readiness to receive patients exposed to Ebola. Sites include University of Nebraska, Emory University (Atlanta), Bellevue Hospital (New York), and Cedars-Sinai (Los Angeles). Centers must care for two patients exposed to viral hemorrhagic fever, train quarterly, and maintain lab testing capabilities and PPE. HHS says the network is ready for outbreak response; the CDC has staff in the DRC and plans to deploy Public Health Service Corps to Kenya to staff the quarantine facility. Kenyan protests at the site have led to two deaths; a court blocked construction. Since 2014, the US has funded Ebola preparedness, about $21 million annually in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが計画する中、米国の国内治療センターがエボラに対応する準備ができている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCのエボラ流行は確認された344例、60死亡で重大。米国への患者搬送実績あり、複数国への拡大リスク存在。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行を主題としており、米国とケニアの対応整備が副次的な内容。Bluedot APIの発生地域には米国、ドイツ、ケニアが含まれているが、これらは治療体制整備や準備計画の所在地であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストのうち、記事サマリーで実際に感染症イベント（ケース発生）が起きている国はDRCだけであるため、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : sans déployer "correctement" la riposte dans les zones sous contrôle de l'AFC/M23, Kinshasa dit suivre de loin la situation et confirme un cas de guérison à Goma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: without properly deploying the response in areas under AFC/M23 control, Kinshasa says it is monitoring the situation from afar and confirms a recovered case in Goma.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: the May 15, 2026 confirmation in Ituri (northeast) has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for a rare Ebola strain with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. As of June 5, 2026, a recovered case was reported in Goma, part of seven total recoveries (six in Ituri, one in Goma). In North Kivu, 533 contacts are under surveillance, though access to areas controlled by the AFC/M23 rebels limits direct contact, forcing(remote) monitoring. Recovery criteria require prior illness with symptoms, a positive initial test, current absence of symptoms, and two negative tests two days apart. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, occurring amid severe humanitarian needs—malnutrition, displacement, and armed-group activity—that complicate the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：AFC/M23統制下のエリアで対応策が「適切に展開」されていない状況下で、キンシャサは遠隔で状況を監視していると述べ、ゴマでの回復症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（致死率の高い病原体）の新規発生で、ワクチン未承認株の集団発生、国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言、複数県での拡大、紛争地域での対応困難などが報告されている。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の新規ウイルス株でPHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・特異的治療なし。紛争地域（M23反政府勢力統制下）での対応困難が指摘されている。DRC内の複数県（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu）に拡大。17番目のDRCエボラアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة إصابات الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 63 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 5 June 2026, in an ongoing outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected. Health Minister Roger Kamba said in Kinshasa that 233 patients are currently receiving care in facilities, either in isolation while awaiting test results or after symptom onset. Laboratory capacity has improved significantly with the arrival of more than 4,000 test kits from Africa CDC, along with international support. The outbreak was declared on 15 May, and authorities and partners have intensified case finding, isolation, treatment, and contact tracing in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体による継続的な感染症アウトブレイクである。国際的な支援と対策が既に動員されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による宣言済みアウトブレイク。確認症例381件、死亡63件（致死率16.5%）。東部州（Ituri、South Kivu）で拡大中。Africa CDCから4,000個以上の検査キットを含む国際的支援を受領。5月15日にアウトブレイク宣言。WPRO地域外（DRC=アフリカ地域）だが、グローバルヘルスセキュリティ上の優先シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les guérisseurs traditionnels en première ligne face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Traditional healers on the front line against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for this rare strain. In Bunia, traditional healers Mariam Kabika and Dauda Tshimanga claim to cure Ebola with plant-based preparations (eucalyptus, avocado, mango, papaya) and three days of inhalation therapy, plus ancestral rituals. No patients have yet tried this remedy in the current outbreak, but such practices can delay diagnosis and care. Health infrastructure is weak, and many communities rely on tradipraticians, who are not officially recognized but often engaged under license-like norms. About 45% of contacts are followed up, highlighting a slow response. WHO advocates integrating community practices into the response. A previous Bulape outbreak (2025) showed community leaders’ rituals can aid isolation and engagement. Authorities urge referrals to health centers and PPE support for traditional healers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：伝統医療者がエボラウイルスの最前線に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（稀なBundibugyo亜種）の発生が確認され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（治療法なし）、異常性（稀な亜種）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な亜種）の発生であり、ワクチンおよび承認済み治療法が存在しない。接触者追跡率が45%と低く、脆弱な保健インフラと伝統医療慣行への依存が懸念される。2025年のBulazeアウトブレイクの経験から、コミュニティリーダーの関与が隔離に役立つ可能性があるが、診断遅延のリスクも併存。

article.articleHeadline: Made-in-India testing tech looks to power Ebola fight as outbreak rages
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo strain has 363 confirmed cases and at least 62 deaths; Uganda reports 1 death and 15 positives, with true toll likely higher, as of June 4, 2026. Testing kit shortages hinder response. Goa-based Molbio Diagnostics has developed a real-time PCR Ebola assay for the Truenat platform, enabling decentralised, near-patient testing with results in about one hour. The test is undergoing clinical validation with WHO, Africa CDC, and local authorities; India is pursuing ICMR validation and CDSCO approval, and WHO has opened Emergency Use Listing (EUL) that Molbio has begun. Truenat, already deployed across India with over 13,000 machines, is a multi-disease platform for TB, COVID-19, HPV, dengue, and potentially Ebola, scalable to outbreak settings; if approved, the assay could be integrated to speed response in India and parts of Africa.

triage.headline_ja: インド製検査技術がエボラ対策強化へ、流行拡大の中で展開進む
triage.triage_reason: DRC及びウガンダでエボラ出血熱の複数国流行が報告され、IHR基準（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）を2つ以上満たし、死亡例が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのエボラ流行とインド製検査技術の対応であり、Goa（インド）はMolbio Diagnosticsの拠点として言及されている。Ugandaも流行国として記載されているが対象国リストにないため除外。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : un laboratoire installé à Mungwalu pour des diagnostics rapides - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: a laboratory established in Mungwalu for rapid diagnostic tests - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) diagnostic capacity established in Mongbwalu (Mungwalu), Djugu territory, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, about 85 km from Bunia. A RadiOne platform-based diagnostic laboratory was installed to deliver rapid testing near affected communities, per a communiqué from the Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) reviewed by ACP. The facility aims to provide fast, reliable EVD confirmation close to outbreak zones, shortening turnaround times and improving decision-making for surveillance and patient-care teams. Deployed by an INRB team with World Health Organization support, the site brings laboratory tools closer to communities to bolster outbreak response and health security in Ebola-affected areas of Ituri. This development marks a significant advance against Ebola in Ituri by enabling quicker responses to suspected cases and helping limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：ムングワル市に迅速診断用検査室を設置 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の診断施設構築という感染症対応の進展報道であり、発生中の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、対応能力強化の記事である。通常のエボラ流行下における支援活動・インフラ整備の報道に分類される。
triage.notes: 本記事はイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行下における診断施設の構築・展開に関する報道である。アウトブレイク自体の新規発生や悪化の報告ではなく、対応能力の強化に焦点が当たっている。DRCにおけるエボラの慢性的流行状況の文脈で、長期曝露と流行易感性の基準は該当するが、新規シグナルではなく進行中の対応フェーズに該当する。WATCHステータスで継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan woman quarantined in Jaipur after showing Ebola-like symptoms
article.articleSummary: Ugandan woman admitted to RUHS hospital in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, with Ebola-like symptoms. Not diagnosed yet; flagged as suspected case during airport screening after arriving from Sharjah on an Air Arabia flight. Sample sent to Pune for testing, with a second sample to be collected after 48 hours. If positive, she would be quarantined for 21 days and treated accordingly; authorities caution that Ebola cannot be confirmed by symptoms alone. The patient has a month-long history of abdominal pain and loss of appetite, currently also suffering a headache. Passengers who traveled on the same flight are advised to remain in home isolation as a precaution. Officials are monitoring the situation and following prescribed protocols.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ人女性、エボラ様症状を示した後、ジャイプールで隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い例の国際的移動（ウガンダ→UAE→インド）により、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」および「渡航制限リスク」に該当。また異常・予想外性が高く、重症度も懸念される。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダからシャルジャ経由でジャイプール到着。エボラ疑い例であり、未確定だが公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。同便乗客の自宅隔離勧告、サンプルはプーネで検査中。Bluedot発生地域にはUAEを含むが、記事の主題はインド国内の隔離ケースのため verified_locations はインドのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon season precautions to stay safe from infections and waterborne diseases
article.articleSummary: New Delhi: Monsoon season increases risks of infections and waterborne diseases as stagnant water becomes a mosquito breeding ground and contaminated water or food can cause stomach infections, fever and flu. Humidity and fluctuating temperatures may weaken immunity. Stay hydrated with clean, boiled water; carry bottled water while traveling. Prefer freshly cooked meals and avoid street junk food and exposed snacks. Eliminate standing water, clear puddles and unclog drains. Wash fruits and vegetables thoroughly before eating. Sleep 6–8 hours and maintain regular indoor exercise. Practice hand hygiene with soap or sanitizer; avoid getting wet in rain. Outdoor safety: check weather, avoid flooded roads, wear rain gear, use insect repellent, and watch for electrical hazards. Home maintenance: repair leaks, clear drainage, prevent indoor moisture, ensure ventilation, and inspect electrical systems. These precautions help reduce monsoon health risks as of 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン季節における感染症および水系感染症から身を守るための注意事項
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインフルエンザを含む一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な患者報告や疾病発生状況を記載していない。新規の感染症イベント、異常な発生パターン、または公衆衛生上の緊急の懸念を示す根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーのモンスーン季節における一般的な感染症予防対策についての情報記事であり、既発生イベントの報告ではない。具体的な患者数、死亡例、異常発生の報告は含まれていない。シグナル検出の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة إصابات الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising number of Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 381 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 63 deaths from Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Minister of Health Roger Kamba announced that 233 patients are currently receiving care in health facilities, either in isolation awaiting test results or after developing symptoms. The outbreak, declared on May 15, has affected Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces in the eastern region. Since the declaration, authorities and international partners have intensified testing, isolation, and contact tracing. Laboratory-confirmation capacity has improved with the arrival of more than 4,000 test kits from the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, plus additional international support. The response remains focused on the eastern provinces with ongoing surveillance and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による381件の確定症例と63名の死亡報告があり、複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）に拡大している重篤な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属）による大規模アウトブレイク。発表日時が2026年6月5日となっているが、記事内容と一貫性がある。AFCDCから4,000以上のテストキットを含む国際的支援が提供されており、対応体制が構築されている。複数地域への拡大とヒト-ヒト感染による急速な広がりが確認されており、フルRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Le virus Ebola peut encore se transmettre sexuellement après la guérison | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | The Ebola virus can still be transmitted sexually after recovery | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus can persist in semen after clinical recovery, a Kinshasa briefing on June 4, 2026 by DR Congo Public Health Minister Roger Kamba warns of ongoing sexual transmission risk and the need for rigorous survivor follow-up and adherence to health guidelines. The Ebola outbreak remains active in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with field operations continuing to contain spread, provide care, and strengthen epidemiological surveillance. Authorities stress medical and psychosocial support for survivors to minimize transmission risk and aid reintegration. The briefing also denounces measures excluding Congolese nationals from international events as unfounded discrimination, emphasizing that transmission risk depends on contact with an infected person, not nationality, and calling to avoid stigma against Congolese abroad.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | エボラウイルスは回復後も性的に伝染する可能性があります | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。現在進行中の東部DRC多地域でのエボラアウトブレイク、性的伝播リスク、サバイバー追跡の課題など複合的なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの公衆衛生大臣による公式声明に基づく。現在進行中のアウトブレイクはイツリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州で継続中。性的伝播リスクの継続は従来の対応戦略を複雑化させる要因。DRC国籍者への国際的な差別措置についての異議も政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: مراكز طبية أميركية جاهزة لمواجهة إيبولا رغم خطط بناء مرفق في كينيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American medical centers ready to confront Ebola despite plans to build a facility in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Thirteen US-government funded medical centers say they stand ready to handle Ebola and other dangerous infections if needed. The World Health Organization reports the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths. One American infected has received treatment in Germany. The US State Department says exposed Americans who are asymptomatic will be isolated in Kenya at a facility under construction, while pledging to keep the United States free of infected travelers. The Department of Health and Human Services confirms the network's readiness to respond to an outbreak. Public health experts urge repatriating infected Americans for treatment domestically after protests at the Kenyan project site left at least two dead and a Kenyan court ordered a halt to construction. Since 2014, the US has spent hundreds of millions to strengthen its health system via the National Center for Training and Education on Emerging Pathogen Causes.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカの医療センターがエボラに対応する準備を整える、ケニアでの施設建設計画にもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行（344確認例、60死亡）が国際的に拡大し（米国、ドイツで患者報告）、複数国での対応準備と渡航制限措置が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、米国、ドイツ、ケニアが言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。米国・ドイツ・ケニアは対象国外のため除外。DRCでの進行中の大規模エボラ流行と、それに対応する国際的な公衆衛生対応が明らかな重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau ghi nhận trên 1400 ca mắc bệnh tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cà Mau records over 1,400 cases of hand, foot and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau Province, Vietnam, has recorded over 1,400 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases this year, a rise of about 149% year-on-year, with 1 death as of June 5, 2026. A 3-year-old from Vĩnh Thạnh, Vĩnh Lộc commune, was admitted to Hồng Dân District General Hospital with fever, sore throat and vesicles on hands and feet; initially HFMD stage 1 with pharyngitis, later progressing to stage 2a with vomiting and agitation. The child developed high fever, seizures, cyanosis and pulmonary edema, was transferred to Bạc Liêu General Hospital and died from HFMD stage 4 on day 4 due to pulmonary edema and cardiorespiratory arrest. HFMD is common in children but can rapidly cause encephalitis, myocarditis, pulmonary edema and circulatory failure. Hot, humid weather and circulation of Enterovirus 71 (EV71), together with under-5 children in daycare, drive transmission. Early detection and timely school absence reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省が手足口病の1,400例以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるEV71関連の手足口病の異常な増加（前年同期比149%）と死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性）および複数のWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当するため。
triage.notes: EV71による手足口病の流行で1名の死亡例（3歳児、急速に重症化）が確認されている。前年同期比149%の増加率は異常性を示す。ベトナムはWPRO地域であり、EV71は既知の流行病原体だが、この急速な増加と死亡例の発生は重要なシグナルである。国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクについては記事では明記されていないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ കാലവർഷം കനത്തതോടെ പടർന്നുപിടിച്ച് പകർച്ചവ്യാധികളും. ഒരൊറ്റ ദിവസത്തെ പനിബാധിതരുടെ എണ്ണം പതിനായിരം കടന്നു. രോ​ഗബാധ കൂടുതൽ മലപ്പുറത്തും കോഴിക്കോട്ടും. കോട്ടയത്ത് ഡെങ്കി മരണവും തിരുവനന്തപുരത്ത് ഷിഗല്ലയും സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു. സ്കൂളുകൾ തുറന്നതോടെ കുട്ടികളിലും പനി ബാധ. സ്വയം ചികിത്സിക്കരുതെന്നും ജാഗ്രത വേണമെന്നും ആരോഗ്യ വകുപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kerala, as the monsoon intensifies, infectious diseases spread; daily fever cases exceed ten thousand; disease burden higher in Malappuram and Kozhikode; a dengue death confirmed in Kottayam and Shigella in Thiruvananthapuram; fever affects children as schools reopen; health department warns against self-medication and urges vigilance.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, as monsoon intensifies, shows rapid spread of infectious diseases. On June 5, 2026, government hospitals recorded 10,121 fever admissions in a single day; 93 patients required critical care. Private facilities likely push numbers higher. Malappuram district registered the highest fever visits (2,140), followed by Kozhikode (1,080). Dengue is spreading: about 200 people with dengue-like symptoms and 59 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases; Thrissur has 19 confirmed dengue, Thiruvananthapuram 12, with one dengue death reported in Kottayam. Leptospirosis has 4 confirmed cases (8 suspected); malaria reported in 32 people, with 5 confirmed in Idukki and Kasaragod. Shigella (shigellosis) has two confirmed cases in Thiruvananthapuram. Since June 2, cases have risen; June 3 saw 9,144 fever patients and 65 hospitalizations. Health department warns against self-medication and urges prompt medical evaluation, especially as schools reopen and pediatric fever cases rise.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州での雨季の激化に伴う感染症の急速な拡大。1日の発熱患者数が1万を超える。マラップラム州とコーザイコード州での疾病負荷が増加。コッタヤムでのデング熱死亡とティルヴァナンタプラムでのシゲラ症が確認。学校再開に伴い子どもたちにも発熱が発生。保健部門は自己投薬を警告し、警戒を呼びかけ。
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（デング熱、レプトスピラ症、マラリア、シゲラ症）が同時に拡大し、1日の発熱患者数が10,000人超、死亡例を含む重症症例が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」および「異常性」を満たすため、フルリスク評価が必要である。
triage.notes: ケーラ州での複数感染症の同時流行（デング熱、レプトスピラ症、マラリア、シゲラ症）。デング熱では死亡例、レプトスピラ症で疑い例を含む8人が報告。雨季の激化と学校再開が感染拡大を助長している可能性。保健部門による公式な警告が発出されており、政府レベルの対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 381 cas, 63 décès, un taux de létalité sous les 17 % - la riposte qui change la donne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 381 cases, 63 deaths, a case fatality rate below 17% — the response that changes the game.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of June 5, 2026: 381 confirmed cases and 63 deaths, case fatality rate under 17%. The Bundibugyo strain—rare, with no approved vaccine or specific therapy—dominates; rapid, near-field laboratories in Mongbwalu (Ituri) deliver results within 24 hours, cutting false negatives to under 2%. Testing capacity nears 100% accuracy. Contact tracing has risen from 9% to 55.5%, with a 90% coverage target. Currently 233 patients are hospitalized, isolated and monitored. The outbreak spans 25 health zones across Ituri (17), North Kivu (7), and South Kivu (1). Declared May 15, 2026; the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Support from Africa CDC (over 4,000 kits) and World Bank-backed labs and logistics underpins a prevention-first strategy—testing, isolation, and tracing—while urging continued adherence to barrier measures. Security and malnutrition in eastern DRC heighten risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：381例、63死亡、致死率17%未満—状況を変える対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC宣言済み）であり、深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および国際支援の実施という複合的リスク要因を有する。
triage.notes: 2026年6月5日現在、DRCのエボラウイルス病の公衆衛生緊急事態が国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として既にWHOにより宣言されている。Bundibugyo株という稀なバリアントの流行。複数の州（イツリ17地区、北キブ7地区、南キブ1地区）に及ぶ25の保健区域にわたって拡散。セキュリティと栄養不良という基礎的リスク要因により状況が複雑化。Africa CDC および World Bankによる国際支援が既に実施中。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Congo, a radio station tries to stop health misinformation
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola outbreak in Congo, centered on Bunia, declared May 15, 2026. By June 5, 2026, at least 381 confirmed cases and 63 deaths reported. Hundreds of cases were suspected at outbreak declaration, but many residents dismissed it as a Western conspiracy. The outbreak has faced skepticism, attacks on health workers, and pervasive misinformation. A local radio show is attempting to counter misinformation and support response efforts amid the crisis. Ongoing challenges include trust and outreach as authorities and aid groups scale up interventions. The article notes laboratory-confirmed cases but does not specify the infection source or any imported/exported cases. The Bundibugyo Ebola subtype is described as rare, contributing to surprise in local communities and complicating public health messaging.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが蔓延する中、ラジオ局が健康に関する誤情報の阻止に努力
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）。確認済み381例・死亡63例、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が高く、国際的拡大リスクあり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認された381例・63死亡のBundibugyo型エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）。Buniaを中心にDRC内で発生。ヒト-ヒト感染の強い証拠、医療従事者への攻撃、誤情報蔓延が対応を阻害。稀なBundibugyo亜型による社会的懸念が高い。DRCは対象国リストに含まれないため、フルRRA実施時は対象国外扱いとなるが、エボラの国際的リスク管理上、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات.. إجراءات احترازية إضافية على القادمين من 3 دول لمواجهة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UAE: Additional precautionary measures for arrivals from three countries to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UAE authorities announced additional precautionary measures to bolster Ebola preparedness for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Starting 13:00 on Saturday 6 June 2026, visa issuance to nationals of these three countries will be suspended, and entry into the UAE will be denied for arrivals from them (including via transit). Entry will be allowed only for those who have spent more than 21 days outside these countries prior to arrival. Shipping and transit operations between the UAE and the three countries will remain unaffected. The measures may be extended depending on health situation. The authorities will continue to monitor global health developments in coordination with local and international partners and adjust restrictions on other countries as risk assessments warrant, as part of Ebola prevention and national readiness.

triage.headline_ja: UAE: 3カ国からの入国者に対する追加の予防措置によるエボラ対策
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の報告であり、IHR基準で国際拡大リスク（UAE）と渡航制限が明確に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行易すさ・管理性の複数基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラは医療対象国として重大。DRCでのエボラ発生に対し、UAEが公式な入国制限を発令した重要なシグナル。記事サマリーはUAEの措置報道だが、感染イベント自体はDRCが主要地域。Uganda/South Sudanはサマリーに「DRCで発生・他国への拡大対応」という文脈のため、表記はあるが実際のイベント発生地はDRCとみなし、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。日付が2026年6月という未来日付であるため、演習シナリオまたはテストデータの可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تعلن إجراءات احترازية مؤقتة للقادمين من 3 دول أفريقية تعزيزاً للجاهزية ضد "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE announces temporary precautionary measures for arrivals from three African countries to bolster preparedness against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts UAE to impose temporary entry restrictions on arrivals from Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The United Arab Emirates will suspend issuing all new visas to citizens of these three countries and bar entry, including transit, unless travelers prove they have resided outside those countries for at least 21 consecutive days before arrival. The measures take effect at 1:00 PM local time on 6 June 2026 and will be reviewed and may be extended as the global health situation evolves. Cargo and general air-trade operations remain unaffected, and routine transit flights continue under existing rules. The announcement, by the National Emergency Crisis and Disasters Management Authority in coordination with the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Ports Security, reflects heightened preparedness against Ebola. Health authorities will monitor developments and adjust measures to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦、エボラ対策としてアフリカ3カ国からの入国者に一時的な予防措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスクが存在し、複数国での発生確認、渡航制限措置の実施、国際的な懸念の高まりが認められる。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの入国者に対するUAEの制限措置が主題。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国に含まれないため除外。エボラはWPRO地域の重要なシグナルであり、複数国での同時発生と国際的な渡航制限措置の実施により高リスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: "الطوارئ والأزمات" و"الهوية والجنسية " تعلنان إجراءات احترازية إضافية للقادمين من عدد من الدول في إطار تعزيز الجاهزية للتعامل مع فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The Emergencies and Crises" and "Identity and Citizenship" announce additional precautionary measures for arrivals from a number of countries as part of strengthening preparedness to deal with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: The United Arab Emirates’ National Authority for Emergency, Crises and Disaster Management and the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship and Ports Security announced enhanced precautionary measures in response to Ebola. Effective 13:00 on 6 June 2026, all new visas, including visitor visas, issued to nationals of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan are suspended to strengthen national preparedness. Cargo flights between the UAE and the three countries will continue. Entry is prohibited for travelers from these countries, including those arriving via transit through other countries, unless they have spent more than 21 days outside those countries before arriving in the UAE; transit flights are not affected. Authorities will monitor Ebola developments with local and international partners and adjust risk-based measures as needed, evaluating potential implications for other countries according to health risk assessments.

triage.headline_ja: 「緊急事態・危機管理」と「身分証明・国籍」が、複数国からの入国者向けに追加的予防措置を発表—エボラウイルス対策の準備態勢強化の一環として
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、複数国での発生確認、主要国による国境制限措置実施。IHR基準3項目（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当し、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでのエボラ発生が明記されている。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リスト外のため除外。南スーダン（366755）も対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCのみ対象国に該当。UAEは措置実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。マルチプル国家による公式な渡航制限措置の発表は、国際的な懸念の高さを示唆しており、RRA進捗が急務。

article.articleHeadline: الطوارئ والأزمات والهوية والجنسية تعلنان إجراءات احترازية إضافية للقادمين من عدد من الدول في إطار تعزيز الجاهزية للتعامل مع فيروس إيبولا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency, Crises, Identity and Citizenship Announce Additional Precautionary Measures for Arrivals from Several Countries as Part of Strengthening Readiness to Deal with the Ebola Virus - Ardu Point
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the UAE’s National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Ports Security announced enhanced precautionary measures to bolster readiness against Ebola. Visa restrictions target travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan: all new visas, including tourist visas, are suspended from 13:00 on 6 June 2026, with possible extension; cargo/shipping flights between the UAE and the three countries will continue. Entry will be denied for travelers from these countries, including those arriving via transit, unless they have spent more than 21 days outside these countries before arriving in the UAE; transit flights are not affected. Authorities will monitor Ebola developments in coordination with local and international partners and adjust measures based on risk assessments and approved health standards.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦、エボラウイルス対応強化の一環として複数国からの入国者向け追加的予防措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常/予想外の公式措置発表、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニングでも流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当。対象国DRCが関連する公式対応イベント。
triage.notes: UAEの公式な渡航制限措置が発表されている。サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンから対象国はDRCのみ。2026年6月5日時点での比較的最近のイベント。エボラ発生の具体的な患者数や重症度については記事に記載がないため『不明』と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Jakbar layani 30.895 terduga TBC hingga akhir Mei 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Jakarta serves 30,895 suspected TB cases through the end of May 2026.
article.articleSummary: West Jakarta (Jakarta Barat) intensified tuberculosis (TB) control, delivering services to 30,859 suspected TB patients through end-May 2026. In the first five months of 2026, 4,438 patients were found and treated to standard quality. Monitoring for 1 January–31 May 2026 shows growth from 3,027 detections by mid-April, supporting a 2026 target of 11,955 TB case detections in Jakarta Barat as part of eliminating TB in DKI Jakarta by 2030. Detection employs both active and passive strategies: active screening and Free Health Checks (CKG) at communities and TB cadres in the field, plus passive presentation of suspects at health facilities. Diagnostic workups rely on sputum examination and radiology (X-ray) per medical indications. All treated patients receive standard care with adherence monitoring, and contacts are evaluated; healthy contacts may receive TB preventive therapy (TPT). Public health outreach emphasizes PHBS, cough etiquette, immunization, and access to TB services.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタ西部が2026年5月末までに結核の疑い患者30,895人に対応
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事はルーチンな公衆衛生活動（症例検出・治療）の進捗報告である。異常な発生パターン、重症度の急増、国際的拡大リスク、管理困難性は認められない。
triage.notes: インドネシア（ジャカルタ西部）での結核症例の定期的な検出・治療報告。同国は結核高負担国として知られており、本記事は保健当局による既定の結核対策プログラムの進捗を示すルーチン情報。シグナルとしての新規性・異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: "الطوارئ والأزمات" و"الهوية والجنسية" تعلنان إجراءات احترازية ضد إيبولا للقادمين من 3 دول
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Emergency and Crises" and "Identity and Citizenship" announce precautionary measures against Ebola for travelers arriving from three countries.
article.articleSummary: UAE authorities announced precautionary Ebola-related travel measures for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The National Emergency, Crisis and Disaster Management Authority and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Ports Security said visa issuance for nationals of the three countries, including tourist visas, will be halted, and entry for travelers from these countries (including via transit) will be prohibited. Entry will be allowed only for those who have spent more than 21 days outside the three countries prior to arrival in the United Arab Emirates. The measures take effect at 13:00 on Saturday, 6 June 2026, and may be extended based on health conditions. Cargo and transit flights to and from the UAE with the three states will continue normally. Authorities will monitor global health developments and adjust risk-based measures as needed.

triage.headline_ja: UAE当局、イボラ対策として3カ国からの入国者に対する予防措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は IHR 上の規定疾患であり、複数国での流行報告（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）に加え、UAE が国際的な入国制限措置を実施しており、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが明確に認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラウイルス病が DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで報告されていることが明示されている。対象国リストに該当するのは DRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。UAE の入国制限措置は国際的関心が極めて高く、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Hà Nội tăng cường phòng chống dịch Ebola tại cửa khẩu quốc tế
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi's CDC steps up Ebola prevention and control at international border crossings.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in Africa prompt Hanoi's CDC to reinforce border controls at Noi Bai International Airport. 24/7 medical quarantine is maintained with two international arrival lanes, four automatic temperature scanners, and eight health staff per shift for fever screening, epidemiological interviews, and health surveillance. Suspected cases are isolated and referred to the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases for assessment, diagnosis, and treatment; if suspected caseload surges, a reception plan at Bac Thang Long General Hospital is activated. Each lane includes a clinic room and a temporary isolation area. WHO currently assesses Vietnam’s risk as low, though vigilance remains high. Travelers returning from affected regions should self-monitor for 21 days and seek care if fever, fatigue, vomiting, or diarrhea appears. Hanoi CDC Director Bùi Văn Hào emphasizes enhanced surveillance, border quarantine, and public communication to prevent importation and protect the community.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイのCDC、国際国境検問所でのエボラ出血熱予防・管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ流行に対応したベトナムの国境強化措置についての報道。記事サマリーでWHOがベトナムのリスクを低と評価しており、実際の患者発生ではなく予防的対応のため、現時点ではシグナルピックアップの基準に達していない。ただし、エボラは重大な疾患であり、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナム国内でのエボラ対策強化であり、実際の患者発生報告ではない。アフリカでの流行に対する予防的措置である。WHO評価では低リスクとされている。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: How Gold Is Driving the Spread of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, began as early as February but was not detected until May 15, when a crisis was declared. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no specific treatment, is driving this outbreak, already described as the third largest on record. More than 80 deaths occurred in the weeks before detection, with reports that five people had died on one street and a sixth fell ill. The illness is spreading through Mongbwalu’s gold-mining economy, where miners and traders work in close contact and cross-border trade can move the virus. Observers note at least one patient bleeding. The crisis underscores delayed detection amid dangerous mining conditions and limited therapeutic options for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 金採掘がエボラの拡大を推進している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolasの新規流行で既に80人以上の死亡、人口密集・国境越境労働による高い感染リスク、治療手段の限定。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（治療法なし）の検出遅延（2月発症→5月15日検出）が特筆。金採掘セクターでの高感染リスク、越境貿易による国際拡大懸念が重大。症例重症度（出血症状報告）と死亡率も高い。DRC当局および国際社会の早急な対応が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: A nurse who survived the current Ebola outbreak: 'I screamed in pain, my body ached and I felt itchy all over'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province with Bunia as the epicenter. Four health workers, including nurse Furaha Tikamanyire at Bunia Evangelical Medical Center, were discharged May 31 after contracting the Bundibugyo strain before official declaration on May 15. Symptoms included headaches, extreme fatigue, stomach pains, loss of appetite, conjunctivitis, eye pain, body aches, and itching; infection likely from close patient contact and exposure to blood. The strain lacks approved vaccines or treatments; care relies on early intensive supportive management. As of June 2, 2026, DRC has 363 confirmed cases, 206 hospitalized/isolated, 62 deaths, with 116 suspected cases; Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases and one death. Ituri logs 341 confirmed cases and 48 deaths across 15 affected health zones. Six people have recovered in the DRC and two in Uganda. WHO stresses early care at specialized facilities to boost survival; outbreak began in Mongbwalu before spreading to Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行を生き延びた看護師：『痛みで叫び、体が痛く、全身がかゆかった』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響（363確認例、62死亡）、異常事象、複数国への拡大（ウガンダで15確認例、1死亡）、国際渡航・貿易制限リスクを示す。WPRO基準でも全項目該当し、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのイトゥリ州での流行。ウガンダは二次的な国境越え拡大例として言及されているのみで、検証済みロケーションはDRCのみ。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）、ワクチン/治療法なし、2026年6月時点での継続流行。

article.articleHeadline: ഇന്ത്യയിൽ വീണ്ടും എബോള വൈറസ് സംശയം; പനിയുമായി സുഡാൻ സ്വദേശിയെ ഹൈദരാബാദ് ആശുപത്രിയിൽ പ്രവേശിപ്പിച്ചു | Ebola outbreak suspected again in India; Sudanese national admitted to Hyderabad hospital with fever
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus suspected again in India; Sudanese national with fever admitted to Hyderabad hospital.
article.articleSummary: Two Sudanese nationals with suspected Ebola are in Hyderabad, India. On 2026-06-05, Gandhi Hospital admitted a 20-year-old Sudanese student with Ebola-like symptoms, transferred Friday from a private hospital for specialist evaluation; he is afebrile and improving, with a close contact under home observation while tests await results. Earlier, a 35-year-old Sudanese man who arrived at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport with fever and myalgia was moved to Gandhi Hospital after thermal screening detected fever; by Friday morning, officials said he had no fever or other symptoms. Authorities maintain high vigilance for travelers from Ebola-affected countries, enforcing strict airport screening and self-declaration forms. The hospital has a dedicated 10-bed Ebola isolation ward. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood, secretions, or organs and is zoonotic (animal-to-human transmission).

triage.headline_ja: インドで再びエボラウイルスが疑われる；発熱を伴うスーダン人国籍者がハイデラバード病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑い患者がインドで報告された。IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当する。国際的に高リスク病原体であり、スーダンからの輸入症例として監視対象。
triage.notes: スーダンからインドへの輸入症例。2名のスーダン人国籍者が関連。検査結果待機中。空港での感染症スクリーニング体制が機能している。ただし、現時点では確定診断ではなく臨床的な疑い。インド側は隔離病床を備え、対応準備が整っている。スーダンのエボラ流行状況が背景にあるリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Két kutatót őrizetbe vettek, mert megpróbáltak Afrikából mpox- vírust bejuttatni az USA-ba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two researchers were taken into custody after attempting to import the mpox virus from Africa into the United States.
article.articleSummary: Two virologists at a high-security U.S. research facility were detained at Detroit Metropolitan Airport in January after returning from Congo-Brazzaville, accused of importing mpox (monkeypox) samples without proper approvals. Authorities found more than 100 vials in their luggage; laboratory testing indicated most samples contained inactivated mpox virus. The defendants could face up to five years’ imprisonment, amid concerns that even inactivated materials require strict international and U.S. transport controls, documentation, and accurate disclosure to border authorities. The case highlights tensions between scientific freedom, biosecurity, and international outbreak regulations. Mpox is an Orthopoxvirus; first human case occurred in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with transmission via close contact, lesions, bodily fluids, or respiratory droplets. Global mpox activity has fluctuated; in the first seven months of 2025, 34,000 lab-confirmed cases and 138 deaths were reported worldwide, though Africa’s Union notes reduced incidence and no longer a public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の研究者が、アフリカからアメリカへのmpoxウイルス密輸を試みたため身柄を拘束された
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティ違反事案であり、100以上のvialを含む無認可のmpoxサンプル密輸試行は国際保健規制違反として深刻。DRCとの関連も含まれ、異常かつ予想外の事案であり、国際的な関心と管理可能性評価の対象となるシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる事案はUS国内（デトロイト）での密輸逮捕事案だが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。発生地域にはRepublic of the Congoも含まれるが、サマリーではCongo-Brazzaville(共和国)からのサンプル輸入とされており、共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本案件はバイオセキュリティ/輸送規制違反の重大事案として、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: UAE announces travel restrictions on three African countries amid Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: UAE authorities NCEMA and ICP announce precautionary Ebola-related travel measures targeting the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. As of 13:00 on Saturday 6 June 2026, new visas for nationals of these countries (including visit visas) are suspended, with cargo flights to/from the UAE continuing normally. Travelers arriving from the listed countries will be denied entry, including those transiting through other countries, unless they have spent more than 21 days outside the listed countries before arriving in the UAE. Transit flight operations remain unaffected. Officials will monitor Ebola developments with local and international partners, assess potential impacts on other countries, and implement measures aligned with risk assessments and approved health standards.

triage.headline_ja: UAEがエボラ懸念を背景に3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航制限を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラの国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念、および複数国での検出に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンのエボラ流行を背景にした渡航制限措置を報じている。対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみが該当する。ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国外。UAEの措置は複数国での発生を反映した国際的対応であり、IHR基準を全て満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: UAE announces precautionary measures for arrivals from 3 countries
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak triggers UAE precautionary measures for arrivals from Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The National Emergency Crisis and Disasters Management Authority announced additional precautionary and proactive steps for travelers from these three African countries to enhance national preparedness and protect community health and safety. The article does not provide case or death counts, laboratory confirmations, or details of the measures themselves. It notes the response aims to mitigate potential importation or spread of Ebola through international arrivals and underscores ongoing public health risk management. Publication date: 2026-06-05. No further outbreak timeline, symptoms, or infection source are specified in the report; the focus remains on travel-related safeguards in the context of the Ebola situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：UAEが3か国からの到着者に対する予防措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤（致死率が高い）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、複数国での報告と渡航制限措置の実施により該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで具体的な症例数や死亡数、確定診断の詳細は提供されていないが、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行が言及されており、UAEが国境での検疫措置を実施している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。エボラは極めて高い致死率を持つVHF（ウイルス性出血熱）であり、多国間への拡大リスクと国際的な対応が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: TKP: Mysteriöse Verhaftung von Ebola-Virologen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TKP: Mysterious Arrest of Ebola Virologists.
article.articleSummary: Two virologists were arrested at Detroit airport in January after allegedly transporting Ebola-related pathogens from the Congo in their luggage. They have been charged with conspiracy to smuggle regulated pathogens. A video by French geneticist Alexandra Henrion-Caude helped bring the case to public attention. The article links the detained researchers to Ebola virus research, with the Congo identified as the origin of the implicated pathogens. No infections, outbreaks, or laboratory confirmations are reported in the piece. The report highlights concerns about handling and transport of regulated pathogens and potential export/import violations, framed by the legal charges rather than confirmed epidemiological details.

triage.headline_ja: TKP: エボラウイルス専門家の謎めいた逮捕
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の発生・流行ではなく、病原体不正輸送に関する法的事件の報道である。実際の感染例、アウトブレーク、検査確認がなく、疫学的なシグナルとしての価値が認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は法的事件（病原体密輸事件）の報道であり、感染症のシグナルではない。記事サマリーで明示されている通り、感染例、アウトブレーク、または検査確認の報告がない。DRCは病原体の出所として言及されているが、実際の疫学的イベントの発生地ではない。Bluedot APIが検出した複数国（米国、フランス）はいずれも対象国リスト外のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: NEW: Zimbabwe pledges US$1 million towards fighting Ebola
article.articleSummary: Zimbabwe pledges US$1 million to help fight Ebola amid an outbreak spanning Central and East Africa, following Africa CDC’s appeal as the DRC outbreak widens into Uganda. As of May 22, 2026, the DRC reports 750 cases; Uganda’s imported cases rose from two to five, indicating active cross-border transmission and sustained regional risk. Zimbabwe’s Deputy Chief Secretary George Charamba announced the donation via X; Health and Child Care Minister Dr Douglas Mombeshora emphasized no Zimbabwean cases to date but heightened alert and expanded border screening. Information Minister Dr Zhemu Soda underscored the regional threat and need for urgent action. Authorities have intensified surveillance at airports and road borders, deploying port-health staff to screen travellers, noting that mobility across DRC, Zambia, Tanzania, Angola, and Zimbabwe raises import risk.

triage.headline_ja: ジンバブエがエボラ対策に100万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間にまたがる複合発生であり、IHR基準で4項目中4項目すべてに該当。対象国（ザンビア、DRC）での実際の症例報告と国際拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境伝播確認）により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの750症例（5月22日時点）とウガンダへの越境伝播（5症例に増加）を明記。ザンビアは地理的隣接国として国境スクリーニング強化の対象に指定されている。アンゴラ・モザンビーク・タンザニア・ジンバブエも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。複数国の政府レベルの対応（財政支援、国境警備体制強化）が記録されている。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan: Suspected Ebola case reported in Jaipur, woman from Uganda isolated
article.articleSummary: Jaipur, Rajasthan reports a suspected Ebola case: a Ugandan woman arriving from Sharjah showed Ebola-like symptoms, was admitted to RUHS Jaipur in strict isolation, and samples have been sent to a Pune lab for testing; lab confirmation is expected by this evening or tomorrow morning. The suspected pathogen is the Bundibugyo strain; Ebola caused by Bundibugyo is a viral haemorrhagic fever with high mortality and, at present, no approved vaccines or specific treatments. India has not reported any Bundibugyo Ebola case. Globally, the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreaks prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (May 17, 2026), and Africa CDC has declared a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security for Bundibugyo Ebola in DRC and Uganda. Temporary IHR recommendations aim to strengthen entry-point surveillance and discourage travel to affected areas. India has provided medical aid to Africa CDC, including a May 24 2.5-ton tranche and a June 2, 2026 43-ton shipment to Kampala, with ongoing support from MEA.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州：ジャイプールでエボラ疑い事例報告、ウガンダから来た女性が隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolaはアフリカで進行中のPHEIC対象株であり、インドでは初の報告例。高い重症度と死亡率を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はインド・ラジャスタン州ジャイプールの疑い事例報告である。発生地域に含まれるDRC（203312）およびUganda（226074）は患者の滞在経路上の国だが、記事の主題となるイベント発生地はインド。UAE（Sharjah）は患者の経由地だが、記事では疑い事例そのものはジャイプールで報告されている。WHO PHeIC（2026年5月17日）および Africa CDC公開宣言の文脈での国際的懸念が存在。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات.. إجراءات احترازية إضافية للقادمين من عدد من الدول في إطار الجاهزية للتعامل مع "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UAE: Additional precautionary measures for arrivals from a number of countries as part of preparedness to deal with Ebola
article.articleSummary: UAE authorities, including the National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Ports Security, announced additional precautionary measures for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan to bolster readiness against Ebola. The measures stop issuing all new visas for nationals of the three countries (including visitor visas) effective 13:00 on Saturday, 6 June 2026, with possible extension, while shipping flights between the UAE and the three nations continue. Entry for travelers arriving from these countries, including via transit through other states, will be barred unless the traveler has spent more than 21 days outside those countries prior to UAE arrival; transit operations are not affected. Authorities will continue monitoring Ebola developments with local and international partners and adjust risk-based measures as needed.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦：エボラ対策の準備体制の一環として、複数国からの入国者に対する追加の予防措置
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスのDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでの発生が背景にあり、UAEが渡航・入国制限措置を実施。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に複数該当し、国家レベルの対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: 記事はUAEの予防措置発表が主体だが、エボラの実際の発生地はDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。エボラは極めてハイリスク疾患であり、対アフリカ国家の渡航制限措置の実施はIHR基準を複数満たしフルRRA進行の優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte à Ebola: la RDC se félicite de la progression du taux de traçabilité des cas contacts avec les patients (passant de 9 à 55,5%), l'objectif étant d'atteindre 90%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response: the DRC hails progress in the rate of tracing contacts of patients (rising from 9% to 55.5%), with the aim of reaching 90%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) shows improved contact tracing, rising from 9% to 55.5% across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with a target of 90%. Twenty days after the official declaration, authorities report 381 laboratory-confirmed cases and 63 deaths, a case fatality rate below 17%. Enhanced surveillance for high-risk contacts includes possible preventive isolation, while new Ebola treatment centers and stronger PPE protect healthcare workers. Diagnostic capacity has expanded via an enlarged laboratory network and RapidOne testing, with false negatives under 2%. More than 4,000 Africa CDC test kits and World Bank support bolster screening, and a new lab in Mongwalu near Bunia enables on-site analyses with a 24-hour turnaround. Officials emphasize the epidemic is not at 900–1,000 cases and that tracing will help anticipate new cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：コンゴ民主共和国が接触者追跡率の進展を称賛（9％から55.5％に上昇）、目標は90％到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目が該当。高い死亡率と国際的な支援体制の構築が示唆されており、シグナルとして識別する価値がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の確定症例381例、死亡63例（致死率17％以下）が報告されている。複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）にわたる発生。国際的な支援（Africa CDC、World Bank）が既に投入されており、診断能力拡大と接触者追跡強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: مراكز أمريكية متخصصة تؤكد جاهزيتها للتعامل مع حالات الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Specialized U.S. centers confirm their readiness to handle Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Thirteen U.S. government-funded medical centers within a network declared readiness to manage Ebola cases, including treating any patients if needed, according to U.S. Health and Human Services and Reuters. The announcement comes as the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to face an Ebola outbreak, with the World Health Organization reporting 344 confirmed infections and 60 deaths. The U.S. State Department said American citizens potentially exposed but asymptomatic would be quarantined at a facility being established in Kenya, while public health experts have urged transferring any infected Americans to the United States for treatment at specialized centers. Since 2014, the United States has invested hundreds of millions to strengthen its ability to respond to high-risk infectious diseases and to bolster specialized outbreak facilities. WHO also noted that containment efforts in Africa have been somewhat delayed.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の専門医療センターがエボラ症例対応の準備完了を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。進行中のDRC エボラアウトブレイク（344例、60死亡）に対する米国の医療対応体制整備という国際的関心の高い事象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUSAとKenyaが含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCのエボラアウトブレイクに対する米国の対応体制整備であり、米国やケニアでの発生ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ケニアの施設は米国市民の隔離用途であり、実際の発生地ではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているため計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmado caso de raiva animal em bovino em Alfenas | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed rabies case in cattle in Alfenas.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in cattle in the rural area of Alfenas, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The infected animal was on a property in Campinho neighborhood, between Alfenas and Divisa Nova. As of 2026-06-05, the Municipal Environmental Surveillance initiated transmission-blocking actions, including vaccination campaigns for dogs and cats and guidance to cattle producers to vaccinate their herd. Notification came from the Instituto Mineiro de Agropecuária (IMA). Authorities urge residents to report rabies symptoms in domestic animals, cattle, horses, and goats to prevent further spread. The response emphasizes ongoing surveillance and vaccination; no laboratory details or infection source are provided.

triage.headline_ja: Alfonasの牛で動物狂犬病が確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来の狂犬病が確認されたが、ヒト感染報告がなく、ブラジルの公衆衛生体系における標準的な対応がとられている。ただし狂犬病の致命性の高さと予防接種キャンペーン展開の状況から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は動物狂犬病（牛）の事例であり、ヒト感染は報告されていない。ブラジルは狂犬病に関する充分な対応能力を有しており、IMA等の地方当局による予防接種キャンペーンが実施されている。ただし狂犬病の致命性の高さと、ヒト感染リスク（家畜生産者への暴露可能性）から、続報注視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: World News in Brief: UN scales up Ebola response, refugees 'exiled' in Africa, Political tensions escalate in Somalia
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with more than 90% of cases in Ituri (also detected in North and South Kivu). The UN notes attacks on frontline workers and rumours hindering control measures; Uganda has expanded screening at 31 entry points, deployed rapid-response teams and mobile labs, and continues community outreach with UNICEF, IOM and UNHCR support. Separately, UNHCR estimates 6.4 million refugees and asylum-seekers displaced in Eastern and Southern Africa by end-2025, many from Sudan, South Sudan and Somalia, with a median under-five displacement exceeding 18 years, underscoring the need for durable solutions beyond emergency aid. In Somalia, renewed violence in central Mogadishu prompts UN calls for restraint and dialogue, warning against a repeat of the 2021 crisis and urging protection of civilians and infrastructure with international facilitation.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュース速報：国連がエボラ対応を拡大、アフリカで難民が「追放」、ソマリアで政治的緊張が激化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの複数国での継続的な流行（DRC、ウガンダ）、医療従事者への攻撃、地域的な警告システムの機能不全がIHR基準2項目（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、国連による対応拡大という社会的関心の高さが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはソマリア、ウガンダ、スーダンも列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCおよびウガンダのエボラ流行。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）に含まれ、ウガンダ・ソマリア・スーダンは対象国リストに該当しないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。記事の前半部分（段落1）がエボラ流行で、後半はソマリアの政治紛争と難民危機について述べられており、感染症イベントとしてはDRCでのエボラが主要な対象。医療従事者への攻撃と根拠のない風説がコントロール措置を阻害していることが管理可能性の懸念を強める。

article.articleHeadline: 感染乙流併發嚴重肺炎及休克　17歲男童危殆留醫PICU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza B infection complicated by severe pneumonia and shock; 17-year-old boy in critical condition admitted to PICU.
article.articleSummary: A 17-year-old boy with preexisting chronic illness in Hong Kong has Influenza B complicated by severe pneumonia and shock, currently in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit. He was first admitted to Tseung Kwan O Hospital on 27 May for fever, vomiting and seizures, and gradually improved. On 3 June he developed fever again with cough and blood-tinged sputum; respiratory samples on 4 June confirmed Influenza B. He was transferred to Union Hospital’s PICU and remains in a critical state. The patient was unvaccinated against seasonal flu; there was no travel or school exposure, and his boarding school reported no flu outbreak among contacts. The Centre for Health Protection continues to investigate. Hong Kong flu activity has risen recently but remains below baseline; HK typically experiences two flu seasons per year, with variable timing.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザBが重度肺炎及びショックを併発　17歳男児が危篤状態でPICU入院中
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザB感染による重症患者（肺炎・ショック）の報告であり重症度基準を満たすが、散発例であり地域的な流行拡大を示す情報がないため。香港の時期的な流行活動は現在ベースライン以下とされている。
triage.notes: 記事は香港での散発的な重症インフルエンザB症例を報告。患者は予防接種未実施、学校・職場での流行なし、渡航歴なし。香港の流行活動は現在ベースライン以下とのこと。重症度は認められるが、地域的流行拡大の兆候に乏しいため、継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 流感｜17歲男童併發嚴重肺炎及休克　情況危殆留醫PICU | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza | 17-year-old boy complicated by severe pneumonia and shock; in critical condition; admitted to PICU | am730
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Hong Kong’s Department of Health Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe influenza B case in a 17-year-old boy with underlying chronic illness. The patient was admitted to Tseung Kwan O Hospital on 27 May with fever, vomiting and a seizure, later improving, but fever recurred on 3 June with cough and blood-streaked sputum. On 4 June he was transferred to United Christian Hospital’s Pediatric Intensive Care Unit, where respiratory samples tested positive for influenza B and the diagnosis was influenza B with severe pneumonia and shock; he remains critically ill. He had not received the 2025/26 seasonal flu vaccine; there were no travel or school exposures during the incubation period, and close contacts were asymptomatic; the boarding school had no influenza outbreak. Active influenza activity in Hong Kong has risen in recent weeks but stays below baseline, though further uptick is possible.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ | 17歳少年が重症肺炎とショックを併発、危篤状態でPICUに入院 | am730
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザBの重症個別症例であり、WPROs基準の重症度（中等度～重症、ICU入院）に該当するが、現時点では散発症例であり国際的な拡大リスクや異常性の明確なシグナルが不足している。情報の発展を監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 香港での個別の重症インフルエンザB症例の報告。香港の検査機関（Department of Health Centre for Health Protection）が調査中。患者は香港内での接触者追跡で感染源が特定されておらず、学校内での流行なし。香港全体のインフルエンザ活動は上昇傾向だがベースラインを下回っている。この段階では散発症例のままだが、香港地域でのインフルエンザ活動の上昇傾向に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'We are catching up' - WHO chief on DR Congo's Ebola fight
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo strain, shows progress but major challenges remain. In the DRC, 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths; suspected cases reduced to 116 from over 1,000; epicentre is Ituri, with cases in North and South Kivu. Three Ebola treatment centres operate in Bunia (Ituri capital) with 80 beds; treatment units exist in five other regional cities, with more planned. Uganda reports one confirmed death and 15 confirmed cases, including a Congolese resident who traveled from the UAE; a U.S.-infected patient is in Germany. WHO risk is very high nationally, high regionally, and low globally. Key obstacles: testing, surveillance, vaccine development; contact tracing around 45% follow-up, needs to exceed 90%. Blanket travel restrictions urged to be lifted; exit screening recommended. Community mistrust remains a barrier. No approved treatments; three vaccines are in development. Leadership and trusted local engagement are essential to ending the outbreak and preventing recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: 「追いついている」- コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策についてのWHO事務局長の発言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数国での死亡者、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。複数国での確認症例と死亡、高い地域リスク評価により、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、USA、Germany、UAEが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内の発生状況。ウガンダでの症例(15確認例、1死亡)が記載されているが、これはDRC住民の移動による輸入例。USA及びドイツの症例も DRC発の輸入例。したがって verified_locations は DRC のみ。WHO が高い地域リスク、全国的な非常に高いリスク評価。検査、監視、ワクチン開発が主な課題。コミュニティの不信が障害。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情延燒　美國13家專責醫院已準備就緒 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola outbreak continues to spread; 13 U.S. designated hospitals are ready.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread, with WHO data reporting 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths. In the United States, 13 designated centers are prepared to admit Ebola patients, with at least nine confirmed capable of handling such cases. Facilities include the University of Nebraska, Emory University, Bellevue Hospital (New York), and Cedars-Sinai Medical Center (Los Angeles). The centers, funded through the National Emerging Special Pathogen Training and Education Center, operate with about $21 million annually to bolster biosecurity since the 2014 West Africa outbreak. U.S. policy plans to build isolation facilities in Kenya have drawn criticism from health experts and former CDC officials. They warn keeping infected citizens abroad may raise medical risks and deter volunteers. Each center must be able to treat at least two viral hemorrhagic fever patients concurrently, conduct quarterly training, and maintain robust lab testing capacity and PPE stockpiles, per HHS.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が続く広がり、米国13の指定医療機関が対応準備完了
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク（DRCで344例、60死亡）と米国での対応体制確立が報告されており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行。米国の医療機関準備は対応状況の報道だが、実際の患者発生は報告されていないため対象国リストでは米国は除外。ケニアでの施設建設計画への言及があるがそれ自体の患者発生報告はないため除外。DRCのみが confirmed outbreak location。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem 74% no primeiro quadrimestre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall by 74% in the first four months.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Londrina, Brazil, shows significant transmission decline in 2026. In the first four months, 1,221 cases have been confirmed with 112 new cases in the last two weeks, while 1,041 are under analysis. Compared with 2025, notifications dropped by 74% in the same period, and fatalities declined to one case in 2026 (eight in 2025, 49 in 2024). The Contingency Plan 2026 expanded vector-control efforts, including about 1,000 mosquito traps across urban and rural Londrina, drone inspections of households, and adult mosquito analysis in partnership with Universidade Estadual de Londrina (UEL). Environmental Surveillance reports inspectors completed 70% of 900 mapped properties, focusing on closed sites in the most affected areas. Residents are urged to schedule inspections at 0800 400 1893.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者数が過去4か月で74%減少
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジル・ロンドリーナにおけるデング熱患者数の顕著な減少を報告しており、公衆衛生への正の進展を示している。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的・政治的関心も国際的支援の必要性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は病例数の大幅な減少（前年同期比74%減）、死亡者数の減少（8例から1例へ）、および積極的な予防管理対策の実施を報告している。これは公衆衛生危機ではなく、むしろ管理成功を示す正の進展であり、シグナルとしてピックアップする要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim da Saúde alerta para o aumento da circulação de vírus respiratórios em Londrina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Bulletin warns of increased circulation of respiratory viruses in Londrina.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) drive increased circulation of respiratory viruses in Londrina, Brazil, per a DVS bulletin. Over the last 15 days rhinovirus, influenza A/B, RSV, and adenovirus were most active, with influenza and RSV most prominent. May 17–23 yielded 85 hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI): 54 adults, 31 children ≤12; data through June 1. There were 18 SARI deaths (2 influenza, 2 RSV, 14 with no virus confirmed). May 24–29, Pediatric Emergency (PAI) had 3,802 visits; 2,021 ILI. UPAs and PAs totaled 14,312 visits; 4,293 ILI (30%). Vaccination coverage is 54.68% overall (May 29): elderly 50.12%, pregnant 89.66%, children 24.29%. UBS vaccination sites operate Mon–Fri 7:00–18:30. Emphasis on vaccination and preventive measures; seek care at nearest UBS; urgent cases at PAs/UPAs. Pediatric care expanded at Maria Cecília and Ouro Branco UBSs.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナでの呼吸器ウイルス循環増加に関する保健速報
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAおよびRSVによる呼吸器ウイルス循環の増加、SARI入院・死亡の報告があるが、対象国リストに該当する地域での発生ではないため、フルRRAの優先度は低い。ただし、ワクチン接種率が比較的低い小児（24.29%）での活動が確認されており、情報の継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はBrazil（ブラジル）のロンドリーナ市だが、ブラジルはCEPR対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。記事には SARI 入院85件、死亡18件が報告されており、小児でのワクチン接種率（24.29%）が低い点が懸念される。地域保健局（DVS）からの公式速報であり、政府機関による対応は確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: UAE suspends new visas for Ebola-hit DRC, Uganda, South Sudan nationals
article.articleSummary: UAE suspends new visas for nationals from Ebola-hit Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan as an additional precaution. The National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority (NCEMA) and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP) said the measure takes effect at 1300 on Saturday, June 6, 2026, and may be extended. Cargo flights between the UAE and the three countries will continue. Travellers arriving from these countries will be denied entry, including those transiting through them, unless they have spent more than 21 days outside the listed countries before arriving in the UAE. Transit flight operations are unaffected. Authorities will monitor Ebola developments in coordination with local and international partners and adjust risk assessments and health standards as needed.
