triage.headline_ja: UAEがエボラ出血熱の流行地域であるDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン国民への新規ビザ発行を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国における流行・確認、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施、国際関心の高さ。IHR基準で「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」に該当し、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が予想される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明示されているエボラ流行地域はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。UgandaとSouth Sudanは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。UAEの渡航制限措置は国際的な渡航・貿易制限に該当し、IHR通知基準を十分に満たす。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: County trains frontline workers on Ebola preparedness and response
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, Turkana County, Kenya, launched a four-day Ebola preparedness and response training for 70 frontline health workers from referral hospitals, sub-county facilities, and entry points. The program covers early detection, screening, triage, isolation, case notification, and infection prevention and control, with practical instruction in PPE use, hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, waste management, and safe patient handling. Simulations strengthen participants' ability to promptly identify, report, and respond to suspected Ebola cases while protecting patients, staff, and communities. Daniel Esimit, Director of Preventive and Promotive Health, emphasizes that preparedness begins with a well-trained health workforce to contain potential threats. The initiative responds to ongoing Ebola outbreaks in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda and ongoing cross-border movement with Kenya, highlighting heightened risk for Turkana and other border counties and the need for vigilance and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのトゥルカナ州がエボラ予防対応訓練を実施、国境地帯の保健作業員70名を対象
triage.triage_reason: ケニアにおけるエボラ準備態勢強化の訓練報告であり、隣接するDRCとウガンダでの現在進行中の発生に起因するリスク認識を反映している。ただし当該記事は能力構築活動であり、ケニアでの実際の患者発生や確認例は報告されていない。スクリーニング基準（異常性・予想外性、流行易感染性）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も存在するが、確認された感染事例がないため情報追跡段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの準備活動だが、実際の感染確認事例はDRCおよびウガンダに限定。ケニアは国境を接する高リスク地域として言及されているため、Kenya（対象国リストに直接含まれないが、DRCが対象国203312として含まれ、地域的連関性あり）を verified_locations に含める。スクリーニング基準3項目該当だが IHR基準は 0 のため PICKUP ではなく WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola a " pris une bonne longueur d'avance ", alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the Ebola outbreak has gained a good head start, WHO warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) is described as extremely grave and complex, worsened by regional insecurity and the absence of a licensed vaccine for this strain. On June 3, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak has gained a head start while the response is still catching up, following a late May visit to assess the situation. The response is organized under Congolese authorities with WHO support, but containment remains a major challenge amid rapid virus spread. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The WHO urges rapid international mobilization and calls on neighboring countries to strengthen vigilance and preparedness to prevent a broader regional health catastrophe. The article provides no case counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラ流行が「大きくリードを広げた」とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（DRC 17例目）。Ituri州での多地域同時流行により、確認済みの地域的脅威。WHOが国際的対応の動員を呼びかけており、周辺国への警戒喚起も行われている。記事にはケース数の明確な報告がないが、WHOの警告レベルから重症度・急速な拡大が示唆される。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれていないため verified_locations には該当国なしとなるはずだが、記事内容がDRCでのエボラ流行に限定されているため、DRCは評価対象の確認国として含められるべきと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: India on high alert as first suspected Ebola case reported in this state, not Kerala, Karnataka, Maharashtra
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease case in Rajasthan, India: Ugandan woman arriving in Jaipur from Sharjah on an Air Arabia flight is isolated in RUHS Hospital's dedicated ward; tests underway to confirm infection. The case is unconfirmed; samples collected and sent to laboratory. Authorities activated emergency monitoring and isolation protocols; no confirmed Ebola case in India linked to the current outbreak. The ongoing Bundibugyo strain outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo has prompted WHO PHEIC status in May; hundreds of cases reported; no vaccine for Bundibugyo strain yet; emphasis on surveillance, contact tracing, border checks. The patient exhibits Ebola-like symptoms such as high fever, severe headache, muscle pain, weakness, vomiting/diarrhea, sore throat; Ebola spread via contact with blood or bodily fluids, not airborne. India increased airport screening; travelers from Uganda, DRC, South Sudan urged to report symptoms and avoid non-essential travel to affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: インドがエボラ熱初の疑い患者報告で厳戒態勢、ケララ州やカルナータカ州ではなくラジャスターン州で
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHOのPHEIC発表済みの現在の流行との関連、インドでの初疑い患者発生という異常性により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダとスーダンからの感染症流行の文脈を含むが、実際のイベント（患者検体）はインドのラジャスターン州（ジャイプール）で報告されている。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。一方、DRCは対象国であり、現在のBundibugyo株の流行地として言及されているため含める。患者はウガンダからの女性がシャルジャ経由でインドに到着した疑い患者。疑い患者であるため確定診断待ちだが、症状と接触歴から高リスク。現在進行中の国際的エボラ流行の文脈での新規国での疑い患者発生は重大。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थानमध्ये इबोलाचा संशयित रुग्ण, युगांडाहून आलेल्या महिलेला क्वारंटाइन करण्यात आले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola patient in Rajasthan; Ugandan woman quarantined.
article.articleSummary: 5 June 2026 update: A Ugandan woman arriving in Rajasthan from Uganda via Sharjah presented Ebola-like symptoms, prompting precautionary measures. She was quarantined at Jaipur's RUHS Hospital, with samples sent to the National Institute of Virology, Pune; officials expect confirmation by this evening or tomorrow morning. No infection confirmed yet. Earlier, a Sudanese traveler at Hyderabad's Rajiv Gandhi International Airport showed fever during thermal screening and was quarantined at Gandhi Hospital, Secunderabad; samples were sent to CCMB for testing. In response to these events, the central government advised against nonessential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州で疑わしいエボラ患者が発生；ウガンダからの女性が隔離された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患に関する疑い症例が複数国で検出され、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限の可能性が該当。対象国インドで確認患者がいなくても、シグナルとしての監視対象。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのラジャスタン州・ハイデラバード州での疑わしいエボラ症例報告。患者はウガンダおよびスーダンからの渡航者で、確認患者なし。中央政府がコンゴ・ウガンダ・南スーダンへの渡航注意喚起を実施。複数の対象国が地域検証により除外された（UAE・スーダン・DRC・ウガンダは患者の出発地または経由地であり、実際の流行地ではないため）。インドは対象国リスト内であり、疑い症例が検出された実際の発生国であるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus: UAE bars entry to travellers from three African countries | The National
article.articleSummary: UAE bars entry to travellers from DR Congo, Uganda and South Sudan amid Ebola outbreak in central Africa. Entry via transit is banned unless travellers have spent more than 21 days outside the three countries before arriving. Visit visas for citizens of these countries are suspended; cargo flights continue. Measures take effect 1pm on Saturday, June 6, 2026, and may be extended. NCEMA and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security announced the steps, with ongoing monitoring alongside local and international partners. UAE reports no Ebola cases; one traveller who had visited the UAE and later tested positive in Uganda did not visit a UAE healthcare facility. In DR Congo there are more than 300 confirmed cases and at least 48 deaths. Ebola transmits via infected bodily fluids; incubation 2 days–3 weeks; symptoms include fever, headaches, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：UAEがアフリカ3ヶ国からの旅行者の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは重篤で致死的な感染症であり、DRC（対象国）で300例以上の確定例と48例以上の死亡が報告されている。複数国での拡大可能性と国際的な渡航制限措置が講じられており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: DRCでの確定例300例以上、死亡48例以上が報告されており、ウガンダへの拡大も確認されている。UAEを含む複数国が公式な入国制限措置を実施。エボラはWHO懸念パブリックヘルスイベント対象疾患。ウガンダはWPRO対象国に含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: राजस्थान: जयपुर में विदेशी युवती में इबोला वायरस संक्रमण जैसे लक्षण दिखे, अस्पताल में भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajasthan: Foreign young woman in Jaipur showed symptoms resembling Ebola virus infection and was admitted to hospital.
article.articleSummary: 19-year-old Ugandan woman, traveling from Sharjah to Jaipur, India, arrived with Ebola virus disease–like symptoms and was admitted to a government hospital in Rajasthan. She is in isolation in a dedicated unit at Rajasthan University of Health Sciences (RUHS) and the hospital, while two samples are sent for laboratory confirmation. One sample has been dispatched to Pune; a second sample will be sent after 48 hours. If the test returns positive, she would be kept in isolation for 21 days and treated accordingly; as of now, Ebola infection is not confirmed. The patient had been experiencing abdominal pain and loss of appetite for about a month and currently has a headache. She is in Jaipur as a tourist. As a precaution, fellow passengers on the same flight have been advised to home-isolate; authorities are monitoring closely and following protocols.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州：ジャイプールの外国人女性がエボラウイルス感染に似た症状を示し、病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疑い患者の国際移動（ウガンダ→UAE→インド）に伴う確認待ちケースであり、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスク・重症度の観点からスクリーニング基準に複数該当。確定診断待ちのため、初期シグナルとしてフルRRA対象に格上げ。
triage.notes: 19歳ウガンダ人女性がシャルジャ経由でジャイプール到着時にエボラ様症状を呈示。ラジャスタン州およびプーネの検査施設で検査中。確定診断待ちだが、国際旅行履歴、隔離措置、同乗客への接触追跡が実施されているため、初期シグナルとしての価値あり。UAEおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations はインドのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Roche develops RUO PCR assay to detect rare Ebola Bundibugyo virus
article.articleSummary: Roche announced an RUO PCR test to detect the rare Ebola Bundibugyo virus, in response to outbreaks in Central and East Africa that prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Developed in six days by Roche’s TIB MOLBIOL, the RUO assay is designed for LightCycler 480 I & II, LightCycler PRO, and cobas z 480 systems. Before full IVD approval, RUO tests can be shipped to laboratories for local validation, with formal IVD or emergency-use validation often taking months or years. TIB Molbiol’s rapid response library (about 15,000 pre-designs and 3,000+ positive controls) enabled quick primer/probe evaluation, and performance and specificity were tested against real clinical samples via independent reference laboratories. Roche is coordinating with public health authorities in affected regions to enable rapid access to testing, following prior RUO releases for mpox, Covid-19, Zika, and MERS.

triage.headline_ja: ロシュが稀なエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルスを検出するRUO PCRアッセイを開発
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo種）の集団発生に対応した診断ツール開発であり、WHOが国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している DRC およびウガンダで発生。IHR基準で「深刻な影響」「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでのエボラ Bundibugyo 集団発生が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Mozambique は発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー本文では具体的な発生が記載されていないため除外。複数の疾患名が列挙されているが、これは Roche の過去の RUO 製品ポートフォリオ（mpox、Covid-19、Zika、MERS）を示すもので、現在のシグナルはエボラ Bundibugyo に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: 17歲長期病少年染乙型流感併發嚴重肺炎、休克　留醫聯合情況危殆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17-year-old boy with a chronic illness infected with influenza B, complicated by severe pneumonia and shock, currently hospitalized in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Hong Kong reports a 17-year-old boy with a chronic illness infected with influenza B, who has developed severe pneumonia and shock and remains in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at United Christian Hospital. He was admitted to Tseung Kwan O Hospital on 27 May for fever, vomiting and seizures; after brief improvement, he deteriorated on 3 June with fever and blood-tinged sputum and was transferred to the United Christian Hospital PICU on 4 June. Respiratory testing confirmed influenza B. He had not received the 2025/26 seasonal flu vaccine and had no travel or school exposure; close contacts are asymptomatic, and his boarding school reported no flu outbreak. Health authorities say Hong Kong flu activity has risen recently but remains below baseline and urge vaccination and prompt care for fever or respiratory symptoms, especially for children, the elderly, and those with chronic illness.

triage.headline_ja: 17歳の慢性疾患患者が乙型インフルエンザに感染し、重症肺炎とショックを併発。現在集中治療室で治療中
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例の重症例であり、患者の重症度は高いが、集団発生の兆候がなく、地域の流感活動は基線以下である。国際的な拡大リスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 香港での個別重症症例の報告。患者は慢性疾患を有する17歳で、インフルエンザBにより肺炎とショックを併発したが、集団発生の証拠はない。濃厚接触者は無症状、学校でのアウトブレイク報告なし。地域の流感活動は基線以下。公開情報源（HK01）による報道であり、当局の公式発表ではない可能性がある。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: National Medical Commission calls for strict compliance of infection control guidelines to prevent HIV, Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C transmissions
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, India's National Medical Commission ordered zero tolerance for unsafe injections in medical colleges and healthcare facilities to curb avoidable HIV, Hepatitis B and Hepatitis C transmissions. The guidance mandates single-use sterile needles and syringes, strict sharps waste segregation and disposal under Biomedical Waste Management Rules 2016, and regular audits by infection control teams. Institutions should align with the National Guidelines for Infection Prevention and Control, emphasizing hand hygiene and safe injection practices, with a ban on needle reuse, syringe sharing, recapping, or improper disposal. The advisory urges gradual adoption of safety-engineered autodisable syringes, periodic competency-based training, and reporting of needle-stick injuries or infection clusters; post-exposure prophylaxis per NACO guidelines should be provided. AiMeD notes the persistence of unsafe practices despite WHO warnings, urging decisive procurement action to prioritize patient safety, while India has capacity to supply safety syringes.

triage.headline_ja: 国家医学委員会、HIV、B型肝炎、C型肝炎の感染防止に向けた感染対策ガイドラインの厳格遵守を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドで重要な感染対策ガイダンスが発出されているが、新規の流行・クラスター報告ではなく、既存の安全対策の啓発・遵守要請が主体。シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主体は医療関連感染（HIV、B型肝炎、C型肝炎）の予防に関する行政指針の発出であり、現在の新規流行やアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし医療施設での「不安全な注射行為の継続」が指摘されており、医療施設内での感染リスクが存在することが認識される。政府・医学委員会の関心は高いが、PICKUP基準には達しない。続報での感染クラスター報告があれば優先度が上がる。

article.articleHeadline: उरणमध्ये डेंग्यूचा शिरकाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak in Uran
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak escalates in Uran city and surrounding areas due to deteriorating sanitation, with clogged drains and standing rainwater creating mosquito breeding grounds ahead of the monsoon. Heightened risks include dengue, malaria, and other vector-borne diseases. Residents report repeated complaints to the municipal corporation about sanitation, drain cleaning, and mosquito-control spraying that have gone unaddressed, and health department actions deemed untimely. The municipality allegedly lacks a regular chief administrator, delaying key decisions and services. Health experts urge eliminating mosquito breeding sites, removing standing water, conducting regular fogging/spraying, and increasing public awareness. If inaction persists, the upcoming monsoon could worsen transmission, potentially triggering a major health crisis for Uran city and nearby areas.

triage.headline_ja: ウラン市でのデング熱アウトブレイク
triage.triage_reason: インドのマハラシュトラ州ウラン市でのデング熱・マラリアの発生が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で懸念が認められるが、現時点では限定的な地理的範囲（単一都市）であり、死亡・入院などの重症度情報が不明瞭である。情報充実後の動向継続を要す。
triage.notes: 記事はマハラシュトラ州ウラン市における衛生悪化によるデング熱・マラリアのアウトブレイク報告。住民の苦情対応遅延、自治体の管理体制不全が指摘されている。モンスーン到来による悪化リスクが言及されているが、現在の患者数・重症度・死亡数の具体的データが記事サマリーに含まれていないため「不明」と判定。WPROスクリーニング基準では4つ該当（異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）するが、公開情報の充実を待つ必要があり「WATCH」とした。

article.articleHeadline: Allerta Ebola in Africa Centrale: l'USL Valle d'Aosta attiva un tavolo di coordinamento e un canale dedicato
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Central Africa: the Valle d'Aosta Local Health Unit activates a coordination table and a dedicated channel.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo trigger Italy’s Valle d'Aosta health response. The Valle d'Aosta Local Health Unit activated an internal technical coordination table to implement national provisions and continuously monitor epidemiology, per the 29 May 2026 Health Ministry ordinance and related surveillance circular. National authorities deem Italy’s infection risk as low and emphasize precautionary measures. The internal group includes Dr. Mauro Occhi (health director), Dr. Luca Cavoretto (EMS), Dr. Stefano Podio (ED), and Dr. Silvia Magnani (Infectious Diseases). Responsibilities cover prevention, surveillance, information, and handling reports, with ongoing liaison to the Ministry, Civil Protection, and regional institutions. A dedicated email for travelers returning from Uganda or the DRC is segr-amb-malinf@ausl.vda.it. Anyone who stayed in Uganda or DRC in the previous 21 days must self-report within 24 hours of entry, even if asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ警報：バッレ・ダオスタ保健局が調整テーブルと専用チャネルを開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolaのウガンダ・DRC での集団発生は深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクを示す。既にイタリアを含む国が対応を開始している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Eボラウイルスの集団発生がウガンダとDRCで報告されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため除外。イタリアは欧州外の対象国ではないため除外。記事の社会的・政治的関心は高く、イタリア当局も低リスク評価としながら積極的な対応を実施している。

article.articleHeadline: Another Ebola Case Reported In India As Hyderabad Hospital Isolates Sudanese Student
article.articleSummary: Sudanese student in his twenties was admitted to Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad, India, with fever prompting Ebola screening amid an ongoing outbreak in parts of Africa. The patient was referred from a private facility on Thursday and immediately placed in an isolation ward established for Ebola preparedness. By Friday morning, his fever had abated and his condition had improved. His attendant was advised to remain at home in isolation while tests are conducted. The report characterizes the case as suspected Ebola, with no laboratory confirmation disclosed and no infection source identified. Results of the diagnostic tests were awaited by authorities, reflecting heightened surveillance in India following the African outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: インドで別のエボラ症例が報告 ハイデラバード病院がスーダン人学生を隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスによる疑い症例がインドで報告され、IHR基準で異常性（予想外）と国際的拡大リスク、WPRO基準で異常性・重症度・流行可能性が該当。社会的・政治的関心も高く、対象国インドでの発生が確認されたため。
triage.notes: スーダン人学生がハイデラバード（インド）の病院に入院し、エボラスクリーニングを受けた。アフリカでの流行が背景にあり、インドでの疑い症例報告は国際的な懸念を生じさせる。検査結果は回答待ち。発生地域にアフリカとスーダンも列挙されているが、実際の患者発症地はインドであり、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan reports first suspected Ebola case as India remains on high alert
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Rajasthan, India: A Ugandan woman who arrived in Jaipur from Sharjah on an Air Arabia flight is in isolation at RUHS Hospital after routine airport screening flagged Ebola-like symptoms. She has not been diagnosed; laboratory tests have been sent for confirmation. The case occurs amid a Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May for the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. There is currently no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo. India has not reported any confirmed Ebola cases; authorities issued travel advisories for affected countries and enhanced entry screening. Earlier in May, a Ugandan woman in Bengaluru tested negative. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood or body fluids and can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, rash and bleeding; it is not airborne. Emphasis remains on rapid testing and isolation pending lab confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ラージャスターン州がインドで初の疑似エボラ患者を報告、インドは厳戒態勢を維持
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な流行下での初の疑似患者報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。WPRO基準も複数該当（異常/予想外、重症度潜在性、流行しやすさ）し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインド・ラージャスターン州での疑似患者と、DRC・ウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ流行の国際的文脈を述べている。ウガンダはサマリー言及がありながら対象国リストに未含有のため verified_locations に含めない。シャルジャ（UAE）は患者の出発地であり感染症発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Marie Roseline Belizaire (OMS): "La epidemia de ébola avanza a gran paso, pero no debemos perder la esperanza"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marie Roseline Belizaire (WHO): "The Ebola outbreak is advancing rapidly, but we must not lose hope."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is advancing rapidly, with at least six people recovered. The Bundibugyo strain, which lacks vaccines and specific treatments, is driving the crisis, unlike the Zaire strain. The response faces mobility and access challenges, notably in Mongblawu Health Zone about 86 km from Bunia, where poor roads necessitate helicopter transport of people and supplies. Health teams have inspected hospitals to identify on-the-ground barriers. Authorities urge anyone with symptoms to seek care at a health facility as early as possible to improve survival. WHO Chief Tedros and expert Marie Roseline Belizaire stress early care, community awareness, and reducing fear; call for a temporary ceasefire to let health workers operate. This is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC, underscoring ongoing public health risks in Ituri and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: マリー・ロスリン・ベリゼール（WHO）：「エボラの流行は急速に進んでいますが、希望を失ってはいけません」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡・入院）、異常・予想外性、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有し、IHR基準を4つ全て満たしており、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。国際的支援の必要性も認識されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生（17例目）で、Bundibugyo株（ワクチン・特異的治療なし）が原因。アクセス制限、医療チーム不足、一時的な停戦呼びかけなど管理上の課題あり。WHOおよび国家当局が強く関与。国際的な関心と支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Rajasthan: Suspected Ebola Case Reported in Jaipur, Woman from Uganda Isolated
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease in Jaipur, Rajasthan: a Ugandan woman arriving from Sharjah was flagged at airport screening with Ebola-like symptoms and admitted to RUHS Hospital in strict isolation; samples sent to a Pune laboratory for testing with confirmation pending, expected by this evening or tomorrow. A separate Sudanese national at Hyderabad’s RGIA was isolated after fever; samples sent to CCMB. Ebola is caused by Bundibugyo virus; high mortality; no approved vaccines or specific treatments. WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026; Africa CDC also declared Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS) for the Congo-Uganda outbreak. India has not reported Bundibugyo Ebola cases. India has provided medical aid to Uganda (2.5 tons on May 24; 43 tons arriving June 2) and advised against non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: インド ラージャスターン州：ジャイプールでエボラ疑い例を報告、ウガンダからの女性が隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の疑い例が複数国で同時に検出され、WHOが既にPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、Africa CDCがPHECS宣言している。確認検査待ち中だが、症例確認時の国際的脅威度は極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダからインド（ジャイプール、ハイデラバード）へのエボラ疑い例の報告を主題としている。WHOが既にPHEIC宣言、Africa CDCがPHECS宣言しているコンゴ・ウガンダ流行の文脈で、新たに地理的に離れたインドでの疑い例検出。検査確認待ち中であるが、確認時の国際的脅威は非常に高い。記事に記載されたスーダン国籍者の報告はハイデラバード（インド）での隔離であり、イベント発生地はインドである。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan tourist isolated in Jaipur hosp over suspected Ebola symptoms: Officials
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, a 19-year-old Ugandan tourist who arrived in Jaipur from Sharjah was isolated at RUHS Hospital with symptoms resembling Ebola virus disease. Lab samples have been sent to a Pune facility for testing; final diagnosis awaits results. No confirmed Ebola case has been reported in India. Authorities have begun enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and airport-based monitoring of travelers from Africa. RUHS is designated as the state's facility for suspected Ebola cases, with dedicated isolation wards, trained staff, PPE stocks, and infection-control resources. Ebola refers to disease caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, which has high mortality and for which no vaccines or specific treatments are approved. India’s health ministry has advised avoiding non-essential travel to Ebola-affected countries (DRC, Uganda, South Sudan) following WHO PHEIC; no Bundibugyo cases reported in India.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ人観光客がジャイプール病院で疑似エボラ症状で隔離：当局者
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑似症例が報告され、国際間の移動（ウガンダ→UAE→インド）を伴い、WHOがPHEIC宣言している状況。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・旅行制限リスクが該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が該当するため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ疑似症例は未確定だが、患者はウガンダから入国し、アフリカのエボラ流行地域との関連がある。WHOのPHEIC宣言下での疑似症報告であり、インドでの初期対応状況（検査、接触者追跡、空港監視）が既に実施されている。DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンなど対象国外の流行地域との国際的な関連性があるため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: ജയ്പൂരിൽ എബോള ലക്ഷണങ്ങളോടെ യുഗാണ്ടൻ യുവതി ഐസലേഷനിൽ; പരിശോധന ഫലം കാത്ത് ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ugandan woman with Ebola-like symptoms in isolation in Jaipur; health department awaiting test results.
article.articleSummary: Jaipur, Rajasthan: A 19-year-old Ugandan woman with Ebola-like symptoms, an imported case, has been isolated at a government hospital in Jaipur after arriving from Sharjah, UAE, on an Air Arabia flight. Health authorities have not confirmed Ebola; samples have been sent to Pune for testing. A second sample will be sent after 48 hours; results are pending; if positive, 21 days of quarantine. The hospital’s superintendent Dr. Anil Gupta cautioned that symptoms resemble Ebola but infection cannot be confirmed on clinical features alone. The patient is under observation in a dedicated isolation room in the Critical Care Block, with Principal Dr. Mohnish Grover overseeing. She reported month-long abdominal pain and loss of appetite, currently with headaches. As a precaution, others who traveled on the same flight are advised to stay in home isolation; the health department is monitoring the situation and following protocol.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプール分離中のエボラ様症状のウガンダ人女性；保健部門が検査結果を待機中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ疑似症例の輸入症例であり、複数国にまたがる接触追跡が必要な重要シグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数の地域を返しているが、記事サマリーの主題はジャイプール（ラージャスターン州、インド）での患者隔離である。ウガンダからの輸入症例であり、UAEを経由。エボラ検査はまだ確認されていないが、疑似症例として国際的関心が高い。同一便の乗客に対するホーム隔離指示あり。

article.articleHeadline: From surveillance to systems: Scaling environmental genomics for epidemic preparedness in Africa
article.articleSummary: Mpox re-emerged as a major public health threat in Central Africa, with outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompting emergency declarations at national, continental, and global levels. ODIN and the complementary ODIN-Mpox project scale environmental surveillance—combining wastewater monitoring with genomic sequencing—to monitor Mpox and co-detect waterborne pathogens such as Vibrio cholerae, Salmonella Typhi, and poliovirus across Burkina Faso, the DRC, and Tanzania, with planned expansion. A key innovation is Laboratories on Wheels, mobile labs performing sequencing and qPCR in the field, enabling non-sewered settings like informal settlements and rural communities. In Tanzania, deployment generated over 70 environmental metagenomes and confirmed Mpox by targeted sequencing. Standardised open-access SOPs, a shared bioinformatics pipeline, and near real-time analysis underpin the approach. Capacity building includes >75 researchers trained, three MSc students, regional knowledge hubs, and alignment with Africa CDC’s 2026–2031 strategy and EU-funded initiatives.

triage.headline_ja: 監視からシステムへ：アフリカにおける感染症対策のための環境ゲノミクスのスケーリング
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤疾患（Mpox、コレラ、腸チフス、ポリオ）の多地域発生を報告しており、スクリーニング基準複数該当。ただし記事は主に環境監視システム・容量構築の記事であり、現在の急性段階アウトブレイク情報というより、予防的監視体制構築の戦略的報道のため、フルRRAの対象外と判断。継続的な情報追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の重篤疾患（Mpox、Vibrio cholerae、Salmonella Typhi、poliovirus）の同時発生と環境ゲノム監視体制構築に関するもの。DRCでのMpox緊急事態宣言、複数国での検出が記述されているが、記事本体がないため詳細な症例数・死亡数等の具体的数値情報は不明。Burkina FasoとTanzaniaも発生地域として提示されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な焦点であり、他国の具体的イベントは環境監視の計画対象として言及されているのみ。社会的・政治的関心は高い（Africa CDC戦略、EU資金支援）が、現在の急性段階アウトブレイク対応というより長期的監視体制構築の報道のため、WATCHの判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: How border districts are fighting Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Ebola outbreaks in eastern DR Congo trigger Uganda to tighten border controls. The Ministry of Health and district Ebola task forces have intensified surveillance at official border points, established screening and quarantine centers, and banned cross-border movements between DR Congo and Uganda. In Arua City, particularly Lia and Odramacaku border towns, traders continue cross-border activity via official routes and informal paths, despite UPDF patrols; illicit crossings threaten containment. Residents like Leticia Avako lament livelihood losses from restricted access to Ariwara in DRC. Authorities vow stronger enforcement, suspend social gatherings and border markets, and deploy security along borders, with boda-boda riders crossing illegally to be arrested. Arua City has tested 18 suspected Ebola cases—all negative and discharged. Health officials emphasize community sensitisation, screening, and early isolation; cross-border links to Ituri’s Bunia and Mahagi are cited to illustrate ongoing regional risk and public-misconception challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 国境地区がエボラ対策に取り組む方法
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大リスク、国際的な国境管理強化、および深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が認められる。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部のイツリ州でのエボラ感染症発生を主題とし、ウガンダが国境統制を強化している状況を報告している。Bluedot APIがノルウェーを発生地域に含めているが、これは誤りと考えられる（記事サマリーにはノルウェーの言及はない）。ウガンダは国境管理強化など対応国として言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生はDRCが主体であり、verified_locationsではDRCのみを列挙した。非公式な国境越境による感染伝播リスク、社会経済的混乱、そして複数国間の公衆衛生上の脅威が認識される。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC Intensifies Preparedness As Ebola Risk Remains High In Nigeria
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, Nigeria's NCDC elevated preparedness as risk of importing Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease remains high amid ongoing East Africa transmission. Nigeria has not recorded confirmed Ebola cases; however, risk is high due to increased international travel, population movement, and porous borders. The NCDC's risk assessment notes delayed detection risk since Ebola symptoms imitate malaria and Lassa fever. Response pillars activated include enhanced entry-point surveillance, laboratory readiness, risk communication, case-management preparedness, and cross-sector coordination. State governments urged to activate emergency response structures and keep front-line workers vigilant for Ebola-like symptoms. Ebola is transmitted through close contact and bodily fluids. The current outbreak in DRC—the 17th to hit the country—has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths across three provinces, with 116 suspected cases. In neighboring Uganda, 15 cases and one death, including a Congolese resident who had travelled via the UAE.

triage.headline_ja: NCDCがナイジェリアにおけるエボラ出血熱リスク高止まりの中、備えを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。東アフリカでの進行中のエボラアウトブレイクと、ナイジェリアを含む複数国への国際的波及リスクが高い。
triage.notes: サマリーはエボラの東アフリカ発生（DRC、ウガンダ）とナイジェリアへのリスク波及について述べている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。モザンビーク、ウガンダ、UAE、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれない。ナイジェリアは現在確認症例なしだが、高リスク状態で対応強化中。

article.articleHeadline: Bengo vacina profissionais de saúde e órgãos de Defesa contra a varíola dos macacos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengo Vaccinates Health Professionals and Defense Organs Against Monkeypox
article.articleSummary: Bengo Province in Angola has begun vaccinating health professionals, defense and security personnel, and residents near borders with neighboring provinces against monkeypox. The program, led by Josefa Gomes, provincial coordinator of the Expanded Vaccination Program, targets groups at elevated occupational risk. With early monkeypox reports in adjacent Zaire, Uíge, and Cabinda provinces, the Bengo Provincial Health Office has reinforced preventive measures to mitigate introduction. The vaccination initiative aims to protect priority groups and strengthen the province’s capacity to respond if the disease is introduced. As of 2026-06-05, no monkeypox cases have been recorded in Bengo.

triage.headline_ja: ベンゴ州がサルポックスに対して医療専門家と防衛機関職員にワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: アンゴラのベンゴ州でのサルポックス予防ワクチン接種開始を報じるもので、隣接する複数州での感染報告があることから流行リスクは存在するが、現在のベンゴ州内での確認患者はなく、情報が限定的。スクリーニング基準に該当する可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラ（対象国リスト外）での事象を主に報じているため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。発生地域にDRC（GeoNames ID: 203312）が含まれているが、サマリーでは隣接州での報告の言及に留まり、DRC内の具体的な発生が主題ではないため除外。アンゴラでの予防的ワクチン接種展開と隣接地域での既報告により、スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、対象国内での発生ではなく情報が限定的であることからWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: മഴക്കാലം രോഗങ്ങളുടെ കാലവും; ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി മുതൽ എലിപ്പനി വരെ, പകർച്ചവ്യാധികളെ പ്രതിരോധിക്കാൻ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കേണ്ട കാര്യങ്ങൾ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The monsoon season, a time of diseases; from dengue fever to chickenpox, precautions to prevent communicable diseases.
article.articleSummary: In Kozhikode, the arrival of the monsoon brings relief from heat but also a rise in communicable diseases. With rainfall, waterborne, airborne, and vector-borne infections become more common. Health experts warn that moisture, water stagnation, and contact with contaminated water create favorable conditions for transmission. The article cites dengue fever and chickenpox as examples of illnesses seen during the rainy season, highlighting the broad disease spectrum during monsoon. It urges adherence to personal hygiene and surrounding cleanliness to curb spread. While no specific case counts are provided, the message emphasizes vigilance in Kerala’s monsoon season and the need to reduce stagnation and maintain sanitary environments to prevent outbreaks of dengue and other common monsoon infections.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時期は病気の時期。デング熱からネズミ咬症まで、感染症を予防するために注意すべきこと
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期における一般的な季節性感染症についての予防啓発記事であり、現在の具体的な流行状況や異常性が報告されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州コージコード地域におけるモンスーン時期の季節性感染症についての一般的な予防啓発である。具体的な症例数、疾患の異常性、入院・死亡報告がないため、シグナルとしてのPICKUPには至らない。ただしモンスーン期のデング熱感染増加傾向は季節性として認識されているため、今後の具体的な流行データを注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mientras el ébola se propaga en el Congo, una emisora de radio intenta frenar la desinformación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a radio station tries to curb misinformation.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, declared on May 15. Authorities report 381 laboratory-confirmed cases and 63 deaths, with hundreds of suspected cases. The response faces skepticism and misinformation, including conspiracy theories that downplay the outbreak as Western manipulation, and attacks on health workers. A local radio station is working to curb misinformation and strengthen public messaging about the outbreak. The situation underscores the challenges of containment amid social resistance while authorities monitor spread of this unusual strain within the region; details on the infection source were not provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大する中、ラジオ局が誤情報に対抗しようとしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確定患者381名、死亡63名という重大な公衆衛生影響を示し、稀な株系統による異常な発生、地域内での継続的な拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 2026年6月5日報告。Bundibugyo株は稀な株系統で、発生源が不明とされている点も注目。社会的抵抗と誤情報が封じ込めを阻害している状況が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: ഇന്ത്യയില്‍ വീണ്ടും എബോള വൈറസ് ഭീതി; സുഡാന്‍ സ്വദേശി ഹൈദരാബാദില്‍ നിരീക്ഷണത്തില്‍ | Ebola Virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus scare in India again; Sudanese national under observation in Hyderabad | Ebola Virus.
article.articleSummary: Two Sudanese nationals under observation for Ebola-like illness in Hyderabad, India. A 20-something Sudanese student was moved Friday from a private hospital to Gandhi Hospital for specialist assessment; his condition has progressed with no fever currently, and household contacts are under health department surveillance awaiting test results. Earlier, a 35-year-old Sudan national who landed at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport with fever was also transferred to Gandhi Hospital’s isolation ward. He underwent thermal screening and was placed in isolation; early Friday tests indicated he had no fever or other symptoms. Authorities have heightened screening of travelers from Ebola-affected regions at airports, with self-declaration forms required. Gandhi Hospital has a 10-bed isolation ward as part of Ebola prevention measures. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, body fluids, or organs, and from animals to humans.

triage.headline_ja: インドでエボラウイルス恐怖が再び勃発；スーダン国籍者ハイデラバードで観察下に | エボラウイルス
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という致死率の高い感染症について、インドで複数の疑い例が報告され、国際的な臨床検査体制が稼働している。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではハイデラバードはインド国内の都市として記述されており、発生地域フィールドに含まれるスーダンは患者の国籍を示すのみで、実際の発生地はインドである。患者がスーダンからインドに入国した国際的なケースであり、エボラ疑い例の複数報告と空港スクリーニング強化が確認されている。検査結果待機中のため確定診断はまだ。

article.articleHeadline: Enfermero congoleño supera el ébola en Ituri y alerta sobre la prevención
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese nurse overcomes Ebola in Ituri and warns about prevention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) continues in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths reported by INSP. The outbreak has spread to neighboring Uganda, which has 16 confirmed cases including one death, described as an imported case from the DRC. The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a 30–50% case‑fatality rate and no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this variant. In Bunia, Etienne Enzo, a 44‑year‑old nurse at the Evangelical Medical Center, contracted EVD while on rounds; after seven tests, he tested positive and received symptomatic care (fever management, vomiting, diarrhea, dizziness; generalized itching; fluids and zinc). He was declared cured last Sunday and now advocates prevention with the INSP, emphasizing risks and protective measures. He is one of four nurses who celebrated recovery with WHO chief Tedros in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ人看護師がイトゥリでエボラを克服し、予防について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された多発地での流行継続、複数国への拡大、高い致死率（30-50%）、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）が含まれているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの381確認症例、64死亡、ウガンダへの波及（16症例）が確認されており、Bundibugyo株による高致死率の流行。WHOも関与している対応中の状況であり、フルRRAへの進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case reported in India's Rajasthan; Ugandan woman quarantined
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case reported in Rajasthan, India: a Ugandan woman visiting Jaipur from a Gulf country exhibited Ebola-like symptoms, flagged at airport screening, and admitted to RUHS Hospital in strict isolation. Samples are being sent to a specialized laboratory in Pune for testing, with confirmation expected this evening or tomorrow morning. Ebola infection has not yet been confirmed; report is required for confirmation. The case involves Bundibugyo virus strain; Ebola is described as a severe viral hemorrhagic fever with high mortality, with no vaccines or specific treatments approved for Bundibugyo-related disease in the article. India has not reported any Ebola Bundibugyo case. Authorities advised avoiding non-essential travel to Ebola-hit countries; border regions of the DRC and Uganda, including South Sudan, are deemed high risk. Earlier, India provided medical aid to Uganda and extended support to Africa CDC per AU Commission.

triage.headline_ja: インド・ラージャスターン州で疑似エボラ症例が報告；ウガンダ人女性が隔離
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の疑似症例がインドで初めて報告された。確認前段階だが高い公衆衛生リスクと国際的な波及懸念がある。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 症例はウガンダから訪問中のウガンダ人女性；国内初のエボラBundibugyo疑似症例。サンプルはプネーの専門検査機関で検査中、本日または明朝に確認予定。DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン国境地域がハイリスクとして指摘されているが、これら国での流行報告は記事サマリーでは明記されていないため verified_locations はインドのみ。Machupoは記事本文に記載されていない可能性があるため、Ebolaに焦点を当てた評価。

article.articleHeadline: Rumors and mistrust persist over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: In Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola outbreak attributed to the Bundibugyo virus has sparked sustained mistrust. By 2026-06-05, Congolese authorities confirmed 363 cases and 62 deaths, with dozens more suspected; Uganda reported 15 confirmed cases, including one death. The outbreak was declared on May 15 after initial testing targeted more common Ebola strains, allowing transmission to proceed undetected for weeks. Because Ebola remains highly infectious after death, burials are supervised to prevent traditional rites, fueling fear and rumors about hospitals. Locals report beliefs that Ebola may not exist, that NGOs exploit the crisis for funding, or that vaccines would infect people, with some blaming sewage systems for spread. Media outreach via Mont Bleu TV/radio is being used to educate the population amid a broader humanitarian crisis and limited health access in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の流行をめぐる根拠のない情報と不信感が続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる国際的な越境感染、高い死亡率、ウガンダへの拡大、社会的混乱が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダが15例の確定例を報告」と二次的な記述に留まり、主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo型エボラは稀であり、公式確認までの検査遅延、高い感染性、埋葬儀式における感染リスク、住民の医療不信・根拠のない情報の蔓延などが相まって、管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 381 cas confirmés et 63 décès, selon les autorités , H24info
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: 381 confirmed cases and 63 deaths, according to authorities, H24info.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 381 confirmed cases and 63 deaths since screening operations began, with a case fatality rate under 17%, attributed to improved patient care and strengthened response. Ituri province accounts for about 95% of cases; other provinces show far fewer—19 in one northern province and roughly three in a southern province. Compared with prior outbreaks, notably the Zaire (Zaïre) strain with mortality up to 80%, the current outbreak is less deadly due to better detection, care availability, and faster management. The DRC declared a new Ebola outbreak on May 15; the WHO has classified it as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo strain response is catching up, but gaps remain in screening, contact tracing, and public trust. Kinshasa held a press conference.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：当局によると確認された381例と63人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際保健上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態と分類した確認済みエボラアウトブレイク。致死率17%未満で管理可能だが、国際的拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性がある。
triage.notes: WHO国際保健上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。Bundibugyo株の流行で、スクリーニング・接触者追跡・公衆信頼面でのギャップが残存。イトゥリ州が約95%の症例を占める。致死率が過去のザイール株（80%）より低い理由は、患者ケアの向上と対応の強化による。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria de Saúde e hospital de Humaitá divulgam orientações após aumento nos casos de gripe - Três Passos News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department and Humaitá Hospital issue guidelines after an increase in influenza cases - Três Passos News
article.articleSummary: Rising respiratory illnesses and H1N1 influenza activity in Humaitá prompted the Municipal Health Department and Adesco Community Hospital to issue new guidelines. The hospital mandates mask use inside facilities, suspends visits by individuals with respiratory symptoms, and recommends that patients seek care only when necessary; companions should be limited to one, and children and seniors should not be brought unless for an evaluation. The measures aim to protect patients, staff, and the community by reducing transmission within the hospital. The Health Department warns that H1N1 influenza is contagious and can progress to severe disease, especially in unvaccinated people. Symptoms include sudden high fever, persistent cough, sore throat, runny nose, body and joint pains, headache, and fatigue, with shortness of breath in severe cases. Vaccination remains the most effective protection; practice hand hygiene, avoid crowds, ventilate spaces, and wear a mask if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: Health Department and Humaitá Hospital issue guidelines after an increase in influenza cases - Três Passos News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマゾナス州フマイタにおけるH1N1インフルエンザの症例増加を報告。WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目が該当する可能性があるが、重症度、国際的拡大リスク、死亡情報など重要な詳細が記事サマリーから不明であり、情報収集を継続する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はフマイタ市における呼吸器疾患とH1N1インフルエンザ活動の増加を報告。病院および保健部門が新しいガイドラインを発出している。ただし、症例数、死亡数、重症度、ワクチン接種率などの具体的な疫学データが不明。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれる。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性（unusual）、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさが該当するため、続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bagaimana Disinformasi Perparah Wabah Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Disinformation Exacerbated the Ebola Outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 350 confirmed cases and 60 deaths within roughly three weeks of the outbreak declaration. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976; INRB confirmed cases after initial misdiagnoses (malaria, typhoid, diarrhea). Misinformation has spurred violence: rumors that coffins caused deaths and that health workers spread the virus via vehicle antennas led to attacks on Mongbwalu General Hospital and the burning of MSF tents, prompting MSF to withdraw staff. About 18 monitored patients disappeared amid fear of infection. The Bundibugyo variant circulating has no available vaccine. Disinformation follows familiar patterns (lab origin claims, vaccine dangers, pharma profiteering, treatment suppression). Local economic competition among gold miners and political tensions in war-affected Ituri further erode trust. Funding cuts from the US (withdrawal from WHO) and European aid worsen response and fuel hoaxes.

triage.headline_ja: ディスインフォメーションがコンゴのエボラ感染症の流行を悪化させた経緯
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。急速な患者発生（350確認例、60死亡）、Bundibugyo株の流行、医療対応の破綻（MSF撤退）、ディスインフォメーションによる暴力とコンプライアンス低下により国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: DRC内Ituri州Mongbwalu地区で発生。17番目のDRCエボラ感染症で、ワクチン未利用のBundibugyo株が流行中。ディスインフォメーション、医療施設への暴力、接触者喪失により対応が大きく阻害されている。米国WHO脱退、欧州支援削減により資金が不足し、ホアックス助長も報告。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo (RDC) : au Sud-Kivu, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) répond à un afflux massif de déplacés sur fond de crise sanitaire aiguë
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): in South Kivu, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) responds to a massive influx of displaced people amid an acute public health crisis.
article.articleSummary: Nearly five million people are displaced in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 1.9 million in South Kivu and Maniema, as violence drives mass movements. In Baraka, access to health care is constrained by insecurity and damaged infrastructure, with many displaced living with host families or in camps such as Monge Monge. MSF reports that fighting between FARDC and AFC/M23 worsens humanitarian needs and compounds cholera outbreaks, malaria, diarrhea, and pneumonia. From January to April 2026, MSF supported Baraka’s general hospital with medical supplies, logistics, and staff training; covered treatment costs for severe malaria, acute respiratory infections, and diarrheal diseases; and backed seven community health sites for rapid case detection. Overall, 26,234 patients were treated: 426 war injuries, 16,574 malaria, 2,953 diarrhea, 3,832 pneumonia. A cholera treatment center treated 1,002 patients; hygiene kits and water interventions were deployed; broader actor mobilization is urged.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）：南キヴ州でのメディサン・サン・フロンティエール（MSF）による大量の避難民流入への対応と急性公衆衛生危機
triage.triage_reason: コレラと疾患多重流行（マラリア、下痢症、肺炎）により公衆衛生への深刻な影響がある。避難民危機と関連し、530万人が被災している東部DRCで国際支援が進行中である。IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻性、異常性、拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: コレラ・マラリア等の多重感染症流行が避難民危機と重なり、医療インフラの損傷と治安悪化により管理が困難な状況。MSFなど国際人道支援機関が既に対応中。記事サマリーから南キヴ州とマニエマ州が主要影響地域であることが確認された。

article.articleHeadline: مراكز محلية أميركية جاهزة لمواجهة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local American centers ready to confront Ebola
article.articleSummary: Thirteen US government-funded medical centers, forming a national network, say they are prepared to handle Ebola if needed. The World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. One American has been treated in Germany. The U.S. State Department says exposed but asymptomatic Americans will be isolated in a Kenya facility under construction, and aims to keep the United States free of Ebola-infected travelers. Reuters confirms nine centers can receive Ebola patients. Health officials have urged repatriation of any sick Americans for treatment in the United States; construction in Kenya has sparked protests and at least two deaths, with a Kenyan court halting the project. Since 2014, the U.S. has spent hundreds of millions to strengthen its health system, funding the 13-center program, the National Center for Training and Education on Emerging Pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに対抗する準備ができている米国の地域センター
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。対象国DRCでのエボラ流行とそれに対する国際対応が明らかに該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行（344確認症例、60死亡）が主題であり、米国・ドイツ・ケニアは対応地域として言及されているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ケニア（対象国外）での施設建設に関する記述があるが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus: भारत में इबोला की दस्तक? युगांडा से आई महिला जयपुर में आइसोलेशन में भर्ती, रिपोर्ट का इंतजार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus: Has Ebola reached India? A woman from Uganda admitted to isolation in Jaipur, awaiting the test results.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases prompt heightened vigilance in India as Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreaks continue in Africa. A Ugandan woman arriving in Jaipur from Sharjah on June 5, 2026, with Ebola-like symptoms, was placed in isolation at RUHS Hospital; her samples are being sent to a Pune lab for confirmatory testing, with results pending. In Hyderabad (Secunderabad), a Sudanese national with fever detected at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport was isolated at Gandhi Hospital; samples were sent to CCMB for testing. India has advised citizens to avoid non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, and to follow health guidelines. WHO has declared international concern over Congo and Uganda outbreaks, and Africa CDC has proclaimed a continental public health emergency for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, highlighting enhanced airport surveillance. India has provided medical aid to Uganda, including PPE and equipment via C-17 Globemaster flights."

triage.headline_ja: Ebola Virus: インドにエボラが到達したか？ウガンダから到来した女性がジャイプールで隔離入院、検査結果待機中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。疑似患者の国際的移動、複数国での検出、WHOおよびアフリカCDCによる公式警告があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はインドでの疑似エボラ患者検出を主題としており、ウガンダ及びスーダン国籍患者がインド領内で隔離されたことが報告されている。アフリカでのBundibugyo Ebolasアウトブレイク継続中。WHOおよびアフリカCDCが国際的懸念を宣言済み。インドは複数州で検査態勢を確立。対象国リスト内ではIndia及びDRCが確認される。Sudan及びUgandaはリスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 新增一宗登革熱輸人個案　病人潛伏期曾訪印尼
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One new imported dengue fever case; the patient had visited Indonesia during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports two dengue fever cases from May 29 to June 4: one locally acquired case announced on June 2 and one imported case whose incubation period included a visit to Indonesia. Health authorities, via the Sham Shui Po district Safe Community Building Support Centre health station, hotline, and questionnaires, assessed over 1,600 residents; no epidemiological links to the local case have been identified, investigations ongoing. Year to date, Hong Kong has 22 dengue cases (20 imported, 2 local). For chikungunya, no new cases were recorded; total infections remain 2, all imported.

triage.headline_ja: 新規で1件の輸入デング熱患者；患者は潜伏期中にインドネシアを訪問
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の輸入症例と局所発生症例が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度の可能性）に該当する可能性があるが、現時点での記事情報から確認できる重症度や国際的拡大リスクは限定的。継続的な発生動向の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での報告であり、China (1814991) に含める。記事サマリーで患者がインドネシアを訪問中に感染したと明記されているため、インドネシア (1643084) も verified_locations に含める。IHR基準2つ以上該当するため PICKUP候補だが、記事に重症度情報が欠落しているため、より慎重に WATCH と判定。局所発生症例の存在とインドネシアとの関連性から継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hallaron decenas de pingüinos de Magallanes muertos en Chubut y Santa Cruz | HaceInstantes: Toda la información en pocas palabras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of Magellanic penguins found dead in Chubut and Santa Cruz | HaceInstantes: All the information in a few words
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Magellanic penguins have been found dead on beaches in Chubut and Santa Cruz, Argentina, in recent weeks, with authorities still unable to determine the cause. Environmental and wildlife groups have urged provincial governments to investigate and asked the public to report new cases. Mass die-offs have occurred in Comodoro Rivadavia and Caleta Olivia. The main concern is whether these deaths reflect a specific event or a broader trend threatening the penguin colonies along the Atlantic coast, including Punta Tombo in Chubut. In response, CADACE has informed the Provincial Agrarian Council, the Province's Wildlife Directorate, SENASA, and local authorities of activation of the Avian Influenza Protocol. CADACE also called on residents to participate in monitoring and to avoid approaching recently dead birds or letting pets near them. If a dead bird is found, take a zoomed photo and send it with the location to CADACE.

triage.headline_ja: チュブト州とサンタクルス州でマゼラン分布ペンギンの死骸が数十羽発見される
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでペンギンの大量死が報告され、鳥インフルエンザプロトコルが発動されているが、原因が未確定であり、人間への感染報告がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはフィリピン（1694008）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはアルゼンチン（チュブト州とサンタクルス州）のペンギン大量死についてのみ述べている。フィリピンは記事の主題ではないため除外。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locations は空配列。動物感染症（鳥インフルエンザが疑われ、プロトコル発動）であるが、人間への感染報告はなく、原因も未確定。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات توقف إصدار التأشيرات لمواطني 3 دول إفريقية احترازاً من "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UAE suspends visa issuance to citizens of three African countries as a precaution against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UAE suspends issuance of new visas to citizens of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan as a precaution against Ebola. The joint announcement by the National Emergency, Crisis and Disaster Management Authority and the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Border Security states entry is blocked for travelers from the three countries, including transit passengers, with entry allowed only for those who have spent more than 21 days outside those countries prior to arriving in the UAE. The measure takes effect at 13:00 local time on 6 June 2026 and may be extended based on health developments. Cargo shipments and transit flights between the UAE and the three countries remain unaffected. Authorities will monitor global health developments and coordinate with local and international partners to assess risks and adjust measures to protect public health and strengthen national preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: UAEが3つのアフリカ諸国の国民へのビザ発行を一時停止 エボラ対策として
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数国での発生報告であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）を満たし、国際的な防疫措置が実施されている。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。UAEはこれら3国への入国制限措置を実施。複数国での発生と国際的な防疫対応の事実が確認される。重症度や患者数などの詳細情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تتخذ إجراءات احترازية إضافية لمواجهة فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE takes additional precautionary measures to combat the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, UAE authorities announced enhanced Ebola risk-prevention measures for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Effective 13:00 on 6 June 2026, all new visas for nationals of those countries (including tourist visas) are suspended, while cargo flights between the UAE and the three countries continue. Entry of travelers from these nations, including those arriving via transit through other countries, is prohibited unless they have spent more than 21 days outside these countries prior to arriving in the UAE. The measures are part of heightened readiness to address Ebola developments, with ongoing monitoring coordinated with local and international partners and adjustments based on risk assessments and health standards, including assessment of potential impacts on other countries.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦がエボラウイルスに対抗するための追加的予防措置を講じる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（高致死率の一類感染症）に対する国際的な渡航制限措置の発動であり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」と「渡航制限リスク」に該当し、複数国での発生および対応が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで複数国が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（Uganda, South Sudan, UAEは対象外）。エボラウイルスは国際保健上の最重要懸念疾患であり、複数国での発生が示唆されている。DRCでの発生確認と、UAEによる渡航制限措置の発動がIHR通知相当のシグナルを構成する。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола продължава на изток при намалено финансиране от Г-7 за Африка
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues east amid reduced funding from the G7 for Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Ebola continues to spread east from central Africa into the Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by a deadly Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain described as untreatable and spreading quickly in conflict-affected zones. The outbreak is described as out of control in parts of Central Africa and the DRC. Reduced humanitarian funding from G7 nations—including a 57% drop in US-led humanitarian aid per OECD data—has strained on-the-ground readiness, with fewer health workers, surveillance, and resources for testing and contact tracing. This undermines early detection and case reporting. The WHO and Africa CDC warn that the Bundibugyo strain has gone undetected for weeks to months due to limited testing capacity and the absence of antibody therapies. The result is heightened uncertainty about regional spread and the potential for further escalation amid weakened surveillance networks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが東方へ拡大、G7のアフリカ向け資金削減の中で継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。制御不能な状況、高い致死性、国際的拡大リスク、弱体化した対応能力が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は治療不可能で数週間～数カ月間未検出。中央アフリカから東方への拡大が報告されており、紛争地帯での拡散と監視体制の崩壊により、地域的な感染拡大および国境越え拡大のリスクが極めて高い。G7からの資金削減による対応能力の著しい低下は深刻な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 境外移入麻疹引發群聚！個案傳染同住友人　疾管署發布提醒 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported measles from abroad trigger a cluster! A case infected a housemate. Taiwan CDC issues a reminder.
article.articleSummary: Imported measles from abroad triggered a Taiwan cluster. Taiwan CDC reported two laboratory-confirmed cases: Case 1, a foreign woman in her 30s who arrived mid-May and developed fever, cough, rhinitis, and a rash within 3 days; Case 2, a man in his 20s in northern Taiwan and Case 1’s housemate, who later developed cough, fever, and rash and was confirmed. The cluster comprises 2 cases, with 491 contacts traced and monitored through June 16. Taiwan’s total measles cases this year reach 11 (3 domestic, 8 imported) from countries including Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan, Japan, and Thailand. Ongoing regional outbreaks are noted, with Japan reporting 511 cases and Bangladesh reporting 70,936 cases and 585 deaths since March. Vaccination remains key—Taiwan has sufficient free MMR vaccine stock; adults born since 1966 traveling to endemic regions should consider MMR vaccination 2–4 weeks before departure. Contacts should follow health monitoring and reporting, with penalties for noncompliance.

triage.headline_ja: 境外移入麻疹引發群聚！個案傳染同住友人　疾管署發布提醒
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入症例による地域内クラスター発生、複数国での同時流行、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 台湾での輸入麻疹クラスター事例。記事サマリーは複数国の流行状況を記載しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナム、インドネシア、タイ、インドのみ。日本、マレーシア、米国、キルギスタン、バングラデシュは対象国外。台湾自体も対象国外だが、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。バングラデシュでの大規模流行（70,936例、585死亡）が背景にあり、区域内での流行拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Kematian Akibat Gigitan Kucing, Dinas Kesehatan Jembrana Minta Jangan Remehkan Serangan HPR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death from Cat Bite, Jembrana Health Office Urges Not to Underestimate Rabies Exposure.
article.articleSummary: Death from suspected rabies in Jembrana, Bali, after a cat attack. On May 23–24, 2026, a 38-year-old man from Banjar Kembangsari, Tukadaya, Melaya, presented at a local health center with hydrophobia and dyspnea, was referred to RSU Negara at 18:42 WITA on May 23, and died at 03:46 WITA on May 24. A history of scratches from a stray cat about a month prior was noted; the attacking cat was shot and not reported. The Jembrana Health and Social Office highlights about 500 dog-bite cases per month and 3,000–4,000 animal bites per year, with 1,500–1,700 human rabies vaccines (VAR) administered monthly. Family members received VAR; authorities urge prompt reporting of suspected rabies exposure and medical care to minimize risk.

triage.headline_ja: 猫の咬み傷による死亡事例、ジェンブラナ保健局が狂犬病暴露を軽視しないよう促す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリ州で狂犬病による死亡事例が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度：死亡例）を1つ満たすが、地域での動物咬傷事例が頻繁（月500件以上）であることから公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的と判断される。情報確認と続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の死亡事例であるが、地域では月500件以上の動物咬傷事例があり、狂犬病ワクチン接種も実施されている。記事の強調点は、地域住民への啓発と早期受診の重要性。WHO通知基準（IHR 2つ以上）には該当しないが、重症度と継続的曝露リスクがあるため、続報監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: هواجس "إيبولا" تخلط أوراق الكونغو الديمقراطية في إسبانيا وديسابر يتمسك بالودية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fears muddle DR Congo's papers in Spain, and Disaper insists on the friendly.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's national football team is scrambling to find a replacement venue for a friendly against Chile after authorities in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain, barred the match amid Ebola fears linked to eastern DR Congo. The squad, in Belgium for a ten-day training camp, plans to travel to Spain to continue preparations and will consider playing behind closed doors if needed. The federation confirms adherence to international health, sporting, and organizational standards and is negotiating a secure alternate stadium to keep the fixture on schedule. WHO data cited by coach Sébastien Desabre report 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in eastern DR Congo. The team concluded the Belgium camp with a 0-0 draw against Denmark and will head to Houston after Spain for the World Cup group stage: Portugal on June 17, Colombia in Guadalajara on June 23, and Uzbekistan in Atlanta on June 27.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱への懸念がコンゴ民主共和国の計画を混乱させ、スペインでの親善試合が問題に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の既知発生地（DRC東部）に関連する記事だが、本件は国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ予選）への間接的な影響であり、新規感染症イベントの報告ではない。公式保健当局の感染症対応に関する新情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC東部での既知エボラ発生（344確認症例、60死亡）に関連した国際スポーツイベント（DRC代表のワールドカップ予選）への間接的な影響である。スペイン当局の試合禁止は移動制限の例ではあるが、本件は感染症の新規ピックアップではなく、既知の発生状況への政治的・スポーツ的反応。DRCのWHOデータは引用済みの情報であり、新規の患者数増加などは報告されていない。対象国内でのイベント（例：DRC内での新規感染確認）ではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Disease Outbreaks, Dry Spells Push Up Beef Prices
article.articleSummary: Beef prices in Uganda have surged as disease outbreaks and drought tighten supply. Wholesale beef now sells at 15,000–17,000 Shs/kg, while retailers quote 20,000–22,000 Shs/kg; the price rise from about 16,000 Shs/kg strains households and businesses. The spike stems from Foot-and-Mouth Disease outbreaks in districts across the cattle corridor—Ntungamo, Abim, Amudat, Amuria, Bukedea, Sembabule, Bukwo, Bulambuli, Gomba and Isingiro—prompting the Ministry of Agriculture to suspend cattle and cattle-product sales and movement in affected areas. Prolonged dry spells have reduced pasture, and higher transport costs and rising regional demand have pushed costs higher. Cross-border traders from the DRC are buying Ugandan cattle for resale in the DRC, with dollar-denominated transactions intensifying price pressure; Uganda's border with DRC has closed following an Ebola outbreak, which could ease demand. Consumers are shifting to cheaper proteins like chicken; some beef portions are reduced.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：疾病発生と干ばつがビーフ価格を押し上げる
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）がウガンダの複数地区で流行しており、公衆衛生への影響（家畜の移動制限、食料供給への影響）と異常性が認められる。また、エボラ出血熱との並記により国際的な懸念も示唆される。IHR基準2つ以上該当およびWPRO基準複数該当のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは口蹄疫がウガンダの複数地区（Ntungamo, Abim, Amudat, Amuria, Bukedea, Sembabule, Bukwo, Bulambuli, Gomba, Isingiro）で発生しており、ウガンダ農業省が家畜および家畜製品の販売・移動を制限している。エボラ出血熱への言及（DRC国境閉鎖）もあるが、主たるイベントはウガンダの口蹄疫である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はウガンダの口蹄疫であり、DRCにおけるイベント発生の明確な記述がないため、verified_locationsはウガンダのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: vaccines alone won't stop an outbreak - here's what else is needed
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) accompanied by cross-border transmission to Uganda; incidents include the burning of an Ebola treatment facility in Mongbwalu and family protests over body retrieval, with police warnings amid grief and fear. Hundreds of Ebola cases reported in the DRC; vaccines alone cannot stop the outbreak. Control requires a mix of vaccination, public-health measures, behaviour change, and community engagement. Lessons from the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak show transmission often occurs during care and burial practices, making safe, dignified burials and engagement with trusted local leaders essential. Families tending to ill relatives, home-based care, and burial rituals can undermine infection control without support. Success hinges on trust, reporting suspected cases, contact tracing, isolation, and credible communication, highlighting the need for coordinated, locally engaged response across borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ワクチンだけでは流行を止められない - 他に必要なことは何か
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（数百症例）とウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行とウガンダへの越境感染について述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国リスト内で確実に該当。Angolaも発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーに明示的な記載がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Carreta da Saúde leva atendimento especializado e reforça combate à hanseníase em Porto Velho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Caravan brings specialized care and reinforces the fight against Hansen's disease in Porto Velho.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil — From June 9–12, a mobile Health Caravan focused on Hansen’s disease (leprosy) will operate across the city and the Vista Alegre do Abunã district, led by the Ministry of Health with Agevisa and Semusa. The Carreta da Saúde – Hansen’s disease offers specialized consultations, active case finding, and educational activities to expand early diagnosis, strengthen search for suspected cases, and reduce transmission and sequelae. The itinerant unit includes clinics for medical assessment, counseling, and referrals, plus outreach on symptoms, transmission, prevention, and treatment. Community Health Agents will direct residents with signs to seek care at the caravan; anyone with compatible symptoms may attend, bringing photo ID, CPF, or SUS card. Early diagnosis improves outcomes and curbs transmission; Hansen’s disease is curable and treatment is free via SUS. Schedule: CEU Square, East Zone — June 9 (morning/afternoon) and June 10 until 12:00; Vista Alegre do Abunã — June 12, all day.

triage.headline_ja: ヘルスキャラバンがポルトベーリョでハンセン病対策の専門的ケアを提供し強化
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の公衆衛生活動（早期診断キャンペーン）の報道であり、新規の異常流行や深刻な健康危機ではない。地域限定的な予防・診断強化プログラムであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンセン病の定期的な公衆衛生活動（モバイルクリニック）の実施を報じたもので、新規感染症イベントやアウトブレイクではない。対象地域はブラジルのポルトベーリョとその周辺地区に限定されており、国際的なシグナル特性を持たない。

article.articleHeadline: இந்தியாவில் முதல் எபோலா பாதிப்பு அறிகுறிகளுடன் நோயாளி ஒருவர் அடையாளம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola infection patient with symptoms identified in India.
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, India reported its first suspected Ebola case with symptoms identified in Rajasthan. A Ugandan national woman traveling on an Air Arabia flight from Sharjah to Jaipur presented with symptoms consistent with Ebola. Airport screening flagged the possibility, prompting health authorities to implement precautionary measures. She was admitted to a hospital in Jaipur and placed under strict isolation. Officials stressed that Ebola infection has not been confirmed; although she shows symptoms, laboratory confirmation will only be possible after testing. Additional samples have been sent for further laboratory analysis, and she is currently being monitored under established infection-control protocols. The situation indicates heightened vigilance while awaiting definitive test results.

triage.headline_ja: インドで最初のエボラ感染症患者が症状を伴って特定された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響の可能性、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）し、エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体による初の疑い事例が多国籍の移動で報告された。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）は最高危険度の病原体。本事例は未確認の疑い事例だが、国際移動（ウガンダ国籍者、シャルジャ経由ジャイプール到着）により国境を越えた感染リスクが存在。ラボ確認待機中だが、空港スクリーニングでの検出および隔離措置が実施されている。インドにおけるエボラの初の疑い事例報告としての報道価値も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Scare In Rajasthan: Ugandan Woman Isolated At Jaipur's RUHS Hospital After Being Flagged During Airport Screening
article.articleSummary: Ebola scare in Rajasthan: A 19-year-old Uganda-origin woman visiting Jaipur was flagged for suspected Ebola during airport screening and admitted to RUHS Hospital for isolation. She arrived in Jaipur from Sharjah on an Air Arabia flight Friday morning. While symptoms resembling Ebola were noted, laboratory confirmation is pending. A sample has been sent to Pune, with a second sample to be collected after 48 hours; she will remain in quarantine until both results are available, and if positive will receive treatment while continuing isolation for 21 days. Rajasthan's health authorities have issued an Ebola alert per WHO guidelines, urging vigilance across government and private hospitals and mandating screening of travellers arriving from abroad, especially Africa. Passengers on the same flight have been advised to self-isolate at home. No confirmed case yet.

triage.headline_ja: ラージャスターン州でのエボラ熱懸念：ウガンダ出身の女性がジャイプール空港スクリーニングで検出され、RUHSホスピタルに隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性（予想外の感染症疑い）と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・UAE経由の移動例）の2つに該当。WPRO基準でも異常性、管理可能性（隔離・検査体制の必要性）が該当。対象国インドでの疑似症例として、フルリスク評価（RRA）進行の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の発病事例はインド（ジャイプール、ラージャスターン州、プネ）のみが疑似症例の対象地。ウガンダ・UAEは患者の移動経路上の地点だが、発症地は記載されていない。ラボ確認待機中（未確認例）だが、エボラ熱の疑似症例・国境越え移動・空港スクリーニングの実施という点で公衆衛生アラート価値が高い。WHO基準に基づく地方当局の対応も既に実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola Cases Reported In Hyderabad, Jaipur; India Remains On High Alert
article.articleSummary: Three suspected Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in India over the last two days: one in Jaipur and two in Hyderabad. The Jaipur patient is a Ugandan woman who arrived from Sharjah on an Air Arabia flight; she was admitted to RUHS Hospital in full isolation after screening detected Ebola-like symptoms, with laboratory confirmation pending. In Hyderabad, a Sudanese student in his twenties was admitted to Gandhi Hospital with similar symptoms after an initial private-care visit; he remains in isolation and his condition has improved, while his attendant is in home isolation until results. A second Sudanese national, 35, flagged during thermal screening at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport and moved to Gandhi Hospital’s isolation facility, is currently asymptomatic and fever-free, with samples sent for testing. The Bundibugyo virus–related outbreak background underpins heightened screening of arrivals from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: インドのハイデラバードとジャイプルで疑わしいエボラ症例が報告；インドは高い警戒状態にある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い事例が複数国から入国者に報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・予想外性、国際的な拡大リスク）を満たす。公衆衛生上の潜在的な深刻な影響と国際的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはUAE（Sharjah）、Sudan、DRC、Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「インドで報告された疑い事例」である。患者はこれらの国からインドに入国した者であり、実際の発生地はインドである。検査確定前の段階で、複数の疑い事例と国際的な移動経路の存在により、フルRRA進行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 衛生防護中心：19歲女學生確診麻疹列本地個案　85人列密切接觸者 (20:23) - 20260605
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection: 19-year-old female student diagnosed with measles listed as a local case; 85 people identified as close contacts (20:23) - 20260605

triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の局所症例で濃厚接触者85人と接触規模は限定的。過去2年間の平均10症例/年に対し現在8症例/年であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は不明。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: مراكز محلية أمريكية جاهزة لمواجهة "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. local centers ready to face Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Thirteen U.S. government-funded medical centers within a nationwide network say they are ready to handle Ebola cases, including treatment for infected patients if needed. The World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. An American patient treated in Germany has Ebola. The U.S. State Department says Americans who are exposed but asymptomatic will be isolated in Kenya at a facility under construction, as Washington commits to keeping Ebola-infected travelers from entering the U.S. Health officials note the network is prepared to respond to outbreaks if required. Public health experts urge repatriating sick Americans to the U.S.; protests at the Kenyan project site left at least two dead, and a Kenyan court halted construction. Since 2014, the U.S. has funded hundreds of millions to strengthen domestic readiness via the 13-centers network under the Emerging Pathogens Training and Education Center.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の地域医療センターがエボラに対応する準備態勢にある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例と死亡が報告され、国際的な拡大リスク（DRC発生、米国・ドイツで患者検出）があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。公衆衛生上の重大な影響と国際的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUSA、Germany、Kenyaも含まれているが、サマリー上ではこれらは患者検出・対応地域であり、エボラの流行発生地はDRCのみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。USA・Germany・Kenyaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。この記事は米国の準備態勢に焦点を当てているが、根本的な疾患イベント（DRCでのエボラ流行）が主題となっているため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm não do tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Encephalitis caused by Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease.
article.articleSummary: Encephalitis linked to Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) in Vietnam, driven by Enterovirus 71 (EV71), with cases rising since early 2026. Hospitals report pediatric HFMD with neurological complications, especially encephalitis, during summer–autumn outbreaks. A 2-year-old case was admitted to Viet Nam - Sweden Uông Bí Hospital after initial HFMD symptoms. EV71 is highly virulent and transmits via respiratory droplets, fecal-oral, or contact with vesicle fluid. Most HFMD resolves in 7–10 days with care, but CNS involvement can progress rapidly, causing meningitis, encephalitis, myelitis, or brainstem encephalitis and potentially fatal outcomes despite treatment. A study of 94 EV71 encephalitis cases at National Children's Hospital Infectious Diseases Center (Jan 2023–Jul 2025) found 81.9% were under 36 months. Prevention emphasizes the 3-clean principle and an EV71 vaccine licensed in Vietnam; VNVC plans to vaccinate children 2 months to under 6 years. Meanwhile, ensure routine immunizations (pneumococcal, influenza, measles, varicella, meningococcal).

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病由来の脳炎
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでエンテロウイルス71（EV71）による手足口病関連脳炎の患者増加が報告されており、小児の神経系合併症（脳炎、髄膜炎など）と致命的転帰の可能性が記載されている。IHR基準で異常性・重症度が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露）に該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、ベトナムにおけるEV71関連脳炎の患者増加は2026年初頭から報告されており、小児（特に36ヶ月未満が81.9%）が影響を受けている。ワクチン接種計画が進行中であることから、当局の対応が進行中。国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクについては記事では明示されていないため「不明」と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Asia-Pacific officials vow to fight against malaria
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, Vientiane hosted the 10th Asia Pacific Leaders’ Summit on Malaria Elimination, led by Lao Prime Minister Sonexay Siphandone and Health Minister Baykham Khattiya. Laos, in partnership with the Asia Pacific Leaders Malaria Alliance, gathered delegates from Cambodia, China, France, Japan, Myanmar, Thailand, Timor-Leste, and Vietnam plus development partners to reaffirm commitments to eliminate malaria in the Asia-Pacific by 2030, building on the 2018 Greater Mekong Subregion Geneva declaration. Lao officials cited a 36% decline in confirmed malaria cases across the GMS from 2015 to 2024, attributing progress to regional cooperation. The summit called for sustainable financing, stronger national ownership, effective management, and greater accountability, while acknowledging challenges such as climate change, cross-border transmission, conflict, population displacement, and limited healthcare access among vulnerable groups, aiming to sustain momentum in the final elimination phase.

triage.headline_ja: アジア太平洋地域の当局者がマラリア対策への決意を表明
triage.triage_reason: マラリア排除に向けた地域首脳会談の報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクではない。既存の進展報告と政策宣言であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア排除に関する政策会談の報道であり、新規アウトブレイク情報ではない。過去の進展（2015-2024年間に36%の症例減少）と将来目標（2030年までの排除）についての宣言である。従って、感染症危機管理のシグナル検知対象ではなく見送りが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case reported in India
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease case reported in Rajasthan, India. A woman from Uganda who arrived in Jaipur from Sharjah on Friday morning aboard an Air Arabia flight was flagged during routine airport screening after exhibiting symptoms consistent with Ebola virus disease. She has been admitted to RUHS Hospital in Jaipur and placed in strict isolation. RUHS Hospital Superintendent Dr. Anil Gupta said she has not been diagnosed with Ebola; while her symptoms resemble the disease, a definitive diagnosis can only be made after laboratory testing. Samples have been sent for laboratory examination, and she is being monitored under established infectious disease protocols. No confirmed case has been reported yet; authorities are awaiting laboratory confirmation to determine if this is an Ebola infection, with travel history from Uganda indicating an imported suspected case.

triage.headline_ja: インドでエボラ疑い症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い症例であり、国際的な移動（ウガンダ→UAE→インド）を伴う輸入症例で、IHR基準2項目以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク）。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される発生地点はインド（ラジャスタン州ジャイプール）。患者はウガンダから移動した輸入症例。エボラは高リスク病原体であり、国際的に深刻な懸念がある。実験室確認待ちの段階だが、疑い症例の報告自体が既に重要なシグナル。UAEはトランジット地で二次感染リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya strengthens Ebola preparedness with new international support
article.articleSummary: Kenya remains Ebola-free as of June 4, 2026, with heightened preparedness after Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Ministry of Health reported 27 suspected Ebola samples tested negative and more than 77,000 travellers arriving from affected countries were screened at 26 designated Points of Entry, with no confirmed cases detected. The International Organization for Migration donated infection prevention and control supplies—thermoguns, hand sanitizers, gloves, soap, colour-coded waste bins, bleach, chlorine and disposable aprons—to strengthen entry-point measures at airports, border crossings and other high-risk sites. Kenya’s preparedness emphasizes surveillance, laboratory capacity, screening procedures, rapid response, and ongoing healthcare worker training; proposed isolation and quarantine facilities are precautionary, not intended to import Ebola. The World Health Organization provided additional support, including over 1,000 PPE kits for major hospitals and border points, with government vigilance maintained due to cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、新たな国際支援によりエボラ熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダとDRCでのエボラ熱流行に対する国境での準備・対策強化の記事であるが、ケニアはエボラ熱確認症例なし（June 4時点で陰性）。国際的拡大リスク認識とWHO支援は存在するが、現時点での流行発生ではなく予防的対策段階のため、続報で実際の患者発生の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）とKenya（192950）が含まれているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。記事はウガンダとDRCにおけるエボラ熱流行の事実を述べており、ケニアはそれに対する予防的対応を報道している。DRCでの確認患者発生があるため、IHR基準「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」に該当。ただしケニア自身では確認症例がなく、現在のところは対策・準備段階である。WPRO基準では複数該当しているが、対象国リスト内での実際の流行発生国がDRCのみであること、および情報不足部分（重症度詳細など）があるため、WATCHとして継続監視を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: Unsafe Food A Threat To India's Public Health, Need Greater Surveillance, Safety Measures: WHO
article.articleSummary: With two days to International Food Safety Day (June 7), WHO reports unsafe food causes 866 million illnesses and 1.5 million deaths globally each year. India faces a especially acute burden, where food safety intersects with malnutrition, poor sanitation, unsafe drinking water, and a large informal food sector.
