Children under five bear a disproportionate share—about one-third of food-borne illnesses while representing only 9% of the population—and face nearly three times the illness risk of adults. In India, diarrhoeal diseases and enteric infections linked to contaminated food persist across states such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha and West Bengal, with flood-prone Assam and Bihar seeing monsoon outbreaks; urban centers like Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai and Bengaluru struggle with adulteration and supply-chain contamination. Biologic hazards (Salmonella, E. coli, Campylobacter, Norovirus) caused roughly 860 million illnesses in 2021. Chemical contamination (lead, arsenic, methylmercury) accounted for nearly 73% of all food-related deaths globally, underscoring long-term cardiovascular, cancer and neurodevelopment risks. The report urges treating food safety as a development issue requiring stronger surveillance and measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドの公衆衛生に対する脅威となる不安全な食品、より大きな監視と安全対策が必要：WHO
triage.triage_reason: 食品由来感染症は既存の公衆衛生課題であり、異常な新興イベントではない。しかし複数の病原体（ノロウイルス、パラチフス、チフス、大腸菌、カンピロバクター）がインド全域で検出されており、特に5歳未満児の高い罹患率と季節的な流行リスク（モンスーン関連）が示唆されている。情報が不足しており、国の食品安全システムの対応能力を確認するため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントはWHOの国際食品安全デーレポートに基づく既知の公衆衛生課題の報告である。インド全土での広範な食品由来感染症の流行は継続的であり、異常な新興イベントではない。ただし、複数州での同時検出、特に洪水易罹患地域（アッサム、ビハール）のモンスーン関連の季節的リスク上昇、および5歳未満児への不均衡な影響が記事の重点である。食品安全監視体制の対応能力が不明であるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Giám đốc Trung tâm Phòng, chống dịch nói gì về nguy cơ Ebola bùng phát thành đại dịch toàn cầu, tỉ lệ tử vong đến 90%?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What did the director of the Center for Disease Prevention and Control say about the risk of Ebola turning into a global pandemic, with a mortality rate as high as 90%?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Ebola virus disease remains a complex global threat, with the Democratic Republic of Congo reporting over 1,000 cases and more than 200 deaths; case fatality can reach about 90%. In Vietnam, doctors warn that there have been no Ebola cases, and the risk of a global pandemic is very low because Ebola is not airborne and transmission requires direct contact with blood or body fluids of symptomatic patients. People remain contagious only after symptoms appear; incubation can be up to 21 days. Early detection, isolation, and strict infection-control at hospitals and border surveillance are crucial. Vaccines exist for high-risk areas and monoclonal antibody therapies can improve outcomes. Vietnam does not require food hoarding or movement restrictions; hospitals are prepared with negative-pressure rooms and PPE training. Close monitoring of new outbreaks remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症対策センター所長がエボラ出血熱の世界的大流行リスク、死亡率90%について語った内容は？
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラウイルス疾患の継続的な流行（1,000症例以上、200死亡以上）は重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示すが、ベトナムでは症例報告がなく国際的拡大リスクは低いと評価されている。情報更新と国境監視体制の状況確認が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行は既知の継続的脅威であり、ベトナムでは症例がなく準備対応段階と評価されている。記事は医学的背景情報を提供しているが、新規の大規模アウトブレイクやWHO緊急警告を示唆していない。スクリーニング基準3つ以上該当し社会的関心も高いが、IHR基準が1つのみのため、追加情報を待つWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Suspek Rabies di Jembrana Bali Berujung Maut, Korban Sempat Abaikan Cakaran Kucing Liar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Rabies in Jembrana, Bali Ends in Death, Victim Had Previously Ignored Scratch from a Wild Cat
article.articleSummary: Suspected rabies death in Jembrana, Bali, involves Ni Ketut Sari (38) of Banjar Kembangsari, Desa Tukadaya, Melaya, who had been scratched by a wild cat. The human case remains unconfirmed, described as suspected rabies. In response, Jembrana’s Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food, with a local foundation, held a vaccination and sterilization drive at Balai Banjar Batuagung on 5 June 2026 to curb transmission and control the dog population. The campaign treated 110 animals: 60 sterilizations and 50 rabies vaccinations. This comes after five residents in Banjar Masean, Desa Batuagung, were bitten by dogs confirmed positive for rabies. Overall, 33 animal rabies cases have been recorded in Jembrana, with the highest numbers in Mendoyo. Authorities urge community participation to vaccinate pets and reduce rabies risk across the province of Bali.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンブラナ、バリ州での狂犬病疑い事例が死亡で終焉、患者は野良猫の引っ掻き傷を以前無視していた
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州ジェンブラナ県）で狂犬病の人間死亡事例（疑い例）が報告され、既に33件の動物狂犬病症例が確認されている。公衆衛生への影響は深刻（死亡例・複数動物例あり）で、地域当局による対応（予防接種キャンペーン）が開始されており、シグナルとしてのピックアップが妥当である。
triage.notes: 人間の死亡事例は「疑い例」（未確認）だが、同地域で確認された33件の動物狂犬病症例が存在し、複数の住民が陽性犬に咬傷を受けている。地域当局による予防接種・避妊去勢キャンペーンが実施され、公式対応が進行中である。WPRO基準において重症度（死亡）、長期曝露（複数住民の咬傷歴、地域に継続的リスク）、流行可能性（ヒト-ヒト感染なしだが動物-ヒト感染の継続的リスク）、管理可能性（地域対応進行中）の4基準に該当し、シグナルとしての価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Emiratos suspende entrada de pasajeros de Sudán del Sur, RDC y Uganda por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Arab Emirates suspends entry of passengers from South Sudan, DR Congo, and Uganda due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United Arab Emirates suspends visa issuance and entry for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan amid an Ebola outbreak. The measure takes effect June 6, blocking new visas and entry for travelers from these countries unless they have spent more than 21 days outside the states before arrival. Cargo flights between the UAE and the three countries will continue; transit flights are unaffected, and the suspension may be extended as part of national preparedness. Bahrain had previously halted flights to these countries on May 19. The Congo Health Institute reports 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 64 deaths; Uganda reports 16 infections, including one death considered imported from DRC. WHO says the virus began circulating in Ituri, DRC near Uganda and South Sudan borders about two months before the May 17 PHEIC declaration. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, hemorrhagic fever, vomiting, and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: アラブ首長国連邦、エボラ出血熱発生によりスーダン共和国、コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダからの乗客入国を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限措置の実施、複数国での確認例（DRC 381例、ウガンダ16例）があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州）、ウガンダ、スーダン共和国でのエボラ発生を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。他国での発生報告があるが、評価対象外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。複数国による渡航制限措置により国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 19歲女子感染麻疹　隔離治療情況穩定
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 19-year-old woman infected with measles; condition stable under isolation and treatment.
article.articleSummary: Measles diagnosed in a 19-year-old woman in Hong Kong; condition stable under isolation and treatment. She developed fever, myalgia and headache from May 29 and sought care at a private clinic on May 30. A rash appeared, and on June 1 she went to Queen Elizabeth Hospital Emergency Department; laboratory testing confirmed measles. Epidemiology shows she was not born in Hong Kong and was vaccinated in her birthplace during childhood. During the incubation period she largely stayed in Hong Kong, and is classified as a local case. The patient is a student. During her infectious period, she visited a private clinic (May 30) and QE Hospital (June 1); otherwise she remained at home. The Centre for Health Protection has contacted the clinic, hospital and building management to identify close contacts and high-risk individuals. As of 5pm today, about 85 close contacts have been identified; none show measles symptoms; surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: 19歳女性が麻疹に感染 隔離治療中で状態は安定
triage.triage_reason: 香港における麻疹の孤立症例。重症度は低く（軽症、安定状態）、国際的拡大リスクも限定的であるが、ヒト-ヒト感染性と接触者追跡が進行中である。情報は現在点での単一症例報告であり、今後の感染動向の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での単一症例報告。患者は軽症で安定している。接触者追跡は進行中で85名の接触者が特定されているが、現在のところ症状者なし。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染性が高い疾患であるため、引き続き監視が必要。香港はChina(1814991)に含める。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश आने से पहले ही बढ़ गए Dengue के मामले, इस मौसम के बुखार को ना करना Ignore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases have increased even before the rains arrive; don't ignore this season's fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases are rising in the summer before the monsoon, driven by climate change that raises temps and increases transmission risk (about 13% per 1°C rise) in dense urban areas where Aedes mosquitoes breed in stagnant water. Early dengue often masquerades as flu, with symptoms including headache; muscle, bone, and joint pains; vomiting and nausea; eye pain; skin rash; and swollen glands. Severe dengue can involve fluid leakage, excessive bleeding, or organ failure and may occur even when platelet counts are not severely low, complicating diagnosis. Preventive measures emphasize eliminating standing water, removing mosquito breeding sites, and using repellents containing DEET, picaridin, citronella, or lemon eucalyptus oil; keeping windows and doors closed; using mosquito nets; and employing fans or air conditioning to reduce indoor mosquito activity. Awareness should extend beyond monsoon to curb fatalities in urban settings. Published date reference: 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季到来前にもデング熱症例が増加、この季節の発熱を軽視するな
triage.triage_reason: インドでのデング熱の季節外れの増加は異常・予想外であり、重症度（重篤なデング熱の可能性）、流行しやすさ（稠密都市部でのAedes蚊の繁殖）、気候変動による長期的な曝露リスクの複数のWPRO基準に該当する。公衆衛生への重要な懸念。
triage.notes: デング熱は季節性疾患だが、気候変動による気温上昇で季節外れの増加が報告されている点が重要。稠密都市部での蚊の増殖とヒト-ヒト接触の可能性が高い。早期の認識と予防対策の強化が必要。インフルエンザも複合感染の可能性として言及されているが、主題はデング熱。

article.articleHeadline: هجمات على فرق دفن ضحايا إيبولا في الكونغو تهدد بتفجير بؤر عدوى جديدة - نافذة مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attacks on Ebola victims' burial teams in the Democratic Republic of the Congo threaten to spark new infection hotspots - Egypt Window
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces renewed spread after burial teams were attacked in Katana, South Kivu, about 30 km north of Bukavu. The trained teams fled, leaving a coffin, raising fears that contaminated bodies could fuel transmission. The attack occurred in territory controlled by rebels Allied for Change and Movement 23 March, hindering access for responders. Since mid-May, the outbreak has 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths. The latest update reports 19 new confirmed cases, including two deaths, across 17 health zones in Ituri, seven in North Kivu, and one in South Kivu. International support includes IOM planning 30 health checkpoints to screen travelers, and a shipment to Bunia enabling about 300 safe burials. There are cautious positives: 32 contacts in Romabara, Ituri, completed 21-day monitoring with no new infections, and a recovered patient in Goma.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス犠牲者埋葬チームへの攻撃が新たな感染源の発生を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。アクティブな地域紛争による対応阻害がある進行中のエボラ流行であり、フルRRA実施必須。
triage.notes: 南キブ州カタナでの埋葬チーム攻撃により、エボラウイルス対応が著しく阻害されている。武装勢力（変化のための同盟と23月運動）支配地域での事案であり、セキュリティ上の懸念が深刻。国際支援（IOM、防疫チェックポイント設置）が進行中。記事配信日時が2026年6月となっているが、これは将来日付であり、データ品質に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UAE tightens entry rules from three countries over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola precautionary measures drive the UAE to suspend new visas and tighten entry rules for travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, effective 1:00 pm on Saturday, June 6, 2026. The National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority (NCEMA) and the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship (UAEICP) say the measures protect public health and strengthen preparedness. All new visa issuance for nationals of the three countries is suspended, and entry to the UAE is restricted for travelers arriving from, or transiting through, those countries. Travelers who have spent more than 21 days outside the listed countries before arrival will be permitted entry. Cargo and transit flights between the UAE and the three countries will continue. Officials will monitor global health developments with partners and may extend measures based on risk assessments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策で UAE が3カ国からの入国ルールを強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大リスク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）が確認され、IHR基準で国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限が該当。スクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が全て Yes となり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）およびスーダン（366755）はサマリーに記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。UAE の入国制限措置は DRC からのエボラ感染拡大を懸念した反応であり、DRC が主要な発生地。複数国での確認による国際的な拡大リスク・懸念が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 兩里登革熱高風險 衛局插黃旗 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever at High Risk in Liangli; Health Bureau Raises Yellow Flag.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is at high risk in Tainan City as the rainy season approaches and temperatures rise. The Health Bureau designated Renhe Village, Rende District, and Yongping Village, Xinying District, as high-risk areas, raising a yellow flag for mosquito control. Imported cases nationwide reached 65 as of June 4, with Indonesia and the Maldives as sources; Tainan has 3 imported cases, while Kaohsiung City reports local transmissions. Vector surveillance shows a surge: ovitraps captured over 96,000 Aedes eggs, up 24,000 from the prior period. Since April 1, positive breeding sites incur penalties under the Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Act. By week 20, 474 districts have mobilization standards; 27,137 households were surveyed, 3,176 standing-water containers found, 53 positive breeding sources identified, and 16,768 health-education contacts completed. Health Director Li Cui-feng urges travelers with fever and dengue-like symptoms to seek prompt care and advises protective measures outdoors and at home.

triage.headline_ja: 両里のデング熱が高リスク 衛生局が黄旗を発揚
triage.triage_reason: 台湾台南市でデング熱の地域感染が報告されており、ベクター監視で蚊の卵が大幅に増加、複数地区が高リスク地域に指定されている。WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、政府の公式対応（衛生局の黄旗発揚）も確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にインドネシアとモルディブが列挙されており、記事サマリーで「インドネシアとモルディブが発生源」と明記されている。対象国リストではインドネシア（1643084）のみが該当。台湾での発生は記事の主題だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ベクター監視データ（96,000個以上のヤブカの卵）から流行リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Where's the Ebola virus hiding and the years-long hunt to find the animal spreading it
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has claimed 63 lives per the World Health Organization, illustrating the ongoing challenge of tracing Ebola’s reservoir. Since 1976, scientists have sought the animal source that transmits Ebola to humans, with little success despite testing thousands of species, including bats. The piece contrasts Ebola with Marburg, whose reservoir was identified in Egyptian fruit bats in Uganda in 2007–08, underscoring the fleeting nature of viral carriage in bats—viruses may be cleared from individual animals even as bat communities spread them. Ebola antibodies and RNA have been detected in several bat species and other animals at times, but antibodies alone are insufficient; the gold standard remains isolation of live virus. Pinpointing the reservoir would enable targeted surveillance, improved mapping of risk areas, and better outbreak prevention in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスはどこに隠れているのか？それを広めている動物を見つけるための何年にもわたる捜索
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：63人の死亡、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、実際のアウトブレイク対応と動物由来感染症対策の観点から早急な情報確保が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクに関するもので、DRCと隣接するウガンダに影響。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エジプトはマールブルグの動物貯蔵宿主（エジプトイヌコウモリ）に関する一般情報として言及されており、現在の発生地ではない。死亡者63人、複数国での感染確認、ズーノーティックリスク、動物由来感染症対策の不確実性などから、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC, WHO Launch Joint Ebola Response Plan
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda triggers a six-month joint preparedness and response plan by Africa CDC and WHO, June–November 2026, targeting US$518 million to rapidly detect and respond. The One Response plan unites governments, partners and communities to strengthen emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics and essential health services, and complements national plans in DRC and Uganda. With no licensed vaccines or therapeutics for Bundibugyo Ebola, the strategy emphasizes health-system strengthening and rapid cross-border actions to protect neighboring communities. Implementation is already underway in affected and at-risk countries, with 10 priority countries enhancing preparedness for early detection and swift response. Authorities urge heightened screening at points of entry and cross-border coordination, while maintaining support for mpox, cholera and measles to avoid disrupting other health responses. The plan seeks to end the outbreak and bolster regional capacity for future threats.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、WHOが合同エボラ対応計画を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の多重感染症同時発生、アフリカ地域での国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性あり）。Bundibugyo型エボラの新規発生は重大なシグナルであり、WHOとアフリカCDCの合同対応計画も国際的関心を示している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの発生として記事で報告されている。記事ではウガンダにも言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC のみが該当対象国。米国5億1,800万ドルの予算規模、6ヶ月の対応計画、ワクチン・治療法なしという点で極めて深刻。mpoxコレラ麻疹との関連言及もあり、複合的な感染症危機の可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : l'OMS et l'Agence de santé africaine annoncent un plan de 518 millions de dollars
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: WHO and the African Health Agency Announce an $518 Million Plan.
article.articleSummary: A 518-million-dollar plan, jointly funded by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), was launched to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring countries, from June to November 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the plan at a press briefing, highlighting six focus areas: emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. The funding aims to strengthen outbreak response across the DRC and border states, enabling rapid case finding, sample processing, and community mobilization to curb transmission. No case or death counts are provided in the article. This joint effort signals intensified international and regional collaboration to contain Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHOとアフリカ保健機関が5億1800万ドルの計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生であり、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WHO・アフリカCDCによる多国間協力的な対応計画の発表は、国際的な関心と支援必要性を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月配信で、DRCおよび隣接国でのエボラ流行対応に関する国際的な資金調達計画を報道している。WHO事務局長の公式発表であり、高い信頼性がある。具体的な症例数・死亡数は記事に記載されていないが、多国間協力的な大規模対応計画の発表は流行の重大性を示唆している。隣接国への拡大リスクも言及されており、国境を越えた感染リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's World Cup dream meets Ebola, U.S. visa roadblock
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Africa is poised to make World Cup history, but the run-up is shadowed by two major threats. First, stringent United States immigration policies threaten the participation and travel of African teams and fans to the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Second, an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa adds public health and logistical complexities to preparations, travel, and spectator attendance as the tournament approaches. The convergence of visa roadblocks and viral transmission pressures raises serious concerns about team readiness, scheduling, and fan support across the continent. Ten African countries are highlighted in connection with the event: Algeria, Cape Verde, DR Congo, Egypt, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Morocco, Senegal, South Africa, and Tunisia. The article underscores the need to address immigration and health challenges to safeguard Africa’s World Cup aspirations and engagement by supporters.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのワールドカップの夢、エボラとアメリカのビザ障壁に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラアウトブレイクは予想外の状況であり、アフリカ大陸全体の国際的な大規模イベント（ワールドカップ）に伴う感染伝播リスクと渡航制限の危険性がある。
triage.notes: 記事では中部アフリカでのエボラアウトブレイクが言及されており、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（民主主義コンゴ共和国）とガーナ。その他の国（南アフリカ、象牙海岸、エジプト等）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ワールドカップという大規模国際イベントに伴う感染伝播リスクと、アメリカのビザ制限による国際的な移動制約が複合的に作用する点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Roger Kamba juge discriminatoire l'interdiction de visa à tout Congolais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola — Roger Kamba deems the visa ban on all Congolese discriminatory.
article.articleSummary: DRC Health Minister Roger Kamba condemns visa bans on Congolese linked to Ebola as discriminatory; at a June 4 Kinshasa briefing, he argued there is no scientific or public health basis to deny visas to Congolese or to citizens living far from the Ebola epicenter. He noted the Ebola epidemic has been contained so far to the Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. Government spokespersons, including Patrick Muyaya, say discussions with U.S. authorities continue to show the evolving response and aim to lift the measure. The briefing highlights ongoing diplomatic work alongside public health measures to facilitate mobility while the outbreak remains geographically confined.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（キンシャサ）：エボラ - ロジェ・カンバ大臣がすべてのコンゴ人への査証禁止は差別的と判断
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生がDRC複数州で継続中であり、IHR基準（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）の複数該当、かつ国際的な外交問題（査証禁止）が発生しており、スクリーニング基準の複数該当と社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC内でのエボラ発生と、これに関連した国際的な査証禁止措置についての外交的対応である。Ituri州、North Kivu州、South Kivu州に限定されており、地理的には限定的だが、DRC政府の国際的な対応と米国との外交交渉が進行中。United Statesは政策決定国として記載されているが、当該感染症イベント発生地ではないため対象国リストから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تعلن خطة لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization announces a plan to combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus unveiled a six-month Ebola response plan on 2026-06-05, partnering with Africa CDC, with a budget of $580 million for June–November to contain the outbreak. The plan, drawing on lessons from prior emergencies, emphasizes political commitment, sustainable funding, and trusted engagement of local communities to curb transmission. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, government data reported 381 confirmed Ebola cases as of June 4, 2026, underscoring the ongoing outbreak. The initiative focuses on accelerating coordination, surveillance, and response to halt spread and prevent further escalation, leveraging lessons from past outbreaks and emergency responses to restore public confidence and effectively manage the health crisis. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of Congo, outbreak response, funding, public health measures, international cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ対策計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中の流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRCで381確認事例が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威である。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによるエボラ対策の6ヶ月計画発表を報告。DRCでの381確認事例という具体的な流行データが示されている。国際的な対応（WHO、アフリカCDC、$580百万予算）が既に動員されており、高い社会政治的関心を示す。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया-डेंगू मुक्त करनाल: जिला प्रशासन ने कसी कमर, हर रविवार 'ड्राई डे' का निर्देश - Lalluram Karnal Malaria and Dengue Prevention ADC Meeting Highlights
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Karnal Malaria-Dengue Free: District Administration Tightens Up, Orders a 'Dry Day' Every Sunday - Lalluram Karnal Malaria and Dengue Prevention ADC Meeting Highlights
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Karnal district in Haryana is pursuing malaria-free status via a district-level Malaria Working Committee chaired by ADC Rahul Raiya, targeting malaria, dengue, Japanese encephalitis, and chikungunya. Key measures include strict cleanliness, fogging, and a mandatory Sunday 'Dry Day' for schools; roofs cleared of debris; regular cleaning of school tanks and coolers; and awareness sessions during prayers. In dengue-affected areas, fogging must be prompt, and loudspeakers on garbage trucks will broadcast prevention messages. Village sanitation committees will ensure regular cleanliness; a nodal officer will be appointed in all offices. Karnal has seen a sharp decline in malaria with only one case in 2026 so far, and dengue cases are under control. Health infrastructure includes 2 sub-divisional hospitals, 8 CHCs, 25 PHCs, and 150 sub-centers.

triage.headline_ja: カルナル県マラリア・デング熱対策強化：地区行政が毎週日曜日の『ドライデー』を指示 - Lalluram カルナル県マラリア・デング熱予防ADC会議ハイライト
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介感染症（マラリア、デング熱、日本脳炎、チクングニア）を対象とした地区レベルの予防対策会議の報告であるが、現在の発生件数は限定的（マラリア1件）であり、すでに管理下にある状況。国際的拡大の具体的リスクは明記されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はカルナル県（ハリヤナ州、インド）における既存の蚊媒介感染症（マラリア、デング熱、日本脳炎、チクングニア）に対する予防対策の強化を扱っている。現在の発生数は限定的で管理下にあるが、蚊媒介感染症の長期的な曝露リスクと流行性の高さが認識されている。地区行政による積極的な対策が講じられており、政府の関心は高い。WPROスクリーニング基準で2つ該当するが、IHR基準に該当なく、深刻な新規発生ではないため、経過観察レベルとした。

article.articleHeadline: 本地麻疹｜居蕪湖街19歲女大學生確診　曾到私家診所及伊院求醫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local measles | A 19-year-old female university student living on Wuhu Street was diagnosed; she had previously visited a private clinic and a hospital for treatment.
article.articleSummary: Measles case in Hong Kong: a 19-year-old female university student, non-local born, residing on Wuhu Street in Hung Hom, is classified as a local case. She spent most of the incubation period in Hong Kong and did not return to school during this time. On May 29 she developed fever, myalgia and headache; she visited a private clinic on May 30 and, due to ongoing symptoms, presented at Queen Elizabeth Hospital on June 1, where laboratory testing confirmed measles. She is currently in isolation and stable. The Centre for Health Protection has initiated contact tracing, contacting the private clinic, the hospital and her residence management to identify close contacts and assess exposure of high-risk individuals. She reports childhood measles vaccination in her birthplace. Published date: 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: 香港での麻疹 | 湖街に居住する19歳の女子大学生が確診、私家診所と病院で受診歴あり
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は国際的に報告義務のある疾患であり、香港での局所伝播ケースは異常・予想外。医療機関での受診に伴う接触者特定の複雑性と二次感染リスクがあり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 香港での局所麻疹ケースであり、記事サマリーに基づき香港は中国（1814991）に含める（ルール6適用）。患者は医療機関（私家診所・Queen Elizabeth Hospital）を複数訪問しており、接触者追跡が進行中。WPRO基準において異常性・流行可能性・長期曝露リスク（医療機関での複数訪問）が該当。

article.articleHeadline: 19歲女學生確診麻疹列本地個案　85人列密切接觸者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 19-year-old female student diagnosed with measles listed as a local case; 85 people identified as close contacts.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Hong Kong: a 19-year-old female student, non-local born, is diagnosed as a local measles case. She reportedly was vaccinated against measles in her birthplace during childhood. From May 28 to June 5 she remained mostly at home; during incubation (May 8–22) and infectious period she did not attend school. Symptoms started May 29 with fever, muscle pains, and headache; a rash appeared and she sought care at a private clinic on May 30, then presented to Queen Elizabeth Hospital Emergency Department on June 1. Laboratory confirmation from clinical samples; she is in isolation and stable. As of 5 June 2026, about 85 close contacts have been identified for medical surveillance. Hong Kong has recorded eight measles cases this year, four imported and four local.

triage.headline_ja: 19歳女子学生が麻疹と診断され地域症例に 密接接触者85人を特定
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の確認症例が香港で報告され、85人の密接接触者が特定されており、制御困難なヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、同地域で今年すでに8例（輸入4例、地域発生4例）が記録されている。地域内での継続的な曝露リスクと流行拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区は中国に含まれるため、verified_locations にはChina(1814991)のみを記載。麻疹は予防接種対象疾患であり、ワクチン接種者での発症報告は注目すべき。85人の密接接触者追跡により二次感染の可能性がある。地域内での継続的な感染監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DRC: What You Need to Know and How to Help
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is centered in Ituri Province, with lab-confirmed cases in Goma, a densely populated transport hub, involving the Bundibugyo strain, a rare form with no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. As of 2026-06-05, the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and the Africa CDC has labeled it a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security. Containment depends on early detection, infection prevention, community trust, and rapid response; four healthcare workers have died. Ongoing challenges include conflict and insecurity restricting health workers and supplies, funding cuts weakening surveillance, mass displacement complicating contact tracing, and community mistrust. Neighboring countries are increasing cross-border surveillance. The IRC has launched an emergency response to reach over 500,000 people, focusing on PPE, hygiene, risk communication, and psychosocial protection, amid a broader humanitarian crisis in eastern DRC (≈15 million in urgent need; 26.7 million food insecure).

triage.headline_ja: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行：知っておくべきことと支援方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言し、アフリカCDCも大陸的安全保障上の公衆衛生緊急事態として認定。稀なBundibugyo株でワクチンなし、密集都市部（Goma）での実験室確認症例、国境を越えた監視強化など、国際的拡大リスク極大。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルス種の中でも稀で、利用可能なワクチン（rVSV-ZEBOV）が効果を示さない可能性がある。Goma（北キブ州）は東アフリカの主要輸送ハブであり、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。紛争・不安定性による保健ワーカー不足、資金削減による監視機能低下、大量避難民による接触者追跡困難、コミュニティ不信など、管理可能性に重大な課題あり。WHOおよびアフリカCDCによる正式な緊急事態宣言により、国際的対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Радиостанция в ДР Конго се опитва да се пребори със здравната дезинформация, докато щамът "Бундибуджо" на ебола се разпространява
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A radio station in the DRC is trying to combat health misinformation as the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola spreads.
article.articleSummary: Bundribugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), concentrated in Bunia, Ituri Province. It marks the 17th Ebola outbreak identified in DRC since 1976. The outbreak was declared on 15 May 2026; as of 5 June 2026, at least 381 laboratory-confirmed cases and 63 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, complicating responses. Public health measures are hindered by widespread skepticism and attacks on health workers, as misinformation circulates. Verite Johnson, a journalist and editorial secretary at a Bunia-based radio-television outlet, launched a 45-minute daily program at 10:00 to combat rumors, featuring health experts who provide updates and answer questions. Local residents, including Samson Gerson and Chantal Francin, express distrust of vaccines and uncertainty about illness, highlighting the challenge of aligning communities with alerts and clinical guidance during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国コンゴのラジオ局が、ブンディブギョ株エボラの拡大に伴う健康ミスインフォメーション対策に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラの17番目の発生として深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（381例の確認症例、63例の死亡）、ワクチンと治療法がない予想外の状況、国際的な拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラは過去のザイール株よりも致死率が低いとされているが、承認されたワクチンと治療法の欠如、保健労働者への攻撃、広範なヘルスミスインフォメーション、そして地域住民の予防接種に対する不信感が対応を著しく困難にしている。イツリ州ブニアを中心としたDRCでの発生であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRC（203312）のみを verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk remains low with UAE well placed to monitor disease | The National
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk remains low globally despite the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, with confirmed cases revised down to 344 and 60 deaths across 24 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Follow-up testing reduced suspected cases; one suspected case recently traveled to Uganda via the UAE. The UAE reports no cases but will bar entry to travellers from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan from Saturday and has implemented contact tracing as a precaution. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri to review treatment and prevention efforts; WHO is coordinating with Uganda and the UAE to assess travel exposure risks and enhance tracing. Ebola is caused by viruses, typically affecting animals such as fruit bats and can infect humans; symptoms usually appear 2–21 days after exposure, beginning with flu‑like illness and potentially progressing to severe disease. There is no vaccine for the latest strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱のリスクは低いままで、UAEは疾患監視体制が整備されている | The National
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での確認例と国境越えの旅行歴により国際的な懸念が生じており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、UAEが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ、南スーダン、UAEは対象国外のため除外。エボラは高い重症度と致死率を示し、ワクチンなしの最新株による流行であること、複数地域での確認と国際的な旅行リンクがある点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 屯門麥理浩徑現非洲狐獴 疑為非法走私異寵 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African meerkats spotted on the MacLehose Trail in Tuen Mun, suspected of illegal smuggling of exotic pets - Sing Tao Daily
article.articleSummary: An African meerkat was spotted on the MacLehose Trail in Tuen Mun by a hiker on June 4, underscoring Hong Kong’s ongoing challenge of illegal import and ownership of exotic pets. Meerkats are native to southern Africa and are not a Hong Kong species; the animal is believed to be an illegally imported pet. Hong Kong law (Public Health (Animals and Poultry Regulations, Cap 139) and Rabies Regulations, Cap 421) imposes penalties up to HK$50,000 and up to one year imprisonment for importing or possessing illegally entered animals without a permit. The AFCD has seized 16 non-pet animals since 2023 through last March, including meerkats, sugar gliders, and porcupines. Past Tai Po Taihu Garden and Lam Tsuen Riverbank incidents involved meerkats walked on leashes; citizens surrendered one meerkat and one porcupine in 2023–2024. The case underscores ecological and public health risks from exotic-pet smuggling and abandonment, with ongoing enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: 屯門麥理浩徑現非洲狐獴 疑為非法走私異寵 - 星島日報
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は違法走私された野生動物の発見であり、具体的な狂犬病の発症・感染事例ではない。公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は野生動物（アフリカマーコット）の違法走私に関する話題であり、感染症の実際の発症・流行事例ではない。狂犬病は規制法に言及されているだけで、現在の発症報告はない。異常・予想外の動物目撃という観点でWPRO基準1つが該当するが、感染症の公衆衛生学的重大リスクは示唆されていないため、シグナルトリアージ対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Announces $580 Million Six-Month Plan to Fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: WHO unveils a $580 million six-month plan to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo to contain a new outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain. The response centers on Bunia, Ituri province, with Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visiting the Evangelical Medical Center (CEM) and other facilities on May 31, 2026, to coordinate the global effort. The plan signals intensified international engagement by WHO and partners to curb transmission in the affected region. The outbreak in DRC has prompted continued emphasis on outbreak control and coordination among agencies as they monitor for potential imported or exported cases. This action underscores ongoing international commitment to address Ebola in Congo as of June 5, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱に対抗するため5億8000万ドルの6ヶ月計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規アウトブレイク、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるコンゴ民主共和国での新規エボラアウトブレイク、WHO による大規模国際対応。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo エボラウイルス株による新規アウトブレイク。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と5億8000万ドルの6ヶ月対応計画により、国際的な関心が極めて高い。輸入/輸出症例のモニタリング言及により、国際拡大リスク評価。記事配信日は2026年6月5日（未来日付、テストデータと推定）。

article.articleHeadline: المعالجون التقليديون في الخطوط الأمامية لمكافحة إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traditional healers on the front lines of the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically Bunia in Ituri province, linked to the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak was declared May 15 and has 359 confirmed cases with 61 deaths. No vaccine or targeted treatment exists for Bundibugyo EVD. Local traditional healers, trusted by communities, operate a “Laboratory of Ancestors” in Bunia offering herbal remedies and inhaled decoctions; they report treating Ebola, though no current patients have been treated in this outbreak. Health workers report deep local distrust, delaying diagnosis and care. The World Health Organization stresses community engagement and integration of local practices; in prior outbreaks traditional leaders helped with isolation and restricting corpse handling. As of now, about 45% of contacts have been followed up, with authorities distributing PPE and encouraging referrals to health facilities to improve the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱対策の最前線に立つ伝統治療師たち：コンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確定症例359件、死亡61件という重篤なアウトブレイク。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの宣言済みアウトブレイク。ワクチン・標的治療がなく、ローカル信頼の課題と接触追跡の遅れが報告されている。WHOが関与し、コミュニティとの協働が強調されている重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заболевания Эболой в ДРК и Уганде выросло до 397
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DRC and Uganda has risen to 397.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda have risen to 397 confirmed cases and 63 deaths (381 in DRC, 16 in Uganda; 62 deaths in DRC, 1 in Uganda). Investigators have traced nearly 10,000 contacts of confirmed cases—4,341 in the DRC and 5,009 in Uganda. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya described the current outbreak as the fourth most severe in history. A Preparedness and Response Plan for Bundibugyo virus disease was launched by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC, with funding of about $580 million required. The plan emphasizes rapid detection, timely response, community-focused measures, continuity of essential health services, protection of frontline workers, and cross-border containment. WHO has declared the situation a regional emergency with high outbreak risk and expects new cases in the coming days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ患者数が397人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが地域緊急事態を宣言し、死亡率が高く、複数国での発生拡大が確認されている。フルRRA進行対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074（Republic of Uganda）で、対象国リスト中のIDは1269750です。記事サマリーに「Uganda」と明記されているため検証位置に含めました。397確認症例、63死亡、約10,000の接触者追跡中。WHO・アフリカCDCが地域緊急事態宣言。資金5億8,000万ドルの準備・対応計画が立案されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-plan mot ebola sjösatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches plan to combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: Plan from June to November 2026 to combat the Ebola outbreak fueling fear in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spillover concerns to neighboring Uganda. The WHO strategy centers on coordinating emergency responses, surveillance, laboratory testing, preventive measures, clinical care, and civil-society engagement, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at a briefing. Since the outbreak began in mid-May, at least 240 deaths and over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases have been reported, though underreporting is expected, according to the CDC. The plan aims to strengthen case finding, diagnostics, and response capacity across the affected region to curb transmission and prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ対策計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響（240人以上の死亡、1,000件以上の疑い例）、隣国ウガンダへの流行拡大リスク、国際的な医療・検査・予防措置の国際調整の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーでは「spillover concerns to neighboring Uganda」と記述されており、ウガンダは懸念地域であり確認された発生地ではないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が対象国リスト内であるため記載。エボラは最優先疾患であり、240人以上の死亡と1,000件以上の疑い例が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Suspension des audiences à la prison centrale de Bunia en raison d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Suspension of hearings at Bunia Central Prison due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Suspension of hearings at Bunia Central Prison in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, due to suspected Ebola cases. The Ituri High Court (TGI) announced on June 3, 2026 that forensic hearings at the Bunia prison are halted until the sanitary situation improves to curb Ebola transmission. Five inmates were transferred earlier to treatment centers at Bunia and Rwampara for suspected Ebola, but they escaped; investigations are underway to locate them in the community. In response, the prison has received personal protective equipment, chlorine, handwashing stations, and infrared thermometers, with regular awareness sessions for staff and detainees. A multi-agency coordination group—including the World Health Organization, MONUSCO’s penitentiary support unit, the International Committee of the Red Cross, provincial authorities, and the Bunia health zone—monitors the situation and coordinates the response to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラのため、ブニア中央刑務所の法廷公判を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定・疑い例が刑務所施設内で発生し、公共施設での対応が取られている。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・管理可能性で複数該当。DRCは対象国である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ疑い例は DRC のイトゥリ州ブニア市の刑務所で発生。ルワンダはWHO等の国際機関の協調対応に言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内の発生イベント。5名の受刑者が逃走した点は、地域内での二次感染リスク拡大の懸念がある。WHOやICRC、UNMONUSCOが対応に参画していることから国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo : les réflexes à adopter face à un cas suspect en France
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola: the steps to take when faced with a suspected case in France.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in France: France’s health system outlines urgent steps for suspected Ebola Bundibugyo. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026 for Ebola virus Bundibugy o in the DRC and Uganda, though not a pandemic; import risk to France remains low, but vigilance is required at first contact. As of 2 June 2026, ECDC reports 363 confirmed cases in DRC with 62 deaths and 206 patients in isolation; Uganda has 15 confirmed cases and 1 death. A suspect case requires recent exposure in a viral transmission zone plus compatible symptoms within 21 days of return, notably fever ≥38°C, severe headache, fatigue, myalgias/arthralgias, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, plus unexplained bleeding or death. Immediate actions: isolate, apply appropriate protections, and call SAMU-C15 to trigger the REB; do not transfer to emergency or lab without prior consultation. If classified as possible, transport is by SMUR; a multi-agency teleconference coordinates evaluation (SAMU, clinician, infectious disease expert, CNR FHV at Institut Pasteur Lyon), with ARS and Santé publique France as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラ：フランスで疑い症例に直面した際に採るべき対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、既に複数国での確認症例あり。フランスでの疑い症例への対応体制整備という段階で、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: サマリーより、エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）はDRCとウガンダで確認されており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダはリストに未含。フランスでの疑い症例対応の記事だが、フランスは対象国ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）で、363確認症例・62死亡。DRCが流行地として対象国に該当するため、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Emirados suspendem vistos e proíbem entrada de cidadãos da RDCongo, Uganda e Sudão do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: United Arab Emirates suspend visas and ban entry of citizens from DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.
article.articleSummary: United Arab Emirates suspends new visas and entry for nationals from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola, effective June 6; visa issuance and entry (including transit) are blocked unless travelers have spent more than 21 days outside the three countries before arrival. Cargo and transit flights continue. The move aims to bolster national preparedness as the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa evolves. As of June 5, the DRCongo reports 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths (up 19 cases and 2 deaths since last Tuesday). The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri Province near Uganda and South Sudan and has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda has 15 cases and 1 death, with at least one death linked to an imported infection from DRCongo. The Bundibugyo strain shows 30-50% fatality; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment exists per WHO. East African Community ministers agreed regional measures to harmonize surveillance at airports, ports, and land borders and formed a regional technical working group; Bahrain had already suspended flights on May 19.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：アラブ首長国連邦がコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンの国民のビザ停止と入国禁止を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱の複数国での確認と国際的な入国禁止措置により、シグナルとして認識する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCongo（363確認例、62死亡）、Uganda（15例、1死亡）、南スーダンでのエボラ発生を述べており、対象国リストではDRC（203312）とUganda（226074）が確認される。Sudanは別の実体（Republic of the Sudan）であり対象リストに含まれないため除外。Bahrain、UAEは措置実施国として記載されるが、イベント発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株の30-50%致命率、ワクチンなし、複数国での地域的調整が報告されており、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Η αποψίλωση των δασών, ο ιός Έμπολα και η σύνδεσή τους με το smartphone στην τσέπη μας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deforestation, the Ebola virus, and their connection to the smartphone in our pocket.
article.articleSummary: Deforestation driven by rising demand for cobalt, gold, and other minerals for electronics heightens Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Although Ebola outbreaks were historically localized, Bundibugyo strain outbreak began in May 2026 in eastern DRC, with 363 confirmed cases and spillover into Uganda. Analyses link each percentage-point rise in Central African deforestation to a 20–40% increase in Ebola and malaria cases; the 2014 West Africa outbreak followed extensive forest loss in Guinea. The pattern coincides with artisanal mining—two million miners in the DRC, 380,000 in the east—driving forest clearance and greater human–bat contact. Global demand for 3TG minerals and gold is expected to triple, while 2024 forest loss reached about 1.5 million hectares (Global Forest Watch), driving mining expansion deeper into the jungle. Public health must couple outbreak response with forest protection, regulated mining, and improved miners’ living conditions, noting Bundibugyo can evade diagnostics and vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 森林破壊、エボラウイルス、そしてそれらとポケットのスマートフォンとのつながり
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの現在の流行（2026年5月、DRC東部で363確認症例、ウガンダへの波及）とマラリアの複合発生で、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。国際的拡大のリスク（ウガンダでの確認）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行パターンが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されているEbola Bundibugyo株の流行は2026年5月にDRC東部で開始、363確認症例、ウガンダへの波及を報告。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。森林破壊とマラリアのリンクも言及されており、複合的な公衆衛生脅威。Bundibugyo株が診断と予防接種を回避できるという特性は管理可能性を低下させる。

article.articleHeadline: Kampf gegen Ebola in Afrika: "Sie sehen aus wie Aliens!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against Ebola in Africa: "They look like aliens!"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with intense mistrust and violent attacks on health facilities. In Rwampara, isolation tents near a city hospital were burned after a dispute over a deceased patient. Kinshasa confirmed the outbreak on May 15; WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, the seventeenth Ebola outbreak since the virus's discovery. No licensed vaccine or specific treatments exist for Bundibugyo. Current counts: over 300 confirmed infections, about 100 suspected cases, and 48 deaths; earlier WHO tallies cited far higher suspected numbers, including cases and deaths in neighboring Uganda. Symptoms: bleeding, dehydration, vomiting, diarrhea. Some tests returned negative because they targeted other strains, fueling distrust. ActionAid reports about one-third doubt Ebola's existence; 34% can name three transmission routes; 64% believe the disease is real. Attacks on centers and fear-aliens imagery hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ対策：「彼らはエイリエンのように見える！」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが2026年5月17日に国際保健上の公式な懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラ出血熱の第17次アウトブレイク。確認感染者300人以上、死亡48人、ウガンダへの波及確認。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イツリ州東部）が主要な発生地域として記述されている。ルワンダやウガンダは地理的に隣接しており波及リスクが言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでのアウトブレイクである。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクはワクチン未承認であり、重大なリスク。コミュニティ不信（約3分の1がエボラの存在を疑う）が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: DRC traditional funeral rites get banned amid Ebola and sparks friction
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts a ban on traditional funeral rites from 22 May 2026 to curb transmission, forcing communities to abandon washing and touching the deceased. Official burial teams in full PPE now manage remains, using sterile handling instead of customary practices, while singing remains a grieving element separated from contact. The resurgent outbreak underscores that Ebola virus can stay active in bodily fluids after death, justifying the safety measures despite cultural trauma. The piece notes public friction between health imperatives and long-standing rituals, with scenes contrasting PPE-clad workers and emotional mourners. It also references a backlog at testing centers delaying official documentation for cases, such as one farmer whose burial had not been formally documented. No case or death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: DRC伝統的葬儀が禁止、エボラ対策で摩擦が生まれる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラ流行は発生報告から即座に国際通知対象。
triage.notes: エボラ流行により、2026年5月22日より伝統的葬儀慣行が禁止された。死体処置時の曝露リスクが公衆衛生対応の理由として明記されている。ただし記事に具体的な症例数・死亡数の記載がなく、検査センターでのバックログが報告プロセス遅延を引き起こしている。文化的摩擦が社会的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Second Sudanese national isolated at Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad after developing fever, samples sent for Ebola testing
article.articleSummary: Second Sudanese national admitted to Gandhi Hospital, Secunderabad (Hyderabad), in isolation after developing fever during quarantine; Ebola testing underway as a precaution. The 23-year-old student travelled from Uganda to Hyderabad for studies and was initially placed under quarantine as part of yellow fever surveillance before fever prompted transfer to hospital for evaluation. Samples were sent to the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) on Friday morning for Ebola testing. A day earlier, another Sudanese traveller at RGIA Hyderabad had fever detected during thermal screening, triggering concerns. Dr. Vamshi Krishna, Nodal Officer for Ebola at Gandhi Hospital, said only two individuals are under observation; a third person cited in reports is an asymptomatic attendant who is a contact and advised home quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードのガンジー病院で隔離されたスーダン人2人目、熱を発症しエボラ検査のため検体を送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラとロシアンルーレット的な黄熱病の複合発生懸念、複数国からの患者流入、早期隔離と検査体制の存在により管理可能性は相対的に高いが、未確定のエボラ疑い例は即座のRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドのテランガーナ州ハイデラバードでの発生を主題としており、スーダン国籍患者の入院であるが、発生地はインド。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国リストに含まれない。エボラ検査は未確定だが、隔離と検査体制が迅速に行動されている点は管理可能性を示唆するも、黄熱病との併行監視とエボラ疑い例の複数発生はリスク高。

article.articleHeadline: Santé. L'OMS annonce un plan d'aide de plus de 500 millions de dollars pour lutter contre Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health. The WHO announces an aid plan of more than $500 million to fight Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization and Africa CDC announced a joint aid plan of $518 million (about €446 million) from June to November to combat an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring countries. The outbreak, declared May 15 in northeast DRC, involves the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, suspected to have circulated undetected for some time. In the DRC, 381 cases have been laboratory-confirmed with 64 deaths; the Ituri province is the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths across three provinces. Across the border in Uganda, 16 cases have been confirmed with 1 death. The plan focuses on emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory analysis, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community outreach to contain the outbreak and limit cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 健康：WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱と闘うために5億ドル以上の支援計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク（confirmed cases 381件、死亡64件）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な対応（5億ドル以上の支援計画）と複数国への拡大（ウガンダで16件、死亡1件）が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認例（16件、死亡1件）は記事に記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはアウトブレイク宣言（5月15日）から約3週間経過した状況での国際的対応の報道。Bundibugyo Ebola strainの長期未検出流行が示唆されており、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: OMS și Africa CDC lansează un plan de 518 milioane de dolari pentru combaterea focarului de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC launch a $518 million plan to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, the WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million joint plan (June–November 2026) to combat an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring countries. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccines or treatments are approved, is driving transmission. In DRC, 381 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported with 64 deaths; the northeast across three provinces is affected, with the Ituri province epicenter accounting for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. Across the border in Uganda, 16 cases have been confirmed, including one death. The plan prioritizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. The current outbreak is larger than the two earlier Bundibugyo epidemics (2007, 2012).

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDCがエボラ出血熱流行に対抗するため5億1800万ドルの計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の確認例および死亡者がDRCおよびウガンダで報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高く、WHOとアフリカCDCによる大規模な対応が開始されている。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラは以前の流行より大規模で、ワクチンや承認された治療法がない。ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Ituri州が震源地で全体の約90%の症例と76%の死亡が集中している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC launch $518 mn plan to combat Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518-million joint plan to tackle the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and across the border in Uganda, targeting June–November 2026. The Bundibugyo strain, described as rare, is believed to have circulated under the radar before May 15 when the outbreak was declared in DRC. As of latest figures, 381 confirmed cases in the DRC with 64 deaths; three provinces affected, the Ituri epicenter accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths. Uganda reports 16 confirmed cases and 1 death. The plan emphasizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement to contain the outbreak and reduce cross-border spread. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo, and the current outbreak is larger than the 2007 and 2012 Bundibugyo events.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱の流行対策に5億1800万ドル規模の計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数国での確認例、高い致死率、承認済み治療法・ワクチン欠如、国際的な公衆衛生対応が必要な状況。WPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、流行可能性、管理困難性が複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているがサマリーでは二次的な記載（確認例1件）。主要な流行地域・対応対象はDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみ含める。Bundibugyo株は稀で、過去のアウトブレイク（2007年・2012年）より大規模である点が重要。ワクチン・治療法がないため管理困難性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-plan mot ebola sjösatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO plan to combat Ebola launched.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, the feared viral hemorrhagic fever, is the focus of a new WHO-led plan backed by Africa CDC to combat the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with cross-border spread to Uganda. The initiative, worth nearly 5 billion kronor, runs June–November 2026 and aims to coordinate acute responses, surveillance, laboratory testing, prevention, clinical care, and community engagement to curb fear and transmission. Since mid-May, the outbreak in the DRC has resulted in at least 240 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases, with the true toll likely higher due to undercounting. The effort emphasizes rapid, synchronized action across affected regions, enhanced monitoring, and support for local health systems to prevent further international spread. Published date reference: 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに対するWHO計画が開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死者240人以上、1000件以上の疑い患者）、異常性（エボラの再発生）、国際的拡大リスク（DRCからウガンダへの越境感染）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク（WHO主導の対応計画発動）が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（少なくとも240人の死亡、1000件以上の疑い患者）が主題である。ウガンダへの越境感染言及があるが、記事本文がないため詳細確認不可。Machupoと併記されているが、記事の主要な対象はエボラである。WHO・Africa CDCによる大規模な対応計画（約50億クローネ）が開始されている点で社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تعلق إصدار تأشيرات جديدة لمواطني 3 دول بسبب "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE suspends issuing new visas for citizens of three countries due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: The United Arab Emirates is suspending all new visas for citizens of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola concerns. The measure takes effect on Saturday, June 6, 2026 at 13:00 UAE time and bans entry of travelers from these three countries, including those in transit. An exemption applies to individuals who can prove they have resided in a country outside the three listed for at least 21 consecutive days before arrival. Cargo shipments and supply-focused commercial flights remain unaffected to preserve trade and logistics. Officials describe the steps as precautionary and flexible, aimed at strengthening national health security amid increasing Ebola indicators in parts of Africa and in coordination with local and international health authorities. The policy will be continuously reviewed as the global health situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスを理由にUAEが3カ国の国民への新規ビザ発給を中止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症が対象国（DRC）で発生しており、国際的な渡航制限が実施されている。IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限、およびWPRO基準の流行リスク・長期曝露が該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラウイルスがアフリカの一部地域で増加指標を示していることが言及されており、DRCが確実に主題の発生地である。ウガンダ・南スーダンについて、見出しと記事サマリーではビザ制限対象国として言及されているが、それらの国でのエボラ発生の直接的な確認はサマリーに記載されていないため、verified_locationsではDRCのみを含める。UAEはビザ制限を実施した国であり、エボラの発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rajasthan Health Department on Alert After Suspected Ebola Case Reported at Jaipur Airport
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case reported at Jaipur International Airport, Rajasthan, India. A foreign woman arriving from Uganda via Sharjah on an Air Arabia flight exhibited symptoms resembling Ebola during health screening and was moved to an isolation facility at RUHS Hospital in Jaipur, where she is under medical observation and in stable condition. No confirmation of Ebola infection has been made. Collected samples have been sent to a specialized laboratory in Pune for testing; authorities say only the laboratory report will determine whether Ebola infection is present or if symptoms are due to another illness. The Rajasthan Health Department has placed authorities on heightened vigilance and is following infectious-disease protocols to prevent public health risk. Officials emphasize not to speculate and await test results. If confirmed, it would represent a travel-related case requiring contact tracing and continued monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ジャイプール空港で疑い例報告後、ラジャスタン州保健局が警戒態勢を敷く
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い例がインドで報告され、国際的な移動経路（ウガンダ→シャルジャ経由）を伴う点、および確定検査待ちの状況がIHR基準を複数満たす。公衆衛生面の重大性と国際的拡大の可能性からフルRRA進行の対象。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い例は未確定だが、国際線での搬入、複数国を経由した渡航経路（ウガンダ発生地域からの直接输入の可能性）があり、IHR通知閾値を明らかに超過。インド当局が警戒態勢を敷いており、検査結果が重要。UAEおよびウガンダは記事の背景情報だが、実際の患者発生はインドのため verified_locations はインドのみ。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS débloque 446 millions d'euros pour endiguer l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO releases €446 million to contain the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring countries prompts a joint WHO-Africa CDC plan worth $518 million (446 million euros) for June–November 2026 to contain spread. Declared May 15 in north-east DRC, the Bundibugyo strain—rare and possibly circulating undetected—drives the response. WHO reports 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths in the DRC, with the Ituri Province epicenter accounting for 90% of cases and 76% of deaths across three provinces. Across the border in Uganda, 16 confirmed cases and 1 death have been reported. The plan targets emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory analyses, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls it a concrete, urgent plan to halt transmission, while the CDC notes this outbreak is larger than the two previous Bundibugyo events in 2007 and 2012.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制するため4億4,600万ユーロを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当し、WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。確定症例381例、死亡64例を伴う国際的なエボラ出血熱流行であり、WHOが大規模資金投入による対応計画を発表している。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの事例は副次的（16確定症例、1死亡）であり、主要な発生地はDRC（イツリ州が確定症例の90%、死亡の76%を占める）。WPRO対象国リストにはDRCが含まれているため、ウガンダは verified_locations に含めない。この流行は新興株（Bundibugyo strain）であり、過去の2007年および2012年の発生より規模が大きいと報告されており、国際的な対応計画の発表により社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyans fearful and furious over US Ebola centre
article.articleSummary: Ebola fears in Kenya as US builds a quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki, Mount Kenya. The centre will quarantine Americans arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo, which is battling a major Ebola outbreak. Kenya has never recorded a case. The facility, with about 50 isolation beds and staffed by US personnel, is nearing completion with no patients to date. US military aircraft have delivered equipment to the base, with at least nine flights since May 24. Locals protest, calling it neo-colonial and dangerous; two deaths were claimed by rights groups amid unclear circumstances. Kenyan President William Ruto defends the partnership, saying refusing would be inhuman. Washington has pledged $13.5 million for Ebola preparedness; Kenyan Health Minister Aden Duale says the quarantine centre will proceed despite a High Court halt order. Critics warn Kenya's fragile healthcare system could be overwhelmed.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア国民がエボラ対策の米国拠点に不安と怒り
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは国際保健上極めて重大な脅威であり、DRCで大規模流行中。ケニアへの米国検疫施設建設という異例の対応、地元の抗議と社会的混乱、国際的な政治的関心が高まっており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的関心・渡航制限懸念）および社会政治的関心が複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのエボラ大流行に対応するための米国がケニアに建設する検疫施設であり、実際のエボラ患者発生はDRCに限定される。ケニアはこれまで患者がなく、当該施設は予防的措置である。Bluedot APIが列挙した地域（ケニア、米国など）は施設の所在地・政治的関心の所在地であり、実際のエボラ感染症イベント発生地ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Equipes do Samu passam por treinamento para transporte de pacientes com suspeita de ebola | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Samu teams undergo training for the transport of patients with suspected Ebola | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro's Mobile Emergency Care Service (Samu-RJ) conducted biosafety training for transporting people with suspected Ebola under Ministry of Health protocols. The program covers proper PPE use—masks, face shields, gloves, impermeable gowns, protective coveralls—and donning/doffing procedures, guided by specialists from INI, Fiocruz, per Health Ministry guidance. In this first phase, instruction targeted ambulances already selected for the task. To ensure rapid response, two ambulances were stationed in the city center and the West Zone, adapted specifically for this transport. The plan calls for coordination among the Central Regulation Center, Inter-hospital Transport, and Samu-RJ's Pre-Hospital Control Committee. Brazil's Health Ministry says Ebola transmission risk is low, but preparedness is essential. A suspected case from Uganda was ruled malaria after INI testing and discharged on Monday, June 1.

triage.headline_ja: Rio de JaneiroのSamu（救急車）チームがエボラ疑似患者の輸送に関する訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的な訓練・準備活動に関するもので、実際のエボラ発生事例ではない。ウガンダからの疑似症例はマラリアと確定診断済み。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: ウガンダからの患者搬出は疑似症例であり、マラリアと診断確定済み。本記事はブラジルでの予防的訓練に関する記事であり、実際の感染症発生ではなく、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: 再多一宗確診猴痘本地個案　52歲患者曾訪「胡同」與先前病例有關連
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another locally confirmed monkeypox case; a 52-year-old patient who had visited a hutong is linked to a previous case.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox case in Hong Kong: a 52-year-old man is locally confirmed, linked to two May 25 Hutong-related cases. He had high-risk exposure on May 2 at the Hutong venue on Shanghai Street, Mong Kok. Genital rash appeared May 21; fever and sore throat May 25; later rash in the arms, chest, and perianal area. He sought care at the Yau Ma Tei Male Social Hygiene Clinic and was isolated at Yan Chai Hospital; laboratory confirmation came from the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Services. Authorities have traced about 300 visitors to Hutong after May 1; outreach via SMS continues into early June. The patient reportedly had no monkeypox vaccination. Since 2022 Hong Kong has 88 cases: 71 local, 17 imported; all male, with most reporting high-risk sexual activity. Public health tips to avoid close contact with suspected cases; WHO notified.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で新たに1件の猴痘ローカル感染が確認、52歳患者が先行例と関連のあるフートン（胡同）を訪問
triage.triage_reason: 香港（中国）でMpoxクレード特定の新規ローカル感染確認。複数症例のクラスター関連、既知ベニューでの継続的曝露リスク、公衆衛生対応中（接触者追跡300名規模）。IHR基準・WPRОスクリーニング基準複数該当、国際通知済み。
triage.notes: 香港は中国の特別行政区。サマリーから香港でのローカルクラスターが明確。クレードI・II両方の報告あり。継続的な接触者追跡中（約300名）、既知ベニュー（Hutong/上海街）への複数訪問リスク。患者層は男性、高リスク性的活動を報告。2022年以来88症例（71ローカル、17輸入）の累積。WHO通知済み。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Was a Disaster Waiting to Happen
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-06-05, Congo's Ebola outbreak is described as a disaster waiting to happen, with Next Africa’s daily newsletter examining the warning signs that were missed in the latest outbreak. The piece centers on the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and scrutinizes which indicators failed to trigger timely action. It situates the incident within a broader Africa-focused public health landscape, highlighting how missed warnings can hinder rapid response to infectious threats. The excerpt also notes other newsletter content, such as a Nigeria-based oil industry update, reflecting the publication’s mix of health and business topics.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は起こるべくして起こった災厄
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で少なくとも3項目が該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラはハイスケーラーリスク疾患であり、DRCでの流行確認によりシグナルトリアージで即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は極度に致命的（CFR 25-90%）で、国際的な懸念対象。記事はDRCでの流行を主題としており、警告信号の見落としと迅速対応の失敗が指摘されている。Nigeriaが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではNigeriaの石油産業の言及のみで、エボラ流行イベント自体はDRCに限定されている。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Corporation intensifies disease prevention measures across Tiruchi
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Tiruchi Corporation has intensified vector-borne disease prevention to curb dengue and scrub typhus amid recent rainfall. The city, spanning 65 wards across five zones, deployed a team of 40 Domestic Breeding Checkers per zone to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sources. Anti-dengue measures include fogging with portable machines and high-power fogging vehicles, plus spraying insecticides in open storm-water drains and drainage channels. Dense shrubs near residential areas are being cleared to reduce scrub typhus risk from infected larval mites in overgrown vegetation. Focus is on densely populated areas and water-stagnation-prone sites; bush clearance and cleaning of water storage tanks are conducted at government schools and anganwadi centres. Water quality monitoring has intensified; chlorination is stepped up in areas with discolored or tasting water. Water samples are collected, distribution networks inspected, and overhead tanks, tail-end connections, and pit taps cleaned. Regular medical camps run at PHCs.

triage.headline_ja: ティルチラパッリ市が病害虫媒介感染症の予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とツツガムシ病の同時報告で WPROスクリーニング基準を1つ以上満たすが、情報が予防対策の実施報告に限定されており、症例数・死亡・重症度の詳細が不明。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は最近の降雨後にデング熱とツツガムシ病が報告されたことを示唆しているが、具体的な症例数・死亡数・重症度データは提供されていない。ティルチラパッリ市が広域的に予防対策を強化している事実は、地域での疾患活動の存在を示唆するが、詳細な流行状況の把握には続報が必要。タミルナードゥ州はデング熱とツツガムシ病の常在地域であり、季節性疾患の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: FG urged to take action to protect Nigerians against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Fears of Ebola importation into Nigeria rise as lawmakers urge urgent funding for the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) after the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province outbreak driven by the Bundibugy(o) strain. Nigeria is on high alert since May 25, 2026, when the NCDC activated emergency preparedness amid porous borders and weak cross-border surveillance. There are no licensed vaccines or targeted treatments for the current variant, heightening the need for robust readiness. Lawmaker Amobi Ogah warns that the NCDC has faced prolonged funding shortfalls, reporting no operational funding in 2025 and unreleased capital allocations in 2026, undermining response capacity. Operational challenges include unpaid contractors, shortages of laboratory reagents and diagnostic materials, stalled treatment center projects, inadequate biosafety facilities, poor ICU infrastructure, and limited oxygen support, hindering rapid-response deployment. He calls for intensified border surveillance by Port Health Authorities to detect and contain potential importations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱からナイジェリア国民を保護するための対策を取るよう促される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国境越え感染リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大の懸念、および社会的・政治的関心が高まっており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC Ituri州で既に発生しており、ナイジェリアへの『輸入懸念』として扱われている。実際の発生地域はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、ナイジェリアでの準備状況の強化が求められており、地域的に監視対象としての重要性は高い。Bundibugyoエボラ種は既知の危険な株であり、ワクチン未対応という点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: IOM: Multi-Country Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak - Situation Report No. 3 (26 May - 2 June 2026)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BVD) continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with transmission expanding in eastern DRC and cross-border concerns rising (26 May–2 June 2026). Transmission remains concentrated in high-mobility settings, underscoring mobility-informed preparedness and response. WHO designates DRC and Uganda as Priority 1a for readiness, with South Sudan, Burundi and Rwanda as Priority 1b; Angola, Central African Republic, Ethiopia, Kenya, Republic of the Congo, United Republic of Tanzania and Zambia as Priority 2. IOM supports national authorities to strengthen preparedness along mobility corridors: population mobility monitoring, points of entry surveillance, cross-border coordination, and community-based interventions in high-risk areas. IOM’s Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) provides mobility analysis, dashboards and weekly reporting. With no licensed vaccines or specific therapeutics for BVD, sustained investment in early detection and community-based prevention remains critical to limit transmission and regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: IOM: 複数国にまたがるブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク - 状況報告書第3号（2026年5月26日～6月2日）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の複数国アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ中心、国境を越える懸念）であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが複数国をPriority 1a/1bに指定し、国際的な準備体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: API発生地域には11国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCとウガンダでの継続的な伝播」であり、対象国リスト内で実際に記載されているのはDRCとザンビアのみ。サマリーで明示されたPriority 1a/1b/2指定国のうち、対象国はDRC（記述あり）とザンビア（Priority 2として言及）。ウガンダ・ブルンジ・ルワンダは対象国外のため除外。ライセンス化されたワクチンまたは特異的治療法がないため管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Punalur municipality launches measures on war footing
article.articleSummary: Three dengue fever cases have been confirmed in Punalur municipality amid a sharp rise in mosquito density detected during a District Vector Control unit field inspection, as monsoon intensifies. Authorities warn of heightened risk of waterborne and infectious disease outbreaks. In response, the municipality has launched aggressive preventive and source-reduction measures, including large-scale chlorination of all domestic and public wells and a framework to test well-water quality. A high-level emergency meeting involving the Vector Control unit, municipal health wing, ASHA workers, and local healthcare professionals mapped an immediate containment plan. Action also targets source reduction: guidelines to rubber and pineapple farmers to prevent stagnant water; orders to private landowners to clear overgrown vegetation; and intensified field inspections to accelerate anti-larval operations in the coming days.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：プナルール市が全力で対策を展開
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州プナルール市でデング熱3例が確認され、蚊の密度上昇が検出された。地域的な公衆衛生対応が進行中だが、現段階では深刻な国際的拡大リスクや重度な症例集積の明確な証拠がなく、追加情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのケーララ州プナルール市での限定的なデング熱事例（3例）を報じており、モンスーン期の蚊媒介疾患リスク上昇という季節的背景がある。地域当局は積極的な予防措置を講じている。現段階での重症度や全体的な影響規模は不明。今後の症例増加動向に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nederlandse viroloog aangeklaagd na smokkel van mpox-monsters uit Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dutch virologist charged after smuggling mpox samples from Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two researchers—a Dutch virologist and a colleague from Cameroon—were charged in the United States with smuggling mpox samples from the Republic of Congo into the U.S. without the required permissions. They arrived in January via Paris at Detroit Metropolitan Airport after a nine‑day stay in Congo. During a baggage check, authorities found vials containing deactivated mpox virus. Although the material could not replicate or infect, U.S. authorities emphasize that even deactivated pathogens are subject to strict import and permit rules. Prosecutors allege the samples were transported on a commercial passenger aircraft without compliance; the investigation has not clarified the transport’s purpose. The FBI notes both suspects are experienced mpox researchers. The laboratory involved is cooperating but has offered no further comment due to the case. Prosecutors will determine whether the conduct was intentional or due to other reasons, with potential implications for the scientists’ careers and for international collaborations in infectious‑disease research, where transport and permits are tightly regulated.

triage.headline_ja: オランダのウイルス学者がアフリカからのmpoxサンプル密輸の容疑で起訴
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの国際的な輸送違反という異常な事象であり、公開情報の規制遵守に関わる懸念がある。ただし発症者や流行の兆候がなく、感染症の公衆衛生的影響は直接的でないため、情報確認待機が適切。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の発生・流行ではなく、研究用mpoxサンプルの規制違反輸送に関する法的事案である。記事は米国・オランダ・カメルーン・コンゴにおける事象を扱うが、対象国リストでの確認済み発生地はDRCのみ。検体は既に不活性化されており、感染リスクなし。国際協力や研究倫理の観点から政府関心があるが、公衆衛生危機そのものではない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS y la agencia de salud africana lanzan plan de 518 millones de dólares para combatir el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and the African health agency launch a $518 million plan to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint $518 million plan to address the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), spanning June to November 2026. The outbreak was declared on May 15, with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola suspected to have circulated for some time. As of the latest figures, 381 cases have been confirmed in the DRC, including 64 deaths, across three provinces, with the epicenter in Ituri, which accounts for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths. Across the border in Uganda, 16 cases have been confirmed, including one death. The plan prioritizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community mobilization, aiming to scale response and contain transmission. The current outbreak is larger than the Bundibugyo outbreaks in 2007 and 2012, according to Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカ保健機関がエボラ対策に5億1800万ドルの計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模アウトブレイク、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。既に381確認患者、64死亡、国際展開（DRC・ウガンダ）。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ(Bundibugyo株)アウトブレイク。381確認患者、64死亡(CFR16.8%)。Ituri州が90%の患者を占める。ウガンダでの患者報告もあるが、対象国リストにはないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO・Africa CDCの協調対応で$518M支援計画。過去の2007/2012 Bundibugyo流行より大規模。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 烏干達伊波拉疫情擴散！新增3例確診、1人死亡　累計病例達19例 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Ebola outbreak spreads! 3 new confirmed cases, 1 death; total cases reach 19 - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Uganda's Ministry of Health confirmed three new Ebola virus disease cases, increasing the total to 19, with one Congolese national dying—the outbreak's second death. Four patients have recovered and been discharged. The three new cases were previously identified as known contacts and are in mandatory institutional isolation, while several contacts remain under observation, indicating ongoing transmission risk within specific contact groups. Ebola virus spreads via contact with blood, secretions, or organs of infected people. Authorities are tightening surveillance and urging the public to follow prevention measures to prevent spread to other regions. The death of a Congolese patient highlights cross-border transmission risk and the need for vigilance and coordinated control.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ疫情が拡大！新規確診例3件、1人死亡　累計病例数19件に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例の継続的増加、死亡例、跨境伝播リスク、および継続的な接触者追跡による継続的伝播リスクが示されており、IHR基準とWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ発生であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の国籍者の死亡事例が報告されており、DRCが対象国であるため含める。跨境伝播リスク、継続的な接触者追跡、死亡例、および公開された情報がすべてフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の実施を強く支持している。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 580 مليون دولار مطلوبة لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: $580 million needed to tackle an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, the World Health Organization reports that the joint plan with Africa CDC to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo requires about $580 million in funding. The outbreak is expanding, particularly in mining areas where the movement of miners and gold trade accelerates transmission. Mongbalo, in Ituri Province in the northeast, has become a key hotspot. The current outbreak began in February and was only detected in mid-May, and is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less common strain with no approved treatment. This is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in DRC to date. The funding gap underscores challenges in surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and rapid response in mining regions as authorities work to curb spread between communities.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱の流行に対処するために5億8000万ドルが必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療薬なし）による第3次最大規模の流行。鉱業地域での採掘者の移動と金取引による急速な伝播が特徴。検出遅延（2月発症、5月中旬検出）によるサーベイランス・検査ギャップの課題あり。WHOと Africa CDCによる5億8000万ドルの資金調達を要する。国際的支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: पड़ोसी देशों में पोलियो के बढ़ते मामलों के बीच बिहार में 28 जून से विशेष पल्स पोलियो अभियान - pulse polio campaign bihar after polio cases in neighbouring countries
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special Pulse Polio campaign in Bihar from June 28 amid rising polio cases in neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: Pulse Polio vaccination campaign in Bihar, India, will run from 28 June to 2 July 2026, targeting all children aged 0–5 years to receive polio vaccine. The move follows new poliovirus cases in neighboring Afghanistan and Pakistan; 2025 totals were 21 in Afghanistan and 31 in Pakistan, with three new cases in each country confirmed in 2026 so far. The health department aims to immunize every child to mitigate transmission risk, identifying beneficiaries with indelible ink markers and monitoring at bus stands, railway stations, markets, and other public spaces. Training for vaccinators and supervisors is planned, along with district and block task forces to review preparations. Newborns will be included in the campaign, and vaccine wastage will be minimized by strict cold-chain use, including using leftover vaccine from opened vials the next day where permitted."

triage.headline_ja: 近隣諸国のポリオ症例増加に伴い、ビハール州で6月28日から特別パルスポリオキャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは国際的に重要な伝染病であり、アフガニスタン・パキスタンでの新規症例確認に対する予防的な公衆衛生対応。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・予想外性が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはビハール州（インド）でのパルスポリオキャンペーン実施が主題であり、アフガニスタン・パキスタンでの症例は背景情報として言及されている。ビハール州は対象国インドに含まれるため verified_locations に入れた。ポリオは根絶目前の疾患であり、新規症例の出現は国際的な懸念事項。予防的キャンペーン実施の決定は、公衆衛生当局の高い警戒を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak further strains DRC's underfunded health system, leaving health workers with limited critical supplies
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo strain; third largest on record with no approved vaccine or treatment.
