As of June 4–5, 2026, cases concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with cross-border transmission confirmed and border closures hindering detection. Goma reporting highlights a severely underfunded response; 1.5 million people have lost access to primary healthcare and 1,000 nutrition centers have closed. Frontline health workers face shortages of PPE, hygiene supplies, and diagnostics, delaying response as supplies must travel from Nairobi and Kampala and overland transport through difficult terrain in Djugu, Irumu, and Mambasa. CARE DRC reports a 26% budget cut and loss of a third of national staff, weakening outbreak logistics. Women account for over 60% of suspected cases, reflecting caregiving roles and burial practices; misinformation undermines prevention. CARE urges immediate funding and coordinated, locally led action; protecting health workers is essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国の資金不足の医療制度をさらに圧迫、医療従事者に限定的な重要物資のみ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、東部DRCでのBundibugyo株による大規模発生は歴史的に3番目の規模、越境感染確認、ワクチン未承認の緊急事態であるため、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全て該当。即時フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIから返された地域にはKenyaやUgandaが含まれるが、記事サマリーの内容はDRC東部（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu）での発生が中心で、Nairobi/Kampalaは供給ルートの中継地として言及されるのみ。越境感染が確認されているため、隣接国への拡大リスクは極めて高いが、記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ発生。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン未承認、女性が60%以上を占める疑似症例、医療従事者への深刻なPPE不足、1.5百万人が初期医療へのアクセスを喪失、予算削減による対応能力の低下など複合的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: 17歲長期病患少年染乙型流感 情況危殆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seventeen-year-old chronically ill boy infected with influenza B in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: A 17-year-old boy with chronic illness in Hong Kong is in critical condition after contracting influenza B. He is hospitalized in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at United Christian Hospital. He first developed fever, vomiting and a seizure last Wednesday and was treated at Tseung Kwan O Hospital; his condition gradually improved but by this Wednesday he again spiked fever and developed a coughing blood-tinged sputum. The following day, due to hypoxemia, he was transferred for further care and tested positive for influenza B with severe pneumonia and shock. He had not received the seasonal influenza vaccine. There was no travel or school exposure; his close contacts are asymptomatic. The Centre for Health Protection notes influenza activity in Hong Kong has risen in recent weeks; with about half a year since the last season, some previously uninfected residents remain, and activity could rise further.

triage.headline_ja: 17歳の慢性疾患患者の少年がインフルエンザBに感染し重篤な状態
triage.triage_reason: 香港でインフルエンザB単一事例の重症化報告だが、IHR基準2以上該当する広域的公衆衛生影響は未確認。ただし重症度基準に該当し、地域内での流行活動上昇が報告されており、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での単一患者の重症事例報告。記事では患者が重篤（PICU入院、低酸素血症、ショック、重症肺炎）であり重症度基準に該当。香港での流行活動上昇が記載されており流行性基準に該当するが、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響の証拠はない。香港は中国の特別行政区のため China (1814991) として分類。ワクチン接種がない背景も注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, scatta il piano d'emergenza: stanziati 518 milioni di dollari | HealthDesk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the emergency plan kicks in: 518 million dollars allocated | HealthDesk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo variant, prompts Africa CDC and the World Health Organization to launch a six-month continental preparedness and response plan (June–November 2026) with a $518 million target to support African countries and partners in contact tracing, rapid detection, and containment. The strategy strengthens cross-border surveillance, laboratory capacity, and protection of vulnerable populations, uniting governments, communities, and organizations under the leadership of affected nations. The Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are the current hotspots, with ten priority countries identified for intensified entry-point controls and public monitoring. No vaccines or therapies specifically approved for Bundibugyo yet, heightening reliance on non-pharmaceutical measures. Success depends on political commitment, sustained funding, and community engagement; lacking trust, tracing and safe care falter. Operations are already accelerating in the DRC to deliver a rapid, coordinated response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、緊急計画が始動：5億1,800万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ（ブンディブギョ変異株）の多国間流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダが現在のホットスポットとして明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。アフリカCDCとWHOが6ヶ月間の対応計画を立案し、5億1,800万ドルの資金配分が決定されている。ブンディブギョ変異株向けの承認済みワクチンや治療法がないため、非医学的対策に依存している。10の優先国が集中的な国境管理対象として特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura amplia chamado para vacinação diante do aumento de casos de influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall expands vaccination drive amid rise in influenza cases.
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, Brazil, expands influenza vaccination drive as cases rise. Updated data as of June 3 show routine vaccination coverage at 33.45%, with 26.81% among children 6 months to under 6 years, 36.02% among adults 60+, and 45.26% among pregnant women—far below the 95% target. Influenza cases increased from 621 in 2025 to 1,574 in 2026 (153.46% rise), with 2,034 total notifications this year and 828 in the 0–6 years age group, the most affected. Vaccination is the main tool to reduce complications, with 72 Family Health Units (USFs) offering vaccines citywide, some with extended hours. Priority groups include children 6 months–<6 years, pregnant women, elderly 60+, postpartum women, people with chronic diseases, disabled, health workers, teachers, security forces, truck drivers, public transport workers, and incarcerated individuals. Influenza causes fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue and may lead to severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者増加に対応してクイアバ市がワクチン接種キャンペーンを拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザ症例の著しい増加（153.46%）と予防接種率の低さが報告されているが、国際的拡大リスクや国家の対応能力に関する情報が不足しており、さらなる情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で、ブラジルのマット・グロッソ州クイアバ市における2026年のインフルエンザ患者数の急増（前年比153.46%）と、それに対応した市当局のワクチン接種キャンペーン拡大について報告している。ただし、死亡数や入院数などの重症度の詳細が不明であり、また国際的な拡大リスクについての記載がない。市当局による対応が報告されているため、現段階では経過観察が適切である。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola acumula 397 casos y 63 muertes confirmadas en...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has reached 397 cases and 63 confirmed deaths in....
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has totaled 397 cases and 63 confirmed deaths (case fatality rate 15.9%). In DRC, 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths have been reported, with 4,341 contacts; in Uganda, 16 confirmed cases and 1 death, with 668 contacts. Health workers on the ground include 34 infections and 6 deaths. The epicenter remains Ituri Province in the DRC, which accounts for more than 90% of cases and about 70% of deaths. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 16. Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya, speaking with WHO, presented a continental preparedness and response plan. Eleven countries are at risk. This is described as the most severe Bundibugyo outbreak yet in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が397例、確定死亡63例に達する（コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダ）
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当する。PHEIC宣言済みの重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、直ちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（GeoNames ID 203312）のみであるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既にPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月16日）であり、Africa CDCとWHOが関与している最高レベルの危機対応状況。

article.articleHeadline: बांग्लादेश में खसरा मचा रहा है उधम, 650 बच्चे मरे, क्या भारत को भी है खतरा, जानें उपाय
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak of measles is wreaking havoc in Bangladesh; 650 children have died; Is India also at risk? Learn the measures.
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh is grappling with a measles outbreak that has caused 601 child deaths and more than 74,500 suspected cases since January–March 2026, with over 60,000 hospitalizations. The outbreak has spread to all eight divisions and 58 of 64 districts. WHO warns cross-border transmission to India and Myanmar is possible, given Bangladesh’s 4,097 km border with India. The most affected are children under five, especially those under two who are unvaccinated. Measles, here described as caused by rubella virus and transmitted by airborne droplets and contaminated surfaces, typically appears 7–14 days after exposure with fever up to 105°F, dry cough, runny nose, red eyes, Koplik spots, and a face/neck rash that spreads to the body. There is no specific treatment; vaccination is the preventive measure. India has herd immunity through routine immunization (Indradhanush); the immediate risk is low, though border areas may see isolated cases.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで麻疹が大流行、650人の子どもが死亡、インドも危険にさらされているか、対策を知る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：601人死亡・74,500症例、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国（バングラデシュは対象外だが、インド・ミャンマーへの国際的波及リスク明記）。
triage.notes: バングラデシュが発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。ただしインド・ミャンマーへの国際的波及リスクが明記されており、これら対象国が直接的な脅威にさらされているため、シグナルとしてPICKUPの判定。601人の死亡、74,500症例という大規模流行、5歳未満特に2歳未満の未接種児が最も影響を受けている点が重大。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Cuáles son las tres vacunas candidatas para frenar el brote de ébola y cómo funcionan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the three candidate vaccines to curb the Ebola outbreak and how they work.
article.articleSummary: DRC and Uganda face Ebola Bundibugyo outbreaks. The DRC reports 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths, with 116 suspected under investigation; Uganda has 16 cases and 1 death. The WHO-designated Public Health Emergency of International Concern marks this as one of the three largest filovirus outbreaks, with nearly 1,000 suspected cases. No licensed vaccines exist for Bundibugyo, so CEPI is accelerating three experimental candidates: IAVI’s rVSV-based vaccine, using material from the University of Texas; Moderna’s mRNA vaccine, with up to $50 million for preclinical and Phase 1 and potential Phase 2/3 scale-up; and a University of Oxford/Serum Institute of India candidate using the ChAdOx1 platform, with up to $8.6 million for preclinical and Phase 1. Serum Institute will manufacture. Selection followed global reviews and consultations with WHO, CDC Africa, ANRS-MIE, Gavi, and affected countries, plus an open call for other candidates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行を抑制するための3つの候補ワクチンとその機能は何か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種）はWHO指定の国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり、DRCとウガンダで大規模流行が発生している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ（Bundibugyo）の主流行地はDRCとウガンダ。インドはSerum Institute of Indiaがワクチン候補の製造パートナーとして言及されているため対象国リストに含める。テキサス/米国は大学の研究施設であり、実際の流行地ではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 340 tonnes de médicaments et intrants de riposte dotées aux provinces touchées - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 340 tonnes of medicines and response inputs allocated to the affected provinces - ACP
article.articleSummary: 340 tonnes of Ebola medicines and response inputs have been allocated to Ituri and North Kivu in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster the outbreak response. The supply, part of the Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience (HEPRR) project, is financed by the World Bank and implemented through the Health System Development Program Management Unit (UG-PDSS). It aims to strengthen care for Ebola patients, support health facilities engaged in the response, and enhance the operational capacity of deployed teams, prioritizing the most affected areas and neighboring zones at risk of spread. Distribution is coordinated by the Incident Management System (SGI) logistics established by the National Public Health Institute (INSP) in collaboration with the provincial health division pharmacist. The allocation should sustain essential health services, improve coordination, surveillance, and preventive measures around active foci, and demonstrate government and World Bank commitment to faster, more effective response and reduced mortality in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：340トンの医薬品と対応物資が被害地域に配分される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生脅威だが、記事の主要内容は医薬品・物資配分の対応措置であり、新規発生の詳細（患者数、死亡数、流行動向）が明記されていない。IHR基準2つ以上の判断材料が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱のコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州およびNorth Kivu州での継続的な流行に対する国際的対応措置（世界銀行による支援）について報じている。ただし、現在の患者数、死亡数、感染動向などの疫学情報が欠けており、シグナルの重要度を確定するにはフルRRAが必要。持続的な曝露と流行リスクが高いため継続監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 34 helsearbeidere smittet av ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 34 healthcare workers infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, 34 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola in the current outbreak, with 7 deaths and 6 recoveries. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC launched a joint plan for June–November to contain the outbreak, costing $518 million, focusing on emergency coordination, surveillance, lab testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, confirmed Ebola cases reached 381 with 62 deaths. In Uganda, another Ebola death brings total to 2, with three additional confirmed infections. Ebola spreads via body fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo variant, noted for high transmissibility and lack of an approved vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 34名の医療従事者がエボラ感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国家発生で、医療従事者への感染、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン未承認型の流行があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な危機を示す。
triage.notes: DRCで381例の確認症例・62名死亡、ウガンダで2名死亡・3名追加感染。Bundibugyo変異株関与、未承認ワクチン。WHO・Africa CDCが6月～11月の遏制計画（5.18億ドル）を発表。医療従事者へのリスク顕著。対象国リストではUgandaは記載なし（1269750は当初リスト外）だが、記事サマリー主題はDRC・Uganda両国のイベントであり、DRCは明確な対象国（203312）。ウガンダはWPRO地域内のプライオリティ国として准包含。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Espagne débloque 1,2 million d'euros pour soutenir la RDC et la région
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Spain unlocks 1.2 million euros to support the DRC and the region.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Spain via AECID commits 1.2 million euros to bolster Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and surrounding Great Lakes region. The funds support the outbreak response to Bundibugyo Ebola strain, a rare variant with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Authorities in the DRC, with WHO and international partners, are intensifying surveillance, diagnostics, patient care, and contact tracing to curb transmission. Spain's contribution aims to strengthen field health teams, improve infection prevention, and back urgent interventions in the most affected zones. The mobilization accompanies other European financing and logistical support for the RDC response, reflecting heightened international concern. Rapid deployment of resources and active community engagement are deemed critical to halt transmission and prevent regional escalation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：スペイン、コンゴ民主共和国と地域支援のため120万ユーロを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）のアウトブレイク、DRCから周辺大湖沼地域への拡大リスク、国際的な資金投入と支援体制の確立により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（希少株、ワクチンなし）のアウトブレイク。DRCの東部および大湖沼地域での継続的な曝露リスク。スペイン含む複数のヨーロッパ諸国から国際的支援が動員されており、高い懸念水準を反映。地域エスカレーション防止が重要課題として強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO announces $518 million six-month plan to fight Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, the WHO Director-General Tedros announced a $518 million six-month plan (June–November 2026) to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, targeting the Bundibugyo strain detected in Bunia, Ituri province. The outbreak, Congo’s 17th Ebola event and among the largest on record, has reached 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths, with Africa CDC warning that authorities are behind the curve. The plan, developed with Africa CDC, emphasizes political commitment, sustained financing, and community engagement to halt transmission. Donors have pledged about $315.8 million of a previously targeted $498 million; allocation details to the plan remain unclear. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola, making this outbreak particularly challenging.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱との戦いに向けた6ヶ月間で5億1,800万ドル計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」（死亡・重症者多数）と「異常/予想外か」（Bundibugyo株、治療法・ワクチン未承認）の2つに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で複数該当。国際的な関心も高く、フルRRA評価が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱。治療法・ワクチン未承認で管理が困難。DRC 17番目のエボライベントで過去最大規模の一つ。確認患者381人、死亡62人。WHOとAfrica CDCが共同で対応計画を策定。国際的な支援必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Trócaire launches emergency appeal amid escalating Ebola outbreak in DRC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with cross-border spread into Uganda; as of 5 June 2026, there is no approved vaccine or specific cure, making prevention, public health measures, and community trust critical to containment. The outbreak center is Ituri Province, where Trócaire is active; last year its programmes reached more than 66,000 people in communities now affected by Ebola. Trócaire has launched an emergency appeal to support Ebola-affected and crisis-affected communities in DRC and the wider region, working with trusted local partners to slow transmission and assist families amid ongoing conflict and displacement. CEO Sean Farrell stresses that reduced international aid weakens health systems and urges immediate action to prevent deepening crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大が懸念される中、トロケアが緊急アピールを開始（DRC）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当する高リスク案件。フルRRA進行は必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主題であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株の流行でワクチン・特効薬がない状況下での危機的拡大。紛争・避難民問題との複合危機要因あり。国際援助削減による保健システム弱化懸念も付加。

article.articleHeadline: Tests rule out canine distemper, Babesia in recent Gir lion deaths: Gujarat min
article.articleSummary: Eight Asiatic lions died in Gujarat's Gir landscape between May 22 and May 27, including six cubs. Laboratory tests at GBRC ruled out canine distemper virus (CDV) and Babesia as causes, with officials noting no evidence of a 2018-like outbreak. Deaths are attributed to seasonal stress, dehydration, and natural causes; one death due to miscarriage, another from injuries in infighting, and cub mortality exceeding 50% linked to hydration deficits. There is no current recommendation to vaccinate free-ranging lions; a vaccine exists but experts advised against wild use. Twelve of 17 quarantined lions have recovered and been released, with others monitored. The 2018 outbreak, which killed 24 lions and prompted vaccine programs, is not echoed in this cluster. Gujarat's Asiatic lion population was 891 in the 2025 count; no clustering of deaths like 2018 is observed.

triage.headline_ja: ギル・ライオンの最近の死亡事例でジステンパー、バベシア症が除外：グジャラート州当局
triage.triage_reason: バベシア症は動物（ライオン）の自然死の調査事例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、人間への感染リスク、国際的拡大の可能性は認められない。検査により主要な感染症原因は既に除外されている。
triage.notes: 本件はアジアライオンの自然死の動物疫学調査であり、人間への感染リスクやパンデミック懸念を示す要素はない。バベシア症は検査によって除外されており、死因は季節的ストレス、脱水、自然原因と結論づけられている。野生動物の個別死亡事例のため公衆衛生上の危機的状況ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya to receive KSh647M as Africa CDC, WHO launch joint Ebola continental preparedness & response plan - TV47 Digital
article.articleSummary: Kenya will receive KSh647 million as Africa CDC and WHO launch a six-month continental Ebola preparedness and response plan for the Bundibugyo virus outbreak, running June 2026 through November 2026. The plan aims to raise US$518 million with partners to help African countries rapidly detect and respond, under a unified 'One Response' approach. It covers emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics and essential health services, with a focus on protecting vulnerable populations and cross-border collaboration. WHO Director-General Tedros emphasizes political commitment, sustained financing, and community participation. Kenya is among 10 African countries designated at high risk in Preparedness Phase; DR Congo and Uganda are in the Response Phase. No licensed vaccines or therapeutics exist for Bundibugyo Ebola. Implementation is already underway, with continued attention to mpox, cholera and measles.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがアフリカCDCとWHOによる共同エボラ大陸規模準備・対応計画の実施により6億4,700万ケニアシリングを受け取る
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak対応の大陸規模な準備・対応計画が開始されており、複数の重大感染症（Ebola、Mpox、Cholera、Measles）が同時に対象となっている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、さらにWPRO基準で重症度・管理可能性が該当し、政府間・国際機関の関心が明示されている。
triage.notes: ケニアについてはPreparedness Phaseの10カ国の一つとして言及されているが、サマリーの主題となっている実際のEbola outbreak（Bundibugyo virus）はDR CongoおよびUgandaのResponse Phaseで発生しており、これらの2カ国が verified_locations に含まれる。複数の感染症が同時に対象とされ、ワクチンおよび治療法がない状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 34 helsearbeidere smittet av ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 34 healthcare workers infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, 34 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola in this outbreak; seven have died and six recovered, according to a WHO spokesperson. On the same day, WHO and the African Union’s Africa CDC launched a joint plan (June–November) to fight the outbreak, with a budget of $518 million, targeting emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, confirmed Ebola cases rose to 381, with 62 deaths. Uganda reports another death, bringing total fatalities there to two, with three additional infections confirmed. Ebola spreads via bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo virus variant, regarded as serious because it is highly contagious and there is no approved vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 34名の医療従事者がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認感染者増加（DRC 381例、ウガンダ 3例）、医療従事者への感染拡大、死亡例の報告、Bundibugyo変異株の関与。IHR基準4項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。記事サマリーから、医療従事者感染34名、DRC確認患者381名・死亡62名、ウガンダで死亡2名・追加感染3名の報告あり。WHO・アフリカCDC合同計画（予算5億1,800万ドル）の立案が明記されており、国際的な対応が既に展開されている。Bundibugyo変異株の高い感染性と有効なワクチンの不在が重症度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Has A $580 Million, 6-Month Plan To Fight Ebola (Live Updates)
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, the World Health Organization unveiled a six-month Ebola response plan valued at about $518 million to curb the outbreak in central Africa, prioritizing emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, clinical care, community engagement, and sustaining essential health services. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, WHO tallies 321 confirmed Ebola cases and 116 suspected; at least 48 deaths and 6 recoveries. Uganda reports 15 total cases with 1 death; 668 contacts traced. The Bundibugyo variant remains without an approved vaccine or treatment, though early healthcare seeking improves survival. The plan coincides with actions in Kenya and by the United States around quarantine facilities and airport screening; CEPI funding for Ebola vaccine development (Moderna, Oxford, IAVI) was announced; a Congo traveler to Italy tested negative. By May 29 Congo reported the first recovery of a confirmed case.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱対策に5億8000万ドル、6ヶ月計画を発表（ライブアップデート）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認感染者321名、死亡48名以上という深刻な影響、複数国への拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・ケニア）、国際的な対応の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCを中心とした中央アフリカのエボラ出血熱の発生。ウガンダも関連記述があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ケニアも記載があるが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。イタリア・米国への言及は検査結果（陰性）の報告のみであり、実際の発生地域ではない。Bundibugyo亜種によるアウトブレイク、ワクチン未承認という公衆衛生上の懸念が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plan de 518 millions de l'OMS et l'Agence de santé africaine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO and the African Health Agency's 518-million plan
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC unveiled a $518 million six-month plan to confront Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of 2026-06-05, Africa CDC reported 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 63 deaths in the DRC, and 16 infections with 1 death in Uganda; 116 suspected cases remain. The plan funds emergency management, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement, supplementing national responses. It aims to protect vulnerable populations, bolster international collaboration, and enable rapid responses to new cases; health systems will be strengthened in ten countries where vaccines or medicines for this Ebola strain are not yet available. A funding tracking mechanism accompanies the effort, with authorities emphasizing joint leadership by states and communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOとアフリカ保健機関による5億1800万ドル規模の計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてが該当。確認済み死亡例を含む現在進行中の多国間エボラ感染症発生イベントであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダの両国でのエボラ発生が報告されているが、Uganda（共和国）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの発生は確実であり対象国に該当。現在進行中の感染症イベント（発表日2026-06-05時点で確認381例、死亡63例）であり、国際的な公衆衛生対応が活発に展開されている状況を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 罕見伊波拉病毒肆虐非洲！世衛攜手非盟斥資168億啟動抗疫計畫 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare Ebola Virus Ravages Africa! WHO Teams Up with the African Union to Allocate 16.8 Billion to Launch an Outbreak Response Plan.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization and the African Union announced a $518 million, six-month emergency response plan (June–November) to address a rare Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries. In DRC’s Ituri Province, the outbreak began mid-May, with 381 laboratory-confirmed cases and 64 deaths; Uganda reports 16 confirmed cases and 1 death, signaling cross-border spread. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. The plan emphasizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. Africa CDC notes the outbreak’s scale surpasses the 2007 and 2012 Bundibugyo outbreaks. Ituri accounts for about 90% of confirmed cases, making it the epicenter of the current crisis.

triage.headline_ja: 稀なエボラウイルスがアフリカを襲う！WHOがアフリカ連合と協力して168億を投じて防疫計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、稀な病原体、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク疾患。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダは「隣国での確認」として言及されている。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo Ebola は治療法とワクチンが現在利用不可であり、過去の同一病原体によるアウトブレイク（2007年、2012年）を超える規模とされている。

article.articleHeadline: В Африке зафиксировали почти 400 случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Africa, nearly 400 cases of Ebola virus disease have been recorded.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, the African Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported 397 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 63 deaths across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In the DRC, 381 infections and 62 deaths; in Uganda, 16 cases and 1 death. The outbreak is described as the fourth most severe observed, with over 10,000 contacts traced (4,341 in the DRC and 5,009 in Uganda). A joint Plan for readiness and response to Bundibugyo virus disease was presented by WHO and Africa CDC. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said US$580 million is needed to implement all planned activities, prioritizing rapid diagnostics, immediate outbreak response, community engagement, continued basic healthcare, protection for frontline workers, and cross-border barrier measures to limit spread. WHO had previously classified the situation as an emergency potentially dangerous to third countries, with regional risk remaining high.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ熱の感染者がほぼ400例確認された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（397確認症例、63死亡）により、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として認識されている。WHO事務局長による高額な国際支援要求と地域リスク判定が社会的・政治的関心の高さを示している。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めていない。DRCのみを対象国として識別。記事では「Bundibugyo virus disease」への言及があるが、主要な報告内容はエボラウイルス病。WHO による PHEIC 相当の判定、US$580百万の国際支援要求、および10,000名以上の接触者追跡が実施されている大規模流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola concerns dent Uganda bookings
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 2026-06-05, continues to affect Uganda's gorilla tourism sector despite officials saying the outbreak is under control and key destinations remain unaffected. Bwindi Impenetrable National Park and Mgahinga Gorilla National Park drive revenue from gorilla trekking; 41,468 gorilla permits were sold in 2024, up 6.8% from 2023. Travel advisories have caused cancellations and postponements ahead of the June–August peak season. Industry voices report hesitation among international operators, though Ugandan venues report no transmission linked to foreign visitors. Authorities say the outbreak's local impact is limited; only a Congolese national fatality; all other confirmed cases monitored and treated, with infections mainly among people exposed to the DRC or cross-border communities. No Ugandan cases traced to tourists; public health response remains robust with surveillance and contact tracing; Uganda hosted international buyers during the Pearl of Africa Tourism Expo without incident.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念によるウガンダのゴリラツーリズムへの打撃
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラアウトブレイクがウガンダに影響を与えており、国際的拡大のリスク（IHR基準3該当）、異常性（WPROスクリーニング基準1該当）、および渡航制限と観光業への影響（IHR基準4該当）が認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC由来のエボラアウトブレイクがウガンダに拡大している状況を報告。ウガンダではゴリラツーリズムが影響を受け、国際的な渡航キャンセルが発生している。DRCとウガンダは越境感染リスク地域であり、対象国リストに含まれるため両国とも verified_locations に含める。アウトブレイク規模は限定的（DRC国民1名死亡、その他ケースは監視下）と報告されているが、国際的な関心と渡航・貿易への影響があることから PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS y agencia de salud africana lanzan plan de $518 millones para combatir brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and African health agency launch $518 million plan to combat Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launch a $518 million plan to tackle the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, running from June to November 2026. The response targets emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community mobilization. The outbreak, declared May 15 in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, involves the Bundibugyo Ebola strain and is the largest Bundibugyo episode on record, surpassing 2007 and 2012 events. As of 2026-06-05, the DRC reports 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths across three provinces, with the epicenter in Ituri, accounting for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. Across the border in Uganda, 16 cases have been confirmed, including one death. The plan seeks to contain transmission and reduce cross-border spread through coordinated international public health action by WHO and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカ保健機関がエボラ出血熱流行対策に5億1800万ドルの計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的流行で、IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。DRC及びウガンダでの確認例、死亡報告があり、WHO・Africa CDCによる大規模対応計画が発動されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaも列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主たる発生地で、ウガンダは国境を越えた散発例（16例、1死亡）の報告に過ぎない。対象国リストにUgandaが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo株による過去最大規模の流行。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا: وفاة شخص وإصابة 3 آخرين بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: One person dies and three others are infected with Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Uganda reports 19 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases. One death was recorded today and three additional infections were reported, all among contacts under quarantine of previously confirmed cases. A Congolese national died, raising the death toll to two, while four patients have recovered and been discharged from hospital. The updates come from Uganda's Ministry of Health, announced via its X account. The report confirms ongoing activity within the Uganda Ebola outbreak and underscores the role of quarantine and contact tracing in containment. No further details on exposure sources, vaccination status, or specific case locations were provided in the brief.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラウイルスで1人死亡、3人が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当し、WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。エボラウイルスは重篤な感染症で国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (not in target list, but DRC is)

triage.notes: エボラウイルスは国際的に非常に高い関心を持つ病原体。記事ではウガンダの事例が主題だが、DRC国籍者の死亡が記載されており、地域的な感染拡大が示唆される。現地時間2026年6月5日現在でウガンダ19確定症例、2死亡、4人回復報告。公式情報源はウガンダ保健省によるX（旧Twitter）発表。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないが、DRCの感染症イベント関連情報として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly Cheese-Linked Outbreak; 15 Med Schools Probed; 'Concern' on FDA Voucher Pilot
article.articleSummary: Listeria monocytogenes outbreak linked to soft ricotta/requeson cheese sold in Maryland, New York, and Virginia has hospitalized seven people and caused one death in a multi-year outbreak. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC plan to raise over $500 million for Ebola outbreak response, while the U.S. HHS says Americans exposed to Ebola will have access to MBP-134, Mapp Biopharmaceuticals’ investigational antibody shown to be promising in animal studies. In Congo, an Ebola burial team was attacked by residents, forcing it to abandon the coffin and raising fears of transmission. The rare Borrelia mayonii Lyme disease type, previously found only in the Midwest, has been detected in New York. Experts expressed deep concern at the FDA’s first public meeting about the Commissioner's National Priority Voucher pilot program.

triage.headline_ja: チーズ関連の致死的なアウトブレイク; 医学部15校が調査対象に; FDA割当パイロットについて「懸念」
triage.triage_reason: リステリアによる多州にわたる食品関連アウトブレイク（死亡1例、入院7例）、およびコンゴでのエボラ出血熱に関する国際対応情報が同時に報告されており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外性）2つ以上に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数の独立したイベント（米国のリステリア・ライム病アウトブレイク、コンゴのエボラ対応）を混合している。対象国リストに該当するのはコンゴ（DRC）のエボラのみ。米国のイベント（Maryland、New York、Virginia）は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。コンゴでのエボラ埋葬チーム攻撃と国際的な資金調達（WHO・Africa CDC）は国際的懸念を示唆しており、シグナル認識の根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: ভারতে ইবোলার হানা! জয়পুরে উগান্ডার পর্যটকের শরীরে সংক্রমণের লক্ষণ ঘিরে চর্চা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola strikes India! In Jaipur, debate over the signs of infection in an Ugandan tourist's body.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is suspected in India after a 19-year-old Ugandan tourist was isolated in Jaipur. The traveler, who arrived from Sharjah by Air Arabia, presented symptoms of abdominal pain, reduced appetite, and headaches, prompting airport screening and immediate isolation. Her samples were sent to a Pune laboratory, with a second set to be collected after 48 hours; confirmation will depend on test results. If positive, she would be quarantined for 21 days and treated accordingly. Africa remains the source region, leading to intensified screening for travelers returning from Africa and a special alert at Dum Dum Airport. WHO guidelines have been issued, and Health Secretary Punyasila Srivastav has disseminated advisories to states, including a self-declaration requirement for arrivals from Africa.

triage.headline_ja: インドでエボラ流行！ジャイプールでウガンダ人観光客の感染疑い
triage.triage_reason: エボラの国際的な感染疑い事例であり、IHR基準で深刻性（Yes）、異常性（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）の3つが該当。対象国インド内での確認事例として、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのジャイプールでウガンダ人観光客にエボラ疑い症状が検出された事例を報じている。ウガンダはアフリカ地域であり非対象国だが、患者が到達した検査・隔離地点はインド（対象国）であるため検証される。検査は進行中で未確定だが、疑い事例の段階で既に WHO ガイドライン発出、空港スクリーニング強化、複数州への保健通知等の対応が取られている。エボラ確定の場合、地域的リスク が大幅に上昇する。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique : Face à l'épidémie d'Ebola Bundibugyo, l'OMS et Africa CDC s'unissent sous une approche "Une seule riposte"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Facing the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, WHO and Africa CDC join forces under a 'One Unified Response' approach.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda prompts Africa CDC and the WHO to launch a six‑month continental plan (June–November 2026) mobilizing $518 million under a 'One Unified Response' (One Response). The strategy unites governments, partners and communities to coordinate emergency response, epidemiological surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, logistics, and continuity of essential health services. It supplements national response efforts already under way in DRC and Uganda. With no vaccine or treatment approved specifically for the Bundibugyo variant, the plan emphasizes health-system strengthening to bolster resilience against acute outbreaks. Ten priority countries will reinforce entry-point controls and cross‑border coordination while maintaining responses to mpox, cholera and measles.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：ブンディブギョエボラ流行に直面し、WHOとアフリカCDCが「ワンユニファイドレスポンス」アプローチの下で力を合わせる
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola多国outbreak（DRC・ウガンダ）、重度の病原体、国際対応の公式発動、$518百万の大規模対応資金、IHR基準4つ全て該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事はDRCにおけるBundibugyo Ebola outbreak（mpox、コレラ、麻疹との同時対応）を主題としており、WHOおよびAfrica CDCによる大規模な公式対応（6ヶ月間、$518百万）が確認される。ワクチンや治療法未承認のため重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Putin Mandates COVID, Flu Tests for Attendees at Economic Forum
article.articleSummary: Attendees and journalists seeking access to Friday's plenary at the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF) were required to undergo testing for COVID-19, influenza and other respiratory diseases. Negative results from laboratories accredited by the forum granted special entry passes, with PCR screening employed on samples from the nose or throat. The measure accompanies Putin's expected appearance alongside Chinese Vice President Han Zheng, Tanzanian President Samia Suluhu Hassan and Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev. The article notes that strict health protocols endured long after the pandemic, recalling February 2022 when then-Chancellor Olaf Scholz visited Moscow under unusual distancing. SPIEF remains a flagship event for Russia's wartime economy, though Western participation has waned due to sanctions. A US delegation led by Rodney Mims Cook is visiting SPIEF 2026 to discuss cultural ties amid the broader East–West dynamic surrounding Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

triage.headline_ja: プーチン大統領、経済フォーラム参加者へのCOVID、インフルエンザ検査を義務化
triage.triage_reason: 発生地域が対象国に含まれず（ロシアは評価対象外）、新規感染症クラスターや異常な流行の報告ではなく、単なる既知疾患に対するイベント入場時の検査措置である。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はセントピータースブルク国際経済フォーラムにおけるプーチン大統領によるイベント入場管理措置を報じており、既知のCOVID-19およびインフルエンザに対する通常の検査要件である。新規アウトブレイク、異常な疫学的パターン、重大な健康影響の報告はない。China は記事で中国副主席の参加が言及されているため verified_locations に含めたが、感染症の実際の発生地ではない。対象国ではないロシアが主たる発生地である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO announces $518 million six-month plan to fight Ebola By Reuters
article.articleSummary: June 5, 2026 — The World Health Organization unveiled a six-month, $518 million plan (June–November 2026) to curb the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Congo, the fourth largest on record. Africa CDC reports 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 62 deaths to date. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine, underpins Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak and triggered a PHEIC declaration. The plan emphasizes political commitment, sustained financing, and community trust as essential to halt transmission, noting the outbreak had persisted for weeks undetected and is now moving rapidly. Donors have pledged about $315.8 million, well below an original $498 million figure, with unclear allocation toward the six-month strategy. WHO and Africa CDC are coordinating the response amid ongoing containment challenges.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱対策に6カ月間で5億1,800万ドルの計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギオ株）のコンゴでの大規模流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO PHEICが既に宣言されており、死亡者を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが明白。
triage.notes: ブンディブギオ株エボラ出血熱の大型流行。PHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）が既に宣言されている。確認症例381例、死亡者62例。現地での治療法・ワクチンなし。記事では資金調達の課題（315.8百万米ドル/498百万米ドル目標）も言及されており、対応能力の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Expert Fears Outbreak Is Heading Into "Nightmare Scenario
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the third-largest on record, with over 1,000 reported cases and 233 confirmed deaths as of 2026-06-05. Experts warn the outbreak may have begun earlier than believed, leaving hundreds more infected undetected. Emergency physician Simon Mardel warns of 'unrecognized chains of transmission' and notes that once they reach 100 confirmed cases, roughly 2,000 close contacts require tracing and monitoring. Contact-tracing is lagging as cases spill across borders into Uganda. The worst-case scenario is Ebola reaching Nigeria, Africa’s most populous nation; the 2014 outbreak eventually killed 11,325 people. The true scope remains uncertain amid major funding cuts to global health programs that have sidelined experienced field staff. Data suggests mortality timing can be five days after infection, with some markers at three days, underscoring the urgency of comprehensive containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ専門家、アウトブレイクが「悪夢シナリオ」に向かうことを懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、複数国で確認される大規模エボラアウトブレイク。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、管理可能性の懸念が大きい。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにUgandaとNigeriaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダに国境を越えて患者が流出」「ナイジェリアに到達することが最悪シナリオ」と記述されており、Ugandaは既に患者流出が確認、Nigeriaはリスク評価段階の記述である。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが確認患者数と死亡数で実際の進行中アウトブレイクを示しているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。資金削減による重大な管理能力低下が指摘されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: África activa un plan de respuesta continental contra el ébola...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa Activates a Continent-Wide Response Plan Against Ebola....
article.articleSummary: African CDC and the World Health Organization activated a continental Ebola response plan to tackle the worst outbreak in recent history, anchored in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and extending to Uganda. As of June 5, 2026, 65 deaths and 397 confirmed cases have been reported, the vast majority in DRC. The six-month plan through November 2026 seeks about €450 million for preparedness, rapid detection, and outbreak response, amid security challenges in northern DRC and ongoing population displacement. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine, is beginning to affect health workers, with at least seven healthcare worker deaths and 34 confirmed health worker cases within the overall balance. The strategy prioritizes protecting vulnerable populations, strengthening cross-border collaboration, and deploying intensified measures in ten priority countries to improve emergency preparedness and enable early detection and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ、エボラ熱に対する大陸規模対応計画を発動...確認症例数と死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で死亡事例・医療従事者への感染が発生しており、国際的な対応計画が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「DRCを中心に拡大」と記述されており、ウガンダでの確定症例は明記されていない。したがってverified_locationsに含めない。Bundibugyo株はワクチンがなく、医療従事者への感染が既に報告されている点が極めて懸念される。アフリカCDCおよびWHOが既に大陸規模の対応計画を発動し、€450百万の資金投入が計画されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare: Suspected cases reported in Hyderabad and Jaipur; patients isolated, test results awaited
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, authorities report suspected Ebola cases in India. In Hyderabad, Telangana, two Sudanese nationals are admitted to Gandhi Hospital with fever; a 35-year-old who arrived from abroad for knee surgery and a Sudanese student in his 20s. Both are isolated and awaiting laboratory results. Telangana has set up a 10-bed Ebola isolation ward at Gandhi Hospital, with Hyderabad Airport implementing enhanced public health measures for travelers from affected regions (Uganda, DRC). In Rajasthan, Jaipur’s RUHS Hospital has admitted a 19-year-old Ugandan woman who arrived from Sharjah; she is isolated in a critical care block. A sample is sent to Pune, with a second sample due after 48 hours; quarantine will continue if positive, up to 21 days. Ebola cannot be diagnosed on symptoms alone, per official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの脅威：ハイデラバードとジャイプールで疑い例が報告；患者は隔離中、検査結果待機中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラは高い公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを持つ疑い例。複数州での同時報告と国際的なリンク（スーダン国籍者、ウガンダ国籍者）から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い例は2つの州で報告：テランガナ州（ハイデラバード）とラジャスタン州（ジャイプール）。患者は国際的背景を持つ（スーダン国籍者、ウガンダ国籍者）。発生地域フィールドにはUAE（シャルジャ）も含まれるが、記事サマリーではインドが主要な疫学的関心事であり、シャルジャは患者の経由地として記載されている。複数の高度隔離病棟設置と空港での強化対策が実施済み。診断は検査室確認待機中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert in Hyderabad: Two Suspected Cases at Gandhi Hospital, Sudan National Under Observation
article.articleSummary: Two suspected Ebola cases under observation at Gandhi Hospital, Hyderabad, as of 2026-06-05. Mohammed Yagouch Ahmed, 36, a Sudanese national who arrived from Sudan and studies in Ahmednagar, is in a dedicated isolation ward after Shamshabad Airport screening flagged suspected Ebola symptoms; a second person who had close contact is also under medical observation. Ahmed’s blood samples have been sent to CCMB Hyderabad for testing and will be forwarded to NIV Pune, with final results expected within one week. A 20-bed isolation ward has been prepared at Gandhi Hospital. Airport screening has been tightened for travelers from abroad. Symptoms to watch include fever, severe fatigue, and bleeding. No infection has been confirmed yet; authorities continue close monitoring amid ongoing Ebola spread concerns in a Central African country.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード警戒：ガンジー病院で疑い事例2件、スーダン国籍者が観察中
triage.triage_reason: Ebola疑い事例の検出により異常性が高く、IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。スーダンからの輸入事例であり国際的懸念あり。ただし現時点で確認症例なし。
triage.notes: スーダムからの輸入事例であるものの、IHR基準3つ該当。Ebol疑い事例の検出自体が深刻（高い致死率）。確認症例はまだであるが、空港検疫の強化、隔離病棟準備など当局の対応は進行中。フルRRA優先度：高。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Sorge vor Ebola-Ausbreitung in Goma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo: Concern about the spread of Ebola in Goma.
article.articleSummary: Ebola concerns in Goma, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid ongoing conflict and health crises. As of 2026-06-05, there are no officially registered active Ebola cases in Goma, but nationwide the DRC has 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country and the first large outbreak in years. Access is hindered by M23 rebel control over parts of the region, complicating containment as population movements challenge contact tracing; the health system is at risk of collapse due to shortages. Preventive measures are being expanded in schools: chlorine handwashing stations, temperature checks, and outreach campaigns led by VIS (Volontariato Internazionale per lo Sviluppo) in collaboration with the Salesians Don Bosco. VIS also funds an ambulance for basic medical care, nutrition programs, and meals for about 300 children, prioritizing information drives for families, teachers, and communities, with funding from the Italian Bishops’ Conference.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：ゴマでのエボラ拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC全体で344確認症例・60死亡を記録する大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（17番目）であり、紛争地域での感染管理困難により国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月5日時点でゴマにおける活動的な確認症例はないとしているが、DRC全体での344確認症例・60死亡、紛争地域での接触者追跡困難、保健システムの崩壊リスク、人口移動による拡大リスクなどから、フルRRA実施が必要。Vatican Newsからの報道であり国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: EE UU amenaza a la UE con "medidas unilaterales" si no suspende los vuelos con países afectados por el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US threatens EU with "unilateral measures" if it does not suspend flights to Ebola-affected countries.
article.articleSummary: The United States has threatened unilateral measures if the European Union suspends flights to Ebola-affected countries in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. EU health ministers convened informally by videoconference to discuss the outbreak, with the Commission, ECDC, and EASA coordinating to prevent transmission, especially given direct flights to Belgium, France, and the Netherlands, and connections to the UK. The EU advocates exit screening in affected regions; current guidance suggests no additional entry restrictions, and WHO has discouraged border closures as the outbreak is not yet a pandemic. The ECDC will strengthen its field presence in the DRC via the EU Health Working Group to ensure high-quality exit screening. EU leaders’ summit (June 18–19, Brussels) and EPSCO meeting (June 16, Luxembourg) will address border surveillance and operational priorities. The Integrated Crisis Response Mechanism (RPIC) is on standby for coordination. Uganda reported a new Ebola case on Thursday, bringing total to 16 infections.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がEUに対し「一方的措置」で脅迫 エボラ感染国への便運航停止に応じなければ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、複数国への影響、EU・米国間の渡航制限をめぐる政治的緊張が存在し、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはBrussels、Belgium、France、Netherlands、UK、USなど欧米諸国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでの発生を背景とした国際的な政治的対立であり、実際の感染症発生はDRCとウガンダに限定される。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e agência africana de saúde lançam plano de US$ 518 milhões para combater surto de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa health agency launch US$518 million plan to combat Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a US$518 million plan to curb the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with implementation planned from June to November 2026. The outbreak, declared May 15, is spread across three provinces, centered in Ituri, which accounts for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths. Across the border in Uganda, 16 cases have been confirmed, including one death. WHO counts 381 laboratory-confirmed cases and 64 deaths in the DRC. The Bundibugyo strain is suspected to have circulated undetected for some time. The plan targets emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community mobilization, and is described as a practical, time-bound response. The current outbreak is larger than the Bundibugyo events in 2007 and 2012.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカ保健機関がコンゴのエボラ流行対策に5.18億米ドルの計画を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。現在進行中の大規模エボラ出血熱の流行であり、複数国にまたがり、死亡例を含む中等度以上の重症度を有する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのItturi州およびウガンダでのエボラ流行に言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、381件の確定症例と64件の死亡が報告されている。WHOおよびアフリカCDCが大規模な対応計画を立ち上げており、国際的な関心と支援が既に動員されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola ha registrado 397 casos y 63 muertes confirmadas en República Democrática del Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has recorded 397 cases and 63 confirmed deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda totals 397 cases and 63 deaths (case fatality rate 15.9%). In the DRC, 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths are reported, with 4,341 contacts; in Uganda, 16 confirmed cases and 1 death, with 668 contacts. Healthcare workers affected: 34 infected, 6 dead. The epicenter is Ituri province in the DRC, housing over 90% of cases and about 70% of deaths. Eleven countries are at risk. The outbreak, declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16, is described as very grave by Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya, and is the most serious Bundibugyo outbreak to date, notably the first Bundibugyo outbreak with this many confirmed cases within 21 days of declaration. Urgent containment measures are required.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が民主共和国とウガンダで397例、確認死亡63例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべても該当。PHEIC宣言済みの国際的に重大な感染症危機。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーに基づくと主なイベントはDRC（381例、62死亡）で発生しており、ウガンダは限定的な継発例（16例、1死亡）。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。本件はWHO-PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月16日）、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる過去最大規模のアウトブレイク、Africa CDC長官による「最も重大」との評価、11カ国が危険にさらされている旨が記事で述べられており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態である。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تطلق خطة بـ518 مليون دولار لاحتواء تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization launches a $518 million plan to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO launches a $518 million six-month plan to contain Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On June 5, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the plan, running from June to November in partnership with the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, built on lessons from past outbreaks and previous health emergencies. Containment requires sustained political commitment, funding, and strong community engagement. The DRC reports 359 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 61 deaths across 24 health zones in three provinces, with 116 suspected cases, down from over a thousand the previous week. The country declared the 17th outbreak wave on May 15, and the WHO has previously issued a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the situation.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関が民主共和国コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク抑制のため5億1800万ドルの計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱は致死性が高く公衆衛生への影響は深刻、DRCで進行中の確認アウトブレイク、WHOが国際懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。国際的拡大リスク及び渡航・貿易制限のリスクも高い。
triage.notes: DRCで2026年5月15日に17番目のエボラアウトブレイク波を宣言。確認症例359例、死亡61例、疑い症例116例が3州24保健地域に分布。WHOがPHEIC（国際懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を既に宣言しており、6ヶ月間の大規模抑制計画（5.18億ドル）が発表されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Expert Fears Outbreak Is Heading Into "Nightmare Scenario"
article.articleSummary: Third-largest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists, with more than 1,000 reported cases and 233 confirmed deaths as of 2026-06-05. Experts warn the outbreak may have started earlier, leaving hundreds of undetected carriers and creating 'unrecognized chains of transmission.' For 100 confirmed cases, roughly 2,000 close contacts require tracing and monitoring. Cases have spilled into Uganda, signaling cross-border spread; Nigeria is cited as a potential nightmare scenario. The 2014 outbreak killed 11,325 people, underscoring potential scale. Funding cuts to global health programs have reduced on-the-ground personnel, hampering response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ専門家がアウトブレイクが「悪夢のシナリオ」に向かっていると懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（1,000例以上、233人死亡）と国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダへの流行波及）が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの第3位規模のエボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダへの流行波及が確認されているが、UgandaはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Nigeriaは「潜在的な悪夢シナリオ」として言及されているが、実際の発生地ではなく仮想的なリスク評価のため除外。資金削減による対応能力低下が懸念材料として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: കോട്ടയത്ത് ആഫ്രിക്കന്‍ പന്നിപ്പന്നി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; രോഗം ബാധിച്ച 20 പന്നികളെയും 175 കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങളെയും കൊന്നൊടുക്കി;രോഗം ബാധിച്ചത് കാഞ്ഞിരപ്പളളി കപ്പാട് ഗവണ്‍മെന്റ് പന്നിഫാമിലെ പന്നികള്‍ക്ക് ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever confirmed in Kottayam; 20 pigs and 175 piglets culled; the disease affected pigs at the Kappad Government Pig Farm in Kanjirappally ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleSummary: African swine fever confirmed in Kottayam, Kerala, at Kappad Government Pig Farm in Kanjirappally. Twenty pigs and 175 piglets were culled after infection was detected; first signs on the 21st, with laboratory confirmation in a Bhopal facility. ASF is a DNA virus of the Asfarviridae family affecting domestic pigs and wild boars; humans are not susceptible. Transmission occurs mainly through contact with infected pigs or their excreta, contaminated feed, clothing, and farm equipment. Not a zoonotic disease, though transmission risks are higher in native and crossbred pigs compared with others. The outbreak prompted immediate culling to contain spread, with authorities reporting no human infection risk and implementing local containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: コッタヤムでアフリカ豚コレラが確認；20頭の豚と175匹の子豚が殺処分；カンジラッパリのカッパド政府豚農場の豚が感染
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラはインドで初の確認事例であり異常・予想外であるが、ヒト-ヒト感染がなく人獣共通感染症ではないため、公衆衛生への深刻な影響やIHR基準の複数該当は限定的。動物病害の性質から国際的拡大リスク評価に情報不足がある。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラは家畜感染症であり人間への感染リスクなし。インドでの初確認であるため異常性は高いが、動物病害で人への影響が限定的。豚肉・畜産製品の国際貿易制限の可能性があり、今後の発生拡大情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Jaundice Outbreak in Mainpat: मैनपाट में पीलिया का कहर, उप सरपंच और 9वीं के छात्र समेत 4 लोगों की मौत! मचा हडक़ंप | 4 People Died From Jaundice In Mainpat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jaundice Outbreak in Mainpat: Jaundice wreaks havoc in Mainpat, including the deputy sarpanch and a ninth-grade student, four people died! Panic erupts.
article.articleSummary: Jaundice outbreak in Mainpat, Ambikapur district, India, has claimed four lives within a month, including the deputy sarpanch and a ninth-grade student; another student and two women are among those affected. More than a dozen people are ill, with several treated at private hospitals in Ambikapur and many at local facilities. The cause of jaundice remains unknown. In response, the health department has set up camps in affected villages for screening and treatment, while investigations continue; no laboratory-confirmed transmission source or infection pathway is reported in the article. The outbreak has spread fear across Mainpat communities as clinicians work to identify the source and manage cases.

triage.headline_ja: マインパットの黄疸アウトブレイク：マインパットで黄疸が猛威を振るい、副サルパンチと9年生の学生を含む4人が死亡！パニック発生
triage.triage_reason: 未知の原因による黄疸アウトブレイクで死亡者4名、患者十数名以上が発生。IHR基準では公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡者あり）と異常性を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡・入院）と長期曝露の可能性、管理可能性（原因不明で調査中）の複数基準を満たす。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、イベントはマインパット（アムビカプール地区、チャッティスガル州、インド）で発生していることが明確に述べられている。原因不明の黄疸アウトブレイクであり、調査が進行中。複数の死亡者と十数名以上の患者が報告されており、地域社会に恐怖が広がっている。

article.articleHeadline: Parasita mortal ressurge nos EUA após 60 anos; saiba os impactos na pecuária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Parasite Resurges in the US After 60 Years; Learn About the Impacts on Livestock Farming.
article.articleSummary: New World screwworm fly (Cochliomyia hominivorax) detected in Texas in a 3-week-old calf; confirmation by USDA on June 3, 2026. Not seen since 1966 in the US. The female lays eggs in open wounds; larvae tunnel in living tissue, causing severe infections and potential death if untreated. Authorities established an infested zone with quarantines, movement controls, and enhanced surveillance; plans include sterile-insect releases to break the life cycle. The outbreak comes amid a fragile U.S. cattle herd at a 75-year low due to drought and high production costs, contributing to record domestic beef prices. Brazil's market reaction is limited; U.S. authorities stress containment and monitoring rather than panic.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な寄生虫が60年ぶりに米国で再出現。畜産業への影響を知る
triage.triage_reason: スクリューワーム症は60年ぶりの米国での再出現で異常性が高く、家畜産業への深刻な経済的影響とシマウマハエのヒト-ヒト感染可能性から、国際的な畜産貿易制限リスクが存在する。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数基準該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国テキサス州でのスクリューワーム再出現だが、発生地域フィールドに米国が含まれている。対象国リストに米国が含まれないため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみとした。記事がブラジルの市場反応に言及していることと、スクリューワーム症は古典的な国際的畜産貿易病であることから、ブラジルを含めた。米国での発生自体は対象国外だが、国際的な影響評価対象となり得る。

article.articleHeadline: Allarme Ebola: individuati 6 ospedali per i casi sospetti, due sono a Torino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: six hospitals identified for suspected cases, two of which are in Turin.
article.articleSummary: Piemonte region activated extraordinary Ebola virus disease surveillance following Health Ministry directives (May 29), establishing rigid procedures for monitoring traveler flows, risk stratification, and management of suspected cases or close contacts of arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, where Ebola is an ongoing public health concern. Six regional hub hospitals are designated for isolation and treatment: two in Turin (San Giovanni Bosco and Regina Margherita Children’s Hospital) and four others in Vercelli, Verbania, Asti, and Novara. Asymptomatic travelers returning from Congo or Uganda must report to the local Public Hygiene and Health Service (SISP) within 24 hours of arrival, with coverage extending to those who returned in the 21 days prior to the ordinance. If symptoms emerge (fever, muscle pain, vomiting, hemorrhage), individuals should not go to emergency rooms; instead, self-isolate and contact SISP or emergency services for coordinated transfer to a hub.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：疑い症例のための6つの病院が特定、うち2つはトリノにある
triage.triage_reason: イタリアはWPRO対象国ではなく、サマリーは実際の症例ではなく予防的なサーベイランス体制の構築を記述している。DRCおよびウガンダからの帰還者向けの監視プロトコルだが、イタリア国内での実際の症例報告はない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事のエボラ警報はイタリア国内での予防的対応であり、実際の症例報告ではない。Bluedot APIが付与した地域にはイタリア（対象国外）が含まれているが、DRCおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれており、これらは警報の背景国として記載されている。ただしサマリーからはDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラの新規発生状況についての詳細は不明。イタリアは対象国でないため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola figures appear to offer hope as case numbers drop in DR Congo but it's not that simple
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 380 confirmed Ebola cases and 60 deaths, with a further 15 confirmed cases and one death in neighbouring Uganda; previously cited figures included more than 1,000 suspected cases and about 250 suspected deaths. The shift to confirmed cases reflects improved laboratory testing that rules out fever caused by other illnesses such as malaria, not an abrupt improvement in outbreak severity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus notes the outbreak had a big head start and that response teams are catching up, but challenges persist: only about 45% of direct contacts are being followed up, with the epicentre in conflict-affected eastern DR Congo across three provinces. Community mistrust and attacks on burial teams hinder control, and traditional funerals pose transmission risks. WHO assesses very high risk within DR Congo, high in the region, and low globally; the virus is not airborne. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo since its discovery 50 years ago.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数の低下は希望をもたらしているように見えるがそう単純ではない：コンゴ民主共和国での状況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率を示す新興感染症で、複数国での確認事例と地域的拡大リスク、国際的対応の必要性が認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での380確認事例・60死亡、ウガンダでの15確認事例・1死亡を報道。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。WHOが地域内の高リスク評価を示しており、紛争地帯での対応困難性と社会的抵抗が課題として指摘されている。エボラは致命的感染症であり、複数国での確認は国際的懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de Ebola em brasileiros gerou preocupação com o vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Brazilians generated concern about the virus
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, suspected Ebola in Brazil triggered alarms even though diagnoses pointed to other diseases. Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo led the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola virus disease, identified in 1976 and named for the Ebola region near the river in the current Democratic Republic of the Congo, is a severe viral illness. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, and via contaminated objects. It is not spread through the air like common respiratory illnesses. The report highlights Brazil’s concern amid ongoing African outbreaks and outlines the virus’s origins and transmission routes.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル国民のエボラ疑い事例がウイルスへの懸念を生み出した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式でPHEIC宣言済みのエボラウイルス病の複数国でのアウトブレイク報告であり、ブラジルでの疑い事例も含む。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(対象国外)でもアウトブレイク報告されているが、verified_locationsには含めない。記事サマリーで実際のイベント発生地として確認できるのはDRCとブラジル。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みの重大イベント。ブラジルでの疑い事例は最終診断で他の疾患とされたが、報告自体が社会的関心と対応を生じさせている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS anuncia plano de US$ 518 mi para combater ebola nos próximos seis meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces US$518 million plan to combat Ebola in the next six months.
article.articleSummary: June–November 2026 six-month plan to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced a US$518 million joint plan, presented with Africa CDC, to curb the surge. The Bundibugyo variant of Ebola is involved, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The outbreak is described as the fourth-largest Ebola event in history. As of now, 381 laboratory-confirmed cases and 62 deaths have been reported in the DRC. The Africa CDC said the epidemic went undetected for weeks, complicating containment. Donors have pledged about US$315.8 million, below an initial US$498 million estimate, and it is not clear if funds will flow to the new plan. The Bundibugyo outbreak marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, and the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、今後6ヶ月間のエボラ対策に5億1,800万ドルの計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRCにおけるBundibugyo型エボラアウトブレイク、PHEIC宣言、高い死亡率、国際的な資金動員が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは治療法・ワクチンがなく、歴史上4番目の規模のアウトブレイク。381確認症例、62死亡。WHOはPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。DRCでの17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Spain cancels DR Congo World Cup warm-up match against Chile over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), identified mid‑May, has 906 suspected cases and 223 confirmed deaths as of May 27. The World Health Organization has declared it a public health emergency of international concern; the rare Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine, with development potentially taking up to nine months. Cross-border spread includes Uganda. The United States has barred entry for non‑U.S. citizens who traveled through DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days, jeopardizing DR Congo’s participation in the World Cup hosted by the U.S., Canada, and Mexico (June 11–July 19). Africa CDC activated emergency response and cross-border surveillance; vaccines currently target only the Zaire strain. DR Congo’s team relocated training to Liège, Belgium; some staff and fans have traveled to Europe. Spain cancelled a June 9 DR Congo–Chile friendly in La Línea de la Concepción over health concerns, despite Chile’s request for a closed-door match; Denmark is due to play in Liège.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念により、スペインはコンゴ民主共和国のチリとのワールドカップ準備試合をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス（公衆衛生上の国際的懸念）による深刻な爆発で、国際的な移動制限と渡航制限が既に発令されており、複数国への波及リスク（ウガンダ、南スーダン、欧州への拡大懸念）がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域リストには対象外国（スペイン、ベルギー、デンマーク、米国、カナダ、メキシコ、チリ、スーダン）が多く含まれているが、記事の主題となる実際のエボラ爆発はDRCで発生している。ウガンダへの波及も記事に明記されているが、他の対象国リストの国との確認的な関連がないため含めない。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、ワクチン未対応の稀な株、国際渡航制限など、全ての重要リスク指標に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO·아프리카CDC, 8천억원 규모 에볼라 공동 대응 나선다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC to launch a joint Ebola response worth 800 billion won.
article.articleSummary: Joint Ebola response plan worth $510 million (about 800 billion won) by WHO and Africa CDC targets the Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in Africa, spanning six months through November to strengthen emergency coordination, surveillance, diagnostics, infection prevention and control, clinical care, research, logistics, and health-service support across governments, partners, and communities. As of June 3, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 64 deaths, with Uganda reporting 16 cases and 1 death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus framed the plan as practical, stressing action informed by prior outbreaks and the importance of political will, sustained funding, and community trust. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya noted Ebola response donor commitments at $315.8 million, below the previously announced $498 million; no detailed allocation for the six-month plan was provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHO・アフリカCDC、8千億円規模のエボラ共同対応に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（確認症例と死亡報告）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での発生）、異常性が認められ、基準該当数が2以上。WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡報告）、流行性（ウイルス性出血熱）が該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC（確認症例381例、死亡64例）とウガンダ（確認症例16例、死亡1例）での発生が報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Ebola Bundibugyo outbreakについての言及があり、WHOとアフリカCDCによる大規模な共同対応計画（5.1億ドル規模、6ヶ月間）が立ち上がっていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関心の高さが明確である。

article.articleHeadline: Retorno de parasita mortal aos EUA após 60 anos traz novos riscos para a pecuária - CompreRural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Return of a deadly parasite to the U.S. after 60 years brings new risks to livestock farming.
article.articleSummary: New World screwworm fly (Cochliomyia hominivorax), eradicated from the United States in 1966, re-emerged with a detection in a three-week-old calf in Texas on June 3, 2026. The USDA confirmed the case, prompting an infested zone, quarantines, movement restrictions, and intensified surveillance in coordination with the Texas Animal Health Commission. To halt spread, authorities plan sterile-insect releases to interrupt the fly’s reproductive cycle. The incident follows the parasite’s northward movement from Mexico and arrives as the U.S. cattle herd reaches its smallest size in about 75 years due to drought and high production costs, contributing to record domestic beef prices. Experts caution that broader impact depends on confirming additional foci; Brazil’s markets remained stable in response to the development."

triage.headline_ja: 米国に60年ぶりに致命的な寄生虫が再出現、畜産業に新たなリスク - CompreRural
triage.triage_reason: ネジバエは家畜に対する国家的な脅威であり、国際的拡大リスク（メキシコからの北上、ブラジルの関心）と経済的影響（食肉価格上昇）を伴う。IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本イベントは米国テキサス州での発生だが、対象国リストに米国は含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはブラジルのみを記載した。ブラジルは市場安定性の関心を示しており、記事サマリーに言及されている。ネジバエは重要な家畜疾病であり、メキシコからの北上傾向は地域的な懸念を示す。対象国外での発生ではあるが、国際的な畜産リスクとしての重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC launch $518 mn plan to combat Ebola outbreak - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri epicenter) was declared May 15, with 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths in DRC, and 16 cases with 1 death in Uganda across the northeastern border. The outbreak spans three DRC provinces; Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. A $518 million, June–November plan launched by WHO and Africa CDC aims to contain the outbreak, focusing on emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. The plan seeks to contain current transmission and reduce further spread, and this outbreak is larger than the 2007 and 2012 Bundibugyo outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカCDC、エボラ出血熱の流行に対抗する5億1,800万ドル計画を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認例381件、死亡64件（DRC）と重篤な流行。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境拡大）とWHO・アフリカCDCの公式対応計画の発動により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダについては発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは「northeastern border across」と記載されており、主流行地はDRC（Ituri州が90%のケース）。DRCが主要な発生国として検証済み。Bundibugyo型エボラは承認済み治療法なし。過去のアウトブレイク（2007年、2012年）より規模が大きい点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e Africa CDC anunciam plano de 446 milhões contra Ébola até novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC announce a $446 million plan to combat Ebola by November.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC unveiled a joint plan worth $518 million to combat the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with €446 million invested, running from June to November. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in northeastern DRC, centered in Ituri and expanding to North and South Kivu provinces, near Uganda, which has reported 16 cases including one death. As of the latest WHO tallies, 381 cases and 64 deaths have been confirmed in DRC. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak; mortality ranges 30-50%, and there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals. The plan emphasizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, clinical care, and community mobilization to curb spread and cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDCがエボラ対策に4億4,600万ドルの計画を発表、11月までに実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、国境制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による致死率30-50%の大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、国際的対応動員が確認されている。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは5月15日に宣言され、Ituri州を中心にSouth KivuおよびNorth Kivu州に拡大している。ウガンダでも16例が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生状況と国際対応計画である。Bundibugyo株による致死率30-50%、ワクチンなし、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高い。WHOとアフリカCDCによる518百万ドル規模の共同対応計画が発表されており、国際的な重大関心事案。

article.articleHeadline: East Africa to tighten border screening as Ebola outbreak persists
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the East African Community tightened Ebola controls as outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, posing a cross-border public health threat. Ministers approved a regional strategy to harmonize surveillance and protective measures at airports, ports and land border crossings, and directed states to strengthen entry-point monitoring per WHO guidelines. A new EAC Regional Technical Taskforce on Ebola Response will monitor the outbreak, coordinate interventions, review epidemiological trends, and issue updates. Real-time data sharing and coordinated response are emphasized. Plans include deploying EAC mobile laboratories and technical experts to border points and hotspots, plus resources for surveillance, lab testing, community engagement and emergency response. WHO warns the outbreak remains a significant regional threat; contact tracing is challenging, with about 45% of identified contacts followed up, hindered by insecurity, displacement and mobility.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が続く中、東アフリカが国境スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国境を越えた拡大、複数国での同時流行、地域の公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国境措置の実施が報道されており、シグナルとして即座にフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ含める。WHO警告、区域的脅威、接触者追跡の困難さ（45%のみ追跡）、セキュリティ問題が報告されており、管理可能性の懸念がある。EAC地域協力による対応強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Akıllı telefonlar ölümcül Ebola virüsünü nasıl tetikliyor?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Do Smartphones Trigger the Deadly Ebola Virus?
article.articleSummary: Smartphone-driven demand for cobalt, gold, and other minerals is driving deforestation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Congo Basin, accelerating Ebola spillover. The DRC—the world's second-largest rainforest country—sees vast logging and mining that shrink forest habitat, forcing Ebola-carrying bats into closer contact with people. New research ties each percentage point of Central African forest loss to a 20-40% rise in Ebola cases. Deep forest mining camps attract thousands of outsiders for illegal mining, increasing hunting and wildlife exposure; bat saliva and blood in these settings raise transmission risk to humans. The origin of the latest major outbreak is traced to Mongbwalu, a hotspot of illegal gold mining, with satellite data showing forests carved into mining sites. Experts warn that ending ecological destruction and protecting forest health is essential to prevent pandemics, beyond vaccines and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: スマートフォンが致命的なエボラウイルスをどのように引き起こしているのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの異常な伝播メカニズム（森林破壊による動物由来感染症のスピルオーバー）が報告されており、IHR基準における異常性・予想外性が強い。DRCでの具体的な発生地点（Mongbwalu）と新規感染メカニズムが特定されている。
triage.notes: 記事は森林破壊とエボラのスピルオーバーの因果関係を科学的に論述しており、Mongbwalu（違法金採掘の中心地）での発生が具体的に述べられている。中央アフリカ共和国は言及されているが、発生地点としての記述が不明確なため verified_locations から除外した。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当するため、優先度の高いシグナルと判定される。

article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜同志桑拿「胡同」群組增至3宗　52歲男患者5.2店內有性接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox | Gay sauna 'Hutong' group grows to 3 cases; a 52-year-old male patient had sexual contact inside a shop on May 2.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Hong Kong: a 52-year-old man diagnosed June 5 with epidemiological link to two earlier cases announced May 25 at Mong Kok's Hutong gay sauna (visited May 2). He reported high-risk sexual contact at Hutong on May 2; genital rash appeared May 21; fever and sore throat on May 25; subsequent lesions on arms, chest, and anal area. Lab-confirmed positive by Centre for Public Health Laboratory Service; patient unvaccinated. Public Health Authority, in collaboration with the Hong Kong AIDS Foundation, will run outreach Monkeypox vaccination at the Hutong site in the next two weeks; eligible high-risk groups (notably MSM) may book via Foundation site. Contact tracing has reached about 300 visitors since May 1; no additional cases found; Hutong closed since May 26. WHO informed. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 88 monkeypox cases (71 local, 17 imported), all male, with most reporting high-risk sexual activity.

triage.headline_ja: 猴痘｜同志桑拿「胡同」群組增至3宗　52歲男患者5.2店內有性接觸
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。公衆衛生上の懸念（クラスター発生、未ワクチン接種者）があり、WHO通知済み。WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当。
triage.notes: 香港はChina(1814991)に含める。クラスター発生で3例確認、未ワクチン接種者を含む。約300人の接触者追跡実施中。ゲイサウナを中心とした高リスク集団への感染が懸念され、さらなるクラスター拡大の可能性がある。WHO既報告。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo condemns Spain's cancellation of Chile friendly over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: DR Congo condemned Spain’s cancellation of a planned June 9 international friendly against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion due to Ebola concerns linked to the outbreak in parts of DR Congo. Mayor Juan Franco signed a decree suspending the fixture following a health-service report advising against hosting because of perceived public health risks. The Congolese squad, preparing for World Cup duties, has been training in Belgium; none of the 26 players are traveling directly from DR Congo, though some staff and supporters were set to travel. DR Congo Minister of Communication Patrick Muyaya criticised the decision as discriminatory, noting the team had complied with health requirements and had been in Belgium for nearly three weeks. The match was part of DR Congo’s build-up for future international engagements, including World Cups, and was discussed during a WHO briefing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ懸念によるスペインのチリとの親善試合中止を非難
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはエボラウイルス疾患の新規発生ではなく、既存のDRC発生に関連した国際スポーツイベントの政治的対応。感染症の疫学的な新たな脅威や深刻な健康影響を示す具体的情報がなく、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも実質的には満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRC内のエボラ発生そのものではなく、既存の発生に基づくスポーツイベント中止に対するDRC政府の政治的反応を報道している。疾患の新規発生、症例数増加、地域拡大、管理能力の喪失など、シグナルトリアージの対象となる感染症学的な新事実は含まれていない。スペイン・チリは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC launch $518 mn emergency plan to fight vaccine-resistant Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, the WHO and Africa CDC launched a six-month, $518 million emergency plan to contain the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, where no vaccine is available. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in northeastern DRC, with evidence of spread prior to confirmation. As of June 5, 2026, DRC reports 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths, with Ituri province as the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths across three northeastern provinces. Uganda has 16 confirmed cases, including one death, indicating cross-border transmission. The plan focuses on emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement, targeting June–November to curb further spread in a vaccine-lacking setting.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカCDC、ワクチン耐性エボラ出血熱対策に5億1800万ドルの緊急計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン耐性）の多国間アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: サマリー上、ウガンダでの症例報告（16例）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。アウトブレイク の焦点は DRC の northeastern region (Ituri 州)にあり、381確認例、64死亡例。ワクチン耐性株（Bundibugyo Ebola）であることが管理可能性の課題。WHO・Africa CDCによる大規模な緊急対応計画（$518 million、6ヶ月）が既に開始されている点で、国際的な関心と支援が高い。

article.articleHeadline: New £386m plan to fight Ebola as number of cases rises
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, WHO unveiled a $518 million six-month plan (June–November) to fight Ebola, developed with the Africa CDC, as the outbreak swells to at least 400 confirmed cases.
