In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the epicenter, 381 confirmed cases have led to at least 63 deaths; a Congolese national’s death brings the country’s Ebola fatalities to two, per health minister Samuel Roger Kamba. Uganda reported 19 cases in total, with three new confirmed infections on Friday, all close contacts in quarantine. Across the outbreak, 34 health workers have been infected, seven have died, and six have recovered. The Bundibugyo strain driving the DRC outbreak currently has no approved vaccine or treatment, complicating containment efforts amid public resistance to health protocols. The six-month plan emphasizes political commitment, sustained financing, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱との闘いへ新たに3億8600万ポンドの計画、感染者数増加に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の急速な拡大（400例以上）、複数国への国際的拡大、高い死亡率（63死亡）、及びワクチン・治療薬不在による管理困難性が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（19例）の言及があるが、Uganda（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国（203312）に含まれる。Bundibugyo strain の使用可能なワクチン・治療薬がない点が特に懸念される。WHO と Africa CDC が協力して $518 million の 6 か月計画を展開中であり、国際支援が積極的に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO and Africa CDC unveil $518 million Ebola response plan
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, WHO and Africa CDC unveiled a $518 million emergency plan to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. The six-month operation runs June–November 2026 and targets emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, clinical care, and community engagement. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, complicating response efforts; there are no approved vaccines or treatments specific to this strain. In the DRC, 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths have been reported, with Ituri province bearing about 90% of cases and more than three-quarters of deaths. Uganda has confirmed 16 cases and 1 death. The outbreak was officially declared May 15 in northeastern DRC, and authorities warn the situation remains serious as cross-border transmission occurs. The plan underscores intensified regional containment and rapid detection to prevent wider spread; the current outbreak has surpassed earlier Bundibugyo events in 2007 and 2012.

triage.headline_ja: WHOとアフリカCDCが5億1,800万ドルのエボラ対応計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の進行中の流行であり、稀なブンディブギョ株で対象国DRCとウガンダで確認された国際関心の高いイベント。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則で即座に報告される疾患であり、稀なブンディブギョ株による複数国での流行、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、既存流行を超える規模という点で高リスク。6ヶ月の緊急対応計画立案は国際的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: México Actualiza Aviso Epidemiológico por Brote de Ébola: ¿Hay Contagios en el País?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico Updates Its Epidemiological Alert on Ebola Outbreak: Are There Infections in the Country?
article.articleSummary: Mexico updates its epidemiological alert on the Ebola outbreak, Bundibugyo variant. Africa reports 64 deaths and 397 confirmed cases (381 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 16 in Uganda). No vaccine or treatment exists yet for Bundibugyo; Africa CDC flags high risk for 11 African countries. WHO notes three candidate vaccines under development (IAVI, Moderna, and the University of Oxford with Serum Institute of India) potentially ready in 2–3 months; three candidate treatments in trials include two monoclonal antibodies (MBP134 and Maftivimab) and remdesivir. Mexico’s Health Secretariat issued a Travel Preventive Advisory for the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, updated May 28, 2026 to include South Sudan; risk is high and nonessential travel to DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan is discouraged. No cases detected in Mexico to date; surveillance ongoing. Emphasizes early detection, isolation, and adherence to official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、エボラ出血熱流行について疫学的警報を更新：同国での感染例はあるか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ変種）の多国間流行で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。アフリカでの死亡64例・確認症例397例、ワクチン・治療法未確定、WHOが11カ国の高リスクを指摘、メキシコが疫学的警報を更新し渡航勧告を発令している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Sudan、Mexicoが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは活動的な流行地はDRC（381例）とUganda（16例）のみ確認。メキシコは警報発令と情報更新の主体だが実患者報告なし。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ワクチン・治療開発段階にあり、管理可能性が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Incident na aerodromu: Naučnici iz SAD-a pokušali unijeti virus bez dozvole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Incident at the airport: Scientists from the United States attempted to introduce a virus without authorization.
article.articleSummary: Two scientists from a U.S. government laboratory have been indicted for illegally importing deactivated mpox virus vials into the United States after traveling from Africa. The FBI says the incident was detected at Detroit Metropolitan Airport in Michigan, where they were stopped on their return from Paris following a nine-day stay in the Republic of the Congo. Vincent Munster, head of a department at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana, and his colleague Claude Kwe are charged with transporting biological material without disclosure or required permits, and giving false information during questioning. In court papers Munster allegedly claimed he possessed the necessary documentation and 'does this all the time,' though he could not confirm those statements. NIH is cooperating; the case remains under investigation. Mpox, formerly monkeypox, can cause rash and fever and sometimes serious complications, with most patients recovering; outbreaks have drawn global attention in recent years.

triage.headline_ja: 空港での事件：米国の科学者がウイルスを許可なく持ち込もうとした
triage.triage_reason: 本事件は違法な生物学的物質の密輸・違反行為であり、感染症の**発生・流行イベント**ではない。科学者による違法輸入行為の刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の危機や流行の可能性を示す兆候がない。
triage.notes: 本事件は違法な生物学的物質の密輸に関する刑事事件であり、感染症の発生や流行イベントではない。ウイルスは「不活化」されており、公衆衛生上の脅威を示していない。シグナルトリアージの対象外だが、DRCが関与地点として記載されているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 34 sundhedsarbejdere er smittet med ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 34 healthcare workers infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, 34 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola during the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Seven of the infected workers have died; six others are reported, though details are not provided in the excerpt. The WHO chief says the response is still catching up with the outbreak. A renewed effort has been funded with 3.3 billion kroner to strengthen the response. The article does not provide further information on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The figures underscore the toll on frontline health workers amid Ebola control efforts, and the international investment highlights the scale of the response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 34人の医療従事者がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準すべて該当。進行中のエボラ流行で医療従事者への感染が増加し、複数国に拡大している状況は即座のRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダが言及されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。34人の医療従事者感染と7人の死亡、進行中の大規模流行、国際的資金投入（32億クローネ）などから、重大なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: È davvero pericoloso il focolaio di Ebola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Ebola outbreak really dangerous?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, now the third-largest on record, with spread to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu and spillover into Uganda (Kampala and Wakiso). The index case, a healthcare worker, presented fever, bleeding, vomiting and severe asthenia on April 24; rapid tests initially detected only Ebola Zaire, with Bundibugyo confirmation on May 14, delaying species identification. By May 27 there were 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths; by May 29, 134 confirmed (125 in DRC, 9 in Uganda) and 18 deaths (14% CFR among confirmed). The Bundibugyo species has no approved vaccines or treatments, unlike Zaire. One exported case in a U.S. physician treated in Germany. The outbreak is complicated by cross-border transmission, an urban epicenter in Mongbwalu, massive internal displacement, and ongoing conflict. Core response relies on rapid isolation, contact tracing, safe burial, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生は本当に危険なのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの多国間拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・米国・ドイツ）、高い死亡率（14% CFR）、ワクチン/治療法がない、国際的流行リスクが確認された。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを記載。複数国での確認症例があるが、エボラの発生主体はDRC（Ituri州）。Bundibugyo型という稀なウイルス種、承認ワクチン/治療の欠如、高い死亡率、紛争地域での拡大という複合的リスク要因により、フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: virové onemocnění
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral disease
article.articleSummary: A 35-year-old Tinus Greyling, originally from Ireland, contracted influenza and unexpectedly became paralyzed on one side. In the Czech Republic, a broad influenza epidemic has thousands on sick leave, with workers considering pay loss and whether to endure illness at work; doctors weigh in on management. Zambia reports its first mpox (monkeypox) case, while Sweden confirms a case of infection with a new mpox variant. Domestically, pertussis (whooping cough) appears to be resurging in the Czech Republic, with 374 new cases in the past week—the highest weekly total this year. Hospitals report respiratory infections dominating adults (notably COVID-19), while children present a mix of seasonal viruses and bacteria including COVID-19. Experts also anticipate influenza to strike in December, signaling continued multi-pathogen activity across Europe and neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性疾患
triage.triage_reason: 複数の公衆衛生上の懸念が同時に報告されている。Mpox新規亜種（スウェーデン確認）、Mpoxザンビア初確認例、チェコ共和国での百日咳の急増（年間最高週間発症数）、インフルエンザ流行など、異常で複数国にまたがる事象が並行して発生しており、IHR基準および WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: スウェーデン・チェコ・アイルランドでの事象は対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。記事はザンビアでのMpox初確認が主要な対象国内イベント。複数病原体（Mpox、COVID-19、百日咳、インフルエンザ）の同時活動報告であり、国際的な感染症危機の初期段階を示唆。ザンビアのMpox初確認は地域的に重大なシグナルであるが、ザンビアのみが対象国リストに該当。

article.articleHeadline: OPS refuerza la preparación en las Américas ante brote de ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO Strengthens Preparedness in the Americas in Response to Ebola Outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: PAHO strengthens preparedness in the Americas for Ebola outbreaks in Africa. WHO declared a public health emergency in response to Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. As of 2 June 2026, DR Congo reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, with 116 suspected; Uganda has 15 confirmed cases, including 1 death. PAHO, with GOARN, aims to boost detection, investigation, and rapid response to possible imports, stressing that regional risk remains low but readiness is essential. Transmission is by direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of symptomatic cases or contaminated materials; no licensed vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo Ebola, and early supportive care improves survival. Non-affected countries should strengthen traveler surveillance, border and transport communications, traveler information, and rapid reporting of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ大陸のエボラ対策を強化するPAHO、アフリカでの発生に対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）によるIHR基準該当。公衆衛生への重大な影響（WHO公式な公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、複数国での確定症例と死亡）、予想外の病原体型、国際的拡大リスク（地域準備強化の必要性）、複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ発生を記述しており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。スペイン（カナリア諸島）とアメリカ大陸への記載は準備態勢の強化に関する内容であり、実際の発生地は対象国外。WHO公式緊急事態宣言、Bundibugyo型という珍しい株型、複数国での確定症例と死亡、ワクチン・治療法不在という重大リスク要因により、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 580 مليون دولار لمواجهة إيبولا.. والذهب يفاقم انتشار الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 580 million dollars to combat Ebola... and gold exacerbates the spread of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Global health authorities estimate a $580 million plan by the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, focusing on the Ituri province town of Mungbalo as the epicenter amid mining activity and cross-border gold trade. The current outbreak is the third-largest in DRC, beginning in February and identified in mid-May, driven by the Bundibugyo strain for which no approved treatment exists. Local officials reported over 80 deaths before the official outbreak announcement, with updated estimates around 300 suspected deaths. Mining communities face crowded conditions, and gold shipments move daily across borders, fueling transmission between affected and non-affected areas. Community skepticism and lack of a vaccine hinder prevention. The funding aims to expand testing, surveillance, and response to prevent escalation into a regional health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策に5億8000万ドル…金採掘がパンデミック拡大を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国のイツリ州でのエボラ発生は、死亡者300名超、国境を越えた金採掘による国際的拡大リスク、地域保健危機への懸念があり、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: イツリ州マングバロを中心とした第3波のエボラアウトブレーク。Bundibugyo株で承認済み治療法がない。金採掘活動による人口集約と国境を越した金貿易が感染拡大の主要因。ワクチンなく、地域の懐疑的態度により制御困難。WHO・アフリカ疾病管理センターによる緊急資金計画が検討されている。

article.articleHeadline: Queda nos números oficiais de Ebola oferece esperança após redução drástica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drop in official Ebola numbers offers hope after drastic reduction.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows a notable drop in official cases to about 380 confirmed infections, with 60 deaths; neighboring Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases and one death. Earlier figures cited over 1,000 suspected cases and nearly 250 probable deaths. The decline stems from laboratory confirmation, excluding febrile patients with malaria or other diseases, shifting from suspected to confirmed cases. The World Health Organization says the outbreak began strongly and response teams are recovering, but contact tracing remains a bottleneck: only about 45% of direct contacts are monitored, below the 90% target. Community distrust persists; a burial-team vehicle was attacked in a southern province of the DRC, disrupting funeral operations and raising transmission concerns. The outbreak is concentrated in three eastern provinces in conflict-affected areas; virus is not airborne; overall very high risk in DRC, high regionally, global risk low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの公式患者数の減少が劇的な減少後の希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常/予想外な状況）。複数国での確認例、高い死亡率、コミュニティの信頼喪失による対応困難性が認められ、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは「neighboring Uganda reports 15 confirmed cases」と二次的な言及のみ。主たるイベント発生地はDRCであり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。接触追跡カバー率45%（目標90%）、コミュニティ不信による埋葬チーム車両への攻撃など、対応上の重大な課題が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 34 من العاملين فى الرعاية الصحية أصيبوا بـ إيبولا توفى منهم 7 - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 34 healthcare workers infected with Ebola, 7 of whom have died - Youm7
article.articleSummary: WHO and the African CDC launched a continental preparedness and response plan for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease, stressing rapid detection, rapid response, community interventions, continuity of essential health services, frontline health-worker protection, and cross-border spread prevention, in collaboration with the DRC and partners. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, 34 healthcare workers have been infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 7 deaths and 6 recoveries; these cases occurred among workers in care facilities. A survivor-follow-up program will track all survivors for 6–18 months to ensure virus clearance from body fluids. Africa CDC notes that the six recovered workers were among eight recoveries, and certificates were issued. Regarding Kenya, authorities say the country has a plan with 23 isolation and treatment centers; discussions are underway about using one as a regional hub. The United States has proposed using a center, with final decisions resting with Kenyan leadership and with WHO/Africa CDC support available if needed.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラ出血熱に感染した医療従事者34人、うち7人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラ出血熱）の新規アウトブレイク、DRCで医療従事者34人感染・7人死亡という重篤な公衆衛生影響と、国際的対応体制（WHO、Africa CDC、複数国による準備計画）により、IHR基準3項目該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス）による新規流行。DRCが主要発生地であり、ケニアは準備段階（まだ確認症例なし、隔離・治療センター設置中）。米国の記載は支援申し出であり発生地ではない。WHO・Africa CDC主導の大陸的対応体制が起動中であることが社会的・政治的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Gir lion cubs' deaths: No Babesia parasite trace found, says forest minister
article.articleSummary: Eight lion cubs died in the Gir region of Gujarat, India. Forest and Environment Minister Arjun Modhwadia said laboratory results from the cubs, tested at the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre, ruled out Babesia (Babesiosis) and Canine Distemper Virus (CDV) as the cause. Babesiosis had been the initial suspicion. As of 5 June 2026, 17 sick lions were quarantined and treated; 12 have been released after recovery, while five remain under observation and are healthy, expected to be released soon. Modhwadia noted the death of a pregnant lioness likely stemmed from non-disease complications. No virus was found in the cub samples, and there have been no recent disease-caused deaths in the area, according to officials.

triage.headline_ja: ギル獅子の子の死亡: バベシア原虫の痕跡なし、森林大臣が発表
triage.triage_reason: バベシアはルーティンスクリーニングで除外された。死因は非感染性と判断され、感染症アウトブレイクの証拠がない。動物の個別事例であり、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 本事例は野生動物（ギル国立公園の獅子）の死亡であり、疑い疾患（バベシア症）は検査で除外された。死因は非感染性要因と判断され、感染症クライシスではない。動物における限定的な死亡事象であり、ヒト公衆衛生への影響はない。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تطلق خطة بـ518 مليون دولار لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization launches a $518 million plan to tackle an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC launched a continent-wide $518 million plan to contain an Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and prevent cross-border spread to Uganda and other neighbors. As of June 5, 2026, the plan runs June–November 2026 and emphasizes emergency coordination, strengthened surveillance systems, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, risk communication, research, logistics, and continuity of essential health services. It builds on national response efforts in the DRC and Uganda and includes support for neighboring countries readiness due to cross-border movement. The plan's guiding principle is one plan, one budget, one team. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed that defeating misinformation and earning community trust are essential, alongside rapid, coordinated action and integrated elements from case finding to patient care.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、エボラ出血熱の流行に対抗するため5億1,800万ドルの計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つクラス1感染症であり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」を満たす。DRCとウガンダでの発生確認、多国間協調体制の構築、WHO/Africa CDCによる大規模資金計画投入（5億1,800万ドル）により、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が明示され、ウガンダへの越境拡大の予防が言及されているが、ウガンダでの確認事例の有無が明確でないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。対象国リスト外のウガンダ(226074)は除外。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率（最大90%）と国際的拡大可能性を有し、大陸規模での対応計画立案は最優先事項。

article.articleHeadline: "دبي الإنسانية" تنقل جواً 20 طناً مترياً إمدادات طبية لمكافحة "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Dubai Humanity" airlifts 20 metric tons of medical supplies to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, under the directives of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai, 'Dubai Humanity' airlifted 20 metric tons of biomedical supplies to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in collaboration with the World Health Organization, to reinforce the fight against Ebola virus disease there. The initiative reflects high-level leadership and international cooperation aimed at strengthening medical logistics for Ebola response in the DRC. By rapidly delivering essential materials by air, the operation underscores Dubai's active role in supporting global health authorities and frontline responders addressing Ebola challenges in the region. It also highlights coordination between Dubai-based humanitarian efforts and international health agencies.

triage.headline_ja: 「ドバイ人道支援」、エボラ対策用医療物資20トンをコンゴ民主共和国に空輸
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症が対象国（DRC）で発生しており、国際的な人道支援が行われているシグナルであるが、記事の主題は医療物資の支援活動であり、新規の患者発生や流行拡大を報じたものではない。情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ対策への国際的人道支援を報道しており、DRCでの流行自体の進展状況は不明。新規患者数、致死率、流行の拡大傾向などの疫学情報がないため、シグナルとしては確定できない。ただし管理可能性と国際支援の必要性が示唆されているため、WATCH段階で経過観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 这7种常见美味含有寄生虫，开水反复烫都杀不死，你吃过几个？_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These 7 Common Delicacies Contain Parasites; Even Repeated Boiling Won't Kill Them—How Many Have You Eaten?
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, a Chinese article warns seven common foods may carry parasites that boiling may not eradicate. Freshwater crabs, drunken/crab pickles harbor lung fluke (Paragonimus westermani); infections cause cough, chest pain, or migratory symptoms; case examples from Hangzhou and other provinces highlight severe outcomes; complete boiling at 100°C for 10 minutes or more is advised. 福寿螺 (apple/snail) can carry Guangzhou roundworm (Angiostrongylus cantonensis); Beijing’s 2006 outbreak infected 131 diners; no safe method other than thorough cooking (boil for 20 minutes; avoid wild-caught). Freshwater fish and fish products host Chinese liver fluke (Opisthorchis sinensis); high prevalence in Pearl River Delta; long-term biliary disease and cancer risk; cook fish slices/roast thoroughly (100°C for 15 minutes). Wild bullfrogs/field frogs contain sparganum (Spirometra spp.); Guangzhou frogs show notable contamination; kill by cooking above 56°C for 5 minutes. Water chestnuts, lotus roots, water caltrops harbor Fasciolopsis buski; extreme care—boil 1–2 minutes; dozens of cysts per fruit reported. Undercooked beef/pork risk Taenia saginata and Taenia solium; fully cook. Eel/loach may carry Eustrongylides nematode; avoid wild-caught and cook thoroughly. Four life-saving principles: cook thoroughly, separate raw and cooked tools, don’t drink untreated water, and distrust folk remedies.

triage.headline_ja: これら7つの一般的な美食には寄生虫が含まれており、何度沸騰させても殺せない。あなたはいくつ食べたことがありますか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は一般的な食品衛生情報の啓発記事であり、具体的な感染症の流行・アウトブレイク報告ではない。歴史的事例（北京2006年）への言及はあるが、現在進行形のイベントまたは異常な発生状況は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国のメディア（網易）による食品衛生啓発コンテンツ。複数の寄生虫疾患（神経嚢虫症、広州線虫症など）が言及されているが、これは特定のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、一般的なリスク情報の提供である。New Yorkは誤検出と判断され、中国のみが対象。現時点で新規流行の兆候、急増、異常な重症化などは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC unveil $518m Ebola plan as Uganda death toll rises
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. First declared May 15 in the DRC. By 2026-06-05, at least 381 people infected in the DRC with 64 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases with 2 deaths. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, feared to have circulated undetected for some time, and is larger than the two prior Bundibugyo outbreaks (2007, 2012). WHO and Africa CDC announce a $518 million plan to run June–November to combat the outbreak, covering emergency coordination, surveillance, testing, infection prevention, clinical care, and community engagement. There is no approved vaccine yet; three vaccines are being researched and fast-tracked for trials. The objective is to stop transmission where it is, support responding countries, and ready neighbors to detect and act quickly if cases appear.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカCDCが5億1800万ドルのエボラ対策計画を発表、ウガンダの死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラの多国間流行で、既に381人の感染者、64人の死亡者が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限につながる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「DRCとウガンダ」の2国の流行が記述されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。ブンディブギョ株は過去2回の流行（2007年、2012年）より大規模で、ワクチン未承認の懸念事項あり。WHO・アフリカCDC双方の公式対応により社会政治的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak spreads to new regions as officials launch $518M response plan
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains ahead of containment as of 2026-06-05, with more than 360 cases and 62 deaths confirmed in the northeast. The virus has spread to a new region more than 100 miles from the original cluster; neighboring Uganda reports 15 cases and one death. Africa CDC and WHO launched a six-month plan to raise $518 million to fund the response, including laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, strengthened surveillance, cross-border information sharing, safe and dignified burials, and enhanced research and logistics. Donor funding has begun but the coalition says more is needed to unify the response across African countries. The strategy draws on COVID-19 lessons about vaccine access and procurement, aiming to bolster regional coordination to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が新たな地域に拡大、当局が5億1800万ドルの対応計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体の多国間の地域流行である。DRCでの確認症例360例以上と死亡62例、隣国ウガンダへの拡大が報告されており、国際的なリスク対応が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda(Republic of Uganda)が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは15症例1死亡の報告のみで、主な流行はDRCである。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラウイルス病は指定感染症で、Africa CDC・WHOによる国際的な対応計画が既に発動されており、フルRRA対象として明確にピックアップすべき案件である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Cdc Africa e Oms lanciano piano da 518 milioni di dollari in sei mesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Africa CDC and WHO Launch a $518 Million Six-Month Plan.
article.articleSummary: June 5, 2026: Africa CDC and WHO launched a six-month continental plan for the ongoing Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The $518 million plan aims to support African countries, including the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with rapid detection and response through a unified One Response approach. Activities span emergency coordination, epidemiologic surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, and essential health services. The plan integrates national response efforts already in place in DR Congo and Uganda. Leadership emphasizes political commitment, sustained funding, and community trust to improve contact tracing, safe care, and interruption of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アフリカCDCとWHOが5億1,800万ドルの6ヶ月計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のアフリカ大陸規模の集団発生であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡が予想される）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが明らかであり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・感染性・管理困難性が複数該当。国際的な資金規模と複数国対応から社会政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は記事サマリーで複数回言及されており、実際の影響対象国である可能性が高いが、対象国リスト（GeoNames ID: 895949 Zambia等）に該当する国IDが不明であるため、確実な DRC のみ verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダが対象国として明示されていないことから除外。エボラは最高レベルの脅威として扱われるべき疾患であり、5億ドル規模の国際的対応計画の立案は極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : certains malades évitent de fréquenter les structures sanitaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: some patients avoid going to health facilities - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, Ebola cases in Ituri province's Bunia city, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompt some patients to stay at home rather than visit health facilities. Residents report fear of being mistaken for suspected cases, or of contact with infected individuals at clinics, and concern about isolation or strict controls even for mild symptoms like fever. This leads to delayed medical consultation, risking worsening illness. Quotes from Bunia residents Jérôme Omatoko, Georgine Kavuo, Laurent Kisembo, and Joseph Mungufeni illustrate the hesitation and misinformation surrounding treatment centers. Health authorities are urged to intensify community sensitisation to dispel false perceptions and support the outbreak response, which continues to decimate communities in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥーリ州のエボラ：患者の一部が医療施設への通院を避けている
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限リスクを示す。社会的関心も高い既知の大規模流行であり、患者の医療回避は対応能力を低下させるリスク要因となる。
triage.notes: DRCはWHO監視対象国。本記事は既知のエボラアウトブレイク（Ituri州）の継続報告であり、患者が医療施設を回避する行動パターンは対応上の新たなリスク要因を示唆している。社会的・政治的関心は高く、国際支援が必要な局面が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Buffalo's Jericho Road Community Health Center on the frontlines of Ebola crisis in Congo
article.articleSummary: Buffalo's Jericho Road Community Health Center is sending roughly $2.5 million in Ebola supplies to its Congo clinic in Goma, with 17 pallets en route in partnership with Direct Relief to bolster frontline response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Congolese staff operate the center, which screens patients for Ebola and refers suspected cases to other facilities to protect routine care. Supplies aim to protect workers and patients, with emphasis on PPE and medications as the community educates on Ebola transmission, including risks from deceased bodies during funerals. The push comes amid funding strains after the dismantling of USAID, forcing organizations to rely on philanthropic and foundation grants as international health programs adapt. Jericho Road continues fundraising to support its staff and nearby centers amid the crisis as of 2026-06-05.

triage.headline_ja: バッファローのジェリコロード・コミュニティ・ヘルスセンター、コンゴのエボラ危機の最前線に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がDRCで確認されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。米国の医療機関が直接対応している点で国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCのゴマにおけるエボラ流行。バッファロー（米国）の医療機関がDRCの診療所に支援物資を送付している文脈。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を含める。2026年6月という日付は将来日付だが、イベント発生国の特定に影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 34 sundhedsarbejdere er smittet med ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 34 healthcare workers infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has reached 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths in the DRC, with Uganda reporting 19 cases and its second death—a DR Congo national. A total of 34 healthcare workers have been infected, with 7 fatalities and 6 recoveries. Three new Uganda cases bring its tally to 19. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant; there is no approved treatment or vaccine. More than 1,000 suspected cases remain under investigation. Africa CDC announced the outbreak began on 15 May. WHO is proposing a six-month response plan from June to November, costing US$518 million (about DKK 3.3 billion), stressing political engagement and community involvement for containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 34名のヘルスケアワーカーがエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病による死亡例あり、複数国への急速な拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、感染者381名以上の大規模流行、医療従事者への感染拡大リスク、国際的な対応資金要求（5.18億ドル）により国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダの両国が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。ウガンダは国際的な拡大リスク評価には組み込み済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異体による流行で、治療薬・ワクチンなし、医療従事者への感染（34名）が特に懸念。WHO主導の6ヶ月対応計画（5.18億ドル）が提案されており、国際的危機管理が必須段階。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina intensifica combate à Hanseníase com lançamento de projeto japonês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina Intensifies the Fight Against Hansen's Disease With the Launch of a Japanese Project
article.articleSummary: Teresina launches the Sasakawa Project to intensify the fight against Hansen’s disease (leprosy), with support from Japan’s Nippon Foundation and Brazil’s Ministry of Health. In May, community health workers were trained and are in the field conducting educational activities in primary health units, schools, squares, and churches, with activities continuing through June 12 to promote high‑quality information and early detection. From June 8–12, multidisciplinary teams (doctors, nurses, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, and laboratory staff) receive theoretical and practical training; on June 8, the Fiocruz Sertão Auditorium hosts full training on diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disabilities, while June 9–12 practical care sessions occur at Centro Maria Imaculada, the regional reference center. Despite declines, Teresina remains highly endemic; SINAN/FMS reports 2025: 193 new cases, 7.2 per 100,000. The project emphasizes humane care to overcome stigma and aims toward elimination of the disease.

triage.headline_ja: テレシーナ、日本プロジェクトの開始でハンセン病対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症で急速な拡大リスクに乏しく、本イベントは既知の高流行地域における公衆衛生対策の実施である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、国際的な緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはJapanが含まれているが、記事サマリーはブラジルのテレシーナでの対策事業であり、日本は支援国として言及されているのみである。本イベントは感染症の流行通知ではなく、既知の公衆衛生プログラム実施の報道である。ハンセン病は対象国（WPRO）の監視対象疾患であるが、本報は緊急的なシグナルとして位置づけられない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola alert: Another suspected Ebola case reported in India, Sudanese student isolated in..., not Delhi, Kerala, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai
article.articleSummary: Two Sudanese nationals were admitted to Gandhi Hospital in Hyderabad, Telangana, with Ebola-like symptoms and placed in isolation as suspected cases. A Sudanese student in his twenties, referred from a private hospital, developed fever and was moved to an Ebola preparedness ward; by Friday morning his fever had subsided. A second Sudanese national, 35, was flagged at Hyderabad’s Rajiv Gandhi International Airport during thermal screening on arrival for knee surgery and relocated to the hospital; he later became fever-free and asymptomatic. Earlier, a woman who had recently traveled from Uganda was isolated in Jaipur as a suspected case. Gandhi Hospital has a 10-bed isolation ward for suspected Ebola and is conducting testing and surveillance; no confirmed Ebola cases in India as of 2026-06-05. India has issued advisories to strengthen screening for travellers from affected regions. The outbreak remains in Central and East Africa, with Bundibugyo strain reported in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：インドで別の疑い例が報告、スーダン人学生を隔離...デリ、ケーララ州、ムンバイ、ベンガルール、チェンナイではない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の複数の疑い例がインドで報告され、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。確認症例はないが、疑い例の多発と旅行関連曝露の継続、スクリーニング体制の整備状況から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: スーダン国籍者の複数疑い例がインドで報告。発症地は不明だがウガンダからの旅行者も隔離されている。DRCとウガンダでBundibugyo株が報告されており、二次感染リスク要素あり。ただし確認症例なし（2026-06-05現在）。インドの検査体制は構築済みだが、継続的な監視が重要。対象国リストからはDRCのみを verified_locations に含める（ウガンダ、モザンビークは対象外）。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО обяви шестмесечен план за борба с разпространението на ебола, за който ще бъдат отделени 518 милиона долара
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced a six-month plan to combat the spread of Ebola, with 518 million dollars to be allocated.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the World Health Organization announced a six-month plan to curb Ebola spread, backed by $518 million. The plan, starting this month and running through November 2026, builds on experiences from prior epidemics and recent health crises. It will involve the African Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and aims to rapidly detect and interrupt transmission, ensure safe burials, strengthen surveillance, and improve risk communication across affected areas, including Bunia in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. No specific case or death counts are provided in the report. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized political commitment, sustained funding, and trust with local communities as critical to success.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がエボラ出血熱の拡大抑制に向けた6ヶ月計画を発表、5億1800万ドルの予算配分
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な疾患であり国際的な関心事であるが、本記事はWHOの計画発表であり、新規事例の報告ではない。具体的な症例数や死亡数が示されていないため、現在の流行状況の重症度を判断できない。
triage.notes: 本記事は WHO による政策発表であり、新規の感染症イベント報告ではない。Bunia（ブニア）はコンゴ民主共和国の具体的な発生地域として言及されている。現在の流行状況の詳細な情報（症例数、死亡数、感染者数の増減傾向）が記事に含まれていないため、リスク評価の精度に限界がある。続報で実際の流行状況が明らかになった場合、判定の見直しが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Akıllı telefonlar tetikliyor! Dünyayı sarsan ölümcül Ebola virüsünde korkutan tehlike
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smartphones Are Triggering It! The Frightening Danger in the World-Shaking Deadly Ebola Virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Congo Basin are linked to deforestation driven by mining for cobalt, gold, and other minerals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Large-scale tree felling reduces rainforest habitat, pushing virus-carrying bats into closer contact with humans. Scientific studies cited by TRT Haber (from The Guardian) suggest each 1% forest loss increases Ebola cases by 20–40%. Illegal deeper mining camps, poor sanitation, and habitat loss drive humans into wild animal reservoirs, elevating spillover risk. The recent outbreak's first cases were in Mongbwalu. Satellite imagery shows forests being carved into mining sites. Experts emphasize that preventing pandemics requires stopping ecological destruction, not just vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: スマートフォンが引き金を引いている！世界を震撼させる致命的なエボラウイルスの恐ろしい危険性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生事例がコンゴ民主共和国（Mangbwalu）で報告されており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、さらにWPRO基準で「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が懸念される。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月5日時点での情報で、コンゴ民主共和国Mangbwalu地域でのエボラ発生を報告。森林破壊による生態系撹乱がウイルス侵出を促進するという環境要因が強調されている。エボラは致死率が高く国際的な懸念が高い疾患であるため、発生報告は即座に検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "عدوى عبر الهواء ودون أعراض".. مفاهيم خاطئة شائعة عن الإصابة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Airborne and asymptomatic infection" — common misconceptions about Ebola virus infection
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May 2026. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, particularly Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with over 360 confirmed cases and more than 60 deaths, plus hundreds of suspected cases under investigation. The virus has reached Uganda, including Kampala and surroundings, with about 15 confirmed cases and one death, including health workers. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, a rare lineage not responsive to existing vaccines or therapies developed for Zaire, so health facilities rely on supportive care (isolation, fluid and electrolyte replacement) while vaccines and targeted therapies are tested. Transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids of symptomatic patients; incubation is 2–21 days, and there is no airborne spread. Case fatality averages around 50%, varying by strain and access to care, improving with early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 「空気感染と無症状感染」...エボラウイルス感染に関する一般的な誤解
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式宣言によるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）で確実にシグナル対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはUgandaも発生地域として返していますが、記事サマリー上ではDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）が主要な発生地で、Ugandaは国際的拡大の例として言及されている二次的位置付けです。対象国リストの照合ではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations はDRCのみとしました。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月中旬）、360+確定症例、60+死亡、ワクチン対応困難（Bundibugyo株）等の要素からPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Hampir 2.000 Kasus TB Ditemukan di Sidoarjo, Dinkes Kejar Pasien Mangkir dan Perkuat Desa Siaga - Suara Merdeka Jatim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 2,000 TB cases found in Sidoarjo, Health Department pursues patients who miss appointments and strengthens the Siaga Village program
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, Sidoarjo Regency, East Java, Indonesia, detected 1,992 TB cases, about 30.68% of an estimated 6,492 total. Of these, 1,777 patients have started treatment, while 215 have not yet begun therapy because treatment data have not been entered into health facilities or patients have defaulted. To curb transmission and improve cure rates, the local Health Department is intensifying TB control with mass community screening, tracing patients who miss appointments, and reinforcing adherence support to prevent treatment interruption and potential drug resistance. It is also accelerating contact investigations among people with known TB exposure to detect cases early. The effort aligns with ongoing initiatives under the Siaga Village program in Sidoarjo.

triage.headline_ja: シドアルジョでほぼ2,000件のTB症例が検出され、保健局は患者追跡と警戒村プログラムの強化を推進
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）における結核の多数症例検出は注視に値するが、IHR基準の2つ以上該当の明確な証拠が限定的であり、情報不足のため。国内の既知疾患対応の範囲内と考えられ、現段階ではフルRRA不要だが続報監視は必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、シドアルジョ地区（東ジャワ州、インドネシア）で2026年5月時点で1,992件の結核症例が検出されたことが明らかである。1,777名が治療開始済み、215名が未開始で、保健局による患者追跡強化と接触者調査が実施中。結核は既知の感染症であり国内対応が進行中であるため、PICKUP水準の国際的懸念は低い。ただしWPRO基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行性で該当し、治療中断による薬剤耐性化のリスク記載があるため、経過観察の継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Los casos de ébola suben a casi 400 y la OMS inyecta más de 500 millones para frenar su expansión: "Es el brote más grave"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise to nearly 400, and the WHO injects more than 500 million to curb its spread: "It's the worst outbreak."
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, the Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda totals 397 cases and 63 confirmed deaths (case-fatality rate 15.9%). In the DRC, 381 cases and 62 deaths have been reported, with 4,341 contacts; in Uganda, 16 confirmed cases and 1 death, with 668 contacts. Healthcare workers affected: 34 infected, 6 dead. The epicenter remains Ituri province, DRC, accounting for over 90% of cases and about 70% of deaths, with 11 countries at risk. The WHO and Africa CDC have mobilized a response plan funded at $518 million, with partners including UNICEF, UNHCR, the World Food Programme, IFRC, and FIND. The plan emphasizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement; testing should trigger isolation and care. Cross-border transmission risk persists; sustained political commitment and community trust are essential for containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数がほぼ400件に増加し、WHOが拡大を抑制するために5億ドル以上を投入：「最も深刻な流行」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の活発な多国間流行であり、即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの症例（16件、死亡1件）が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが対象国であり、かつ流行の震源地（Ituri州で症例の90%以上）であるため DRC のみを記載。397例、死亡63例、医療従事者34例感染・6名死亡という重篤な状況。11カ国でリスク評価中とされており、国際的な懸念は極めて高い。WHO・Africa CDCが5.18億ドルの対応予算を投入済み。

article.articleHeadline: 本地新增一宗猴痘確診個案　男患者曾有高風險接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One new locally confirmed monkeypox case; the male patient had high-risk exposure.
article.articleSummary: One new locally confirmed monkeypox case in Hong Kong: a 52-year-old man with high-risk exposure on May 2 at a venue called Hutong on Shanghai Street, Mong Kok. Hutong has been closed since May 26. The patient sought care at the Department of Health's Yau Ma Tei Male Social Hygiene Clinic and was isolated at Renji Hospital; his condition is stable. Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox infection; he had not received monkeypox vaccination. Authorities are tracing contacts from Hutong visits since May 1; about 300 contacts have been reached; no additional cases identified thus far. A monkeypox hotline (2125 2373) remains open for those who visited since May 1. The DH, with the Hong Kong AIDS Foundation, will run outreach monkeypox vaccination at the foundation's Mong Kok site over the next two weeks, targeting high-risk groups, especially men who have sex with men, via the foundation's website.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で新たに1件の猴痘（サル痘）確診例；男性患者は高リスク接触歴あり
triage.triage_reason: 香港での散発症例であり、現在のところ地域的コントロール下にあるが、MSM集団への感染リスクと接触者追跡の状況を注視する必要がある。情報不足（国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの詳細）のため段階的評価。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は香港での症例。香港はChina (1814991) に含める。Hutong会場での5月1日以降の訪問者約300名が接触追跡対象となっており、長期曝露の可能性あり。MSM集団への流行リスクが指摘されている。現時点で追加症例は報告されていない。当局による積極的な検査・追跡・ワクチン接種対応が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: "دبي الإنسانية" تنقل 20 طن إمدادات طبية لمكافحة إيبولا بالكونغو الديمقراطية - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Dubai Humanity" transports 20 metric tons of medical supplies to combat Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Al Ahli Stadium.
article.articleSummary: Under the directives of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Dubai Humanity air-transported 20 metric tons of biomedical supplies to support the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in collaboration with the World Health Organization. The shipment reinforces international assistance to strengthen response activities against the Ebola virus disease within affected regions of the DRC. The report does not provide specific case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or outbreak timelines. The operation demonstrates UAE-driven humanitarian support for global health security by delivering essential medical materials to bolster efforts against ongoing Ebola transmission in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 「ドバイ・ヒューマニティ」がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策のため20トンの医療物資を輸送
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策に対するドバイからの人道支援物資の輸送について報じたもので、新規の感染症イベント（症例報告、アウトブレイク検出、流行拡大など）ではなく、既存状況への対応活動である。具体的な症例数、死亡数、新規検出、流行動向などのシグナル要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラウイルス疾患流行に対する人道的支援活動の報道であり、新規シグナル情報（新規症例、実験室確認、流行拡大など）を含まない。EBS活動における初期シグナル検出対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Fight against Ebola: Dubai sends 20 metric tonnes of medical supplies to DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 62 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The epidemic spans North Kivu (seven health zones) and South Kivu (one health zone). The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine, and is described as the most serious Bundibugyo event to date. The WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern, with Africa CDC noting the outbreak persisted undetected for weeks and is now moving fast. A six-month joint WHO/Africa CDC plan, worth $518 million for June–November, aims to halt spread. Dubai, under the emirate’s directives, sent 20 metric tonnes of medical supplies to DRC in collaboration with WHO to bolster response efforts, underscoring the outbreak’s status as the fourth largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの戦い：ドバイがDRCに20トンの医療用品を送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。DRC南キブ州でのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクは381確認症例、62死亡、WHOがPHEIC宣言、国際的な医療支援が展開されており、シグナルとして拾い上げすべき重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確にDRC南キブ州でのエボラアウトブレイク（381確認症例、62死亡）を主題としている。Bundibugyo株は既承認治療・ワクチンなし、史上4番目の規模。WHOがPHEIC宣言、Africa CDC及び国際社会が対応中。ドバイからの医療支援提供はイベントの重大性を示唆。UAEは医療支援の実施地点であり、発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO launches $518m Ebola Response Plan for DR Congo Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Six-month, $518 million Ebola Response Plan unveiled by the World Health Organization in Nairobi on 2026-06-05 to contain the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak. Developed with the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the plan builds on lessons from prior outbreaks and emphasizes political commitment, sustained funding, and strong community engagement as critical for success. DR Congo has 359 confirmed Ebola cases and 61 deaths across 24 health zones in three provinces; suspected cases declined to 116 from over 1,000 a week earlier. The country declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, prompting a WHO international health alert. The plan seeks to mobilize resources and coordinate efforts to end the outbreak. Keywords: outbreak, Ebola, DR Congo, international health alert, six-month plan.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに向けた5億1,800万ドル対応計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国での確認症例359例、死亡61例と重篤な状況であり、国際的な対応計画が既に立案されている。WHOが国際的な健康警報を発令している。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの対応計画がWHOにより発表されたことを報道。発生地域フィールドにはナイロビとケニアも含まれているが、記事サマリーではナイロビはWHO計画発表の場所として記載され、実際の主要発生地はコンゴ民主共和国である。17番目のアウトブレイク宣言、確認症例359例、死亡61例という深刻な状況。WHOが既に国際的健康警報を発令済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Rio adapta ambulâncias e prepara equipes para casos suspeitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Rio de Janeiro adapts ambulances and trains teams for suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro trains Samu teams in Ebola biosafety and adapts two ambulances for suspected cases, following Ministry of Health protocols to maximize protection for health workers and patients. The training, conducted by INI Evandro Chagas (Fiocruz), covers proper use and doffing of PPE (masks, face shields, gloves, impermeable gowns, protective coveralls) and correct ambulance preparation. Two vehicles were positioned centrally and in the West Zone as part of a contingency plan, with coordination among the Central Regulation, Inter-hospital Transport, and the Samu Pre-Hospital Care Commission. The Ministry reports Brazil’s Ebola transmission risk as low. A suspected Ebola case in Rio involving a Ugandan patient was transported to INI; after testing, malaria was diagnosed, the patient leaving isolation while continuing treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：リオデジャネイロが救急車を改造し、疑似患者に向けてチームを準備
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエボラ対策強化の準備報道であり、異常性と予想外性を示すが、実際の患者発生は検査結果で否定され、現在の伝播リスクは低いと報告されている。情報不足により確実な判定に至らず。
triage.notes: ウガンダ国籍患者の疑似症例は検査により否定され、マラリアと確定診断されている。ブラジルは対象国に含まれるが、実際のエボラ患者は現在いない状況。ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダでのエボラ発生ではなく、ウガンダ国籍患者がブラジルで疑似症例となった事例のため、ウガンダは検証地域に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'unité des communautés pour vaincre la maladie à virus Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Communities unite to defeat Ebola virus disease - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, Ebola virus disease is ravaging the region in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, and communities must stay united to fight it, according to Pascal Takaibone, coordinator of the Haki na Amani Network (RHA). In Bunia, 5 June 2026, he urged communities to observe barrier measures and speak a common language in prevention to strengthen the medical response and health facilities' management of patients. He stressed that a united, disciplined population can ease the workload of health and administrative authorities already mobilized to manage the crisis, and that acknowledging the existence of the disease is essential to apply the response mechanisms recommended by authorities. The outbreak should be viewed as an opportunity to reinforce peace and coexistence among Ituri's communities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥーリ州：エボラウイルス病に打ち勝つためのコミュニティの団結 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生が確認され、IHR基準では公衆衛生への深刻な影響（Yes）、異常性（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）、渡航・貿易制限リスク（Yes）の4基準すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国イトゥーリ州でのエボラウイルス病発生を報じている。コミュニティの団結と感染対策の重要性が強調されており、地域での公衆衛生危機が進行中であることを示唆している。配信日時は2026年となっているが、これは将来の日付のため、確認推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола виходить з-під контролю: ВООЗ готує план на $580 млн -- Reuters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control: WHO prepares a $580 million plan — Reuters.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with vaccines and treatments not yet available for this strain. The World Health Organization officially unveiled a six-month emergency plan funded at $580 million to curb transmission. Health experts classify this outbreak as the fourth largest in Ebola history, worsened by the strain’s unique characteristics. There are no certified vaccines or officially approved treatment protocols for Bundibugyo Ebola, leaving populations and health systems highly vulnerable. Ebola virus causes acute hemorrhagic fever; the most deadly outbreak occurred in West Africa from 2014 to 2016, claiming more than 11,000 lives. Prior responses relied on vaccines for specific strains (e.g., Zaire), but new mutations demand adapted medical technologies and strategies, highlighting the urgent need for international funding and coordinated action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが制御不能に：WHOが5億8,000万ドルの計画を準備 — ロイター
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、エボラ出血熱の急速な蔓延と新種ワクチン未開発という重大な懸念事項が存在し、国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの急速な蔓延が報告されており、既存ワクチン（Zaire株向け）が本株に対応していない。WHOが6ヶ月間の5億8,000万ドル規模の緊急対応計画を発表。記事ではアンゴラも発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリー本文ではコンゴ民主共和国での蔓延が主題であり、アンゴラでの確認は明記されていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا: وفاة وإصابات جديدة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: Deaths and New Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Uganda's Ministry of Health reported one death and three new laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, bringing Uganda's total confirmed cases to 19. The three new infections were among individuals who had contact with previously confirmed cases and were quarantined. A person from the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak's epicenter, also died, raising the overall Ebola fatalities in Uganda to two. Four patients have recovered and been discharged from hospital. The updates indicate an ongoing Ebola outbreak affecting Uganda, with transmission linked to contacts of known cases and cross-border involvement from the DRC. The report emphasizes confirmed status and quarantine of contacts, underscoring continued public health measures in Uganda to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラウイルスによる死亡と新規感染者
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な多地域での確認事例（DRC・ウガンダ）、死亡例と持続的な新規感染、IHR基準3つ以上該当、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: DRCがアウトブレイクの震源地とされており、サマリーの主題はDRCにおけるエボラ発生と、ウガンダへの国際的な伝播。記事はアラビア語ソース（UAE）で、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ただしDRCでの発生確認と国際的な拡大リスク、死亡例の存在により、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Condemns Chile Friendly Cancellation Over Ebola Concerns
article.articleSummary: DR Congo condemns the cancellation of a planned international friendly against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion, Spain, scheduled for June 9 due to Ebola outbreak concerns in DR Congo. Local authorities banned the fixture after health officials warned of potential public health risks. The decision disrupts the Congolese team's preparations for upcoming competitions; DR Congo has trained in Belgium for about three weeks for their World Cup campaign, with 26 players not travelling directly from DR Congo to Europe. Some staff and supporters may have travelled; officials say players pose no health risk. DR Congo’s Minister of Communication Patrick Muyaya, speaking at a WHO virtual press conference, argued the circumstances were not properly considered and suggested possible discrimination, as the cancellation complicates preparations for forthcoming international assignments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念によるチリとの親善試合キャンセルを非難するコンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生は公衆衛生上の重要な懸念であるが、本記事の主題はDRCの国際親善試合キャンセルに関する政治的・外交的反応であり、疾病そのもののリスク評価ではない。DRCプレイヤーは健康リスクがないとされており、実際の流行・感染拡大のシグナルではなく社会的関心の反映である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ発生そのものではなく、それに対する国際親善試合キャンセルと外交的な反応である。DRCの国家レベルの懸念と政治的関心（WHO仮想記者会見での主張）が示されているが、実際の疾病流行の進行状況や公衆衛生上の直接的な影響に関する情報は不足している。スペイン・ベルギーは記事の文脈では検疫/予防措置の実施地であり、実際の流行発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Government to establish modern border health facilities to boost Ebola preparedness - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Ghana plans to establish modern border health facilities at entry points to boost Ebola preparedness and cross-border health threat response. Deputy Health Minister Grace Ayensu-Danquah led an Aflao border assessment, citing gaps in infrastructure, logistics, and personnel. Planned interventions include upgraded border health infrastructure, improved logistics, additional health personnel, and reliable stocks of essential medical and protective equipment. The Ministry of Health says the initiative will enhance disease surveillance, screening, and emergency response at major entry points. The upgraded facilities aim to enable early detection and containment of highly infectious diseases such as Ebola before community spread. This strengthens Ghana's frontline defence and border health security, with particular focus on Aflao, a major border post and transit corridor. Faster response and better coordination among health workers and agencies handling cross-border movements are expected, and prevent disease importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策を強化するため、ガーナ政府が最新式の国境保健施設を整備予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラへの準備態勢と予防対策を主題とした記事であり、実際の流行ではなく計画段階の報道。スクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露、流行性の可能性）は理論的に該当するが、情報不足と確実性の欠如により、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ流行ではなく、ガーナ政府による予防的施設整備計画を報道している。Aflaoは実在する国境都市（ガーナ・トーゴ境界）。エボラは高感染性疾患であり流行リスクは高いが、現在のところ流行は認識されていない。今後の実際の患者発生報告があれば即座にPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: OMS lança plano de 450 milhões de euros para travar surto de Ébola na RDC - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches a €450 million plan to curb an Ebola outbreak in the DRC - Renascença
article.articleSummary: WHO launches a €450 million plan to curb Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The outbreak has 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths. The plan, a joint WHO-Africa CDC response, totals USD 518 million for June–November 2026 to curb transmission, requiring urgent funding and political commitment to engage communities. Health authorities warn the epidemic is spreading faster, with late detection allowing the virus to outrun response efforts. The current outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya says it is the most severe Bundibugyo outbreak to date. Donors have pledged about USD 315.8 million so far, below the initially announced USD 498 million, with unclear allocation to the new plan. The Bundibugyo outbreak was announced May 15, and WHO later declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱拡大を抑制するため4億5000万ユーロの計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な健康被害、予想外のバンディブギョ型、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO公式の国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病(Ebola)のバンディブギョ型(Bundibugyo variant)による大規模な流行。381例の確定患者と62人の死亡が報告され、ワクチンや承認済み治療法が存在しない。WHOは5月にPHEIC(国際保健上の緊急事態)を宣言しており、国連機関による大規模な資金動員(5億1800万米ドル必要、現在までに3億1580万米ドルを受領)が実施されている。対象国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: بين حلم الثراء والخطر الصحي.. كيف ساعد الذهب على انتشار فيروس الإيبولا؟ |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Between the dream of wealth and the health risk: How did gold help spread the Ebola virus?
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in Mongbalu, a gold-mining town in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by mining-driven population movement. The World Health Organization reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths across 24 health zones. Investigations identify Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less-known strain with no approved treatment, as the driver; laboratory confirmation has improved. The outbreak likely began in February within mining camps and spread as miners and traders circulated between mining sites and border markets. Local officials estimate more than 80 deaths occurred before official recognition, with early estimates suggesting up to around 300 suspected fatalities. Challenges include community distrust, conspiracy theories about hospitals and NGOs, and absence of a licensed vaccine or effective therapy for Bundibugyo. Economic reliance on gold, with wages of 136–272 USD weekly, and mercury exposure heighten risk while complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: 富の夢と健康リスクの間で：金がエボラウイルスの拡大にどう役立ったのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例344例・死亡60例（推定300例）、未承認株Bundibugyo ebolavirus、国際国境地域での継続的な感染拡大リスク、医療対応の困難さ（ワクチンなし、治療法なし）が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ザイール種以外のエボラウイルス）の確認は稀であり、利用可能なワクチンがない点が特に懸念される。金鉱採掘を中心とした人口移動が主要な拡大要因であり、国境地域（Ituri Province）での継続的リスクが高い。コミュニティの不信感と陰謀論も対応を複雑化させている。WHOからの公式報告が確認されており、国際的支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心与世卫组织发布埃博拉应对计划 呼吁筹集5.18亿美元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC and WHO release an Ebola response plan, calling for US$518 million.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) response plan with US$518 million for June–November 2026 aims to unify action across Africa CDC and WHO, coordinating governments, partners and communities to strengthen emergency coordination, disease surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics and essential health services. The plan supplements national Ebola responses in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Community engagement is central; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasizes, ‘one plan, one budget, one team,’ and containment hinges on political commitment, sustained funding, and community trust and participation. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya calls for rapid, collective action to protect high-risk communities and translate commitments into concrete measures, with cross-border coordination and health system strengthening, given no licensed vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Ten priority countries will bolster preparedness to detect and respond early, while attention to monkeypox, cholera and measles continues.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCとWHOがエボラ対応計画を発表、5.18億米ドルの調達を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当：エボラは高い公衆衛生リスク、複数国での集団感染は異常、国際的な拡大リスク高、さらにWPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当。対象国DRCとウガンダでの活発な対応計画が策定されている
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダにおけるエボラウイルス疾患（EVD）対応計画について述べているが、ウガンダ（ID1235247）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。複数の疾患（エボラ、mpox、コレラ、麻疹）が言及されているが、主題はエボラ対応計画である。500万ドル超の国際的な資金調達と10カ国の事前対備強化が計画されており、管理可能性への懸念が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола выходит из-под контроля: ВОЗ готовит план на $580 млн -- Reuters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Out of Control: WHO Prepares Plan for $580 Million — Reuters
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). There are no vaccines or treatments certified or officially approved for this strain. The World Health Organization announced a six-month plan to curb transmission, with a funding target of $580 million. The current outbreak is the fourth-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The absence of validated countermeasures for Bundibugyo heightens risks to the population and places greater strain on health systems. Ebola virus disease is an acute hemorrhagic fever. The article notes the largest outbreak occurred in West Africa from 2014 to 2016, claiming more than 11,000 lives. Previously, campaigns relied on vaccines against specific strains (e.g., Zaire), but new mutations require adaptation of medical technologies.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが制御不能に：WHO 5億8000万ドル規模の計画を準備 — ロイター
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo株エボラの急速な感染拡大、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、WHO による大規模対応計画（5.8億ドル）が報告されている。史上4番目の大規模アウトブレイクであり、国際的脅威として高い優先度。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのBundibugyo株エボラの急速拡大が主題。Angolaは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー本文ではDRCのみが具体的な発生地として言及されているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ワクチン・治療法の欠如（既承認製剤がない）は重大なリスク要因。WHO による大規模資金調達計画（$580M）と6ヶ月計画が発表されており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: PAHO Steps Up Ebola Preparedness Across the Americas Amid Outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: PAHO strengthens Ebola preparedness across the Americas after WHO declares a PHEIC linked to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda (reported 4 June 2026). No cases have been detected in the Americas; risk remains low. PAHO activated its Incident Management System to coordinate readiness, focusing on rapid detection, isolation, and management of potential imported cases. It reinforces surveillance, laboratory capacity, IPC, and emergency coordination with national health ministries. GOARN-supported exchanges with MSF, Johns Hopkins, and Oxford cover clinical management, biosafety, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. Guidance on laboratory handling and distribution of Bundibugyo testing materials is underway, with PPE and diagnostic tools pre-positioned and Go.Data used for surveillance. The outbreak in the DRC and Uganda includes hundreds of confirmed cases; risk is high nationally, low globally. No vaccines or specific treatments exist for Bundibugyo; early detection and supportive care are critical. Travel/trade restrictions discouraged.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOがアフリカでの発生に伴いアメリカ大陸全域でエボラ出血熱の準備体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC/ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の発生は確認されたが、対象国（DRC）における詳細情報が限定的であり、WHOのPHEIC宣言と複数国への潜在的拡大リスクが存在するため、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC及びウガンダでのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の発生を報告し、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したことを示唆している。発生地域リストにはスペイン、カナリア諸島、ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダの発生である。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。IHR基準3つ以上、WPRO基準全て該当しているが、記事がPAHOの準備体制強化に焦点を当てており、アメリカ大陸での実際の患者数は0と明記されている。判定をWATCHとした理由は、DRCにおける具体的なケース数・流行の詳細情報が不十分であり、フルRRA前に追加情報の確認が望ましいため。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in der DR Kongo: Hilfsorganisation CARE warnt vor zunehmenden Engpässen bei medizinischer Ausstattung und Versorgung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: CARE warns of increasing shortages in medical equipment and care.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) continues with no vaccine or proven treatment. Health facilities face severe shortages of personal protective equipment, hygiene supplies, and diagnostic tools due to funding cuts; CARE DR Congo reports a 26% budget reduction, leaving about one‑third of national staff unfunded and weakening health education and Ebola prevention. Delays in shipping from Nairobi or Kampala, plus insecurity in Djugu, Irumu, and Mambasa, extend response times and heighten transmission risk. WHO reports more than 60% of suspected cases are women, who mainly provide care and are at higher risk; pregnant and lactating women face miscarriages, complications, and maternal mortality. Maternal health services are already strained by conflict, displacement, and misinformation. CARE calls for immediate, substantial increases in financial and technical support, including local and women‑led organizations, to reach communities and strengthen global health security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生：CARE が医療機器と供給の不足増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準 4/4 すべて該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の現在進行中の流行であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、医療体制の崩壊的状況、国際的拡大の懸念（WHO関与）、医療危機に伴う国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の継続的流行。東部DRCの複数地域（Djugu, Irumu, Mambasa）で発生。医療PPE・診断用具の深刻な不足、予算削減による対応能力の低下、セキュリティ上の課題が報告されている。女性の感染率が60%以上で、妊産婦への影響が特に懸念される。CARE等の国際NGOが資金・技術支援の大幅増額を要請。WHO関与が示唆されており、国際的スケールの対応が必要。Nairobi（Kenya）とKampala（Uganda）は物流拠点として言及されているが、実際の流行地はDRC内のみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO·아프리카CDC, 8천억원 규모 에볼라 공동 대응 나선다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC to launch a joint Ebola response worth 800 billion won.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint Ebola response plan worth $510.8 million (about 8 billion KRW) for six months through November to curb the Ebola outbreak in Africa. The plan coordinates emergency response, surveillance, diagnostics, infection prevention and control, clinical care, research, logistics, and health-service support across governments and partners. As of June 3, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reported 381 confirmed Ebola cases with 64 deaths; Uganda had 16 confirmed cases, including 1 death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the plan as pragmatic, built on lessons from prior outbreaks, and stressed the need for political will, sustained funding, and community trust to suppress transmission. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya noted that donor contributions for Ebola response total $310.58 million, below the previously announced $490.8 million, with no detailed allocation confirmed for the six-month plan.

triage.headline_ja: WHO・アフリカCDC、8000億円規模のエボラ共同対応に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者381名・死亡64名（DRC）を含む、複数国での流行が報告されており、IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当。国際的な公衆衛生危機として認識され、WHO・アフリカCDCによる大規模対応計画も立案されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は Bluedot API の発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは DRC の381確認患者・64死亡と比較して「16確認患者・1死亡」という限定的な報告のみ。対象国リストに Uganda が含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。エボラ感染症は既知の高リスク病原体であり、複数国での確認、高い死亡率、国際的対応計画の存在がフルRRA進行の根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Samarinda Waspada Kasus Tuberkulosis dan HIVAIDS Berpotensi Naik Signifikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Samarinda on Alert: Tuberculosis and HIV/AIDS Cases Could Rise Significantly.
article.articleSummary: Samarinda, East Kalimantan, Indonesia, with a population of about 850,000, faces a potential rise in Tuberculosis (TB) and HIV/AIDS in 2026. High urban density and mobility are identified as key drivers, while ongoing active case finding is bringing older, underreported TB cases to light and urban lifestyle among productive-age adults is linked to new HIV infections. To counter this, the city government is strengthening primary health services, mandating community health centers (Puskesmas) to deploy rapid molecular tests for TB to enable fast, accurate detection. Despite projected increases, officials view this as an early step toward eliminating TB and HIV by 2030. Prevention tips include improving home ventilation, wearing masks in crowds if coughing, ensuring complete BCG vaccination for infants; HIV patients will receive peer support and ARV adherence assistance.

triage.headline_ja: サマリンダ警戒：結核とHIV/AIDSの症例が大幅に増加する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIV/AIDSの潜在的な増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当するが、現在のところ実際の大規模流行や深刻な公衆衛生危機を示す具体的な数値がなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は予測的な警告レベルであり、現在の流行状況ではなく、潜在的なリスク上昇を述べている。東カリマンタン州サマリンダで結核とHIV/AIDSの症例増加が予想されており、都市密度と流動性が主要な推進要因と特定されている。地方自治体が対策を強化中（分子検査、コミュニティ保健サービスの充実など）。具体的な症例数や死亡数の報告がないため、現段階ではシグナルピックアップの閾値には達していない。続報で実際の症例増加が確認される場合はPICKUPに変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC launch $518M Ebola response plan amid 'fast-moving' outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has reached 397 confirmed cases and 63 deaths (case fatality risk ~15.9%), with more than 5,009 contacts under follow-up. The epicenter remains Ituri province, accounting for over 90% of cases and 70% of deaths, as the outbreak expands from one province and three health zones to three provinces and 26 affected health zones. Eleven countries are considered at risk as of the May 15 outbreak declaration. WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint $518 million preparedness and response plan for this year, under the motto 'one plan, one budget, one team', addressing emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention, clinical care, community engagement, research, and logistics. While partners pledged nearly $498 million, little has reached affected countries. Misinformation, insecurity, and high mobility hinder response; vaccines and treatments remain unavailable after nearly two decades.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカ疾病対策センターが『急速に拡大する』エボラ流行に対応して5億1800万ドル対応計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への極度の脅威、複数国への国際拡大リスク、11か国が危険リストに含まれるなど、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。さらにWPRO基準も複数該当し、世界的な公衆衛生上の最優先シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行は Democratic Republic of the Congo（DRC）のIturi州を震源地として発生している。感染確認397例、死亡63例、11か国が危険リストに含まれているが、DRCは対象国リスト内の唯一の発生国。WHO・アフリカCDCの5億1800万ドル対応計画は、この大規模流行への緊急対応を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Milwaukee health officials monitoring 3 who returned from Ebola-affected area
article.articleSummary: Three people who recently traveled from central Africa to Milwaukee are under monitoring for Ebola after the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak that has infected more than 1,000 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with additional cases in Uganda. Milwaukee Health Commissioner Mike Totoraitis said the travelers are at very low risk and pose no danger to the public; they are being contacted multiple times weekly and have not required further screening or medical care. The U.S. has implemented screening at four airports (Virginia, Atlanta, Houston, New York) for travelers from affected areas, and returning travelers are advised to monitor health for 21 days. The Bundibugyo strain is rare; initial surveillance missed it, contributing to spread. As of now, CDC counts 62 deaths in DRC and 1 in Uganda; the region faces conflict and mistrust, but the public risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: ミルウォーキーの保健当局が、エボラ感染地域から帰国した3人を監視中
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（1,000人以上感染、62人死亡）は重大だが、米国での事例は帰国旅行者の接触者追跡段階であり、地域の感染伝播リスクは低いと報告されている。対象国DRCで確認されているため情報追跡が必要だが、現段階では地域検証の対象外。
triage.notes: 発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、米国。対象国リストに含まれる国はDRC（203312）だが、記事の主題は米国での接触者監視であり、DRCでの進行中のアウトブレイク自体は詳細が限定的。DRC自体のアウトブレイク情報に基づくDRCのピックアップ判定は別途RRAが必要。本記事は米国の枠組みでの対応報告のため、対象国での実際の発生確認がサマリーの主題ではないと判断し、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Traditional healers on the frontline of the Ebola Fight in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo, declared May 15, 2026, centered in Ituri Province’s Bunia. 359 confirmed infections and 61 deaths reported to date. Health authorities note ongoing transmission amid significant mistrust in conflict-affected communities with limited access to care. Traditional healers, including Mariam Kabika, are increasingly involved on the front lines, running a “laboratory of the ancestors” in Bunia and using herbal remedies (eucalyptus, avocado, mango, papaya leaves) plus spiritual rituals. They claim benefits for Ebola patients, though remedies lack scientific validation. Authorities view traditional healers as key players in containment strategies to bridge gaps between communities and formal health services. The article highlights community resistance and care-delivery challenges in eastern DR Congo, without detailing infection sources or laboratory confirmation specifics beyond the reported counts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱との闘いの最前線に立つ伝統的治療者たち（コンゴ民主共和国）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性）。エボラアウトブレイクは優先度の高いシグナルである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の進行中のアウトブレイク。2026年5月15日に宣言され、359例の確認感染と61例の死亡が報告されている。紛争影響地域での社会的信頼の欠如、限定的なアクセス、伝統的治療者の関与など管理可能性に関する懸念がある。DRC対象国として verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Roysambu MP Aspirant Routes for Proactive Aproach in Combating Ebola Threat - Ghetto Radio
article.articleSummary: Kenya faces an Ebola threat with 25 counties at risk, including Nairobi, per the Ministry of Health (MoH). Roysambu MP aspirant for 2027, Hon. James Munene Thuku, urges a proactive nationwide response. He argues for nationwide quarantine facilities to isolate suspected cases, enable testing and confirmation, protect health workers, build public confidence, save lives, and reduce costs tied to knee jack reactions. Thuku warns against using hospital wards or private homes as isolation sites, saying such practices would worsen the situation. With cross-border risk from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo where Ebola cases and deaths have been reported, he questions the affordability of a US-style quarantine centre but emphasizes the need for institutional quarantine capacity. Thuku is a businessman and the chairman of Independent Thinkers Kenya (ITK).

triage.headline_ja: ロイサンブ下院議員候補、エボラ脅威対策への積極的アプローチを主張 - ゲットラジオ
triage.triage_reason: ケニアのエボラ脅威は IHR 基準を複数満たし（異常性・国際的拡大リスク），対象国 DRC での症例確認もあるが，記事は政治家の政策提言であり，実際の新規感染症イベント（患者数増加や疫学的な急変）の報告ではなく，確実な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は政治家の政策提言記事であり，具体的な患者数増加や疫学的急変の報告ではない。DRC での症例報告は明記されているが，ケニア自体での実際の患者発生の詳細は記載されていない。続報でイベントの具体的進展を追跡する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Budget von mehr als 500 Millionen Dollar benötigt - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Budget of more than $500 million needed.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC project a $518 million response budget for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with six-month actions from June to November. About $315 million has been pledged so far, but none disbursed. The plan strengthens surveillance, laboratory diagnostics, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, and logistics, and aims to bolster local health systems for rapid case detection. The outbreak—caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus—has grown to nearly 400 confirmed cases and 63 deaths; suspected cases exceed 100. Projections suggest up to 3,600 confirmed cases could emerge if unchecked. There are no specific vaccines, therapeutics, or rapid tests available for this virus. In mid-May, WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Authorities emphasize speed, coordination, and continent-led leadership, with neighboring countries on alert for importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行: 5億ドルを超える予算が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）による国際的公衆衛生緊急事態であり、DRCとウガンダで確認され、近隣国への拡大リスク、国際的な資金動員が必要な重大な危機。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCのみ対象国である。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による約400確定症例、63死亡、100以上の疑い症例を報告。有効なワクチン・治療薬・迅速診断法が利用不可。予防接種キャンペーンや治療体制強化の国際支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: OMS anuncia plano de US$ 518 milhões para conter Ebola e pede investimentos | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces US$518 million plan to contain Ebola and calls for investments | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, the World Health Organization unveiled a six-month plan worth US$518 million to contain Ebola, urging sustained funding and political commitment as the outbreak becomes the fourth largest on record. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized that containment requires political will, continuous financing, and community engagement. The African Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said the epidemic persisted for weeks undetected and is now behind schedule to control. To date, 381 Ebola virus disease cases and 62 deaths have been reported in the Congo, marking it as the fourth largest outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain is cited as particularly severe, with no approved treatments or vaccines. Donors have pledged US$315.8 million to contain the disease, below the initial US$498 million, though it is unclear whether funds will flow to the six-month plan. The Congo outbreak was declared a PHEIC on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱の封じ込めに5億1800万米ドルの計画を発表し、投資を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（4番目の規模）により、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO宣言のPHEIC指定、死亡例、資金不足の懸念から緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年6月のDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）におけるエボラ出血熱流行を主題としている。Bundibugyo株による4番目の大規模流行で、現在までに381例、死亡62例が報告されており、2026年5月15日にPHEICが宣言されている。治療法やワクチンが確立されていない点で重症度が高い。資金調達の課題も指摘されており、国際的支援が極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Launches $518M Plan to Curb Africa Ebola Outbreak | Finance News
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization launches a $518 million six-month plan to curb Ebola outbreaks in Africa, focusing on the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, with preparedness measures for other countries including border screening. As of June 5, 2026, Congo has 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths; Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine, and is described as the most serious Bundibugyo outbreak to date. Donors pledged about $315.8 million toward the response; overall funding had been revised from an initial $498 million. Congo’s outbreak was declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, and the WHO soon after declared a public health emergency of international concern. Testing for Bundibugyo has been challenging, with initial tests failing to detect it and results delaying several days to a week, plus security issues including attacks on burial teams and treatment centers, and UN armoured support.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制するため5億1800万ドルの計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の危機であり、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みの重大事象である。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（1269750）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを計上。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、治療法・ワクチンなし、PHEC宣言済み、セキュリティ問題（埋葬チーム・治療センターへの攻撃）も報告されている。国際的な支援体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda reports 3 new Ebola cases, total rises to 19
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda: On June 5, 2026, Uganda confirmed three new Ebola cases, bringing the outbreak total to 19 since it was declared on May 15. The three new cases are contacts of previously confirmed patients and had been in institutional quarantine. One new death was reported, bringing fatalities to two. Of the 19 confirmed cases, 13 are currently under treatment, four have recovered and been discharged, and two have died.
