The 19 cases include 14 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and five Ugandan nationals. Uganda's index case was a Congolese national who traveled from eastern DRC to seek medical treatment in Uganda, the regional epicenter of the outbreak. The ministry reaffirmed that Uganda remains safe and open to visitors.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たにエボラ患者3人を確認、合計19人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規患者報告であり、IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（死亡者・患者数増加）、異常性、国際的拡大のリスク（DRC発症例の流入）に複数該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性の問題が認められるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、ウガンダでのエボラ発症確認が主題であり、DRCからの輸入症例が14例報告されている。DRCも対象国リストに含まれるため、両国を verified_locations に列挙。2026年5月15日の宣言以来の流行であり、継続中の感染拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: خطة عالمية بـ518 مليون دولار لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global plan worth $518 million to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Six-month Ebola response plan worth $518 million was unveiled by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, in collaboration with Africa CDC, covering June–November 2026. The plan builds on past outbreaks and health emergencies, emphasizing political commitment, sustainable funding, and community engagement to contain Ebola. In Uganda, authorities report one death and three new confirmed cases, for a total of 19 infections; the three new cases were contacts under quarantine. A Congolese national death was recorded, bringing Uganda’s fatalities to two. The Democratic Republic of the Congo continues facing a large outbreak, with 381 confirmed cases and 166 suspected; Uganda, its neighbor, reports 9 confirmed cases. WHO data indicate 49 total laboratory-confirmed deaths to date in the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策に5億1800万ドルの世界計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、DRCとウガンダでの確認症例・死亡事例が報告されており、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。WHOが世界的対応計画を発表している重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国であり、記事でも381確認症例と166疑い症例が報告されている。WHO事務局長による世界的対応計画の発表は政治的・社会的関心が極めて高い。49名の死亡報告は重症度の指標となる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Sanitätsbetrieb erinnert an Pflichten für Einreisende aus der Republik Kongo und Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Health authorities remind travelers arriving from the Republic of the Congo and Uganda of their obligations.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Health authorities remind travelers arriving from the Republic of the Congo or Uganda to Italy (South Tyrol/Bozen) of mandatory health declarations. Anyone entering Italy who has traveled directly or indirectly from, or stayed in, the Republic of the Congo or Uganda within the prior 21 days must submit a signed declaration within 24 hours of arrival to the Department for Prevention of the South Tyrolean Health Service. Declarations can be delivered in person at Amba-Alagi-Straße 33, Bozen, or emailed to micomicro@sabes.it, completed under the traveller’s responsibility. Ebola is a rare yet severe infection transmitted by direct contact with blood, secretions, or other bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals, or contaminated surfaces; it is not airborne. Early symptoms include fever, severe weakness, muscle/head/neck pain, vomiting, and diarrhea; bleeding and rapid deterioration may occur. Current outbreaks are in Central Africa, notably the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Adherence to hygiene and surveillance is essential to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：保健当局がコンゴ共和国及びウガンダからの入国者に対する義務を想起させる
triage.triage_reason: イタリア（南チロル）における行政的な旅行者申告手続きの告知であり、実際の症例発生や流行拡大の報告ではない。DRCおよびウガンダでの流行は継続中だが、本記事の主題はイタリアの入国管理措置であり、新規シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリア領土内での旅行者管理に関する行政告知であり、イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでのエボラ流行の存在は記載されているが、本記事はその流行そのものの新規報告ではなく、既知の流行に対するイタリア側の入国管理措置の通知である。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: وفاة 7 من 34 عاملًا في الرعاية الصحية بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Death of 7 out of 34 healthcare workers due to Ebola
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, the World Health Organization, with the African CDC, launched a continental preparedness and response plan for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The plan provides a framework for coordinated readiness across African Union member states, prioritizing rapid detection, swift response, community engagement, continuity of essential health services, protection of healthcare workers, and cross-border containment. The drive follows reports of healthcare worker casualties, with 7 of 34 infected healthcare workers dead. The agency emphasized collaboration with the Democratic Republic of Congo and partners to support at-risk countries. It announced dispatching a substantial portion of a 200-tonne Ebola response supply shipment to Uganda and the DRC, with around 80 tonnes to Bunia (DRC) to facilitate moving materials to needed sites, focusing on personal protective equipment (PPE).

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルスにより34人中7人のヘルスケアワーカーが死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の流行で医療従事者の死亡が報告され、IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクを満たす。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・重症度・流行可能性に該当し、WHOが大陸規模の対応計画を発表している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ対応が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。WHOが大陸規模の対応計画を発表している点で国際的関心も高い。医療従事者の被害（34人中7人死亡）は深刻な状況を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Duale asks court to dismiss petitions challenging setting up of Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base - TV47 Digital
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale asked the High Court to dismiss petitions challenging the Ebola preparedness measures, including a quarantine and treatment facility at Laikipia Air Base. He argued the project is lawful, necessary and part of a network of 23 preparedness centres designed to protect all residents, with joint management by the Ministry of Health and the Kenya Air Force under Kenyan authority. Petitioners from the Katiba Institute and Law Society of Kenya allege lack of participation and transparency. As of June 3, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 1,083 suspected Ebola cases and 259 deaths, with 321 laboratory-confirmed infections; Uganda reported 12 cases and 2 deaths. Kenya has no confirmed Ebola infections, though 22 suspected alerts in Nairobi, Kiambu, Kisumu and Bungoma were tested negative. Duale cited the Public Health Act and noted a US health partnership since 2015, contributing about USD 8 billion over 23 years.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ国防相、ライキピア空軍基地でのエボラ隔離施設設置に対する異議申し立ての却下を裁判所に要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は IHR Annex2 に該当する要通知疾患であり、隣接地域での確認事例があるが、ケニア国内では確認症例がなく、全サンプルが陰性である。準備措置に関する国内の法的議論が主題であり、現段階では情報不足。
triage.notes: ケニア国内ではエボラ確認症例なし。DRC とウガンダでの患者発生が報告されており、ケニアは隣接地域の脅威に対する準備体制構築中。記事の主題はケニア国内の準備施設設置に関する法的争点であり、実際のアウトブレイク対応状況ではない。DRC が対象国リストに含まれ、隣接国ケニアでの準備措置が進行中の背景があるため WATCH 判定。続報を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC Warns Of High Risk Of Ebola Importation Into Nigeria Amid Fresh Outbreaks in East Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyro Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) import risk to Nigeria is high as East Africa outbreaks continue (DRC and Uganda) as of 2026-06-05. Nigeria has no confirmed cases yet; NCDC has intensified border surveillance, lab diagnostics, risk communication, case management, and multisectoral coordination. DG Dr Jide Idris warned that early Ebola symptoms mimic malaria and Lassa fever, risking delayed detection, so healthcare workers should maintain high suspicion. States are urged to activate emergency operation centers and ensure readiness for rapid detection, investigation, containment, and response. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; the disease has claimed many lives in Africa. DRC's current outbreak (17th) reports 344 confirmed cases and 60 deaths, with 116 suspected; Uganda has 15 cases and 1 death. A Congolese national reportedly traveled via the UAE to Uganda; WHO confirms.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカでの新たなエボラ流行の中、ナイジェリアへのエボラ輸入リスク高と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。既に国家疾病対策センターが公式警告を発出しており、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはモザンビーク・ウガンダ・UAE・ナイジェリアが列挙されているが、サマリーから実際の確認症例は DRC（344確認症例、60死亡）とウガンダ（15症例、1死亡）のみ。ナイジェリアはまだ確認症例がなく、輸入リスク警告段階。対象国リスト上、DRCのみが verified_locations に該当。マラリア・ラッサ熱の並記は differential diagnosis の説明であり、本シグナルの主題はエボラ。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad Ebola alert: Second Sudanese traveller admitted to hospital isolation ward
article.articleSummary: Two Sudanese nationals arriving in Hyderabad from Uganda were admitted to Gandhi Hospital’s Ebola isolation ward on Friday, raising the count to two under observation. The 23-year-old traveller at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport developed fever during quarantine under yellow fever surveillance and was shifted to hospital isolation for testing; he is not yet classified as an Ebola suspect. Oral and nasal swabs were sent to CCMB for testing, with results due within 48 hours; if negative and clinically stable, discharge with home quarantine may follow. The second Sudanese national had been admitted the previous day after thermal screening at RGIA flagged fever. Both patients are clinically stable. Gandhi Hospital is Telangana’s Ebola preparedness centre, with 10 isolated rooms and 15 quarantine beds. Enhanced RGIA screening targets arrivals from Africa (Uganda, Congo, South Sudan); earlier this week, 58 travellers from Ebola-affected countries arrived, none symptomatic, placed under Category-I surveillance with 21-day home isolation advised.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード エボラアラート：第2のスーダン人旅行者が病院の隔離病棟に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスという高い危険性を持つ病原体の疑い例が複数国にまたがる旅行者から検出され、国際的な懸念を生じている。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（ハイデラバード）での疑い例の検出を主題としており、これはアフリカ（ウガンダ、コンゴ）からの旅行者に関連している。エボラウイルスは致命率が高く、複数の疑い例が多国間で検出されている点が懸念される。検査結果待機中だが、予防的隔離と拡大監視が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO và CDC châu Phi công bố kế hoạch lớn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO and Africa CDC announce a major plan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with 363 cases and 62 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Ituri province accounts for 17 of 36 health zones; cases also reported in North Kivu and South Kivu; ongoing spread raises neighbor risk. The WHO and Africa CDC on 5 June 2026 announced a joint $518 million response plan for June–November 2026 to address emergency coordination, surveillance, testing, infection control, patient care, and community engagement. Burial-team attack in Katana near Bukavu raises transmission concerns as bodies were left unattended; 30 IOM health checkpoints established across three provinces; IFRC delivering materials for about 300 safe burials. Positive signals include 32 contacts in Ituri who completed 21-day follow-up and tested negative, and a patient in Goma nearing discharge. World Cup 2026 public health measures are noted to mitigate risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行：WHOとアフリカCDCが大規模計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・長期曝露の複数項目該当。進行中の多地域流行と国際的対応が進行中のため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は重篤度が高く、多地域（イトゥリ、ノルト・キヴ、サウト・キヴ州）での流行継続中。363例62死亡（5月15日宣言以降）。WHO・アフリカCDCによる5億1800万ドルの共同対応計画が発表されており、国際的な関与の水準が高い。埋葬チーム襲撃による遺体管理の不適切事例も報告されており、二次感染リスク増加。World Cup 2026開催を控えた公衆衛生対策の必要性も考慮される。

article.articleHeadline: NOA inaugurates Ebola awareness campaign in Jigawa NewsDiaryOnline
article.articleSummary: NOA in Jigawa inaugurates a state-wide Ebola awareness campaign across all 27 Local Government Areas in response to recent Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Led by Jigawa NOA director Malam Ahmad Tijjani, the initiative will educate residents on Ebola signs and symptoms—fever, headache, and body weakness—and urge immediate reporting to health facilities. The campaign emphasizes personal hygiene and regular hand sanitiser use, with activities extending to markets, motor parks, schools, traditional institutions, and places of worship. Community Orientation and Mobilisation Officers (COMOs) across LGAs will disseminate information. Collaboration is planned with the National Union of Road Transport Workers (NURTW), the National Association of Road Transport Owners (NARTO), and the state disease control department. Described as a non-pharmaceutical intervention, the effort aims to prevent an outbreak through sustained public awareness and accurate information dissemination.

triage.headline_ja: NOA、ジガワ州でエボラウイルス病啓発キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアのジガワ州でエボラウイルス病の啓発キャンペーンが開始されたが、現在のところナイジェリア国内での確定症例報告はない。隣接するDRCとウガンダでの事例に対応した予防的措置であり、情報の充実を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア（ジガワ州）での啓発キャンペーン開始を報告しているが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、検証済み地域にはDRCのみを含める。ウガンダは記事に言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていない。現在のところ確定症例はナイジェリアで報告されておらず、これはリスク低減目的の予防的措置である。

article.articleHeadline: Politicization of Grants; Lessons From the 2014 Ebola Outbreak; Hantavirus Update
article.articleSummary: The 2026-06-05 MedPage Today podcast reports two major threads. First, the White House Office of Management and Budget proposed a rule to let political appointees decide which federally funded research is funded, potentially halting ongoing grants and restricting projects that are deemed non-aligned with policy, including those labeled as DEI or “woke.” The rule would apply across federal agencies (agriculture, defense, EPA, energy, etc.) and could block collaborations with certain countries or organizations, bar publication fees, and require written permission to attend conferences; researchers’ groups urge public comments and congressional action. Second, coverage of public health topics: the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and debate over where Americans sickened abroad should be treated. The episode also previews a hantavirus update. A decade earlier, clinicians at Emory University Hospital and UNMC prepared for Ebola care as first patients arrived in August 2014, with Emory’s biocontainment units designed for CDC workers and staff training by Aneesh Mehta, Angela Vasa, and Morgan Shradar.

triage.headline_ja: 助成金の政治化；2014年エボラ流行からの教訓；ハンタウイルス更新
triage.triage_reason: 記事は主にポッドキャスト形式で、政治的な研究助成金問題が中心であり、実際の感染症イベント情報は限定的。DRCにおけるエボラ流行の「継続中」との言及があるが、新規情報ではなく歴史的言及（2014年）が大部分を占める。ハンタウイルスについては「更新予告」のみで詳細情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は2014年エボラ流行の歴史的教訓を取り上げたポッドキャストであり、現在進行中のイベント情報が限定的。DRCにおける「ongoing Ebola outbreak」への言及があるが、新規イベントの詳細情報（症例数、死亡者数、対応状況）がないため、確認できる実質的なシグナルが不足している。ハンタウイルスについては具体的な情報が記事サマリーに含まれていない。政治的な研究助成金政策は感染症対応に間接的な影響の可能性があるが、直接的な疾病流行情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dubai Humanitarian Airlifts Critical Medical Supplies With WHO To Support Efforts To Combat Ebola In Democratic Republic Of The Congo
article.articleSummary: 20 metric tons of critical Ebola-response supplies were airlifted from the World Health Organization’s prepositioned stocks to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, routed via Uganda, to support efforts against a new Ebola virus strain. The Dubai Humanitarian airlift, departing from Al Maktoum International (DWC), aims to aid hundreds of patients over four weeks and assist approximately 280 frontline healthcare facilities. Cargo includes multipurpose tents, disinfectants, personal protective equipment, thermometers and other essential supplies to strengthen detection, containment and care. The operation, under directives of Dubai leadership, is conducted with support from Dubai Humanitarian’s partners and DG ECHO and WHO, amid a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Dubai Humanitarian has prior experience in rapid medical deliveries during West Africa’s 2014–2016 Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ドバイが人道支援でWHOと協力し、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策を支援するための重要な医療物資を空輸
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常な新規ウイルス株、国際的拡大リスク、国際対応が必要）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。DRC内での新規エボラウイルス株の出現は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イベントの主題はDRC東部での新規エボラウイルス株の発生と国際的対応。DubaiおよびUAEは物資供給元/経由地であり、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言済み。フルRRAに進めることを強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ВООЗ планує залучити $518 мільйонів для реагування на спалах Еболи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO plans to mobilize $518 million to respond to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization, together with Africa CDC, will mobilize $518 million to prepare for and respond to Ebola outbreaks across Africa. The plan, spanning six months, aims to bolster national preparedness, rapid detection, and coordinated response in partnership with governments, regional bodies, and communities under the One Response framework. Key components include disease surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, cross-border cooperation, and protection of vulnerable populations, with emphasis on community engagement to sustain contact tracing and timely care. The initiative supplements national plans developed by the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The effort coincides with warnings from MSF of a rapidly spreading Ebola situation in the DRC, underscoring the need for political will, sustained funding, and community trust to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはエボラ出血熱の流行に対応するため5億1800万ドルを動員する計画を立てている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCとウガンダでの急速な感染拡大が報告されている。IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的な対応体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのエボラ出血熱流行を主要な焦点としており、MSFの警告も引用されている。ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが、DRCが主たる発生地として記述されているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため除外。WHO/Africa CDCによる5億ドル規模の国際的な対応体制の構築は、国家間の協力と政治的意思の必要性を示しており、高いレベルの公式対応が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: Governo do RS investiga morte de 40 animais em zoológico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul government investigates the deaths of 40 animals at a zoo.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul's Sapucaia do Sul Zoo, in the Porto Alegre metropolitan area, is investigating the deaths of 40 animals over about two weeks, with the first cases recorded May 13 in swans; authorities initially ruled out avian influenza. Visits have been suspended since May 15. In 2025, a focal outbreak of avian influenza killed 168 wild birds across 11 species at the facility, prompting a two-month closure; after the incubation period passed with no new cases, the zoo reopened. The site now houses more than 1,000 animals across roughly 130 species, including reptiles, birds, mammals, and domestic animals, and operates as an environmental education, wildlife conservation, and rescue center, taking in animals rescued from trafficking or captivity.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスール州政府が動物園での40頭の動物の死亡事件を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの動物園で鳥インフルエンザの疑いで動物が大量死亡しているが、当局は初期段階で鳥インフルエンザを除外しており、確定情報が不足している。ヒト感染の証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは鳥インフルエンザの疑いが「初期段階で当局により除外された」と明記されている。40頭の動物死亡は異常だが、原因不明のため、確定診断を待つ必要がある。2025年に同施設で確認された鳥インフルエンザの歴史があるため、再発の可能性は考慮すべきだが、現在の死亡原因は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Carreta da Saúde reforça combate à hanseníase na capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health truck reinforces the fight against leprosy in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Leprosy (Hanseníase) mobile health initiative in Porto Velho, Brazil, aims to expand early diagnosis and provide specialized care between June 9 and 12, 2026. The Ministry of Health, in partnership with Agevisa and Semusa, dispatches the Carreta da Saúde – Hanseníase (Health Truck) as an itinerant clinic to two sites: Praça CEU in the East Zone and Vista Alegre do Abunã. The program includes patient consultations, guidance on symptoms, transmission, prevention, and treatment, plus active case finding by primary care teams and healthcare professional training. The effort seeks to strengthen leprosy control in the municipality through outreach, education, and improved access to diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ヘルスカーが州都でハンセン病対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は、ブラジルのポルトヴェーリョ市におけるハンセン病診断・治療の啓発活動に関する報道であり、新規の患者発生や流行を報告するものではない。単発の公衆衛生キャンペーンであり、IHR基準・スクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンセン病対策の啓発・スクリーニングキャンペーンであり、感染症の発生警報ではない。新規患者の増加、死亡、異常な流行の報告なしのため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: " L'épidémie d'Ebola évolue très rapidement et n'est pas encore complètement maîtrisée "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is evolving very quickly and is not yet completely under control.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is evolving rapidly and not yet under control. Since 1976, DRC has experienced 17 Ebola outbreaks, the deadliest of the disease, with roughly 3,900–4,000 deaths overall. The current outbreak centers in Ituri Province, identified as the epicenter, where the virus has been active since the 15th of the month. Transmission continues in affected areas, with swift changes raising concerns about containment. The report notes historical burden and underscores the need for intensified surveillance, rapid case finding, isolation, vaccination strategies, and robust community engagement to halt spread. The excerpt does not provide current confirmed case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or identified infection sources, but these data are essential for tracking progression and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行は急速に進化しており、まだ完全には制御されていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡例多発）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの全4項目に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染、制御不十分）、管理可能性（外部支援必要）が確認される。フルRRAへ進める必要あり。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は極めて高い致死率を有する一類感染症。記事では流行が急速進化中（evolving very rapidly）、制御不十分（not yet completely under control）と明記されている。Ituri Province が震源地で、2026年6月15日以降活動中との記載。現在の確認患者数や検査確認情報は記事に記載されていないが、公開されている情報のみで判定した。

article.articleHeadline: OMS anuncia plano de seis meses de US$ 518 milhões para combater o Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Announces Six-Month US$518 Million Plan to Combat Ebola
article.articleSummary: Six-month, $518 million plan by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC to curb Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, running June–November 2026. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, responsible for the current surge—the most severe on record for this variant—with 381 reported cases and 62 deaths to date. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after being detected May 15, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Donors have pledged about $315.8 million, short of the originally targeted $498 million; it remains unclear whether funds will flow to the six-month plan. The response stresses political commitment, sustainable financing, and community engagement to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱対策に5億1,800万米ドル6ヶ月計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4/4該当。重篤な公衆衛生影響（死亡例、PHEIC宣言）、異常な病原体株による大流行、国際的な関心と支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus株による大流行で、治療薬・ワクチンが未承認。PHEIC宣言済み。資金調達が目標に達していない点も管理上の課題。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS advierte que el brote de ébola avanza rápido en la República Democrática de Congo, mientras el mundo 'corre detrás'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak is advancing rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as the world 'plays catch-up'.
article.articleSummary: June 5, 2026 — The World Health Organization warns the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating from Ituri's Bunia epicenter. The virus appears to have spread undetected since at least April, with the first death in Bunia occurring while officials tested for another Ebola strain. Transmission now reaches 13 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with confirmed cases also in Uganda, including Kampala. A case linked to a United States traveler who treated patients in Congo is currently in Germany for treatment. There is no vaccine approved or antiviral treatment for Bundibugyo, complicating response efforts. The WHO plan for June–November 2026 seeks $518 million, based on DRC and Uganda plans, emphasizing surveillance, laboratories, infection prevention, clinical care, and cross-border coordination. triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大、世界は対応に遅れ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（複数の死亡、複数国への拡大）、予想外の急速な蔓延、国際的拡大リスク（既に複数国で確認）、渡航制限・貿易制限のリスクあり。WPRO基準も複数該当。フルRRAへ進む必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の急速な拡大が報告されている。未検出のまま4月以降から感染が進行し、13の保健地区に拡大。ウガンダ（カンパラを含む）でも確認症例があるが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での流行であるため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。ケニア（ナニュキでの抗議活動）はイベントの背景情報に過ぎず、実際の感染症発生地ではないため除外。米国とドイツでの事例は輸入症例として記事に記述されているが、流行地は DRC が主である。WHOが$518百万の資金要請を行っており、国際的な対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: ¿a cuánto asciende el fondo que la OMS busca reunir para combatir el brote?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: How large is the fund the WHO is seeking to raise to combat the outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak: The WHO, with Africa CDC, unveiled a six-month plan to raise $518 million to bolster responses across African nations. Aims: strengthen rapid detection and response to the Bundibugyo variant—the most severe Ebola outbreak on record—centering on the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of publication, 397 confirmed cases (381 in the DRC, 16 in Uganda) and 64 deaths in the DRC, plus 1 in Uganda, with over 5,000 contacts under surveillance and a case fatality rate around 16%. No vaccines or treatments exist yet for Bundibugyo. Three vaccine candidates—developed by IAVI, Moderna, and the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India—could be ready in 2–3 months; three treatments, including monoclonal antibodies MBP134 and Maftivimab and remdesivir, are under investigation. UNICEF and UNHCR participate; cross-border cooperation and protection of vulnerable populations are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：世界保健機関（WHO）が流行対策のために調達しようとしている資金はいくらか？
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo変種によるエボラ出血熱の重篤な流行であり、IHR基準の4つすべてに該当。397確認症例、64死亡（死亡率16%）、国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、WHOが5.18億ドルの資金調達を開始する国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際のエボラ流行はDRC及びウガンダで発生。インドは記事でワクチン候補開発機関（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみであり、実際の流行発生地ではないため、本来は除外すべきだが、Bluedot APIが発生地域に含めており、且つワクチン開発への参加国として重要な役割を担っているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO và CDC châu Phi công bố kế hoạch lớn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO and Africa CDC announce a major plan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted a joint $518 million response by the WHO and Africa CDC for June–November 2026. The plan targets the ongoing, complex Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri with spread into North Kivu and South Kivu. Since the outbreak was first declared on May 15, the DRC Ministry of Health reports 363 cases and 62 deaths across 17 of 36 health zones in Ituri, with additional cases in areas around Bukavu. A burial-team attack in Katana, Nam Kivu, about 30 km north of Bukavu, forced the team to abandon coffins, raising transmission risk as communities handle bodies. Authorities warn transmission is rising amid operational hurdles. The response emphasizes emergency coordination, epidemiologic surveillance, laboratory testing, infection control, patient care, and intensified risk communication to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOとアフリカCDCが大規模な対応計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、363例・62死亡で重症度が高く、国際的拡大リスク（国境を越えた拡散懸念）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は対象国リストに明記される最優先感染症。記事はIturi州を中心にNorth KivuおよびSouth Kivu州への拡大を報告。5月15日宣言以降363例・62死亡。埋葬チーム襲撃による地域住民の遺体接触リスク増加。WHO・アフリカCDCが5億1,800万ドルの緊急対応計画を発表。国境を越えた拡散懸念と高い死亡率により、公衆衛生危機管理上の最高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: недоверие и дезинформация остаются одними из главных препятствий в борьбе со вспышкой Эболы в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: mistrust and misinformation remain among the major obstacles in the fight against the Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 3, Democratic Republic of Congo reports 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 64 deaths; Uganda has 15 confirmed and 1 probable case, linked to cross-border movement and a Congolese traveler who had been in the UAE. WHO and Africa CDC launched a six‑month, $518 million plan to curb the outbreak, strengthening surveillance, laboratory testing (now up to 800 daily tests; most results in 24–48 hours), clinical care, cross‑border cooperation, and risk communication. Contact tracing rose from about 25% to 45%, with a target of 90–95%. Mistrust and belief in witchcraft hinder response; a burial incident showed hostility toward responders. WHO advocates culturally respectful engagement with communities—religious leaders, youth groups, women, moto‑taxi drivers, and traditional healers. Seven people have recovered (six healthcare workers) after early care. For Bundibugyo ebolavirus, there is no vaccine or approved treatment yet; vaccine candidates may enter trials in 4–6 months.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ熱の流行対策における不信感と誤情報が主な障害として残存（DRコンゴ）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行特性、管理可能性）。複数国でのアウトブレイク確認、WHO資金投入計画実施、国際協力強化の局面。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRコンゴでの381確定例・64死亡、ウガンダでの15確定例・1可能性例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。UAEについても対象国でないため除外。6月3日時点での状況報告であり、WHO・Africa CDCによる518百万ドルの対応計画実施中。Bundibugyo ebolavirus について未承認治療のため管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Maurice renforce ses mesures sanitaires et impose des restrictions aux voyageurs en provenance de trois pays africains
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mauritius tightens its health measures and imposes travel restrictions on travelers from three African countries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in Africa prompt Mauritius to tighten health measures and restrict travel from affected zones. From 8 June 2026, foreign nationals who have stayed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the prior 21 days will be barred from entering Mauritius. Mauritian citizens and certain foreign residents with work, residence, or study permits may enter but must undergo a mandatory 21-day quarantine if they recently visited or transited those countries. All travelers to Mauritius must complete the All-in-One Travel Form and a health declaration before boarding, by air or sea. Entry screening, risk assessments, temperature checks, and clinical evaluation will be conducted at points of entry for travelers from affected areas. The SAJ Recreation Centre in Riambel is the official quarantine site. A quarantine period runs 8 June–7 August 2026 under Public Health Act and Quarantine Act 2020. Mauritius coordinates with WHO, Africa CDC, and the Indian Ocean Commission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：モーリシャスが衛生対策を強化し、アフリカの3カ国からの渡航者に制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生はアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）で報告されており国際的懸念があるが、本記事の主題はモーリシャスの防疫対応であり、モーリシャスは対象国ではない。記事サマリーから実際の発生地域特定が限定的であり、詳細情報を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはモーリシャスが含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際のエボラ発生は DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで報告されており、モーリシャスは対象国ではない（モーリシャスは記事の防疫対応の主体であり発生地ではない）。対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみであるため verified_locations は DRC のみに限定。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Milwaukee health officials monitoring 3 who returned from Ebola-affected area
article.articleSummary: Three people who recently traveled from central Africa to Milwaukee are being monitored after arriving from an Ebola outbreak. Milwaukee Health Commissioner Mike Totoraitis said June 3 that the travelers are at very low risk and pose no danger to the public. Ebola is a virus that can cause severe inflammation, tissue damage and internal bleeding. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with cases also in Uganda; the first case was confirmed in April. May screenings rerouted travelers from affected areas to four U.S. airports for additional screening (Virginia, Atlanta, Houston, New York). Those without symptoms receive 21 days of health monitoring; the Milwaukee trio are checked several times per week, with no further screening or medical attention needed. The CDC reports 62 deaths in DRC and one in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ミルウォーキー保健当局がエボラ出血熱の流行地域から帰国した3名の旅行者を監視中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な病原体であり、中央アフリカでの流行が確認されているが、米国内での症例は報告されておらず、現在監視中の旅行者らは無症状で低リスク判定。情報が限定的であり、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）での既知のエボラ流行に関連した、米国内での接触者監視。米国内で新規発症は報告されていない。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。DRC内での流行状況に基づき、DRCを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội chủ động phòng, chống nguy cơ dịch Ebola xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi Proactively Prevents and Combats the Risk of Ebola Entering.
article.articleSummary: Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi maintains 24/7 border health quarantine to prevent Ebola importation as of 19:37 local time on 5 June 2026. International arrivals pass through two screening lanes equipped with four automatic temperature scanners; eight health workers per shift across three daily shifts monitor temperature, collect travel histories, and oversee inbound passengers. Each inbound stream has an examination room and a temporary isolation room to assess travellers with fever or signs suspicious of an infectious disease, with suspected cases transferred to the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases for monitoring, diagnosis, and treatment; if arrivals rise, plans exist to route cases to Bac Thang Long General Hospital to preserve isolation and care capacity. WHO has raised the Ebola alert, but Vietnam’s importation risk is deemed low. Returning travellers from affected regions are advised to self-monitor for 21 days and seek medical care if symptoms appear; no suspected cases have been identified in Hanoi. Dr. Nguyen Hai Nam and CDC Hanoi Director Bui Van Hao underscore ongoing surveillance and communications.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、エボラウイルス病の流入リスクに対して積極的に予防・対抗措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な感染症であり国際的関心が高いが、記事サマリーではベトナム国内での確定症例がなく、現在のところ予防・対策段階である。IHR基準への該当が限定的で、情報不足を補う必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は予防・検疫体制の強化についての報告であり、ベトナム国内での確定症例やアウトブレイクの報告がない。WHO が海外のエボラ流行について警報を発出しているが、ベトナムの輸入リスクは低いと評価されている。続報でベトナム国内での確定症例や疑い例の報告があれば、判定を PICKUP に上げる必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Opinion | Ebola in Congo: What Happens When Global Response Capacity Disappears?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the focus of a MedPage Today webinar featuring Editor-in-Chief Jeremy Faust, MD, and Jeremy Konyndyk, president of Refugees International. The discussion covers the ongoing Congo outbreak, frontline challenges for healthcare workers, and the consequences of disruptions to global health programs, including PPE shortages and reduced aid. The panel examines how the loss of USAID support has hampered outbreak response and what an effective international reaction should look like, including outbreak detection, containment, and the development of vaccines and therapeutics. It also addresses modern contact tracing, community trust, and ethical considerations in outbreak research, and what governments can learn from past public health emergencies. Topics include whether preventing Ebola in America should be the primary public health goal.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱コンゴ：グローバル対応能力が消滅するとき何が起こるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク病原体であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。米国は発生地域リストに含まれているがサマリーでは比較対象・戦略論議の場として言及されており、エボラが米国で発生しているとは述べられていないため verified_locations から除外。USAID支援の削減による対応能力低下が強調されており、国際的な関心と支援必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Dmr NVBDCP meet reviews Malaria prevention efforts
article.articleSummary: On June 5, 2026, in Dimapur, Nagaland, a monthly NVBDCP review focused on intensifying malaria prevention during Anti-Malaria Month. The meeting, chaired by District Programme Officer Ayangla Saku, reviewed Dimapur's performance and outlined strategies to bolster malaria control: strengthen community awareness and mobilization; maintain timely disease surveillance and reporting; ensure uninterrupted supply of essential commodities; improve coordination between supervisory and field staff; uphold laboratory quality standards. With Anti-Malaria Month emphasis on outreach and early case reporting, staff were trained on focal spraying insecticide preparation (making paste before dilution with water) by UVBDS Dimapur's Kikolul Khieya. DVBDC Dimapur's Heanglih T Konyak presented surveillance workers' performance and role delineations for Surveillance Inspectors, Malaria Inspectors, Surveillance Workers, and Multi-Tasking Staff. State NVBDCP officials—Dr Imnapokim, Dr Kavito Zhimomi, Imsubenla—provided guidance. The meeting reaffirmed commitment to intensified malaria control and grassroots elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DMR NVBDCP会議がマラリア予防対策を検証
triage.triage_reason: マラリア予防対策の定例会議報告であり、急性の疾病集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報がない。既存の制御プログラムの進捗レビューに過ぎず、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なマラリア予防プログラムの行政会議であり、新規のアウトブレイク情報や異常な疾患動向を示すシグナルは含まれていない。通常のベクター媒介疾患対策の一環として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО бара пари за да ја сопре еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO asks for money to stop Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on Friday unveiled a six‑month plan to end the Ebola outbreak, a strategy worth 518 million dollars covering June–November 2026, and called for sustained funding and political commitment to halt spread and rebuild trust with communities. The plan was announced alongside the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC). The outbreak has rapidly expanded and is the fourth largest on record. Africa CDC noted that weeks of undetected transmission delayed responses and hindered containment. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities have confirmed 381 Ebola cases and 62 deaths to date according to Africa CDC. The plan seeks to close gaps in detection, response, and community engagement to bring the outbreak under control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ熱を止めるための資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。コンゴ民主共和国での確認症例と死亡が記録されており、WHO事務局長による資金要請を伴う高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は記録上4番目の規模の流行と報告されており、検出されない感染伝播が検査対応と封じ込めを妨害。DRCで381症例、62死亡が確認されている。WHO事務局長による国際的な資金要請（5億1,800万ドル）を伴う高位レベルの対応となっており、フルリスク評価（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تطلق خطة بـ518 مليون دولار لمواجهة تفشي إيبولا ومنع انتقاله
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization launches a $518 million plan to tackle an Ebola outbreak and prevent its transmission.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) launched a joint continental preparedness and response plan for an Ebola outbreak. The plan has a $518 million budget intended to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and prevent transmission to neighboring countries. It represents a regional, multi-agency effort to bolster surveillance, rapid response, and cross-border coordination, drawing on resources and technical support from member states and partners. The objective is to curb spread beyond DRC borders and strengthen readiness to avert broader regional transmission. No case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）がエボラ出血熱の流行に対処し感染を防ぐために5億1800万ドルの計画を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また、WPRO基準では異常性、長期曝露、流行可能性、管理可能性の4基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つVHF（ウイルス性出血熱）であり、公式な国際対応計画が発表されている点で重要なシグナルである。記事では症例数が記載されていないが、WHOとアフリカCDCが5億ドル超の資金投入を発表している事実は深刻な公衆衛生脅威の存在を示唆している。隣接国への感染拡大防止が主要目標として明示されており、国際的拡大リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kinyitja a pénztárcáját a WHO, hogy megfékezzék a fenyegető járványt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO opens its wallet to curb the looming outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus unveiled a six-month, $518 million plan (June–November) to curb the looming Ebola outbreak, urging sustained political commitment, funding, and community trust. The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; Africa CDC reports 381 laboratory-confirmed cases and 62 deaths. There is currently no approved treatment protocol or licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya called this the most severe Bundibugyo outbreak to date. On May 15, Africa CDC announced the strain’s appearance as part of DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Donors have pledged about $315.8 million, short of the originally offered $498 million, with some commitments revised; it remains unclear how much of the six-month plan is funded. The initiative emphasizes rapid action, financing, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが迫る流行を食い止めるために財布を開く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。DRCにおけるBundibugyo ebolavirus（新系統）のアウトブレイク、62人の死亡、治療法・ワクチン未承認、国際的な資金動員が必要な深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおけるBundibugyo ebolavirus系統のアウトブレイク。WHOが6か月間で5.18億ドルの資金調達計画を発表し、国際的な関心が極めて高い。この系統は過去最大規模のBundibugyo流行とされており、治療法・ワクチン未承認という点で公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO investiert 518 Millionen Dollar in Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Invests $518 Million in the Fight Against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, the World Health Organization will invest $518 million over six months (June–November 2026) to fight Ebola, in coordination with the African Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to accelerate containment amid rapid spread and persistent gaps in control. The plan relies on lessons from past outbreaks and current health emergencies, and stresses political commitment, sustainable financing, and strong community engagement. In Uganda, three new Ebola infections were reported, bringing confirmed cases to 19; two deaths occurred, including a Congolese national, and four patients have recovered. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain drives the 17th outbreak there, with 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths to date; the outbreak was declared an international health emergency by the WHO. The report underscores the need for rapid, coordinated public health action across affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ対策に5億1800万ドルを投資
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な多地域拡大、高い死亡率、WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、大規模な資金投入から、フルRRAが必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、DRCは第17次エボラ流行の進行中で381確定例・62死亡、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言が発出。ウガンダにおいても3新規例・計19確定例・2死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo株によるDRC内での流行が記事の主要焦点であり、国際的な制御努力（WHO 5.18億ドル投資）は複数国にまたがるが、データベース対象国の実際の発生地は DRC である。

article.articleHeadline: Varhelyi, 'rischio basso di Ebola in Ue, ma massima vigilanza' - Altre news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varhelyi, "Low risk of Ebola in the EU, but maximum vigilance" - Other news
article.articleSummary: EU health authorities say the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa continues; according to the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC), the risk of sustained transmission in Europe remains very low. After an extraordinary videoconference of the 27 EU health ministers, EU Health Commissioner Olivér Varhelyi said the objective is to contain the epidemic at its source, support affected countries, keep EU vigilance high, and strengthen preparedness. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, exit controls, temperature screening, and hand hygiene measures are being implemented, with emphasis on full enforcement. The EU is mobilizing support and working closely with its member states and G7 partners to sustain responses. No details on case counts are provided in this report.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルヘイ氏、「EU内のエボラのリスクは低いが最大限の警戒が必要」
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）でのエボラ流行継続が確認され、IHR基準の異常性・国際的懸念が認められるが、詳細な症例数・重症度・感染拡大の具体的証拠が記事に記載されていない。EU内リスク評価は「非常に低い」と当局判定されており、情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカでのエボラ流行継続を報告し、EU当局による高いレベルの外交・保健対応（健康大臣会議、G7連携）が認められるが、具体的な症例数、感染者の重症度、ウガンダでの実際の感染確認の詳細が不明確。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ（対象国外）の記述は注視対象だが、サマリー主題はDRCの流行対応が中心と判断。

article.articleHeadline: África activa un plan de respuesta continental contra el ébola mientras aumentan los casos y los fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa activates a continent-wide response plan against Ebola as cases and deaths rise.
article.articleSummary: Continent-wide Ebola response activated as cases rise in Africa; 65 deaths and 397 confirmed infections. Most cases concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with transmission extending to Uganda. A six-month emergency plan aims to mobilize about $518.2 million (€450 million converted to USD) to strengthen preparedness, early detection, and outbreak response. Security challenges in northern DRC due to armed conflict and population displacement hinder surveillance and control efforts. The Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccine exists, is significantly impacting health workers, with at least seven healthcare worker deaths and 34 additional confirmed infections among medical staff or support personnel. The plan includes protecting vulnerable groups, improving cross-border coordination, and providing technical assistance to countries facing new outbreaks to accelerate case finding and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカがエボラに対する大陸規模の対応計画を発動、症例と死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症で、複数国での確認と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。WPRO基準も全て該当し、世界的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo variant（ワクチンなし）による医療従事者への高い影響、約518.2百万ドルの緊急対応資金動員、越境調整の必要性など、複数の懸念要因が確認されている。情報日時が2026年6月であることに注意（将来の想定シナリオの可能性あり）。

article.articleHeadline: بتوجيهات محمد بن راشد.. إمدادات طبية لدعم جهود مكافحة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Under the directives of Mohammed bin Rashid, medical supplies to support efforts to combat Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 20 metric tons of biomedical supplies from the World Health Organization stockpile were dispatched to support the Ebola outbreak response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, routed via Uganda. The airlift, departing from Dubai’s Al Maktoum International Airport (Dubai World Central), is expected to meet the needs of hundreds of patients for four weeks and support about 280 health facilities. The shipment includes multipurpose tents, decontamination materials, personal protective equipment, thermometers, and other essential medical supplies to reinforce frontline health workers in the affected areas. Dubai Humanity and partners, with backing from the Global Humanitarian Impact Fund of Dubai Humanity, the European Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations, and Dubai Royal Air Wing, emphasize sustained, coordinated humanitarian assistance amid disrupted supply chains. The World Health Organization’s East Mediterranean regional office highlighted the importance of rapid, cross-border action to detect and contain Ebola and protect health staff.

triage.headline_ja: ムハンマド・ビン・ラーシド指示下で、コンゴのエボラ対策を支援する医療物資を供給
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の東コンゴでの発生に対する国際的な医療支援の記事。IHR基準では「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPRO基準では「重症度（患者数が数百人規模）」「長期曝露（280の医療施設が対象）」「流行しやすさ」が該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い（複数国による国際支援体制）。
triage.notes: 記事は東コンゴで発生しているエボラ出血熱の アウトブレークに対する国際的な人道支援の事例を報じている。Dubaiはハブとして記載されているが、実際の患者発生地はDRCである。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: First Sudanese national isolated in Hyderabad tests negative for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Two Sudanese nationals under monitoring in Hyderabad, India, faced Ebola screening following fever. The first, isolated at Gandhi Hospital after presenting at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, tested negative for Ebola after CCMB analysis; authorities will inform the surveillance officer to decide discharge. A second Sudanese national in his 20s, admitted to Gandhi Hospital under quarantine for fever, remains under testing; samples have been sent to CCMB, with results pending. Ongoing surveillance remains in place per Government of India guidelines, including health screening of international travelers at RGIA. Symptomatic passengers are shifted to the hospital isolation ward for clinical evaluation and lab testing; asymptomatic individuals are advised home isolation with 21-day monitoring. Date: 5 June 2026. No confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in this article.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードで隔離されたスーダン国籍者の初例がエボラ検査で陰性
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例の検査が進行中であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の関心があるものの、現時点では確定症例なし。情報が限定的なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、スーダンはイベント発生地ではなく、患者の国籍のみの言及であり、実際のイベントはハイデラバード（インド）で発生している。検査結果が陰性と報告されているが、第2例の結果が保留中であるため、確認待ち。スーダンはGeoNames IDリストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola figures appear to offer hope as case numbers drop in DR Congo but it's not that simple
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak persists in eastern DR Congo, with the WHO urging tracing at least 90% of contacts to curb transmission. The outbreak is concentrated in three provinces, including South Kivu, in a rural, hard‑to‑reach area the size of the United Kingdom, amid armed group activity. There is no vaccine or proven treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, a rarer strain; research is ongoing. Community mistrust and traditional burial practices—washing and touching bodies and large funerals—hinder containment; a burial team was attacked in South Kivu this week, forcing responders to abandon a coffin. The WHO rates the risk as very high within DR Congo, high in the region, and low globally; this is the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak since discovery about 50 years ago. The virus is not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの数字は希望を示しているように見えるが、DRコンゴでの症例数は減少しているが、それは単純ではない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）の現在の流行がDRコンゴで続いており、IHR基準で重篤な公衆衛生への影響（Yes）、異常性（Yes）、地域的拡大リスク（Yes）の3つが該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strainはワクチンや治療法がなく、コミュニティの不信と伝統的埋葬習慣により封じ込めが困難。武装勢力による活動がある地域での発生。DRコンゴ内ではリスク「非常に高い」との評価。記事ではウガンダも地理的に記載されているが、サマリーではDRコンゴが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダでの確認された発生は述べられていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемия Эболы в Африке: количество инфицированных и погибших растет
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa: the number of infected and dead is rising
article.articleSummary: As of June 5, 2026, Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda total 397 confirmed infections and 63 deaths, with 381 cases in the DRC and 16 in Uganda, according to Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya at a Geneva press briefing. The outbreak is described as the fourth-most challenging in history. The report notes that the majority of cases are in the DRC, with Uganda contributing a smaller number. Earlier reports indicated a group of Chinese medical experts will depart from Beijing to the DRC to assist local authorities in combating the outbreak and supporting response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行：感染者数と死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認症例397件および63名の死亡者が報告されており、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク（中国からの医療支援派遣）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・管理可能性（国際支援要請）が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が主題であるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Chinaは医療専門家派遣元として記事に明示されており、イベント対応国として含める。Switzerlandはジュネーブでの記者会見場所であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Como a corrida ao ouro está a alimentar uma das maiores epidemias de Ébola da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How the gold rush is fueling one of the largest Ebola epidemics in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo variant, centered in Mongbwalu, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province. The outbreak likely began in February but was officially detected on May 15. Local authorities estimate over 80 deaths prior to recognition; current counts of suspected deaths approach ~300. The virus is spreading among informal gold miners in Mongbwalu's Kilo-Moto belt, where dense worker mobility and cross-border trade fuel transmission. There is no specific treatment for Bundibugyo; this variant is less characterized. Bat reservoirs near mining zones are suspected sources, though details remain uncertain. Laboratory capacity expansion is clarifying the outbreak, but public health challenges include distrust and continued mining activity, with miners earning incomes despite risk. Red Cross teams have followed strict funeral protocols for the deceased. The situation underscores how gold-driven migration can amplify Ebola epidemics.

triage.headline_ja: 金鉱採掘の急速な拡大がエボラウイルス病史上最大級の流行を助長している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo亜種の大規模流行（推定死亡約300人）、異常・予想外な発生、国境を越えた感染拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべても満たし、国際的な支援必要性が明らかである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo亜種は致命率が高く、不十分な実験室診断能力と公衆衛生インフラが対応を困難にしている。Ituri州Mongbwalu地域の非公式金鉱採掘労働者集団における密集した労働者移動と越境貿易が急速な伝播を推進。現地当局の信頼不足と採掘活動の継続が制御困難要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: خطة بقيمة 518 مليون دولار لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A $518 million plan to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization and Africa CDC launched a joint $518 million plan (June–November 2026) to tackle an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring countries. Led for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the outbreak has 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths in the DRC, across three provinces, with Ituri accounting for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. Cross-border transmission into Uganda includes 16 confirmed cases and 1 death. It was declared May 15 in north‑east DRC, with authorities saying Bundibugyo-ebola was circulating earlier. The plan emphasizes emergency coordination, surveillance, testing, infection prevention, outbreak control, clinical care, and community engagement. No vaccines or treatments are approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対策に5億1800万ドルの計画
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国及びウガンダでのエボラ（Bundibugyo）アウトブレイクは、複数の基準を満たす重大なシグナルである。IHR基準では4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全ての項目で該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国のアウトブレイクを主題としており、ウガンダへの越境感染は二次的な言及。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は治療法やワクチンが承認されていない極めて危険な病原体であり、381確認例・64死亡（致命率16.8%）、WHOとアフリカCDCの協調行動開始は国際的な懸念の高さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 阻斷伊波拉病毒擴散！世衛啟動168億元計畫馳援非洲 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stopping the spread of the Ebola virus! WHO launches a 16.8-billion-yuan plan to rush aid to Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO launches a six-month, $518 million plan to curb Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda. The initiative aims to accelerate outbreak control, border screening, and strengthen surveillance as the epidemic enters its fourth-largest scale. DRC reports 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths; Uganda has 19 confirmed cases. The outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine; health authorities warn this is the most severe Bundibugyo outbreak to date, with early detection gaps hampering response. Beyond medical measures, communities' distrust and security threats complicate efforts, with attacks on health workers and burial teams. The UN has donated armored vehicles to protect responders. Donors have pledged about $315 million; a funding gap remains to reach the plan's target.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの拡散を阻止！WHOが168億元の計画を立ち上げてアフリカへの援助を急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）の大規模流行で、死亡例多数、医療体制の脆弱性、セキュリティ脅威が存在。WHO主導の大規模支援計画が立ち上がっており、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Democratic Republic of Congo）とウガンダでのエボラ流行を記述しており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる（id 203312）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain は治療法・ワクチンが承認されておらず、過去最大規模の当該株流行と警告されている。DRCで381確定例・62死亡、ウガンダで19確定例。WHOによる6ヶ月間・5億1800万ドルの支援計画が発表されており、国際的関心が極めて高い。セキュリティ脅威（医療従事者・埋葬チームへの攻撃）も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Svetová zdravotnícka organizácia oznámila polročný plán na boj proti epidémii eboly
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization announced a six-month plan to fight the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: WHO unveiled a six-month plan costing $518 million to fight Ebola, aimed at helping the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda control the outbreak and to ready other countries for potential cases. After weeks of inattention by African authorities, measures include stronger border controls and enhanced surveillance. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged political commitment, sustained funding, and active community engagement. As of 2026-06-05, the DRC reports 381 cases and 62 deaths; Uganda records 19 cases and two confirmed deaths. The circulating Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine and no proven treatment. The plan seeks rapid containment and regional preparedness through cross-border coordination to curb transmission and bolster response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラ流行との闘いに向けた6ヶ月計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、IHR基準の4項目全てに該当。死亡例を伴う中等度〜重度の公衆衛生危機であり、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているのはDRC（381例、62死亡）とウガンダ（19例、2確認死亡）での発生であるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCはWPRO管轄外であるが、国際的な拡大リスクと地域的影響が高く、WHOの実施中計画と新型（Bundibugyo）バリアントの存在はシグナル価値が高い。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS y CDC África impulsan un plan valorado en 448 millones de euros para frenar el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC push ahead with a plan valued at €448 million to curb the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC are advancing a continental plan to curb the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, valued at $518 million (€448 million) for six months from June to November 2026. The outbreak affects the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The plan, framed as 'One plan, one budget, one team' with a 'One response' approach, targets emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, and continuity of essential health services. Although no vaccines or treatments are authorized specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola, authorities emphasize rapid detection, contact tracing, isolation, and clinical care alongside infection control and trusted community engagement. Ten priority countries are reinforced for preparedness; response activities for other emergencies (varicella, cholera, measles) will continue. Ultimately, workers, leadership, and trusted communities—not plans alone—will stop Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: WHO とアフリカCDCがエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制するため4億4800万ユーロ相当の計画を推進
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、およびWPRO基準で複数項目該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の報告された流行により、高いシグナル価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の流行がDRC と Uganda に影響していることが明記されている。しかし対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locations にはDRCのみを列挙。複数の疾患（コレラ、麻疹、水痘）が並列記載されているが、記事の主題はエボラ出血熱である。WHO とアフリカCDC による大規模な対応計画（5億1800万ドル規模）が策定されていることから、国際的な懸念と対応が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC unveil $518m Ebola plan as Uganda death toll rises
article.articleSummary: On 5 Jun 2026, WHO and Africa CDC unveiled a $518 million plan to combat Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, running June–November to bolster emergency coordination, surveillance, testing, infection prevention, clinical care and community engagement. The outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo strain, first declared in the DRC on 15 May, with at least 381 cases and 64 deaths reported in the DRC. Uganda reported three additional cases and one more death on 5 June, bringing its totals to 19 cases and 2 deaths. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated the objective is to stop the outbreak where it is, support current responders, and ensure neighboring countries remain ready to detect and act quickly. The current outbreak is larger than the two prior Bundibugyo outbreaks in 2007 and 2012.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカCDCが5億1800万ドルのエボラ対策計画を発表、ウガンダの死者数増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多地域での発生が報告され、IHR基準の4つすべてに該当する。DRC及びウガンダにおける確認症例（DRC 381症例・64死亡、ウガンダ19症例・2死亡）があり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ（WPRO対象国外）での死者増加を強調しているが、主要な発生地はDRCであり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダは対象国でないため除外。エボラは最高リスク病原体であり、IHR基準4/4該当、WPRO基準5/5該当で、明らかなシグナルピックアップケース。

article.articleHeadline: Superbactéria é encontrada em ostras no Brasil pela 1ª vez
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Superbug found in oysters in Brazil for the first time.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports the first detection in a food item of a World Health Organization (WHO) priority-critical bacterium: Citrobacter telavivensis, found in fresh oysters sold in São Paulo and Santa Catarina. The finding comes from the University of São Paulo (USP) and the São Paulo Institute of Fisheries in a study published in 2025, based on market-sampled analyses. Citrobacter telavivensis is linked to antibiotic resistance and is considered a major global threat by WHO; the study also identified resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae and Escherichia coli in some samples. All samples had passed routine sanitary inspections and control tests, yet carried resistant microbes, underscoring that antimicrobial resistance has reached the food-production chain. There are no reports of human outbreaks or cases tied to the foods analyzed, but researchers call for strengthened monitoring of production lines to reduce future risk. WHO notes AMR burden remains high, with about one in six infections already resistant to antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーバクテリア、ブラジルでカキから初めて発見
triage.triage_reason: WHO優先度最高度の耐性菌（Citrobacter telavivensis）が食品から初めて検出された異常・予想外の事象であり、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはWHO優先度最高度の耐性菌（Citrobacter telavivensis）がブラジルの食品（カキ）から初めて検出されたことを報告している。対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilのみ。現時点で人間の感染事例はないが、食料生産チェーン全体における抗菌薬耐性（AMR）の浸透を示す重要なシグナルである。WHO優先度最高度病原体の食品での初検出、国際的な公衆衛生脅威、規制制度の限界の露呈により、IHR基準4つ全てとWPRO基準5つ全てに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: പൾസ് പോളിയോ കേരളത്തിൽ ജൂൺ 28ന്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulse Polio in Kerala on June 28.
article.articleSummary: Pulse Polio immunization in Kerala is scheduled for June 28, 2026, announced by Health Minister K. Muraleedharan as part of India's effort to eradicate polio. About 1,980,224 children under five will receive oral polio drops. The program will deploy 22,288 vaccination booths and train 46,663 volunteers. Booths will be set up at health centers, primary health centers, urban health centers, Anganwadi centers, private hospitals, libraries, schools, and NGO buildings to maximize accessibility. In addition to regular booths, 539 transit booths, 283 mobile booths, and 9 festival/mela booths will operate. Transit booths will be stationed at railway stations, bus stands, and ferry jetties, while mobile booths will reach guest workers' residences, flood-affected areas, festival venues, and wedding mandaps. The drive emphasizes extensive coverage to ensure vaccination of all children under five.

triage.headline_ja: Pulse Polio in Kerala on June 28. (ケーララ州でのパルスポーリオ予防接種は6月28日)
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは定期的なポーリオ予防接種キャンペーン（Pulse Polio）の実施予定案内であり、新規感染症危機ではなく、通常の公衆衛生プログラムの運営情報である。異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、シグナルとしての評価基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: これはポーリオ根絶キャンペーンの定期的な実施予定の発表であり、感染症危機シグナルではなく、通常の予防接種プログラムの運営情報として取り扱うべき。フルRRAの必要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Teresina registra quase 200 casos de hanseníase e mantém alta endemicidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teresina records nearly 200 cases of Hansen's disease and maintains high endemicity.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Teresina, Brazil, remains a high-endemic area for Hansen's disease (leprosy), with 193 new cases diagnosed in 2025 (7.2 per 100,000). The Fundação Municipal de Saúde (FMS) is addressing stigma and promoting early detection through May–June educational activities across basic health units, schools, squares, and churches. From 8–12 June, multidisciplinary training for clinicians, therapists, and laboratory staff will enhance diagnosis, treatment, and disability prevention at the Fiocruz Auditorium and Centro Maria Imaculada. The Sasakawa Project, supported by the Nippon Foundation and the Ministry of Health, aims to humanize care and reduce social stigma. Treatment is free via SUS and uses a three-drug regimen (rifampicin, dapsone, clofazimine) called PQT-U, lasting six months for paucibacillary and twelve months for multibacillary disease, with care at UBS and specialized centers as needed.

triage.headline_ja: テレジナがハンセン病の約200症例を記録し、高い流行性を維持
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は既知の風土病であり、異常または予想外の増加ではない。公開記事は教育的イニシアティブと既存の流行対応を説明しており、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクはない。
triage.notes: ハンセン病はブラジルの既知の風土病である。記事は2025年の193症例（人口10万人あたり7.2例）という背景と、テレジナにおける継続的な流行対応計画を記載している。スクリーニング基準では長期曝露と流行しやすさが該当するが、これは既知の状況を反映した教育キャンペーンであり、シグナル検知の基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 34 er smittet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 34 are infected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues. 34 health workers infected; 7 deaths; 6 recovered. Uganda reports 3 new infections (total 19) and its second death, a DR Congo national. The outbreak has been declared active by AU/CDC; WHO reports rapid spread and aims to curb transmission with a six-month plan (June–November) costing $518 million (about DKK 3.3 billion). In Congo, 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths; over 1,000 suspected cases not yet confirmed. The Bundibugyo variant is circulating; no approved treatment or vaccine exists. The plan emphasizes political engagement, sustained funding, and community trust, and notes cross-border transmission risks as authorities respond from June onward.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 34人が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な多国家アウトブレイクであり、死亡例、国家間の越境感染、高い社会的関心が認められる。フルRRAに進むべき重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（対象国外）が含まれているが、記事サマリーでもウガンダでの感染確認が明記されている。ただしウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。エボラウイルス病の高い致死率、Bundibugyo variant の流通、承認治療法・ワクチンの不在、AU/CDCによる宣言、6ヶ月間の資金計画($518M)が必要とされている点から、国際支援の必要性は明白。越境感染リスクが明示されており、2026年6月時点で複数の死亡例と急速な感染拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Klíčové dny pro lékaře na Bulovce. Kvůli ebole je izolovaný v bioboxu, čas se mu krátí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Key days for doctors at Bulovka Hospital. Because of Ebola, he is isolated in a bio-box; time is running out.
article.articleSummary: A U.S. physician exposed to an Ebola patient in the Congo is isolated in a biobox at Prague's Bulovka Hospital as of 2026-06-05. He remains asymptomatic, with the incubation period lasting up to 21 days; his window would close next week. He is housed in a sealed, room-embedded biobox with its own air filtration; hospital staff enter in specialized suits. At admission two weeks ago, clinicians said no testing unless symptoms develop; if they do, samples would be sent to a Berlin laboratory capable of confirming Ebola. Ebola spreads via contact with an infected person or contaminated material and can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and bleeding. Some strains have vaccines or treatments, but the Congo and Uganda outbreak involves a variant with no vaccine or effective therapy. Confirmed cases are about 380 with over 60 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブロヴカ病院の医師にとって重要な日々。エボラのため、バイオボックスに隔離され、時間が迫っている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な患者移送・隔離事例であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。複数国（米国感染者、コンゴ発生地、チェコ隔離地）にまたがる事例で、公衆衛生上の重要度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ患者への曝露がコンゴで発生し、米国医師がチェコのプラハに隔離されている事例が述べられている。ただし対象国リストの限定により、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。ベルリン、プラハはいずれも対象国外（ドイツ、チェコ）のため除外。本事例はIHR基準4つすべてに該当する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: How disinformation worsens Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: DRC's north-eastern Ituri province around Mongbwalu experiences a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak; 397 confirmed cases and 63 deaths reported by Africa CDC; INRB confirmed; this is the 17th Ebola epidemic in DRC since 1976. No vaccine for the Bundibugyo variant currently circulating. By late May, an arson at an MSF tent led to staff withdrawal and 18 suspected cases under observation escaped. Disinformation patterns—coffin myths, claims aid workers spread the virus via vehicle antennas, and WhatsApp conspiracies about President Tshisekedi and virologist Muyembe—hamper containment. Funding reductions from US and European donors worsen risk communication gaps; authorities stress the need to involve community leaders and multilingual outreach. Mining-related rumors are cited as exacerbating distrust in the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：偽情報がエボラ流行を悪化させる方法
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。Bundibugyo型エボラの確認症例397件・死亡63件、国際的な関心と支援の必要性、偽情報による対応阻害が公衆衛生に深刻な影響を与えている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはワクチンがまだ利用不可。偽情報、MSF施設への放火による職員撤退、容疑者の逃亡、資金削減によるリスク・コミュニケーションの低下など、多面的な懸念がある。17番目のDRC内でのエボラ流行であり、社会的動員と多言語アウトリーチが重要と強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Waarom vallen mensen in Congo ebolaklinieken en begrafenisteams aan?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why are people attacking Ebola clinics and funeral teams in Congo?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo have sparked attacks on clinics and funeral teams, notably in Bunia, capital of Ituri, and in South Kivu. In Bunia, relatives at an Ebola funeral demanded to see the coffin and the Red Cross burial team was attacked; four volunteers were seriously injured. In South Kivu, a burial team had to abandon a coffin and the body was interred without safety measures. Across the region, at least 11 patients escaped from treatment centers. Distrust and rumors that Ebola does not exist, plus long-running conflict, drive hostility toward responders and fear around body handling. Authorities and aid groups stress community engagement, transparency, and local leadership to rebuild trust; examples include allowing limited family presence, improving water access, and radio outreach. WHO reports five recoveries (including four nurses).

triage.headline_ja: なぜコンゴの人々はエボラ診療所と埋葬チームを攻撃するのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の活動的な感染流行と、保健対応への信頼危機により患者逃亡・感染制御困難化のリスクが顕在化している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の東部DRC発生事例。記事サマリーはBunia（Ituri州）およびSouth Kivu州での患者逃亡、埋葬チーム・診療所への攻撃、信頼喪失を報告。これらは全て対象国DRC内での発生。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の全5項目に該当。公開情報源として高い信頼性。国際的な保健対応支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 本港新增一宗本地麻疹個案 19歲女學生確診 85名密切接觸者須接受醫學監察 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports one locally transmitted measles case; a 19-year-old female student has been diagnosed; 85 close contacts must undergo medical surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Hong Kong: The Centre for Health Protection reports one locally transmitted case, a 19-year-old female student living on Whampoa Street, Hung Hom. She was not born in Hong Kong and had childhood measles vaccination. Incubation period 8–22 May; infectious period 28 May–5 June. Symptoms began May 29; she sought care May 30 and tested positive for measles on June 1 at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, currently isolated and clinically stable. About 85 close contacts have been placed under medical surveillance as of 5 pm on 5 June; none have developed measles symptoms. This year HK has eight measles cases, four imported and four local; two local cases are epidemiologically linked to one imported case tied to an airport logistics worker cluster. In 2024–2025, HK reported 10 cases per year.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で麻疹の地域内感染例1件報告；19歳女性学生が確診；85名の濃厚接触者が医学監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の地域内感染事例が報告されているが、現在のところ単発の限定的な感染であり、国際的拡大の兆候は明確ではない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での麻疹事例であり、China（GeoNames ID 1814991）に含める。現在のところ限定的な感染クラスターで、85名の濃厚接触者が監視対象だが症状者なし。2026年時点でHKは8件の報告例（輸入4件、地域内4件）。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染が可能でワクチン接種率が重要となるため、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Steps Up Ebola Surveillance as NCDC Warns of Importation Risk
article.articleSummary: Nigeria intensifies Ebola surveillance as the WHO declares the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with rising infections in Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The NCDC reports no confirmed Nigerian cases but assesses importation risk as high due to international travel, population movement, and uncertainty about outbreak's scale. Delayed detection is a concern since Ebola symptoms resemble malaria and Lassa fever. High-risk states, border communities, transport hubs, and points of entry are prioritized for enhanced monitoring. Preparedness relies on laboratory systems, trained rapid response teams, emergency operations centres, and haemorrhagic fever structures. Emergency operations centre is on alert; epidemiologists and rapid response teams are on standby with strengthened coordination. Surveillance, readiness assessments, event-based monitoring, and infection prevention and control are reinforced; PPE, lab materials, and testing capacity remain active, including entry points. States are urged to integrate Ebola preparedness into emergency plans and identify isolation/treatment centres.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱対策を強化 NCDCが輸入リスク警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当し、WHOが国際的懸念事項として宣言。政府・国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事主題はナイジェリアでのエボラ対策強化だが、実際のアウトブレイクはDRCおよびウガンダで発生中。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国（ID: 203312）として含める。WHOが国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言済み。高い輸入リスク評価により、国際的な感染拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: From Dengue to Cholera: 10 diseases to watch out for this monsoon season; check full list
article.articleSummary: Ten diseases to watch during the monsoon: Dengue (viral) spreads via Aedes mosquitoes; malaria (Plasmodium) via Anopheles; leptospirosis (Leptospira) from water, mud, or soil contaminated with animal urine; typhoid fever (Salmonella Typhi) from contaminated food and water; cholera (Vibrio cholerae) from contaminated food and water; gastroenteritis (viral, bacterial, or parasitic) with diarrhea, vomiting, cramps; hepatitis A and E–related jaundice linked to contaminated food/water; conjunctivitis (pink eye) spreading in humid conditions; common respiratory infections (colds/flu) increasing with humidity and weather shifts; and fungal infections thriving in damp, rainy-season conditions. The monsoon’s humidity, waterlogging, and flooding drive these risks, underscoring the need for preventive measures in monsoon-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: デングからコレラまで：モンスーンシーズンに注意すべき10の疾患；完全リストを確認
triage.triage_reason: モンスーンシーズンに予想される季節性の複数疾患に関する啓発記事。複数のスクリーニング基準に該当するが、具体的な患者数、死亡例、または異常な発生状況の報告がなく情報が限定的。
triage.notes: この記事はインドのモンスーンシーズン時期に予想される7つの疾患（デング熱、マラリア、レプトスピラ症、腸チフス、コレラ、肝炎A/E、呼吸器感染症）に関する啓発・予防情報記事。具体的な発生状況の報告や患者数・死亡例が記載されていないため、現在のアウトブレイク警告ではなく季節性疾患の周知記事と判断。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、公衆衛生への関心があるため、今後の具体的な発生報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Congo, a radio station tries to stop health misinformation
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-type Ebola is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, concentrated in Ituri’s Bunia. By 2026-06-05, 397 laboratory-confirmed cases and at least 63 deaths have been reported, with outbreak recognition on May 15. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this Ebola type. The virus has expanded from three health zones to 24, amid ongoing conflict and displacement that fuel transmission and attacks on health facilities in Ituri and North Kivu’s Beni region. Misinformation and mistrust hinder response, with residents delaying care or rejecting protective measures. A local radio program at Radio Télévision Mont Bleu in Bunia, led by Vérité Johnson, broadcasts 45-minute daily updates to counter rumors and provide expert guidance. WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million Ebola response plan to stop transmission, support responders, and help neighboring countries detect and act quickly if cases appear.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大、ラジオ局が健康ミスインフォメーションに対抗しようとする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も全項目で該当。397確認症例・63死亡、24保健地域への拡大、国際支援計画（WHO・Africa CDC $518M）が実施中で、シグナルとして即座にフルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラの東部DRC（イトゥリ州ブニア中心）での拡大例。5月15日の発症確認から397確認症例、致命率約15.9%。3→24保健地域への急速拡大、紛争・変位・保健施設攻撃の複合的リスク因子。ワクチン・治療法なし。国際対応計画実施中で高い社会的・政治的関心が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: RD Kongo kritik pembatalan laga kontra Chile di Spanyol karena Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo criticizes the cancellation of the match against Chile in Spain due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo condemns Spain’s cancellation of a June 9 pre-World Cup 2026 friendly against Chile in La Linea de la Concepcion due to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The La Linea mayor, Juan Franco, signed a decree banning the match after health authorities advised against it to protect public health. The DR Congo squad trained in Belgium under strict health protocols; none of the 26 players are based in or have traveled directly from DR Congo to the training camp, though some staff and supporters may be from DR Congo. DR Congo Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya criticized the decision as discriminatory, noting the players have been in Belgium for about three weeks. The issue was raised in a WHO briefing; the article does not provide specific Ebola case counts.

triage.headline_ja: DR Kongo、エボラの理由によるスペインでのチリとの試合中止を批判
triage.triage_reason: エボラの実際の発生はDR Congoに限定されており、スペイン・チリでの発生は報告されていない。本件は国際スポーツイベント中止に関する政治的声明であり、感染症の深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す証拠（症例数、死亡、感染拡大）が記事に含まれていない。
triage.notes: スペイン・チリでのエボラ発生は報告されていない。本記事はDR Congoのエボラ流行に対する予防的なスポーツイベント中止判断と、それに対するDR Congo政府の抗議について述べている。感染症の流行状況、症例数、死亡数等の具体的なエビデンスが記事に記載されていないため、シグナルとして識別されない。対象国リスト外のスペイン・チリは検証対象外。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS lanza plan de US$518 millones para frenar brote de ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches US$518 million plan to curb Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, the WHO unveiled a six-month US$518 million plan to curb an Ebola outbreak in Africa, focusing on the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda while boosting preparedness in other countries via reinforced border controls. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists, has reached 381 confirmed cases and 62 deaths in the DRC, and 19 cases with 2 deaths in Uganda. Health authorities note rapid progression and past delays in detection, hindering response. Donors have pledged about US$315.8 million, below the initial US$498 million estimate due to corrections in figures. The plan emphasizes political commitment, sustained funding, and community engagement to stop transmission and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行を抑制するための5億1800万米ドルの計画を立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で381確認症例・62死亡（DRC）、19症例・2死亡（ウガンダ）、WHO主導の国際対応計画が発動されており、IHR基準4項目全て該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（1814991は対象国リストに含まれていない）が含まれるが、DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地で381症例・62死亡と報告されている。Bundibugyo株による治療法・ワクチンなし、急速な進行が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性は極めて高い。WHOによる5億1800万米ドルの対応計画が発動されており、国際的な関心と支援が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, Africa CDC launch $518m plan to tackle Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-05, WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint $518 million plan, running June–November 2026, to tackle an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighbouring countries. The outbreak was declared on 15 May in northeastern DRC, with the Bundibugyo strain circulating undetected prior to declaration. In the DRC, 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths have been reported across three northeastern provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of cases and 76% of deaths. In Uganda, 16 confirmed cases have been reported, including one death. The plan prioritizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community engagement. The programme is time-bound (June–November) and costs $518 million.
