The current situation in Congo and Uganda remains a focal point of concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴで抑制困難である理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。致死率90%の高リスク病原体による複数国での継続的な流行であり、国際的な懸念も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの拡大言及するが、サマリー主題はDRC発生のエボラ流行であり、DRCのみを対象国として確認。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。致死率90%の高リスク病原体による国際的な流行拡大はPICKUP判定の根拠。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e CDC África lançam plano de resposta ao surto de ebola na região
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC launch response plan to the Ebola outbreak in the region.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a continental response plan to the Ebola outbreak that began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with over 100 suspected cases and 48 deaths reported. The plan, running June–November 2026, aims to mobilize US$518 million to accelerate preparedness, detection and response across African countries and partners, complementing national plans in DRC and Uganda. It centers on emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, and safeguarding essential health services. With no vaccines or specific treatments for Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus, the strategy emphasizes health-system resilience and rapid response even amid acute health emergencies. Implementation has begun in affected and high-risk countries. The plan calls for stronger border screening and cross-border coordination, and continued mobilization to address mpox, cholera and measles alongside Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: WHO and Africa CDC launch response plan to the Ebola outbreak in the region.（WHOとアフリカCDCがエボラ出血熱の流行への対応計画を立ち上げ）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱を含む複合的な公衆衛生危機であり、複数国での流行と国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 複数の高リスク疾患（エボラ出血熱、mpox、コレラ、はしか）が同時進行。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダが言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみに限定。WHOとアフリカCDC主導の大規模な国際対応計画（518百万ドルの資金動員）が実施中であり、社会政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Un centre de quarantaine américain pour Ebola provoque la colère au Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American Ebola quarantine center sparks anger in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Ebola quarantine center for American citizens exposed to the virus, a 50-bed facility at Laikipia Air Base in Kenya, is near completion, triggering protests and controversy. Kenya has had no Ebola cases since the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak was declared in mid-May and shares no border with DRC. Residents fear virus importation and criticize foreign-resourced care; hundreds protested outside the base on Monday, and rights groups say two protesters were shot dead. A Kenyan court ordered last week the suspension of the project in the name of the common good, but locals report that construction continues. Health Minister Aden Duale says the center will not be stopped, and the Ebola outbreak does not require popular consultation; President William Ruto says Kenyans lack information to understand the project. US officials, including Marco Rubio, say the United States cannot and will not allow Ebola cases to enter the U.S., drawing neocolonial criticism.

triage.headline_ja: 米国のエボラ隔離センターがケニアで怒りを引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ症例の実際の発生や確認はケニアにはなく、米国の隔離施設建設に関する社会政治的議論が主題。DRCでのアウトブレイク存在は背景情報だが、当該記事はケニアでの症例報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ隔離施設建設に関する社会的反発であり、ケニアでのエボラ症例発生ではない。DRCでのアウトブレイク宣言は背景情報として言及されているのみ。ケニアでの実際の症例確認はないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。社会政治的関心は高いが、感染症イベント自体の国内発生がないため、トリアージはWATCHとする。

article.articleHeadline: Two Federal Employees Arrested for Allegedly Smuggling Deadly Virus Into the US * 100PercentFedUp.com * by Joshua C.
article.articleSummary: Two foreign nationals working for the NIH at Rocky Mountain Laboratories in Montana were charged with conspiring to smuggle the monkeypox (mpox) virus into the United States. On January 25, 2026, they reportedly arrived at Detroit Metropolitan Airport with a black plastic case containing 113 vials hidden inside foam coolers; testing showed at least 17 vials held deactivated mpox, while others contained chickenpox virus and human DNA. The defendants allegedly lied to Customs and Border Protection about the contents, and the materials were not authorized for import. Authorities say the incident is linked to an mpox outbreak in the Republic of Congo. NIH initiated security steps, including securing lab spaces, restricting access, and conducting an inventory audit. The FBI, CBP, and HHS Office of Inspector General are handling the investigation. Defendants are Vincent Munster (Dutch) and Claude Kwe (Cameroonian).

triage.headline_ja: 米国への致死的ウイルス密輸容疑でNIH職員2名が逮捕
triage.triage_reason: 天然痘類ウイルス（mpox、chickenpoxを含む）の不正な密輸事案であり、意図的な病原体の越境移送、米国でのバイオセキュリティ侵害の懸念、国際的な感染症危機管理上の重大な問題を構成する。IHR基準で『異常・予想外』『国際的拡大リスク』『感染症対応体制への脅威』が該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症の自然発生ではなく、意図的な病原体密輸という極めて異例のバイオセキュリティインシデントである。記事サマリーではコンゴでのmpox流行との関連が言及されているため、DRCを verified_locations に含める。米国の地域（Montana、Detroit、Michigan）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。117vialのうち脱活性化されたものを含む点、chickenpoxウイルスとの混在など、密輸物の性質の詳細が不明な部分が多く、追加情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Congo, a radio station tries to stop health misinformation
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, concentrated in Bunia, Ituri province. The outbreak was announced on May 15, with 397 confirmed cases and at least 63 deaths reported by the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention as of June 5, 2026. Skepticism, attacks on health workers, and misinformation have challenged the response to this rare Bundibugyo type Ebola. In Bunia, journalist Vérité Johnson, editorial secretary at Radio Télévision Mont Bleu, launched a program to combat rumors and raise awareness about the outbreak. The radio show is described as a vital tool to win over residents who have been unaware or skeptical about the facts of Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大する中、ラジオ局が保健情報の誤情報対策に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、予想外、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの確認症例397例、死亡63例の進行中のアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的フォーカスはDRC（Ituri州Bunia市）に限定。進行中のBundibugyo型エボラアウトブレイク、2026年6月5日時点で確認症例397例・死亡63例。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに含まれるIturi、Buniaはいずれもコンゴ領内であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana: Sudanese Traveller Tests Negative For Ebola; 2nd Suspected Case Under Observation
article.articleSummary: First suspected Ebola case in Telangana, a Sudanese traveler isolated at Gandhi Hospital, has tested negative. The National Institute of Virology (NIV), Pune, confirmed Ebola-negative, with samples (two blood, throat swab, urine) analyzed by CSIR-CCMB, Hyderabad under NIV guidance. Screening at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport continues; symptomatic arrivals go to isolation, while asymptomatic passengers enter 21-day home monitoring. The traveler reportedly visited Uganda weeks earlier before returning to Sudan and arriving in Hyderabad. A second suspected case, a KL University student in Vijayawada with travel history to Ebola high-risk countries, was admitted to Apollo Hospitals and later moved to Gandhi Hospital; results are awaited. Protocols—from airport screening to isolation—are in place, with separate routes/lifts and sanitation; health officials emphasize Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, not through the air, and urge public calm.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州：スーダン人旅行者のエボラ検査は陰性；2番目の疑い患者経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（国際的に高い警戒が必要な疾患）とニパウイルスの2件の報告があり、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限リスクが該当。検査陰性でも疑い患者が複数存在し、監視体制が敷かれている段階であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はテランガナ州とインドの都市（ハイデラバード、プネー、ビジャヤワダ）での発生を報告している。ウガンダとスーダンは発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリーでは旅行歴の参照のみであり、実際の発生地は印度のみ。エボラ検査は陰性だが、2番目の疑い患者が経過観察中で、国際的な旅行歴（ウガンダを経由）を伴うため、シグナル価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Carolina Dieckmann faz alerta após diagnóstico de infecção grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carolina Dieckmann issues warning after being diagnosed with a serious infection.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian actress Carolina Dieckmann was hospitalized for more than four days and diagnosed with pyelonephritis, a bacterial kidney infection. The condition began as an asymptomatic urinary infection that progressed to a fever of 39°C and severe lumbar pain during preparations for a work trip to a remote region. She initially suspected dengue or chikungunya but sought medical care rather than self-medicating. Hospital exams confirmed advanced but controlled pyelonephritis; doctors warned that delaying the correct antibiotic could allow the infection to progress to sepsis, a potentially fatal complication. Now discharged, Dieckmann is in recovery, noting ongoing inflammation but improving. She urged followers to seek medical evaluation for persistent symptoms, especially high fever, and to avoid ignoring urgent signs of illness.

triage.headline_ja: カロリーナ・ディエックマン、重篤な感染症診断後に警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医学的事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常な集団発症や流行を示す証拠がない。ChikungunyaおよびDengueへの言及は患者の鑑別診断候補に過ぎず、確認された集団事例ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は有名人（女優カロリーナ・ディエックマン）の個人的な腎盂腎炎の症例報告であり、感染症イベント検知の対象ではない。Chikungunya/Dengueはあくまで鑑別診断として言及されているに過ぎず、確認された患者数、地域的流行、公衆衛生への集団的影響を示す証拠がない。公開された健康メッセージとしての社会的関心は存在するが、シグナルとしての価値は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Minsal se despliega en Aeropuerto de Santiago y llama a que niños salgan del país con su vacuna contra el sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health deploys at Santiago Airport and calls on children to leave the country with their measles vaccine.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Chile’s Ministry of Health, at Santiago International Airport, urged travelers to verify that children have two measles vaccine doses before international trips, noting winter holidays and events like the FIFA World Cup increase travel. Measles is highly contagious, potentially spreading to 12–18 people from a single case. If children lack two doses, they should not travel and must be vaccinated at least 15 days before departure; infants 6–12 months traveling abroad should be vaccinated early and complete doses at 12 and 36 months upon return. Chile has had no autochthonous measles transmission for over 30 years, yet about 95,000 children up to six years may be under-protected. About 4 million passengers are expected through Santiago Airport in June–July, with 45% international. The Ministry also notes an Ebola outbreak in Africa (DRC, Uganda) with low risk to Chile, prompting epidemiologic surveillance, quarantine and testing of contacts. Vaccine information since 2021 is available at PortalPaciente.minsal.cl, and adults born 1971–1981 should consider a booster if traveling without proof of two doses.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がサンティアゴ空港に配置され、子どもたちに麻疹ワクチン接種を受けて国外に出ることを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: チリでの麻疹対策報道だが、実際の流行ではなく予防的措置についての情報。DRCおよびウガンダのエボラ発生は低リスクとして報告されており、記事の主題はチリの麻疹ワクチン接種推奨。対象国での実際の流行イベントとしての直接的な証拠に欠ける。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチリの麻疹ワクチン接種推奨キャンペーン。DRCおよびウガンダのエボラ発生は言及されているが、チリへのリスクは低いと記事自体が述べている。チリは対象国でなく、DRCとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれるが、実際の流行イベント（ケース報告など）の具体的な詳細は記事に示されていない。麻疹についてはチリは30年以上、在来性の伝播がない状態が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Wantrouwen bevolking bemoeilijkt bestrijding ebola-uitbraak: behandelcentra aangevallen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Population distrust hampers Ebola outbreak response: treatment centers attacked.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, remains uncontrolled with at least 378 confirmed cases and 62 deaths; the true toll is likely higher due to testing costs and limited access. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccine, and the virus has spread to neighboring Uganda with at least two deaths reported there. The WHO warns this could become Africa’s largest Ebola outbreak in 15 years. Response efforts are hampered by widespread distrust among local communities, with aid workers frequently attacked; treatment centers are targeted and funerals linked to deceased patients often trigger violence. Funeral practices are restricted to specialized teams to prevent transmission, though families may attend without viewing the body. Security forces typically accompany relief workers. Despite these challenges, the WHO reports five patients cured and discharged this week.

triage.headline_ja: 人口の不信感がエボラ感染症対策を阻害：治療センターが攻撃される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo variant）の国際的拡大（DRC→Uganda）、深刻な死亡・罹患数、治療困難な社会状況が IHR 基準 3 項目に該当し、また WPRO スクリーニング基準の複数項目を満たすため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC（Ituri 州）と Uganda での発生を報告しているが、対象国リストに Uganda が含まれていないため、DRC のみ verified_locations に列挙。Bundibugyo 型エボラはワクチン非存在、死亡率および国際拡大リスク、コミュニティ不信による対策困難など、複数の危機要因が重合している。WHO による「過去 15 年間でアフリカ最大級のアウトブレイク予測」は政治的・国際的関心を急速に高める要因となる。

article.articleHeadline: Marco Rubio's mixed signals on Kenya Ebola centre spark concern
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Ebola debate centers on Kenya's Laikipia quarantine facility as Rubio's policy stance shifts. He previously pledged no Ebola cases entering the US, but before the Senate he said Americans who test positive while in Kenya could be evacuated to Europe or the United States for treatment. Experts warn this risks exporting an infectious, asymptomatic patient during the contagious 8–14 day window within the 21-day incubation. Prof. Shem Otoi Sam argues the approach ignores epidemiology: an individual can be highly infectious before symptoms. WHO guidelines offer two options: treat in-country with strict isolation, or evacuate only after negative tests or with extraordinary biosafety. The controversy runs as Ebola outbreaks widen in the DRC (344 cases, 60 deaths across 24 health zones in 3 provinces) and Uganda (15 cases, 1 death). Kenya is Tier II high-risk; the facility’s protective value remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: マルコ・ルビオのケニア・エボラセンターに関する矛盾した姿勢が懸念を招く
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は IHR 基準の複数項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、DRC と Uganda での実際の流行が進行中。患者の国際的移送に関する政策論争により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主にケニアの検疫施設とルビオ長官の政策議論を扱っているが、エボラウイルス感染症の実際の流行は DRC（344 例、60 死亡）と Uganda（15 例、1 死亡）で確認されている。ケニアは Tier II 高リスク地域として位置付けられているが、現時点では確認された症例の報告はない。サマリーに基づき、実際の発生地域は DRC と Uganda のみを verified_locations に含める。米国は政策論争の舞台だが感染症の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Ebola Cases Rise to 19: Latest Updates
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-05, Uganda reports 19 Ebola cases since the outbreak began May 15. Three new cases are contacts of previously confirmed patients under institutional quarantine. Of the 19, 14 are imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and five are Ugandan nationals; the index case was a Congolese national seeking treatment in Uganda. One new death involving a Congolese national brings the total deaths to 2. Thirteen patients are receiving treatment, four have recovered and been discharged. The DRC has 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths; six patients have been discharged in the DRC. WHO notes progress, with recoveries in Uganda and an online Africa regional briefing on the update.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ症例が19件に増加：最新情報
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、死亡例を伴う複数国での発生、国際的な拡大リスク、および高い社会・政治的関心を示している。IHR基準3つおよびWPRO基準4つに該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのエボラ症例増加を報告していますが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外しました。DRCは対象国（ID:203312）に含まれており、DRCでの363確認症例と62死亡が報告されています。これはDRC発生のアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダは流出地域です。DRCのみを記載しています。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma tres nuevos casos de ébola y eleva a 19 los contagios en el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases and raises the total number of infections in the country to 19.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms three new Ebola cases, bringing its total to 19 infections, with two deaths reported in Uganda and a Congolese national's death in the outbreak. The three new cases were contacts in institutional quarantine. Thirteen patients are hospitalized and four have been discharged. Uganda closed its border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 27 amid the cross-border outbreak that began in eastern DRC’s Ituri province and was declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Across the outbreak there are 400 confirmed cases (381 in the DRC, 19 in Uganda) and about a 16% case-fatality rate, with over 5,000 people under surveillance. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, lacking approved vaccines or treatments, has a fatality rate of 30–50%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhaging.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ出血熱患者3人を確認、国内感染者数は19人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、DRCウガンダを含む複数国への国際的な拡大が既に確認されている。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。発生源および主要なシグナル地はDRC（Ituri州）。ウガンダへの拡大確認だが、DRCのみを記載。PHEIC宣言済みで、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は30-50%の致死率を有する。5,000人以上が監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Questions For...CNN's Clarissa Ward Reporting from the Epicenter of the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: From Bunia in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, the latest Ebola outbreak has produced 363 confirmed cases and 62 deaths, according to the CDC. CNN's Clarissa Ward reports from the red zone at Bunia General Hospital, where suspected patients are isolated; health workers are scrambling to contain the virus amid grief and fear. The outbreak is believed to have originated in Mongbwalu, a remote gold-mining town in eastern Congo. Local funerary customs, involving touching and washing the body, complicate containment, per authorities. Radio campaigns urging social distancing, handwashing, and avoiding contact with dead animals are crucial given low literacy and limited TV access. Journalists face harsh access barriers, requiring ministry approvals and multisession accreditation before entering Ituri. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak endured by the DRC, illustrating ongoing poverty, disease, and human resilience.

triage.headline_ja: CNN記者クラリッサ・ワードがエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの震源地から報告：5つの質問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高致死率の危険病原体であり、363確定例と62死亡者が報告されており、DRCでの発生は国際的懸念事項。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHOの懸念すべき公衆衛生上の問題。DRCではこれが17番目のアウトブレイクであり、地元の埋葬慣行がウイルス伝播を複雑化させている。国際的な関心が高く、ジャーナリストアクセスも規制されている点から社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: خطة بقيمة 518 مليون دولار لمكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A $518 million plan to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization and Africa CDC launched a joint $518 million plan to curb an Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and spilling into Uganda. The program runs June–November 2026. The outbreak was declared May 15 in northern DRC, with the Bundibugyo strain believed to have circulated earlier. As of June 5, 2026, 381 Ebola virus disease cases have been confirmed in the DRC, including 64 deaths. Ituri province is the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths across three affected provinces. Across the border in northeastern Uganda, 16 confirmed cases and one death have been reported. The plan emphasizes enhanced surveillance, case management, vaccination, and cross-border coordination to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス対策に5億1800万ドルの計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ発生は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、予想外の地域での出現、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクを提示している。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州を中心に381確認症例（64死亡）、ウガンダへの越境感染16例（1死亡）が記録されている。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、WHO及びアフリカCDCによる6ヶ月間の統合対応計画が発動されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: India Delivers Fresh Medical Aid to Boost Uganda's Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: Uganda receives a second tranche of medical aid from India to bolster Ebola response, with delivery to Uganda and Africa CDC. The aid aims to strengthen emergency response capacity, disease surveillance, and preparedness for potential new cases. Officials say the support will help monitor, detect, and respond to Ebola infections and enhance regional disease-control initiatives in East Africa and the Great Lakes region. Uganda reports that recent infections have been linked primarily to imported and cross-border transmission rather than widespread community spread; surveillance teams, contact tracing, and rapid response remain active. The effort accompanies ongoing collaboration with Africa CDC to establish a regional pandemic preparedness and response centre in Uganda. The international aid underscores regional cooperation, border screening, laboratory capacity, and information-sharing to prevent outbreaks. Citizens urged to follow guidance and report symptoms promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：インドがウガンダのエボラ対応を強化するための医療支援を提供
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラ発生は確認されているが、記事は主に国際支援・協力体制の確立に焦点を当てており、新規感染例の詳細情報が不足している。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに複数国が列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はウガンダでのエボラ対応であり、実際の流行地はウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）。インドは医療支援の提供国として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。オーストラリア、モザンビークはサマリーに記載なく除外。継続的な流行状況の監視が必要だが、現時点では報告された感染例の詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: São Luís entra em alerta para SRAG com aumento de casos de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Luís goes on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) with an increase in COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: São Luís, Maranhão, Brazil faces rising COVID-19–related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin, while much of the country reports declines in SRAG hospitalizations linked to coronavirus. São Luís is among 15 Brazilian capitals with SRAG activity at alert, high risk; the city is categorized as high risk due to the surge in COVID-19 infections. Fiocruz projects about a 95% probability that the long-term growth will persist, keeping the capital in an attention state for severe respiratory cases in the coming months. The bulletin also notes increased Respiratory Syncytial Virus (VSR) hospitalizations in the Northeast, including Maranhão, a concern for young children. Vaccination against COVID-19 and influenza remains the main preventive measure; officials urge protection for elderly, children, and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: サンルイスがCOVID-19症例増加に伴うSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）警報態勢に入る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンルイスにおけるCOVID-19関連のSRAG症例増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）で複数該当する。しかし具体的な死亡数や入院数などの詳細情報が不足しており、国全体では他地域でSRAG減少傾向が報告されているため、現段階ではWATCHとして継続監視を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で、ブラジルのマラニャン州サンルイス市におけるCOVID-19関連SRAG症例増加を報告。Fiocruzの公式情報源に基づいている。ただし具体的な死亡数や感染者数の詳細データが記事サマリーには含まれていない。RSVの増加も報告されているが、主要なシグナルはCOVID-19関連SRAGの地域的増加。IHR基準2つ以上該当でPICKUP相当だが、全国的には減少傾向、地域限定的な懸念であることを考慮しWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC et en Ouganda : la Guinée rassure, aucun cas enregistré sur le territoire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC and Uganda: Guinea reassures, no cases recorded within its territory.
article.articleSummary: No suspected or confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded in Guinea as of June 5, 2026, despite Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The World Health Organization declared an International Public Health Emergency on May 17, 2026. Guinea’s Ministry of Health reassures the population and has strengthened prevention, surveillance, and preparedness under coordination by the National Agency for Health Security (ANSS). Measures include expanded epidemiological surveillance nationwide, enhanced sanitary checks at airports, ports, and borders, rapid diagnostics in national laboratories, and reactivated epidemic-response coordination mechanisms. Ebola spreads by direct contact with blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects, not by air, water, or food. Symptoms include sudden fever, fatigue, headaches, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat, and in severe cases unexplained bleeding. Individuals with symptoms, especially after recent travel to DRC or Uganda, should call 115 or seek care immediately.

triage.headline_ja: RDCおよびウガンダでのエボラ：ギニアは安心を表明、領土内での症例は記録されていない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多国での活動的な流行（DRC・ウガンダ）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC及びウガンダでのエボラ流行を報じており、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ギニアはWHO PHEIC宣言後の地域的対応を示す文脈だが、記事サマリーでは「ギニア内での症例なし」との確認が主要内容。DRCでの活動的な流行と複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e CDC África lançam plano de resposta ao surto de ebola na região
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC launch a response plan to the Ebola outbreak in the region.
article.articleSummary: June 5, 2026 — The World Health Organization (WHO) and Africa CDC launched a regional Ebola response plan running June–November 2026, aiming to raise $518 million to support African countries and partners in accelerating preparedness, detection, and response to the outbreak. The plan complements national plans announced by the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, seeking to unify and strengthen the region's response on emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, and essential health services. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized that containment relies on country‑led partnership and coordinated action, noting that political commitment, sustained funding, and community trust and participation are critical; without community involvement, contact tracing falters, safe care is delayed, and transmission continues.

triage.headline_ja: WHO及びアフリカCDCがエボラ出血熱の地域流行対応計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度を持ち、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性、深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確。WHOと各国が協調的対応計画を発表する段階であり、トリアージスクリーニング対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されているが、GeoNames IDで対象国に含まれるのはDRC (203312) のみ。ウガンダ (226074) は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラ出血熱は極めて高いリスク病原体であり、複数国での流行の可能性、WHO・CDC・各国政府による協調対応計画の発表により、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'Afrique mobilise 518 millions de dollars pour stopper l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Africa mobilizes $518 million to halt the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus drives Africa-wide mobilization of $518 million over six months (June–November 2026) to bolster detection, prevention, and response, announced by Africa CDC and the World Health Organization. The response centers in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri province as the epicenter, and complements national plans in DRC and Uganda. The plan uses a 'One Response' approach to coordinate governments, international partners, and communities, aiming to strengthen emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory capacity, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and logistics, with a strong emphasis on community engagement to improve contact tracing and access to safe care. No vaccine or treatment is currently approved for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus. Ten priority countries will receive enhanced preparedness, alongside reinforced cross-border cooperation and health-system strengthening to sustain broader health programs including mpox, cholera, and measles.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アフリカが流行を阻止するため5億1,800万ドルを動員
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ（Bundibugyo virus）による大規模流行で、DRC・ウガンダで確認され、国際的な資金動員と対応体制整備が進行中。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、治療法・ワクチン未承認の状況から、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ州が震源地として明記されている。ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）も発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーでは「DRCの国家計画とウガンダの計画を補完」と記述されており、ウガンダでの実際の発生確認は明示的でない。ただしDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo エボラウイルスによる流行で、現在承認されたワクチンまたは治療法がない状況は深刻。6ヶ月間（6月～11月2026年）の対応計画、10カ国への優先的な備備強化が予定されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS lanza plan de más de 500 millones de dólares para frenar brote de ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO launches a plan worth more than $500 million to curb an Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint plan worth $518 million to curb an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa, spanning June–November 2026. The outbreak was declared May 15 in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain suspected to have circulated for some time. The latest figures show 381 confirmed cases in the DRC with 64 deaths; across the border in Uganda there are 16 confirmed cases and one death. The outbreak has hit three provinces, with the epicenter in Ituri, where about 90% of confirmed cases and 76% of deaths occur. The plan emphasizes emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, and community mobilization, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The current outbreak is larger than the two previous Bundibugyo outbreaks registered in 2007 and 2012.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカのエボラ出血熱の流行を食い止めるため5億ドル以上の計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間拡大と重大な公衆衛生的影響を示す。WHO/Africa CDC共同対応計画の発表により高い国際的関心がある。
triage.notes: Ituri州が震源地で確認症例の90%、死亡の76%を占める。ウガンダでも確認されているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は過去の2007年、2012年の流行より大規模。WHO/Africa CDC共同で518百万ドルの対応計画を発表しており国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: تمويل جديد لمكافحة فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New funding to combat the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: US Department of State announced an additional $38 million to fight Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, bringing total direct U.S. funding for the effort to over $200 million. In the same update, the DRC reports 452 confirmed Ebola cases, with 71 new infections confirmed in the past 24 hours, and 82 deaths among the confirmed cases. The outbreak remains active in the country, with authorities continuing surveillance, contact tracing, and response measures supported by international partners. The announcement underscores ongoing international support to curb transmission and prevent further cases as of June 5, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス対策のための新たな資金援助 - コンゴ民主共和国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク（452確定例、82死亡）は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示し、国際的支援（米国38百万ドル追加援助）を必要とする継続的脅威である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが United States を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではDRCでの実際のアウトブレイク（452確定例、82死亡）が主題であり、米国は資金援助国としての言及のみ。よって verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。対象国リストに DRC (203312) は含まれていないが、エボラはWHO上の特に重要な公衆衛生脅威であり、IHR基準で4項目該当のため PICKUP 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola mobiliza OMS e CDC África em plano de resposta continental contra surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola mobilizes WHO and CDC Africa in a continental plan to combat the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers a continental response by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC. On June 5, 2026, authorities announced a joint plan running June–November 2026 to raise about $518 million to bolster preparedness, early detection, and rapid response across African countries and partners. More than 100 suspected Ebola cases and 48 confirmed deaths have been reported in the region, linked to the Bundibugyo variant, for which there are no vaccines or specific treatments. The plan complements national strategies in the DRC and Uganda and seeks to unify public health operations continent-wide, including emergency coordination, epidemiological surveillance, advanced laboratory testing and rapid diagnostics, infection prevention and control, clinical care, logistics, community engagement, and research. Leadership emphasizes country-led action; cross-border screening and solidarity are stressed. The agenda also maintains attention on mpox, cholera, and measles.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがWHOとアフリカCDCを動員し、大陸全体の感染拡大に対する対応計画を策定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、複数国への越境感染と大陸規模の感染症対応体制構築が明示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。複数感染症（エボラ、mpox、コレラ、麻疹）の同時監視体制が構築されている点も注目。2026年6月-11月の大陸規模対応計画であり、WHOおよびアフリカCDCの指導下での緊急対応体制。

article.articleHeadline: Amerikanen openen quarantainecentrum voor ebola in Kenia ondanks kritiek en protest
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Americans open Ebola quarantine center in Kenya despite criticism and protests.
article.articleSummary: June 5, 2026: The United States advances a quarantine center in Kenya for Americans exposed to Ebola, opening a 50-bed field hospital at Laikipia Air Force Base near Nanyuki; materials and experts arrived June 3. Kenyan protests and a High Court ruling blocked the plan, but the government proceeds. Ebola is described as highly contagious and deadly; Kenya has reported no cases. US physicians have urged Congress to address clinical, ethical, operational, and legal questions, noting prior outbreaks where exposed Americans were treated in US centers and transmission was contained. Travel measures: Canada, Jordan, Bahrain, and the Bahamas ban entry for visitors to affected areas; Canada requires a three-week quarantine for returnees. India, Mexico, and Thailand screen on arrival. Uganda suspends flights to/from DRC; DRC reports 381 confirmed Ebola cases, Uganda 16, with at least 65 deaths; many suspected deaths untested.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、批判と抗議にもかかわらずケニアでエボラ隔離センターを開設
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の高い致死性と感染力、DRCおよびウガンダでの既知の流行、複数国での渡航制限措置、ケニアでの施設開設を通じた予防的対応が国際的関心を集めている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの隔離施設開設を主題とするが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、サマリーで実際の流行は DRC（381確定症例）とウガンダ（16症例、少なくとも65死亡）で確認されており、インド・タイは到着時スクリーニングを実施している。複数国での渡航制限、公開討論、そして予防的医療インフラ整備が進行中であるため、強いシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Da floresta ao smartphone: a conexão entre Ebola e mineração
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From the forest to the smartphone: the connection between Ebola and mining.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda are linked to deforestation and artisanal mining. The latest outbreak began in May 2026 in the DRC, with 363 confirmed cases and spillover into Uganda. Ebola circulates mainly among bats, but forest fragmentation brings bats closer to communities, increasing transmission. In Gabon, about 20% of people in forested areas show immunological protection against Ebolavirus. A 2025 analysis suggests Central African deforestation could raise Ebola and malaria incidence by up to 40%; past outbreaks followed forest loss, including the 2014 Guinea event, with the current episode preceded by Congo Basin degradation. In the DRC, artisanal mining for minerals such as gold, tantalite, tin, tungsten—and the broader 3TG suite used in smartphones—drives deforestation and livelihoods for about 2 million people, including >380,000 in the east, often with weak health infrastructure. Mongbwalu, a growing mining town, is the outbreak’s initial focus.

triage.headline_ja: 森からスマートフォンへ：エボラウイルスと鉱業のつながり
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCとウガンダでのエボラ活動的流行（363確定例）、複数国への波及、鉱業活動による継続的曝露リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）への波及が記述されているが、verified_locationsには対象国のDRCのみを含める。ガボン、ギニアも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。鉱業関連の環境破壊と脆弱な保健基盤が長期的リスク要因として特定されている。2026年5月発症の活動的アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Response Update: June 5, 2026
article.articleSummary: Nearly $38 million in additional Department of State Ebola funding is announced, bringing total direct DoS Ebola response funding to over $200 million, in support of a broader $1.8 billion UN OCHA package that also includes $350 million for Ebola response and humanitarian aid in the DRC, South Sudan, and Uganda. The US remains the largest financial contributor. To protect Americans, U.S. embassies provide updated travel and health information; a voluntary process guides U.S. citizens exposed to Ebola or seeking departure from the DRC, South Sudan, or Uganda, with health, travel, and screening measures in effect. STEP enrollment encouraged. Regional response focuses on contact tracing, border screening, clinic-based response, and community education. Direct U.S.-funded partner activities include commodity procurement, border screening, risk communications, diagnostic supplies, detection and treatment, and food assistance for suspected/confirmed cases and health workers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応アップデート：2026年6月5日
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、複数国での国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが存在する。IHR基準3項目以上該当、かつ米国を含む国際的な関心と支援活動が存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRC、南スーダン、ウガンダでのエボラ対応について述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。米国は資金援助国として言及されているが、発生国ではないため除外。エボラは極めて致死率の高い感染症であり、国境スクリーニング、接触者追跡、渡航情報の発出など、複数の対応が実施されていることから、国際的な懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Minsal hace llamado para que niños que viajen al extranjero estén vacunados contra el sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health urges that children traveling abroad be vaccinated against measles.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 June 2026, Chile highlights measles vaccination for travelers after outbreaks in neighboring countries—Mexico, Canada, the United States and Peru—with imported cases. Parents of traveling children should ensure two measles doses before departure, with vaccines administered at 12 and 36 months, and vaccinate at least 15 days before travel. About 95,000 children under six may lack full protection. Verify vaccination records at portalpaciente.minsal.cl (Clave Única) under 'Tus Hijos'; infants 6–12 months traveling abroad should be vaccinated early and complete 12- and 36-month doses upon return. Those under 18 should have two doses; adults born 1971–1981 should consider a booster if traveling. Santiago Airport projects ~4 million passengers in June–July, with 45% outbound. Separately, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompts a low but real risk, with Chilean epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省は海外旅行する子どもが麻しんワクチン接種を受けるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 麻しんとエボラの複数疾患が言及されているが、チリの記事は主に麻しんの予防的呼びかけであり、確定患者情報が不明。DRCのエボラアウトブレイク言及は二次的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot発生地域にはペルー・メキシコ・米国・カナダ・ウガンダが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。チリは対象国でないため除外。サマリーではDRCとウガンダのエボラアウトブレイクが言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。麻しん情報は隣国での流行警告としての言及で、チリ国内の確定患者数は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS et le CDC Afrique lancent un plan d'urgence de 518 millions de dollars
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO and Africa CDC launch a $518 million emergency plan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda, declared May 15 in northeastern DRC. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. According to WHO, 381 confirmed cases and 64 deaths in DRC; Uganda reports 16 cases and 1 death. To counter it, WHO and Africa CDC launched a $518 million emergency plan for six months through November 2026 to boost surveillance, labs, infection prevention, patient care, community engagement, and cross-border readiness. Funding pledges total about $315.8 million, with over 200 tons shipped. Challenges include insecurity, community resistance, and attacks on response teams, with the virus circulating weeks before detection. The aim is to stop transmission where it is and curb regional spread. Transmission is by direct contact with infected fluids. The Bundibugyo outbreak has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOとアフリカCDCが5億1,800万ドルの緊急計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数国での確認症例と死亡、国際的支援動員がある。
triage.notes: UgandaはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは症例が少数（16例、1死）で、主要な感染地はDRCのIturi州である。対象国リストにUgandaは含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外。Bundibugyo株は致命的で、ワクチンや承認治療法がなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: 28k active TB patients under treatment in T'gana
article.articleSummary: Telangana faces ongoing tuberculosis control, with nearly 28,000 patients under treatment in the state and 7,663 new cases identified during a recent 100-day intensive screening campaign. The efforts, part of the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, screened more than 387,000 vulnerable individuals and performed 168,000 chest X-rays to flag potential TB. Newly diagnosed patients were linked to treatment, underscoring active case finding as central to reducing transmission. Challenges persist in tribal and remote areas where patients may discontinue therapy, avoid diagnostics, or suffer nutritional deficiencies. The state has built substantial infrastructure to support early diagnosis and treatment, including 171 TB units, 435 detection centres, 191 rapid molecular testing facilities, and 52 portable handheld X-ray devices. Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla reviewed progress at Lok Bhavan, aiming for a TB-free Telangana, with district-level reviews planned to address local barriers.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州で2万8千人の結核患者が治療中
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、インドでの症例報告は常態的です。記事は公衆衛生対策の進捗報告であり、異常な発生、国際的な拡大リスク、または国際支援の必要性を示す証拠がありません。
triage.notes: 結核はインドの風土病であり、テランガナ州での継続的な症例確認と治療努力は予想された活動です。28,000人の患者数は州内での一般的な疾病負荷を反映しており、異常な発生パターンではありません。記事は積極的な症例発見キャンペーンと治療インフラの整備に関する州政府の取り組みを報告しており、対応が機能していることを示唆しています。

article.articleHeadline: East Africa: EAC States Harmonise Ebola Border Screening As DR Congo Outbreak Raises Regional Alarm
article.articleSummary: East African Community (EAC) member states agreed to harmonise Ebola surveillance and border screening at airports, ports and land crossings to curb cross-border transmission amid the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak. As of 1 June 2026, DRC reported 121 confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease cases and 1,077 suspected, with 17 confirmed deaths and 246 suspected deaths; Uganda reported 11 confirmed cases and 1 death. Uganda identified 642 contacts, with 638 under active follow-up. Ministers directed harmonised traveller health declarations, standardised screening procedures, and exit screening at points of entry, plus intensified risk communication, community engagement and sanitation interventions. Ten EAC mobile laboratories have been deployed across Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan and the DRC. An EAC Regional Technical Taskforce on Ebola Response and other high-consequence diseases will monitor outbreaks; each partner state must nominate two health experts and one EAC affairs official. Resource mobilisation and container-lab deployment will be accelerated, with regional vaccine, therapeutics and diagnostic approvals pursued via a framework with the African Medicines Agency and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ: EAC諸国、DRC アウトブレイクが地域的警報を引き起こす中、エボラ国境スクリーニングを調和
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（DRCからウガンダへの越境確認例あり）、複数国への影響、IHR基準3つ以上該当、および地域的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの確認例が述べられている。Bluedot APIが他の東アフリカ諸国（Sudan、Mozambique、Rwanda、Tanzania、Kenya、Burundi、Uganda）を発生地域として列挙しているが、サマリー上でこれらの国での実際の患者確認例は明記されていない（ウガンダは「11確認例、1死亡」と明記）。verified_locationsには、確認された実際の発生地（DRC）のみを含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれておらず、記事の地理的中心がDRCのアウトブレイクであることを考慮。国際的拡大の懸念は高く、地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念は甚大である。

article.articleHeadline: OMS e CDC África lançam plano de resposta ao surto de ebola na região
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO and Africa CDC launch a response plan for the Ebola outbreak in the region.
article.articleSummary: On 5 June 2026, WHO and Africa CDC unveiled a continental plan to respond to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has reported over 100 suspected cases and 48 deaths. The plan runs June–November 2026 and seeks to raise $518 million to bolster preparedness, detection, and response across Africa, complementing national plans from DRC and Uganda. It aims to unify emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, and health services support; with emphasis on protecting vulnerable populations and cross-border collaboration. Since no vaccines or specific treatments exist for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, measures focus on health system resilience and rapid response. Implementation has begun in affected and high-risk countries; member states are urged to enhance border screening, entry-point health measures, and transboundary coordination, while continuing to address mpox, cholera, and measles.

triage.headline_ja: WHO およびアフリカCDC、アフリカ地域のエボラ出血熱の流行に対応するための計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱による100件以上の疑い例と48人の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの国境越え拡大の可能性）、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。WHO/Africa CDCによる国際的な対応計画立案も確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属Bundibugyo種）の流行であり、ワクチンや特異的治療法がない。ウガンダは記事内で言及されているが、国別の症例報告はDRCに限定されている。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに登録。mpox、cholera、measlesも同時に提及されているが、主要なシグナルはEbolaの流行。6月～11月の6ヶ月間の対応計画が立案されており、5億1800万米ドルの資金調達が計画されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS destina US$ 518 mi para combater surto de ebola na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO allocates US$ 518 million to combat an Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint plan to contain an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and Uganda, with a US$518 million budget for June–November 2026. The strategy covers emergency coordination, surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement, research, logistics, health worker protection, and maintenance of essential health services, plus cross-border collaboration and preparedness in other at-risk African countries. There are no vaccines or licensed treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola; response relies on early detection, contact tracing, patient isolation, and preventive care. The outbreak began in Ituri in eastern DRC and has spread to North and South Kivu, with confirmed cases in Uganda. As of 2 June 2026, DRC counted 363 cases and 62 deaths; Uganda had 16 cases and 1 death as of 4 June.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカのエボラ出血熱との闘いに518百万米ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の多国間アウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明白。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの確認事例も述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州が主要な発生地域。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはワクチンおよび承認済み治療法が存在しないため、管理可能性が低い。WHO・Africa CDCの大型投資計画（$518M）は国際的な関心の高さを示唆。
